    if h : i + 1 ≤ n + 1 then
      (e i (by omega)).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ D.d i ∘ₗ (e (i + 1) h).toLinearMap
    else if h' : i = n + 1 then
      h' ▸ ((e (n + 1) le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ g ∘ₗ f.toLinearMap)
    else 0
  have hd' : ∀ i (h : i + 1 ≤ n + 1), d' i =
      (e i (by omega)).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ D.d i ∘ₗ (e (i + 1) h).toLinearMap := by
    intro i h; simp only [d', dif_pos h]
  have hdtop : d' (n + 1) = (e (n + 1) le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ g ∘ₗ f.toLinearMap := by
    simp only [d', dif_neg (show ¬ (n + 1 + 1 ≤ n + 1) by omega)]
    rw [dif_pos trivial]
  refine ⟨c', d', D.ε.comp (e 0 (by omega)).toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g' x
    show D.ε (e 0 (by omega) (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G g' • x)) = D.ε (e 0 (by omega) x)
    rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, D.ε_inv]
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := D.ε_surj x
    exact ⟨(e 0 (by omega)).symm y, by simp⟩
  · intro _
    ext x
    show D.ε (e 0 (by omega) x) = 0 ↔ x ∈ LinearMap.range (d' 0)
    rw [LinearMap.mem_range, hd' 0 (by omega)]
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply]
    have h0 := D.exact0 (by omega)
    have : D.ε ((e 0 (by omega)) x) = 0 ↔ (e 0 (by omega)) x ∈ LinearMap.range (D.d 0) := by
      rw [← AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, h0]; rfl
    rw [this]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact ⟨(e 1 (by omega)).symm y, by simp [hy]⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact ⟨e 1 (by omega) y, by rw [← hy]; simp⟩
  · intro i hi
    ext x
    by_cases hin : i + 1 ≤ n
    · 
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_range, hd' i (by omega), hd' (i + 1) (by omega)]
      simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply,
        LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff]
      have := D.exact i (by omega)
      have hx : D.d i ((e (i + 1) (by omega)) x) = 0 ↔
          (e (i + 1) (by omega)) x ∈ LinearMap.range (D.d (i + 1)) := by
        rw [← LinearMap.mem_ker, this]
      rw [hx]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
        exact ⟨(e (i + 2) (by omega)).symm y, by
          apply (e (i + 1) (by omega)).injective; simp [hy]⟩
      · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
        exact ⟨e (i + 2) (by omega) y, by rw [← hy]; simp⟩
    · obtain rfl : i = n := by omega
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_range, hd' i (by omega), hdtop]
      simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply,
        LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff]
      have hx : D.d i ((e (i + 1) (by omega)) x) = 0 ↔
          (e (i + 1) (by omega)) x ∈ LinearMap.range g := by
        rw [← LinearMap.mem_ker, hg]
      rw [hx]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
        exact ⟨f.symm y, by apply (e (i + 1) le_rfl).injective; simp [hy]⟩
      · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
        exact ⟨f y, by rw [← hy]; simp⟩

name: TheoremA.exists_homotopy
statement:
theorem exists_homotopy (R : Res B k) (θ : B →* B) (f g : ∀ i, FreeMod B (R.c i) →+ FreeMod B (R.c i))
    (hf : IsChainLift R θ f) (hg : IsChainLift R θ g) :
    ∀ n, ∃ K : ∀ i, FreeMod B (R.c i) →+ FreeMod B (R.c (i + 1)),
      (∀ i (l : ZG B) x, K i (l • x) = hat θ l • K i x) ∧
      ∀ j, j < n → j ≤ k → HomEq R f g K j
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ _ _ => by simp, fun j hj => by omega⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨K, hsl, heq⟩ := ih
    by_cases hn : n ≤ k
    · classical
      cases n with
      | zero =>
        have hmem : ∀ j : Fin (R.c 0),
            f 0 (Pi.single j 1) - g 0 (Pi.single j 1) ∈ LinearMap.range (R.d 0) := by
          intro j
          have : f 0 (Pi.single j 1) - g 0 (Pi.single j 1) ∈ R.ε.ker := by
            show R.ε _ = 0
            rw [map_sub, hf.aug, hg.aug, sub_self]
          rw [R.exact0] at this; exact this
        choose y hy using hmem
        let K0 : FreeMod B (R.c 0) →+ FreeMod B (R.c 1) := semiExt (hat θ) y
        refine ⟨Function.update (β := fun i => FreeMod B (R.c i) →+ FreeMod B (R.c (i + 1)))
          K 0 K0, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro i l x
          by_cases h : i = 0
          · subst h; simp [K0, semiExt_smul]
          · simp [Function.update_of_ne h, hsl]
        · intro j hj _
          obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
          intro x
          rw [Function.update_self]
          have := semilinear_ext (hat θ) (f 0 - g 0) ((R.d 0).toAddMonoidHom.comp K0)
            (fun l x => by simp [hf.semilinear, hg.semilinear, smul_sub])
            (fun l x => by simp [K0, semiExt_smul])
            (fun j => by simp [K0, semiExt_single, hy])
          exact congrArg (fun F => F x) this
      | succ n =>
        have hmem : ∀ j : Fin (R.c (n + 1)),
            f (n + 1) (Pi.single j 1) - g (n + 1) (Pi.single j 1) -
              K n (R.d n (Pi.single j 1)) ∈ LinearMap.range (R.d (n + 1)) := by
          intro j
          rw [← R.exact n (by omega)]
          show R.d n _ = 0
          rw [map_sub, map_sub, ← hf.comm n (by omega), ← hg.comm n (by omega)]
          cases n with
          | zero =>
            have h0 := heq 0 (by omega) (by omega) (R.d 0 (Pi.single j 1))
            rw [h0, sub_self]
          | succ n' =>
            have h0 := heq (n' + 1) (by omega) (by omega) (R.d (n' + 1) (Pi.single j 1))
            rw [h0, R.d_d n' (by omega), map_zero, add_zero, sub_self]
        choose y hy using hmem
        let K1 : FreeMod B (R.c (n + 1)) →+ FreeMod B (R.c (n + 1 + 1)) := semiExt (hat θ) y
        refine ⟨Function.update (β := fun i => FreeMod B (R.c i) →+ FreeMod B (R.c (i + 1)))
          K (n + 1) K1, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro i l x
          by_cases h : i = n + 1
          · subst h; simp [K1, semiExt_smul]
          · simp [Function.update_of_ne h, hsl]
        · intro j hj hjk
          by_cases h : j = n + 1
          · subst h
            intro x
            simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (show n ≠ n + 1 by omega)]
            have := semilinear_ext (hat θ) (f (n + 1) - g (n + 1) - (K n).comp (R.d n).toAddMonoidHom)
              ((R.d (n + 1)).toAddMonoidHom.comp K1)
              (fun l x => by simp [hf.semilinear, hg.semilinear, hsl, smul_sub])
              (fun l x => by simp [K1, semiExt_smul])
              (fun j => by simp [K1, semiExt_single, hy])
            have hx := congrArg (fun F => F x) this
            simp only [AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
              LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe] at hx
            rw [← hx]; abel
          · have hj' : j < n + 1 := by omega
            have := heq j hj' hjk
            cases j with
            | zero =>
              simp only [HomEq] at this ⊢
              rwa [Function.update_of_ne (show (0 : ℕ) ≠ n + 1 by omega)]
            | succ j =>
              simp only [HomEq] at this ⊢
              rwa [Function.update_of_ne (show j + 1 ≠ n + 1 by omega),
                Function.update_of_ne (show j ≠ n + 1 by omega)]
    · exact ⟨K, hsl, fun j hj hjk => heq j (by omega) hjk⟩

name: TheoremA.comparison
statement:
theorem comparison (R : Res B k) (θ : B →* B) (f g : ∀ i, FreeMod B (R.c i) →+ FreeMod B (R.c i))
    (hf : IsChainLift R θ f) (hg : IsChainLift R θ g) :
    ∃ N : Submodule (ZG B) (FreeMod B (R.c (k + 1))), N.FG ∧ N ≤ R.S ∧
      ∀ s ∈ R.S, f (k + 1) s - g (k + 1) s ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hsl, heq⟩ := exists_homotopy R θ f g hf hg (k + 1)
  let C : FreeMod B (R.c (k + 1)) →+ FreeMod B (R.c (k + 1)) :=
    f (k + 1) - g (k + 1) - (K k).comp (R.d k).toAddMonoidHom
  have hCsl : ∀ l x, C (l • x) = hat θ l • C x := by
    intro l x; simp [C, hf.semilinear, hg.semilinear, hsl, smul_sub]
  have hCS : ∀ x, C x ∈ R.S := by
    intro x
    show R.d k (C x) = 0
    simp only [C, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe,
      map_sub, ← hf.comm k le_rfl, ← hg.comm k le_rfl]
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      have h0 := heq 0 (by omega) le_rfl (R.d 0 x)
      rw [h0, sub_self]
    | succ k' =>
      have h0 := heq (k' + 1) (by omega) le_rfl (R.d (k' + 1) x)
      rw [h0, R.d_d k' (by omega), map_zero, add_zero, sub_self]
  refine ⟨Submodule.span (ZG B) (Set.range fun j => C (Pi.single j 1)),
    Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_range _), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact hCS _
  · intro s hs
    have hs' : R.d k s = 0 := hs
    have : C s = f (k + 1) s - g (k + 1) s := by
      simp [C, hs']
    rw [← this]
    exact semilinear_mem_span (hat θ) C hCsl s

name: TheoremA.RelPres.conj_t_of_mem_centralizing
statement:
theorem conj_t_of_mem_centralizing {P : Type*} [Group P] (V : Subgroup P) (v : P) (hv : v ∈ V) :
    (t * of v * t⁻¹ : HNNExtension P V V (MulEquiv.refl V)) = of v
proof:
:= by
  have := equiv_eq_conj (φ := MulEquiv.refl V) ⟨v, hv⟩
  simpa using this.symm

name: TheoremA.RelPres.classCR_isFP_two_centralizing
statement:
theorem classCR_isFP_two_centralizing {P : Type u} [Group P] (h1 : ClassCR R P) (h2 : IsFP 2 P)
    (V : Subgroup P) (hV : V.FG) :
    ClassCR R (HNNExtension P V V (MulEquiv.refl V)) ∧
      IsFP 2 (HNNExtension P V V (MulEquiv.refl V))
proof:
:=
  classCR_isFP_two_hnn h1 h2 (MulEquiv.refl V) ((Group.fg_iff_subgroup_fg V).2 hV)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.HB.sup_fg
statement:
theorem HB.sup_fg {G : Type u} [Group G] (hG : Group.FG G) {N : Subgroup G} (hN : HB R N)
    {K : Subgroup G} (hK : K.FG) : HB R (N ⊔ K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, _, h1, h2, f, hf, V, hV, rfl⟩ := hN
  obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_centralizing h1 h2 V hV
  let E := HNNExtension P V V (MulEquiv.refl V)
  let conjT : E →* E := (MulAut.conj (t : E)).toMonoidHom
  let Z : Subgroup E := (K.map f).map (of : P →* E) ⊔ (f.range.map (of : P →* E)).map conjT
  have hGr : f.range.FG := by
    rw [MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
    exact Subgroup.fg_map' f (Group.fg_def.mp hG)
  refine ⟨E, _, c, d, (of : P →* E).comp f, (by rw [MonoidHom.coe_comp]; exact (of_injective (φ := MulEquiv.refl V)).comp hf), Z,
    (Subgroup.fg_map' _ (Subgroup.fg_map' _ hK)).sup
      (Subgroup.fg_map' _ (Subgroup.fg_map' _ hGr)), ?_⟩
  let W₀ : Subgroup P := ((V.comap f) ⊔ K).map f
  have hXV : f.range ⊓ V ≤ W₀ := by
    rintro _ ⟨⟨g, rfl⟩, hv⟩
    exact ⟨g, Subgroup.mem_sup_left hv, rfl⟩
  have hWV : W₀ ⊓ V ≤ f.range := by
    rintro _ ⟨⟨g, -, rfl⟩, -⟩
    exact ⟨g, rfl⟩
  ext x
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_comap, MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hZ : Z ≤ Subgroup.closure ((of '' (W₀ : Set P)) ∪
        ((fun y => t * of y * t⁻¹) '' (f.range : Set P))) := by
      refine sup_le ?_ ?_
      · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨f k, ⟨k, Subgroup.mem_sup_right hk, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
      · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨_, ⟨g, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨f g, ⟨g, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hweq⟩ := mem_of_mem_closure_centralizing V f.range W₀ hXV hWV
      (of (f x)) (hZ hx) ⟨f x, rfl⟩
    have : w = f x := of_injective (φ := MulEquiv.refl V) hweq
    subst this
    exact (Subgroup.mem_map_iff_mem hf).1 hw
  · intro hx
    have hle : V.comap f ⊔ K ≤ Z.comap ((of : P →* E).comp f) := by
      refine sup_le ?_ ?_
      · intro n hn
        simp only [Subgroup.mem_comap, MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at hn ⊢
        refine Subgroup.mem_sup_right ⟨of (f n), ⟨f n, ⟨n, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        exact conj_t_of_mem_centralizing V (f n) hn
      · intro k hk
        exact Subgroup.mem_sup_left ⟨f k, ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hle hx

name: TheoremA.RelPres.HB.exists_centralizing_embedding
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, _, h1, h2, f, hf, V, hV, rfl⟩ := hN
  obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_centralizing h1 h2 V hV
  exact ⟨_, _, c, d, hnnMap (MulEquiv.refl _) (MulEquiv.refl V) f (fun a ha => ha)
    (fun a => rfl), hnnMap_injective _ _ _ _ _ hf (fun g hg => hg) (fun g hg => hg)⟩

name: TheoremA.Seg.tail_append
statement:
theorem tail_append (L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)) (e : ℤ × Bool × ℤ) :
    tail x (L ++ [e]) = tail x L * (sgn (x e.1) e.2.1 * x 0 ^ e.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp [tail]
  | cons f L ih => simp [tail, ih, mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Seg.tail_concat_z
statement:
theorem tail_concat_z (L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)) (s : ℤ) (b : Bool) (z w : ℤ) :
    tail x (L ++ [(s, b, z + w)]) = tail x (L ++ [(s, b, z)]) * x 0 ^ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [tail_append, tail_append, zpow_add]; simp [mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Seg.ok_concat
statement:
theorem ok_concat {L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)} {e f : ℤ × Bool × ℤ} (h : OK (L ++ [e]))
    (hf : f.1 ≠ 0) (hef : e.2.2 = 0 → ¬ (e.1 = f.1 ∧ e.2.1 ≠ f.2.1)) :
    OK (L ++ [e] ++ [f])
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g hg
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hg with hg | hg
    · exact h.1 g hg
    · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hg; subst hg; exact hf
  · rw [List.isChain_append]
    refine ⟨h.2, List.isChain_singleton _, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb
    simp only [List.getLast?_append, List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some_or,
      Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq, List.head?_cons] at ha hb
    subst ha; subst hb; exact hef

name: TheoremA.Seg.ok_dropLast
statement:
theorem ok_dropLast {L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)} {e : ℤ × Bool × ℤ} (h : OK (L ++ [e])) :
    OK L
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun g hg => h.1 g (List.mem_append_left _ hg), (List.isChain_append.1 h.2).1⟩

name: TheoremA.Seg.ok_change_z
statement:
theorem ok_change_z {L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)} {s : ℤ} {b : Bool} {z w : ℤ}
    (h : OK (L ++ [(s, b, z)])) : OK (L ++ [(s, b, w)])
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g hg
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hg with hg | hg
    · exact h.1 g (List.mem_append_left _ hg)
    · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hg; subst hg
      exact h.1 (s, b, z) (by simp)
  · have h2 := List.isChain_append.1 h.2
    rw [List.isChain_append]
    refine ⟨h2.1, List.isChain_singleton _, ?_⟩
    intro a ha c hc
    simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq] at hc
    subst hc
    exact h2.2.2 a ha (s, b, z) (by simp)

name: TheoremA.Seg.sgn_zpow
statement: theorem sgn_zpow (g : G) (b : Bool) : sgn g b = g ^ (if b then (1 : ℤ) else -1)
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> simp [sgn]

name: TheoremA.Seg.eq_nil_or_concat'
statement:
theorem eq_nil_or_concat' (L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)) :
    L = [] ∨ ∃ L' s b z, L = L' ++ [(s, b, z)]
proof:
:= by
  rcases L.eq_nil_or_concat with h | ⟨L', ⟨s, b, z⟩, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr ⟨L', s, b, z, by simp [h]⟩

name: TheoremA.Seg.exists_segForm_mul
statement:
theorem exists_segForm_mul (z₀ : ℤ) (L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)) (hL : OK L) (s : ℤ) (b : Bool) :
    ∃ z₀' L', OK L' ∧ eval x z₀' L' = eval x z₀ L * sgn (x s) b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : s = 0
  · subst hs
    rcases eq_nil_or_concat' L with rfl | ⟨L', s', b', z, rfl⟩
    · refine ⟨z₀ + (if b then 1 else -1), [], hL, ?_⟩
      simp [eval, tail, zpow_add, sgn_zpow]
    · refine ⟨z₀, L' ++ [(s', b', z + (if b then 1 else -1))], ok_change_z hL, ?_⟩
      simp only [eval, tail_concat_z, sgn_zpow, mul_assoc]
  · rcases eq_nil_or_concat' L with rfl | ⟨L', s', b', z, rfl⟩
    · refine ⟨z₀, [(s, b, 0)], ⟨by simpa using hs, List.isChain_singleton _⟩, ?_⟩
      simp [eval, tail]
    · by_cases hc : z = 0 ∧ s' = s ∧ b' ≠ b
      · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, hb⟩ := hc
        refine ⟨z₀, L', ok_dropLast hL, ?_⟩
        simp only [eval, tail_append, mul_assoc, zpow_zero, one_mul]
        congr 1
        have : sgn (x s') b' * sgn (x s') b = 1 := by
          cases b <;> cases b' <;> simp_all [sgn]
        rw [this, mul_one]
      · refine ⟨z₀, L' ++ [(s', b', z)] ++ [(s, b, 0)], ok_concat hL hs ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro hz h
          exact hc ⟨hz, h.1, h.2⟩
        · simp only [eval, tail_append, zpow_zero, mul_one, mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Seg.exists_segForm
statement:
theorem exists_segForm {g : G} (hg : g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range x)) :
    ∃ z₀ L, OK L ∧ eval x z₀ L = g
proof:
:= by
  induction hg using Subgroup.closure_induction_right with
  | one => exact ⟨0, [], ⟨by simp, List.IsChain.nil⟩, by simp [eval, tail]⟩
  | mul_right g _ y hy ih =>
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨z₀, L, hL, rfl⟩ := ih
    exact exists_segForm_mul x z₀ L hL s true
  | mul_inv_cancel g _ y hy ih =>
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨z₀, L, hL, rfl⟩ := ih
    exact exists_segForm_mul x z₀ L hL s false

name: TheoremA.Seg.map_tail
statement:
theorem map_tail {H : Type*} [Group H] (f : G →* H) (L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)) :
    f (tail x L) = tail (fun s => f (x s)) L
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp [tail]
  | cons e L ih => simp [tail, ih, sgn]; split_ifs <;> simp [ih]

name: TheoremA.Seg.map_eval
statement:
theorem map_eval {H : Type*} [Group H] (f : G →* H) (z₀ : ℤ) (L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)) :
    f (eval x z₀ L) = eval (fun s => f (x s)) z₀ L
proof:
:= by
  simp [eval, map_tail]

name: TheoremA.Seg.eval_mem
statement:
theorem eval_mem {H : Subgroup G} (z₀ : ℤ) (L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)) (h0 : x 0 ∈ H)
    (hL : ∀ e ∈ L, x e.1 ∈ H) : eval x z₀ L ∈ H
proof:
:= by
  refine H.mul_mem (H.zpow_mem h0 _) ?_
  induction L with
  | nil => exact H.one_mem
  | cons e L ih =>
    refine H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem ?_ (H.zpow_mem h0 _)) (ih fun f hf => hL f (by simp [hf]))
    have := hL e (by simp)
    unfold sgn; split_ifs
    · exact this
    · exact H.inv_mem this

name: TheoremA.exists_suitable_VR
statement:
theorem exists_suitable_VR (R : Set ℕ)
    (h : HB R (Subgroup.normalClosure (enumRelators (twoGenEnum (omegaEnum R))))) :
    ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Group K), ClassCR R K ∧ IsFP 2 K ∧
      ∃ g : VR R →* K, Function.Injective g
proof:
:=
  rope_trick _ h

name: TheoremA.relativeLeary_of_kernelHB
statement: theorem relativeLeary_of_kernelHB (h : KernelHB) : RelativeLearyFP2.{u}
proof:
:= by
  intro R H _ hH
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hH.exists_injective_hom_VR
  obtain ⟨K, _, hKC, hKF, g, hg⟩ :=
    exists_suitable_VR R (h R _ (isNatEnumerator_omegaEnum.twoGenEnum))
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := hKC
  let up : K →* ULift.{u} K := MulEquiv.ulift.symm.toMonoidHom
  exact ⟨ULift.{u} K, inferInstance, ⟨n, e, he, ⟨ψ.trans MulEquiv.ulift.symm⟩⟩,
    IsFP.of_mulEquiv MulEquiv.ulift.symm hKF, (up.comp g).comp f,
    (MulEquiv.ulift.symm.injective.comp hg).comp hf⟩

name: TheoremA.coeffEquiv_of
statement:
theorem coeffEquiv_of (e : G ≃* H) (g : G) :
    coeffEquiv e (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G g) = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ H (e g)
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeffEquiv, MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, MonoidAlgebra.domCongr_single]

name: TheoremA.coeffEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem coeffEquiv_symm (e : G ≃* H) (a : MonoidAlgebra ℤ H) :
    (coeffEquiv e).symm a = coeffEquiv e.symm a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeffEquiv]
  rfl

name: TheoremA.freeTransport_smul
statement:
theorem freeTransport_smul (e : G ≃* H) {c : ℕ} (a : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) (v : FreeMod G c) :
    freeTransport e c (a • v) = coeffEquiv e a • freeTransport e c v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [freeTransport]

name: TheoremA.freeTransport_symm_smul
statement:
theorem freeTransport_symm_smul (e : G ≃* H) {c : ℕ} (a : MonoidAlgebra ℤ H) (w : FreeMod H c) :
    (freeTransport e c).symm (a • w) = (coeffEquiv e).symm a • (freeTransport e c).symm w
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [freeTransport]

name: TheoremA.transportLin_apply
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.mem_ker_transportLin
statement:
theorem mem_ker_transportLin (e : G ≃* H) {c c' : ℕ}
    (d : FreeMod G c →ₗ[MonoidAlgebra ℤ G] FreeMod G c') (w : FreeMod H c) :
    w ∈ LinearMap.ker (transportLin e d) ↔
      (freeTransport e c).symm w ∈ LinearMap.ker d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, transportLin_apply]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := congrArg (freeTransport e c').symm h
    simpa using this
  · intro h; rw [h]; simp

name: TheoremA.mem_range_transportLin
statement:
theorem mem_range_transportLin (e : G ≃* H) {c c' : ℕ}
    (d : FreeMod G c →ₗ[MonoidAlgebra ℤ G] FreeMod G c') (w : FreeMod H c') :
    w ∈ LinearMap.range (transportLin e d) ↔
      (freeTransport e c').symm w ∈ LinearMap.range d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_range, transportLin_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(freeTransport e c).symm y, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine ⟨freeTransport e c y, ?_⟩
    simp [hy]

name: TheoremA.IsFP.of_mulEquiv
statement: theorem IsFP.of_mulEquiv {n : ℕ} (e : G ≃* H) (h : IsFP n G) : IsFP n H
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, d, ε, hinv, hsurj, h0, hex⟩ := h
  refine ⟨c, fun i => transportLin e (d i), ε.comp (freeTransport e (c 0)).symm.toAddMonoidHom,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g x
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [freeTransport_symm_smul, coeffEquiv_symm, coeffEquiv_of]
    exact hinv _ _
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hsurj z
    exact ⟨freeTransport e (c 0) x, by simp⟩
  · intro hn
    ext w
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom,
      Function.comp_apply, Submodule.mem_toAddSubgroup, mem_range_transportLin]
    have := congrArg (fun A : AddSubgroup (FreeMod G (c 0)) =>
      (freeTransport e (c 0)).symm w ∈ A) (h0 hn)
    simpa using this
  · intro i hi
    ext w
    rw [mem_ker_transportLin, mem_range_transportLin, hex i hi]

name: TheoremA.IsFP.congr
statement: theorem IsFP.congr {n : ℕ} (e : G ≃* H) : IsFP n G ↔ IsFP n H
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsFP.of_mulEquiv e, IsFP.of_mulEquiv e.symm⟩

name: TheoremA.Coding.Cs_zero
statement: theorem Cs_zero : (Cs 0 : Fc ℓ) = 1
proof: := by simp [Cs]

name: TheoremA.Coding.vv_zero
statement: theorem vv_zero : (vv 0 : Fc ℓ) = dd
proof: := by simp [vv, Cs_zero]

name: TheoremA.Coding.VS_le_VZ
statement: theorem VS_le_VZ (S : Set ℤ) : VS ℓ S ≤ VZ ℓ
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.closure_mono (Set.image_subset_range _ _)

name: TheoremA.Coding.kappa_c0
statement: theorem kappa_c0 (y : Fin ℓ → B) : kappa y c0 = inlK a0
proof: := by simp [kappa, c0, a0]

name: TheoremA.Coding.kappa_dd
statement: theorem kappa_dd (y : Fin ℓ → B) : kappa y dd = inlK ad
proof: := by simp [kappa, dd, ad]

name: TheoremA.Coding.kappa_ee
statement: theorem kappa_ee (y : Fin ℓ → B) : kappa y ee = inlK ae
proof: := by simp [kappa, ee, ae]

name: TheoremA.Coding.kappa_Cs
statement: theorem kappa_Cs (y : Fin ℓ → B) (s : ℤ) : kappa y (Cs s) = inrK (Ys y s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Cs, Ys, map_list_prod, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def, kappa, cc]

name: TheoremA.Coding.kappa_vv
statement:
theorem kappa_vv (y : Fin ℓ → B) (s : ℤ) :
    kappa y (vv s) = inlK (a0 ^ s) * inrK (Ys y s) * inlK (ad * ae ^ s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vv, map_mul, map_zpow, kappa_c0, kappa_dd, kappa_ee, kappa_Cs, mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Coding.kappa_sgn_vv
statement:
theorem kappa_sgn_vv (y : Fin ℓ → B) (s : ℤ) (b : Bool) :
    kappa y (Seg.sgn (vv s) b) = inlK (pre s b) * inrK (Seg.sgn (Ys y s) b) * inlK (post s b)
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · simp only [Seg.sgn, map_inv, kappa_vv, pre, post, mul_inv_rev, zpow_neg, Bool.false_eq_true,
      if_false, mul_assoc, map_mul, map_zpow]
  · simp only [Seg.sgn, kappa_vv, pre, post, if_true]

name: TheoremA.Coding.altProd_mul_left
statement:
theorem altProd_mul_left (x a : A3) (L : List (B × A3)) :
    CoprodI.of (M := amalgFam A3 B) (i := false) x * altProd (P := amalgFam A3 B) a L =
      altProd (P := amalgFam A3 B) (x * a) L
proof:
:= by
  cases L with
  | nil => simp only [altProd, map_mul]
  | cons p L => simp only [altProd, map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Coding.kappa_eval_aux
statement:
theorem kappa_eval_aux (y : Fin ℓ → B) : ∀ (z₀ : ℤ) (L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)),
    kappa y (vv 0 ^ z₀ * Seg.tail vv L) = altProd (P := amalgFam A3 B) (headA z₀ L) (tailAlt y L)
  | z₀, [] => by
    simp only [Seg.tail, mul_one, map_zpow, vv_zero, kappa_dd, headA, tailAlt, altProd]
    rfl
  | z₀, [e] => by
    have h
proof:
:= kappa_eval_aux y e.2.2 []
    simp only [Seg.tail, mul_one] at h ⊢
    rw [show vv 0 ^ z₀ * (Seg.sgn (vv e.1) e.2.1 * vv 0 ^ e.2.2) =
      vv 0 ^ z₀ * Seg.sgn (vv e.1) e.2.1 * vv 0 ^ e.2.2 by group, map_mul, h, map_mul,
      kappa_sgn_vv]
    simp only [headA, tailAlt, altProd, map_zpow, vv_zero, kappa_dd, map_mul, inlK, inrK,
      mul_assoc]
    rfl
  | z₀, e :: f :: L => by
    have h := kappa_eval_aux y e.2.2 (f :: L)
    rw [show vv 0 ^ z₀ * Seg.tail vv (e :: f :: L) =
      vv 0 ^ z₀ * Seg.sgn (vv e.1) e.2.1 * (vv 0 ^ e.2.2 * Seg.tail vv (f :: L)) by
        simp only [Seg.tail]; group, map_mul, h, map_mul, kappa_sgn_vv]
    simp only [headA, tailAlt, altProd]
    rw [show post e.1 e.2.1 * ad ^ e.2.2 * pre f.1 f.2.1 =
      post e.1 e.2.1 * (ad ^ e.2.2 * pre f.1 f.2.1) by group,
      ← altProd_mul_left (post e.1 e.2.1) (ad ^ e.2.2 * pre f.1 f.2.1)]
    simp only [map_zpow, vv_zero, kappa_dd, map_mul, inlK, inrK, mul_assoc]
    rfl

name: TheoremA.Coding.kappa_segEval
statement:
theorem kappa_segEval (y : Fin ℓ → B) (z₀ : ℤ) (L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)) :
    kappa y (Seg.eval vv z₀ L) = altProd (P := amalgFam A3 B) (headA z₀ L) (tailAlt y L)
proof:
:=
  kappa_eval_aux y z₀ L

name: TheoremA.Coding.map_fst_tailAlt
statement:
theorem map_fst_tailAlt (y : Fin ℓ → B) : ∀ L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ),
    (tailAlt y L).map Prod.fst = L.map fun e => Seg.sgn (Ys y e.1) e.2.1
  | [] => rfl
  | [e] => rfl
  | e :: f :: L => by
    simp only [tailAlt, List.map_cons]
    rw [map_fst_tailAlt y (f :: L)]
    rfl

name: TheoremA.Coding.tailAlt_eq_nil
statement:
theorem tailAlt_eq_nil (y : Fin ℓ → B) {L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ)} (h : tailAlt y L = []) :
    L = []
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg List.length (map_fst_tailAlt y L)
  rw [h] at this
  simpa using this.symm

name: TheoremA.Coding.piece_ne_one
statement:
theorem piece_ne_one {s s' z : ℤ} {b b' : Bool} (hs : s ≠ 0) (hs' : s' ≠ 0)
    (h : z = 0 → ¬ (s = s' ∧ b ≠ b')) : post s b * ad ^ z * pre s' b' ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have h0 := congrArg (fun x => Multiplicative.toAdd (expA 0 x)) he
  have h1 := congrArg (fun x => Multiplicative.toAdd (expA 1 x)) he
  have h2 := congrArg (fun x => Multiplicative.toAdd (expA 2 x)) he
  cases b <;> cases b' <;>
    simp [post, pre, expA, a0, ad, ae, toAdd_zpow] at h0 h1 h2 h <;> omega

name: TheoremA.Coding.altOK_cons
statement:
theorem altOK_cons (p : B × A3) (M : List (B × A3)) :
    AltOK (P := amalgFam A3 B) (p :: M) ↔
      p.1 ≠ 1 ∧ (M ≠ [] → p.2 ≠ 1) ∧ AltOK (P := amalgFam A3 B) M
proof:
:= by
  cases M <;> simp [AltOK]

name: TheoremA.Coding.altOK_tailAlt
statement:
theorem altOK_tailAlt (y : Fin ℓ → B) (hY : ∀ s, s ≠ 0 → Ys y s ≠ 1) :
    ∀ L : List (ℤ × Bool × ℤ), Seg.OK L → AltOK (P := amalgFam A3 B) (tailAlt y L)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | [e], h => by
    show Seg.sgn (Ys y e.1) e.2.1 ≠ 1
    have
proof:
:= hY e.1 (h.1 e (by simp))
    unfold Seg.sgn; split_ifs <;> simpa using this
  | e :: f :: L, h => by
    rw [tailAlt, altOK_cons]
    refine ⟨?_, fun _ => ?_, altOK_tailAlt y hY (f :: L) ⟨fun g hg => h.1 g (by simp [hg]),
      h.2.tail⟩⟩
    · show Seg.sgn (Ys y e.1) e.2.1 ≠ 1
      have := hY e.1 (h.1 e (by simp))
      unfold Seg.sgn; split_ifs <;> simpa using this
    · exact piece_ne_one (h.1 e (by simp)) (h.1 f (by simp)) (List.isChain_cons_cons.1 h.2).1

name: TheoremA.Coding.expFirst_Ys
statement:
theorem expFirst_Ys (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (s : ℤ) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (expFirst hℓ (Ys FreeGroup.of s)) = s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ys, map_list_prod, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def, map_zpow, expFirst,
    FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, List.prod_ofFn]
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single ⟨0, hℓ⟩]
  · simp
  · intro i _ hi; simp [hi]
  · simp

name: TheoremA.Coding.Ys_of_ne_one
statement: theorem Ys_of_ne_one (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) {s : ℤ} (hs : s ≠ 0) : Ys (FreeGroup.of : Fin ℓ → _) s ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := expFirst_Ys hℓ s
  rw [h] at this
  simp at this
  exact hs this.symm

name: TheoremA.Coding.vhom_injective
statement: theorem vhom_injective (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) : Function.Injective (vhom : FreeGroup ℤ →* Fc ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
  intro g hg
  have hmem : g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range (FreeGroup.of : ℤ → FreeGroup ℤ)) := by
    rw [FreeGroup.closure_range_of]; trivial
  obtain ⟨z₀, L, hL, rfl⟩ := Seg.exists_segForm FreeGroup.of hmem
  rw [Seg.map_eval] at hg
  simp only [vhom, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of] at hg
  have hk := congrArg (kappa (B := FreeGroup (Fin ℓ)) FreeGroup.of) hg
  rw [kappa_segEval, map_one] at hk
  rcases L.eq_nil_or_concat with rfl | ⟨L', e, hLe⟩
  · simp only [Seg.eval, Seg.tail, mul_one, vv_zero] at hg ⊢
    have := congrArg (fun x => Multiplicative.toAdd
      (expA 1 ((FreeGroup.lift (Sum.elim FreeGroup.of fun _ => 1) : Fc ℓ →* A3) x))) hg
    simp [dd, expA] at this
    simp [this]
  · exfalso
    have hne : tailAlt (FreeGroup.of : Fin ℓ → FreeGroup (Fin ℓ)) L ≠ [] := by
      intro h; have := tailAlt_eq_nil _ h; simp [hLe] at this
    exact altProd_not_mem_range (altOK_tailAlt _ (fun s hs => Ys_of_ne_one hℓ hs) L hL) hne 1
      (by rw [hk, map_one])

name: TheoremA.Coding.range_vhom
statement: theorem range_vhom : (vhom : FreeGroup ℤ →* Fc ℓ).range = VZ ℓ
proof:
:= by
  rw [VZ, vhom, FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure]

name: TheoremA.Coding.Ys_pair
statement:
theorem Ys_pair {B₁ B₂ : Type} [Group B₁] [Group B₂] (y₁ : Fin ℓ → B₁) (y₂ : Fin ℓ → B₂)
    (s : ℤ) : Ys (fun i => (y₁ i, y₂ i)) s = (Ys y₁ s, Ys y₂ s)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · have := (MonoidHom.fst B₁ B₂).map_list_prod (List.ofFn fun i => (y₁ i, y₂ i) ^ s)
    simpa [Ys, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def] using this
  · have := (MonoidHom.snd B₁ B₂).map_list_prod (List.ofFn fun i => (y₁ i, y₂ i) ^ s)
    simpa [Ys, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def] using this

name: TheoremA.Coding.Ys_yU
statement: theorem Ys_yU (s : ℤ) : Ys (yU (ℓ := ℓ) (J := J)) s = (Ys FreeGroup.of s, 1)
proof:
:= by
  have := Ys_pair (FreeGroup.of : Fin ℓ → FreeGroup (Fin ℓ)) (fun _ => (1 : J)) s
  exact this.trans (by simp [Ys])

name: TheoremA.Coding.Ys_yT
statement: theorem Ys_yT (j : Fin ℓ → J) (s : ℤ) : Ys (yT j) s = (Ys FreeGroup.of s, Ys j s)
proof:
:=
  Ys_pair _ j s

name: TheoremA.Coding.Ys_yU_ne_one
statement: theorem Ys_yU_ne_one (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) {s : ℤ} (hs : s ≠ 0) : Ys (yU (ℓ := ℓ) (J := J)) s ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ys_yU]; intro h; exact Ys_of_ne_one hℓ hs (congrArg Prod.fst h)

name: TheoremA.Coding.Ys_yT_ne_one
statement: theorem Ys_yT_ne_one (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (j : Fin ℓ → J) {s : ℤ} (hs : s ≠ 0) : Ys (yT j) s ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ys_yT]; intro h; exact Ys_of_ne_one hℓ hs (congrArg Prod.fst h)

name: TheoremA.Coding.sgn_injective
statement:
theorem sgn_injective {G : Type*} [Group G] {g h : G} (b : Bool) (he : Seg.sgn g b = Seg.sgn h b) :
    g = h
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> simpa [Seg.sgn] using he

name: TheoremA.Coding.mem_VS_of_kappa_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z₀, L, hL, rfl⟩ := Seg.exists_segForm vv hx
  rw [kappa_segEval, kappa_segEval] at he
  have hm := eq_of_altProd_eq (altOK_tailAlt _ (fun s hs => Ys_yT_ne_one hℓ j hs) L hL)
    (altOK_tailAlt _ (fun s hs => Ys_yU_ne_one hℓ hs) L hL) he
  have hm' : (tailAlt (yT j) L).map Prod.fst = (tailAlt yU L).map Prod.fst := hm
  rw [map_fst_tailAlt, map_fst_tailAlt] at hm'
  clear hm
  have hm := hm'
  refine Seg.eval_mem vv z₀ L (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨0, h0, rfl⟩) ?_
  intro e he'
  refine Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨e.1, ?_, rfl⟩
  have := congrArg (fun l => l[L.idxOf e]?) hm
  simp only [List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_idxOf he', Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
    at this
  have h2 := sgn_injective _ this
  rw [Ys_yT, Ys_yU] at h2
  exact (hD e.1).1 (congrArg Prod.snd h2)

name: TheoremA.Coding.kappa_eq_of_mem_VS
statement:
theorem kappa_eq_of_mem_VS (j : Fin ℓ → J) {S : Set ℤ} (hD : ∀ s, Ys j s = 1 ↔ s ∈ S)
    {x : Fc ℓ} (hx : x ∈ VS ℓ S) : kappa (yT j) x = kappa yU x
proof:
:= by
  have : VS ℓ S ≤ MonoidHom.eqLocus (kappa (yT j)) (kappa yU) := by
    rw [VS, Subgroup.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    show kappa (yT j) (vv s) = kappa yU (vv s)
    rw [kappa_vv, kappa_vv, Ys_yT, Ys_yU, (hD s).2 hs]
  exact this hx

name: TheoremA.Coding.retr_kappa
statement:
theorem retr_kappa (y : Fin ℓ → FreeGroup (Fin ℓ) × J) (hy : ∀ i, (y i).1 = FreeGroup.of i) :
    (retr (J := J)).comp (kappa y) = MonoidHom.id (Fc ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  rcases k with k | i
  · simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, kappa, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, Sum.elim_inl,
      MonoidHom.id_apply, retr, inlK]
    erw [CoprodI.lift_of]
    exact FreeGroup.lift_apply_of (f := fun k : Fin 3 => (FreeGroup.of (Sum.inl k) : Fc ℓ))
  · simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, kappa, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, Sum.elim_inr,
      MonoidHom.id_apply, retr, inrK]
    erw [CoprodI.lift_of]
    show FreeGroup.lift _ ((y i).1) = _
    rw [hy]
    exact FreeGroup.lift_apply_of (f := fun k : Fin ℓ => (FreeGroup.of (Sum.inr k) : Fc ℓ))

name: TheoremA.Coding.kappa_yU_injective
statement: theorem kappa_yU_injective : Function.Injective (kappa (yU (ℓ := ℓ) (J := J)))
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := retr) fun x => by
    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, retr_kappa _ (fun i => rfl)]; rfl

name: TheoremA.Coding.kappa_yT_injective
statement: theorem kappa_yT_injective (j : Fin ℓ → J) : Function.Injective (kappa (yT j))
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := retr) fun x => by
    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, retr_kappa _ (fun i => rfl)]; rfl

name: TheoremA.Coding.retr_apply_kappa
statement:
theorem retr_apply_kappa (y : Fin ℓ → FreeGroup (Fin ℓ) × J) (hy : ∀ i, (y i).1 = FreeGroup.of i)
    (x : Fc ℓ) : retr (kappa y x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, retr_kappa y hy]; rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.thetaMap_of
statement:
theorem thetaMap_of (f : FreeGroup (Fin d)) :
    thetaMap N (of f) = SemidirectProduct.inl ((f : FreeGroup (Fin d) ⧸ N), 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [thetaMap]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.thetaMap_conj
statement:
theorem thetaMap_conj (f : FreeGroup (Fin d)) :
    thetaMap N (t * of f * t⁻¹) = SemidirectProduct.inl (1, (f : FreeGroup (Fin d) ⧸ N))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_inv, thetaMap_of]
  simp only [thetaMap, lift_t]
  rw [← map_inv, ← SemidirectProduct.inl_aut]
  simp [swapAct]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.thetaMap_right
statement: theorem thetaMap_right (l : ropeL' N) : (thetaMap N l).right = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : ropeL' N ≤ (SemidirectProduct.rightHom.comp (thetaMap N)).ker := by
    rw [ropeL', Subgroup.closure_le]
    rintro _ (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp [ropeXs, thetaMap_of]
    · simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, MonoidHom.mem_ker, MonoidHom.comp_apply, ropeYs]
      rw [thetaMap_conj]; simp
  simpa using this l.2

name: TheoremA.RelPres.alphaC_x
statement:
theorem alphaC_x (i : Fin d) (h : ropeXs N i ∈ ropeL' N) :
    alphaC N ⟨ropeXs N i, h⟩ = ((FreeGroup.of i : FreeGroup (Fin d)) : FreeGroup (Fin d) ⧸ N)
proof:
:= by
  simp [alphaC, ropeXs, thetaMap_of]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.alphaC_y
statement: theorem alphaC_y (i : Fin d) (h : ropeYs N i ∈ ropeL' N) : alphaC N ⟨ropeYs N i, h⟩ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [alphaC, MonoidHom.mk'_apply, ropeYs]
  rw [thetaMap_conj]; simp

name: TheoremA.RelPres.centHNN_conj_of_mem
statement:
theorem centHNN_conj_of_mem (r : FreeGroup (Fin d)) (hr : r ∈ N) :
    (t * of r * t⁻¹ : CentHNN N) = of r
proof:
:=
  conj_t_of_mem_centralizing N r hr

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeL'_map
statement: theorem ropeL'_map : (ropeL' N).map gC = ropeL N gC
proof:
:= by
  rw [ropeL', MonoidHom.map_closure, Set.image_union, ← Set.range_comp, ← Set.range_comp]
  rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeLEquiv_apply
statement: theorem ropeLEquiv_apply (l : ropeL' N) : (ropeLEquiv N gC hg l : B) = gC l
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeXB_mem
statement: theorem ropeXB_mem (i : Fin d) : ropeXB N gC i ∈ ropeL N gC
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeYB_mem
statement: theorem ropeYB_mem (i : Fin d) : ropeYB N gC i ∈ ropeL N gC
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeXs_mem
statement: theorem ropeXs_mem (i : Fin d) : ropeXs N i ∈ ropeL' N
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeYs_mem
statement: theorem ropeYs_mem (i : Fin d) : ropeYs N i ∈ ropeL' N
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeAlpha_x
statement:
theorem ropeAlpha_x (i : Fin d) :
    ropeAlpha N gC hg ⟨ropeXB N gC i, ropeXB_mem N gC i⟩ =
      ((FreeGroup.of i : FreeGroup (Fin d)) : FreeGroup (Fin d) ⧸ N)
proof:
:= by
  have : (ropeLEquiv N gC hg).symm ⟨ropeXB N gC i, ropeXB_mem N gC i⟩ =
      ⟨ropeXs N i, ropeXs_mem N i⟩ :=
    (MulEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 (Subtype.ext rfl)
  simp only [ropeAlpha, MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, this, alphaC_x]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeAlpha_y
statement:
theorem ropeAlpha_y (i : Fin d) :
    ropeAlpha N gC hg ⟨ropeYB N gC i, ropeYB_mem N gC i⟩ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : (ropeLEquiv N gC hg).symm ⟨ropeYB N gC i, ropeYB_mem N gC i⟩ =
      ⟨ropeYs N i, ropeYs_mem N i⟩ :=
    (MulEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 (Subtype.ext rfl)
  simp only [ropeAlpha, MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, this, alphaC_y]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeXHom_of
statement: theorem ropeXHom_of (i : Fin d) : ropeXHom N gC (FreeGroup.of i) = ropeXB N gC i
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeYHom_of
statement: theorem ropeYHom_of (i : Fin d) : ropeYHom N gC (FreeGroup.of i) = ropeYB N gC i
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeYHom_eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem ropeYHom_eq_of_mem (r : FreeGroup (Fin d)) (hr : r ∈ N) :
    ropeYHom N gC r = ropeXHom N gC r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ropeYHom, ropeXHom, MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom,
    MulAut.conj_apply]
  rw [centHNN_conj_of_mem N r hr]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeL_closure_gens
statement:
theorem ropeL_closure_gens : Subgroup.closure
    ((ropeL N gC).subtype ⁻¹' (Set.range (ropeXB N gC) ∪ Set.range (ropeYB N gC))) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.closure_closure_coe_preimage

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Subgroup.fg_map'
statement:
theorem Subgroup.fg_map' {G P : Type*} [Group G] [Group P] (f : G →* P) {H : Subgroup G}
    (hH : H.FG) : (H.map f).FG
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsMulFG H := hH
  infer_instance

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Subgroup.fg_prod'
statement:
theorem Subgroup.fg_prod' {G P : Type*} [Group G] [Group P] {H : Subgroup G} {K : Subgroup P}
    (hH : H.FG) (hK : K.FG) : (H.prod K).FG
proof:
:= by
  have : H.prod K = H.map (MonoidHom.inl G P) ⊔ K.map (MonoidHom.inr G P) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨ha, hb⟩
      have : ((a, b) : G × P) = MonoidHom.inl G P a * MonoidHom.inr G P b := by simp
      rw [this]
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mem_sup_left ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩)
        (Subgroup.mem_sup_right ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)
    · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
      · rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩; exact ⟨ha, K.one_mem⟩
      · rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩; exact ⟨H.one_mem, hb⟩
  rw [this]
  exact (Subgroup.fg_map' _ hH).sup (Subgroup.fg_map' _ hK)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.HB.embedsSuitable
statement:
theorem HB.embedsSuitable {G : Type u} [Group G] {N : Subgroup G} (h : HB R N) :
    EmbedsSuitable R G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, _, h1, h2, f, hf, -⟩ := h
  exact ⟨P, _, h1, h2, f, hf⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.HB.of_fg
statement:
theorem HB.of_fg {G : Type u} [Group G] (hG : EmbedsSuitable R G) {N : Subgroup G}
    (hN : N.FG) : HB R N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, _, h1, h2, f, hf⟩ := hG
  exact ⟨P, _, h1, h2, f, hf, N.map f, Subgroup.fg_map' f hN,
    Subgroup.comap_map_eq_self_of_injective hf N⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.HB.comap
statement:
theorem HB.comap {G₀ G : Type u} [Group G₀] [Group G] {N : Subgroup G} (h : HB R N)
    (g : G₀ →* G) (hg : Function.Injective g) : HB R (N.comap g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, _, h1, h2, f, hf, V, hV, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨P, _, h1, h2, f.comp g, hf.comp hg, V, hV, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.HB.map_equiv
statement:
theorem HB.map_equiv {G G' : Type u} [Group G] [Group G'] {N : Subgroup G} (h : HB R N)
    (e : G ≃* G') : HB R (N.map (e : G →* G'))
proof:
:= by
  have := h.comap (e.symm : G' →* G) e.symm.injective
  rwa [Subgroup.comap_equiv_eq_map_symm] at this

name: TheoremA.RelPres.HB.inf
statement:
theorem HB.inf {G : Type u} [Group G] {N₀ N₁ : Subgroup G} (h₀ : HB R N₀) (h₁ : HB R N₁) :
    HB R (N₀ ⊓ N₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P₀, _, a₀, b₀, f₀, hf₀, V₀, hV₀, rfl⟩ := h₀
  obtain ⟨P₁, _, a₁, b₁, f₁, hf₁, V₁, hV₁, rfl⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_prod a₀ b₀ a₁ b₁
  refine ⟨P₀ × P₁, _, c, d, f₀.prod f₁, fun x y hxy => hf₀ (congrArg Prod.fst hxy),
    V₀.prod V₁, Subgroup.fg_prod' hV₀ hV₁, ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp [Subgroup.mem_prod]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.HB.transfer
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, _, a, b, f, hf, V, hV, rfl⟩ := hN
  obtain ⟨Q, _, a', b', k, hk⟩ := hH
  have hki : Function.Injective (k.comp i) := hk.comp hi
  obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_amalg a b a' b' hGfg f (k.comp i)
  refine ⟨Amalg f (k.comp i), _, c, d, (Amalg.inr f (k.comp i)).comp k,
    (Amalg.inr_injective hf hki).comp hk, V.map (Amalg.inl f (k.comp i)),
    Subgroup.fg_map' _ hV, ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_comap, Subgroup.mem_map, MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hvx⟩
    have hmem : Amalg.inr f (k.comp i) (k x) ∈
        (Amalg.inl f (k.comp i)).range ⊓ (Amalg.inr f (k.comp i)).range :=
      ⟨⟨v, hvx⟩, ⟨k x, rfl⟩⟩
    rw [Amalg.range_inl_inf_range_inr hf hki] at hmem
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hmem
    have h1 : Amalg.inr f (k.comp i) (k (i g)) = Amalg.inr f (k.comp i) (k x) := by
      rw [← hg]; exact Amalg.inr_apply f (k.comp i) g
    have hx : i g = x := hk (Amalg.inr_injective hf hki h1)
    have h2 : Amalg.inl f (k.comp i) (f g) = Amalg.inl f (k.comp i) v := by
      rw [hvx, ← hg]; exact Amalg.inl_apply f (k.comp i) g
    have hv' : f g = v := Amalg.inl_injective hf hki h2
    exact ⟨g, show f g ∈ V by rw [hv']; exact hv, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨f g, hg, ?_⟩
    rw [Amalg.inl_apply]
    exact (Amalg.inr_apply f (k.comp i) g).symm

name: TheoremA.RelPres.exists_rawWord
statement:
theorem exists_rawWord (ψ : PresentedGroup S ≃* B) (b : B) :
    ∃ w : RawWord (Fin n), ψ (PresentedGroup.mk S w.eval) = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := PresentedGroup.mk_surjective S (ψ.symm b)
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := RawWord.eval_surjective x
  exact ⟨w, by rw [hx, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.wordFor_spec
statement:
theorem wordFor_spec (ψ : PresentedGroup S ≃* B) (b : B) :
    ψ (PresentedGroup.mk S (wordFor ψ b).eval) = b
proof:
:=
  (exists_rawWord ψ b).choose_spec

name: TheoremA.RelPres.eval_hnnGenRelator
statement:
theorem eval_hnnGenRelator (j : Fin m) :
    (hnnGenRelator φ a ψ j).eval = FreeGroup.of (stableLetter n) *
      FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd 1) (wordFor ψ (a j : B)).eval *
        (FreeGroup.of (stableLetter n))⁻¹ *
          (FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd 1) (wordFor ψ (φ (a j) : B)).eval)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hnnGenRelator, RawWord.eval_append, RawWord.eval_pos, RawWord.eval_neg,
    RawWord.eval_inv, RawWord.eval_rename]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnGen_rels
statement:
theorem hnnGen_rels : ∀ u ∈ hnnGenRelators φ a ψ,
    FreeGroup.lift (relGens ψ (of : B →* HNNExtension B A C φ) (hnnY φ)) u.eval = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hu
  rw [eval_hnnGenRelator]
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, lift_relGens_castAdd, wordFor_spec]
  have hT : relGens ψ (of : B →* HNNExtension B A C φ) (hnnY φ) (stableLetter n) = t := by
    simp [relGens, stableLetter, hnnY]
  rw [hT, t_mul_of, mul_inv_cancel_right, mul_inv_cancel]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnPres_conj_gen
statement:
theorem hnnPres_conj_gen (j : Fin m) :
    hnnPresT φ a ψ * relBase ψ 1 (hnnGenRelators φ a ψ) (a j : B) * (hnnPresT φ a ψ)⁻¹ =
      relBase ψ 1 (hnnGenRelators φ a ψ) (φ (a j) : B)
proof:
:= by
  have h := PresentedGroup.one_of_mem (rels := relExt S 1 (hnnGenRelators φ a ψ))
    (Or.inr ⟨_, List.mem_ofFn.2 ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ : (hnnGenRelator φ a ψ j).eval ∈ _)
  rw [eval_hnnGenRelator] at h
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv] at h
  rw [mul_inv_eq_one] at h
  rw [← wordFor_spec ψ (a j : B), ← wordFor_spec ψ (φ (a j) : B), relBase_mk, relBase_mk]
  exact h

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnPres_conj
statement:
theorem hnnPres_conj (ha : Subgroup.closure (Set.range a) = ⊤) (x : A) :
    hnnPresT φ a ψ * relBase ψ 1 (hnnGenRelators φ a ψ) (x : B) =
      relBase ψ 1 (hnnGenRelators φ a ψ) (φ x : B) * hnnPresT φ a ψ
proof:
:= by
  let f₁ : A →* HNNPres φ a ψ :=
    (MulAut.conj (hnnPresT φ a ψ)).toMonoidHom.comp ((relBase ψ 1 _).comp A.subtype)
  let f₂ : A →* HNNPres φ a ψ :=
    (relBase ψ 1 _).comp (C.subtype.comp φ.toMonoidHom)
  have hf : f₁ = f₂ := by
    apply MonoidHom.eq_of_eqOn_dense ha
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    simp only [f₁, f₂, MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply,
      Subgroup.coe_subtype]
    exact hnnPres_conj_gen φ a ψ j
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun hf x
  simp only [f₁, f₂, MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply,
    Subgroup.coe_subtype] at this
  rw [← this, inv_mul_cancel_right]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnGenPresEquiv_of_castAdd
statement:
theorem hnnGenPresEquiv_of_castAdd (ha : Subgroup.closure (Set.range a) = ⊤) (j : Fin n) :
    hnnGenPresEquiv φ a ψ ha (PresentedGroup.of (Fin.castAdd 1 j)) =
      HNNExtension.of (ψ (PresentedGroup.of j))
proof:
:=
  relPresEquiv_of_castAdd _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ j

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hnnGenPresEquiv_of_stable
statement:
theorem hnnGenPresEquiv_of_stable (ha : Subgroup.closure (Set.range a) = ⊤) :
    hnnGenPresEquiv φ a ψ ha (PresentedGroup.of (stableLetter n)) = t
proof:
:=
  relPresEquiv_of_natAdd _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 0

name: TheoremA.RelPres.exists_fin_generating_tuple
statement:
theorem exists_fin_generating_tuple {A : Type*} [Group A] (hA : Group.FG A) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : Fin m → A), Subgroup.closure (Set.range a) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Group.isMulFG_iff.mp hA
  refine ⟨s.card, fun i => (s.equivFin.symm i : A), ?_⟩
  rw [← hs]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Finset.mem_coe]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact (s.equivFin.symm i).2
  · intro hx; exact ⟨s.equivFin ⟨x, hx⟩, by simp⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ClassCR.hnn
statement:
theorem ClassCR.hnn {R : Set ℕ} {B : Type u} [Group B] (hB : ClassCR R B) {A C : Subgroup B}
    (φ : A ≃* C) (hA : Group.FG A) : ClassCR R (HNNExtension B A C φ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := hB
  obtain ⟨m, a, ha⟩ := exists_fin_generating_tuple hA
  exact classCR_of_relPres he _ (hnnGenPresEquiv φ a ψ ha)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.isFP_two_hnn_of_pres
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, a, ha⟩ := exists_fin_generating_tuple hA
  exact isFP_two_of_relPres ψ hB _ (hnnGenPresEquiv φ a ψ ha)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.classCR_isFP_two_hnn
statement:
theorem classCR_isFP_two_hnn {R : Set ℕ} {B : Type u} [Group B] (hB : ClassCR R B)
    (hB2 : IsFP 2 B) {A C : Subgroup B} (φ : A ≃* C) (hA : Group.FG A) :
    ClassCR R (HNNExtension B A C φ) ∧ IsFP 2 (HNNExtension B A C φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hB.hnn φ hA, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := hB
  exact isFP_two_hnn_of_pres ψ hB2 φ hA

name: TheoremA.RelPres.relBase_gen
statement:
theorem relBase_gen (ψ : PresentedGroup S ≃* B) (k : ℕ) (U : List (RawWord (Fin (n + k))))
    (i : Fin n) : relBase ψ k U (ψ (of i)) = of (Fin.castAdd k i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [relBase, relBaseAux, PresentedGroup.toGroup.of]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.relBase_mk
statement:
theorem relBase_mk (ψ : PresentedGroup S ≃* B) (k : ℕ) (U : List (RawWord (Fin (n + k))))
    (x : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    relBase ψ k U (ψ (PresentedGroup.mk S x)) =
      PresentedGroup.mk (relExt S k U) (FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd k) x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relBase, relBaseAux, MonoidHom.comp_apply, MonoidHom.coe_coe,
    MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply, toGroup_mk, lift_of_map_eq_mk]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.lift_relGens_castAdd
statement:
theorem lift_relGens_castAdd (ψ : PresentedGroup S ≃* B) (i : B →* E) (y : Fin k → E)
    (x : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    FreeGroup.lift (relGens ψ i y) (FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd k) x) =
      i (ψ (PresentedGroup.mk S x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_map']
  simp only [relGens, Fin.append_left]
  exact lift_presentation ψ i x

name: TheoremA.RelPres.relFwd_of
statement:
theorem relFwd_of (hU : ∀ u ∈ U, FreeGroup.lift (relGens ψ i y) u.eval = 1) (x : Fin (n + k)) :
    relFwd ψ i y U hU (of x) = relGens ψ i y x
proof:
:= by
  simp [relFwd, PresentedGroup.toGroup.of]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.relFwd_relBase
statement:
theorem relFwd_relBase (hU : ∀ u ∈ U, FreeGroup.lift (relGens ψ i y) u.eval = 1) (b : B) :
    relFwd ψ i y U hU (relBase ψ k U b) = i b
proof:
:= by
  have : (relFwd ψ i y U hU).comp (relBase ψ k U) = i := by
    apply hom_ext_presentation ψ
    intro j
    simp [relBase_gen, relFwd_of, relGens]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this b

name: TheoremA.RelPres.relPresEquiv_of_castAdd
statement:
theorem relPresEquiv_of_castAdd (hU) (β : E →* PresentedGroup (relExt S k U)) (hβi hβy hgen)
    (j : Fin n) :
    relPresEquiv ψ i y U hU β hβi hβy hgen (of (Fin.castAdd k j)) = i (ψ (of j))
proof:
:= by
  simp [relPresEquiv, relFwd_of, relGens]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.relPresEquiv_of_natAdd
statement:
theorem relPresEquiv_of_natAdd (hU) (β : E →* PresentedGroup (relExt S k U)) (hβi hβy hgen)
    (l : Fin k) :
    relPresEquiv ψ i y U hU β hβi hβy hgen (of (Fin.natAdd n l)) = y l
proof:
:= by
  simp [relPresEquiv, relFwd_of, relGens]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.classCR_of_relPres
proof:
:=
  ⟨n + k, extendEnum e (Fin.castAdd k) U, he.extendEnum _ _,
    ⟨(MulEquiv.cast (by rw [enumRelators_extendEnum]; rfl)).trans Φ⟩⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.classCR_of_relPres'
statement:
theorem classCR_of_relPres' {R : Set ℕ} {E : Type v} [Group E] {n k : ℕ}
    {e : ℕ →. RawWord (Fin n)} {S : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n))} (he : IsEnumerator R e)
    (hS : enumRelators e = S) (U : List (RawWord (Fin (n + k))))
    (Φ : PresentedGroup (relExt S k U) ≃* E) : ClassCR R E
proof:
:= by
  subst hS
  exact classCR_of_relPres he U Φ

name: TheoremA.RelPres.isFP_two_of_relPres
proof:
:= by
  have hS : IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S) := IsFP.of_mulEquiv ψ.symm hB
  have h := isFP_two_presentedGroup_subst_union_finite S (FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd k))
    (RawWord.eval '' {w | w ∈ U}) ((List.finite_toSet U).image _) hS
  exact IsFP.of_mulEquiv Φ h

name: TheoremA.RelPres.coprodFwd_of
statement:
theorem coprodFwd_of (x : Fin (n₀ + n₁)) :
    coprodFwd ψ₀ ψ₁ (of x) = coprodGens ψ₀ ψ₁ x
proof:
:= by
  simp [coprodFwd, PresentedGroup.toGroup.of]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.coprodPresEquiv_of_castAdd
statement:
theorem coprodPresEquiv_of_castAdd (j : Fin n₀) :
    coprodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁ (of (Fin.castAdd n₁ j)) = Monoid.Coprod.inl (ψ₀ (of j))
proof:
:= by
  simp [coprodPresEquiv, coprodFwd_of, coprodGens]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.coprodPresEquiv_of_natAdd
statement:
theorem coprodPresEquiv_of_natAdd (j : Fin n₁) :
    coprodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁ (of (Fin.natAdd n₀ j)) = Monoid.Coprod.inr (ψ₁ (of j))
proof:
:= by
  simp [coprodPresEquiv, coprodFwd_of, coprodGens]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.IsEnumerator.coprodEnum
proof:
:=
  (h₀.extendEnum _ _).mergeEnum (h₁.extendEnum _ _)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.enumRelators_coprodEnum
statement:
theorem enumRelators_coprodEnum {n₀ n₁ : ℕ} (e₀ : ℕ →. RawWord (Fin n₀))
    (e₁ : ℕ →. RawWord (Fin n₁)) :
    enumRelators (coprodEnum e₀ e₁) = coprodRels (enumRelators e₀) (enumRelators e₁)
proof:
:= by
  simp [coprodEnum, enumRelators_mergeEnum, enumRelators_extendEnum, coprodRels]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ClassCR.coprod
statement:
theorem ClassCR.coprod {R : Set ℕ} {B₀ B₁ : Type u} [Group B₀] [Group B₁] (h₀ : ClassCR R B₀)
    (h₁ : ClassCR R B₁) : ClassCR R (Monoid.Coprod B₀ B₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₀, e₀, he₀, ⟨ψ₀⟩⟩ := h₀
  obtain ⟨n₁, e₁, he₁, ⟨ψ₁⟩⟩ := h₁
  refine ⟨n₀ + n₁, coprodEnum e₀ e₁, he₀.coprodEnum he₁, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  rw [enumRelators_coprodEnum]
  exact coprodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁

name: TheoremA.RelPres.isFP_two_coprod_of_pres
proof:
:= by
  have := isFP_two_presentedGroup_two_sources_union_finite S₀ S₁
    (FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd n₁)) (FreeGroup.map (Fin.natAdd n₀)) ∅ Set.finite_empty
    (IsFP.of_mulEquiv ψ₀.symm h₀) (IsFP.of_mulEquiv ψ₁.symm h₁)
  rw [Set.union_empty] at this
  exact IsFP.of_mulEquiv (coprodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁) this

name: TheoremA.Coding.presentedGroupEmptyEquiv
statement:
theorem presentedGroupEmptyEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (PresentedGroup (∅ : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n))) ≃* FreeGroup (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have h : Subgroup.normalClosure (∅ : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n))) = ⊥ :=
    le_bot_iff.1 (Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal (Set.empty_subset _))
  exact ⟨(QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq h).trans QuotientGroup.quotientBot⟩

name: TheoremA.Coding.classCR_isFP_two_freeGroup
statement:
theorem classCR_isFP_two_freeGroup (n : ℕ) :
    ClassCR R (FreeGroup (Fin n)) ∧ IsFP 2 (FreeGroup (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := presentedGroupEmptyEquiv n
  refine ⟨⟨n, noneEnum, IsEnumerator.noneEnum, ⟨?_⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [enumRelators_noneEnum]; exact e
  · exact IsFP.of_mulEquiv e (isFP_two_presentedGroup_of_finite _ Set.finite_empty)

name: TheoremA.Coding.classCR_isFP_two_freeGroup'
statement:
theorem classCR_isFP_two_freeGroup' (X : Type) [Finite X] :
    ClassCR R (FreeGroup X) ∧ IsFP 2 (FreeGroup X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨eX⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin X
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_freeGroup (R := R) n
  exact ⟨h1.of_mulEquiv (FreeGroup.freeGroupCongr eX.symm),
    IsFP.of_mulEquiv (FreeGroup.freeGroupCongr eX.symm) h2⟩

name: TheoremA.Coding.classCR_isFP_two_coprodI
statement:
theorem classCR_isFP_two_coprodI (h₀ : ClassCR R B₀) (h₀' : IsFP 2 B₀) (h₁ : ClassCR R B₁)
    (h₁' : IsFP 2 B₁) :
    ClassCR R (CoprodI (amalgFam B₀ B₁)) ∧ IsFP 2 (CoprodI (amalgFam B₀ B₁))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_coprod h₀ h₀' h₁ h₁'
  exact ⟨c.of_mulEquiv coprodIEquiv.symm, IsFP.of_mulEquiv coprodIEquiv.symm d⟩

name: TheoremA.Coding.classCR_isFP_two_Fc
statement: theorem classCR_isFP_two_Fc : ClassCR R (Fc ℓ) ∧ IsFP 2 (Fc ℓ)
proof:
:=
  classCR_isFP_two_freeGroup' _

name: TheoremA.Coding.fg_Fc
statement: theorem fg_Fc : Group.FG (Fc ℓ)
proof: := (classCR_isFP_two_Fc (R := ∅)).1.fg

name: TheoremA.Coding.Q_zero
statement: theorem Q_zero (s : ℤ) : (Q s 0 : Fc ℓ) = c0 ^ s
proof: := by simp [Q]

name: TheoremA.Coding.Q_succ
statement: theorem Q_succ (s : ℤ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < ℓ) : (Q s (i + 1) : Fc ℓ) = Q s i * cc ⟨i, hi⟩ ^ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q, Q, List.prod_take_succ _ _ (by simpa using hi), mul_assoc]
  simp

name: TheoremA.Coding.Q_top
statement: theorem Q_top (s : ℤ) : (Q s ℓ : Fc ℓ) = c0 ^ s * Cs s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q, List.take_of_length_le (by simp)]; rfl

name: TheoremA.Coding.vv_eq_Q
statement: theorem vv_eq_Q (s : ℤ) : (vv s : Fc ℓ) = Q s ℓ * dd * ee ^ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q_top, vv]

name: TheoremA.Coding.psi_c0
statement: theorem psi_c0 (s : ℤ) : psi s (c0 : Fc ℓ) = c0
proof: := by simp [psi, c0]

name: TheoremA.Coding.psi_dd
statement: theorem psi_dd (s : ℤ) : psi s (dd : Fc ℓ) = Q s ℓ * dd * ee ^ s
proof: := by simp [psi, dd]

name: TheoremA.Coding.psi_ee
statement: theorem psi_ee (s : ℤ) : psi s (ee : Fc ℓ) = ee
proof: := by simp [psi, ee]

name: TheoremA.Coding.psi_cc
statement: theorem psi_cc (s : ℤ) (i : Fin ℓ) : psi s (cc i) = Q s i * cc i * (Q s i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [psi, cc]

name: TheoremA.Coding.psi_Q
statement:
theorem psi_Q (s r : ℤ) : ∀ i ≤ ℓ, psi s (Q r i : Fc ℓ) = Q (r + s) i * (Q s i)⁻¹
  | 0, _ => by
    rw [Q_zero, Q_zero, Q_zero, map_zpow, psi_c0, zpow_add]; group
  | i + 1, hi => by
    rw [Q_succ r (by omega), map_mul, psi_Q s r i (by omega), map_zpow, psi_cc, Q_succ _ (by omega),
      Q_succ _ (by omega)]
    simp only [conj_zpow, zpow_add]
    group

name: TheoremA.Coding.psi_vv
statement: theorem psi_vv (s r : ℤ) : psi s (vv r : Fc ℓ) = vv (r + s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vv_eq_Q, vv_eq_Q, map_mul, map_mul, psi_Q s r ℓ le_rfl, psi_dd, map_zpow, psi_ee, zpow_add]
  group

name: TheoremA.Coding.psi_comp
statement: theorem psi_comp (s r : ℤ) : (psi s).comp (psi r) = (psi (r + s) : Fc ℓ →* Fc ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  rcases k with k | i
  · fin_cases k
    · change psi s (psi r (c0 : Fc ℓ)) = psi (r + s) c0
      rw [psi_c0, psi_c0, psi_c0]
    · change psi s (psi r (dd : Fc ℓ)) = psi (r + s) dd
      rw [psi_dd, psi_dd, map_mul, map_mul, psi_Q s r ℓ le_rfl, psi_dd, map_zpow, psi_ee,
        zpow_add]
      group
    · change psi s (psi r (ee : Fc ℓ)) = psi (r + s) ee
      rw [psi_ee, psi_ee, psi_ee]
  · change psi s (psi r (cc i : Fc ℓ)) = psi (r + s) (cc i)
    rw [psi_cc, psi_cc, map_mul, map_mul, map_inv, psi_Q s r i (by omega), psi_cc]
    group

name: TheoremA.Coding.psi_zero
statement: theorem psi_zero : psi 0 = MonoidHom.id (Fc ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  rcases k with k | i
  · fin_cases k
    · exact psi_c0 0
    · change psi 0 (dd : Fc ℓ) = dd; rw [psi_dd, Q_top, Cs_zero]; simp
    · exact psi_ee 0
  · change psi 0 (cc i : Fc ℓ) = cc i; rw [psi_cc]; simp [Q]

name: TheoremA.Coding.psi_neg_psi
statement: theorem psi_neg_psi (x : Fc ℓ) : psi (-1) (psi 1 x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, psi_comp]; simp [psi_zero]

name: TheoremA.Coding.psi_injective
statement: theorem psi_injective : Function.Injective (psi 1 : Fc ℓ →* Fc ℓ)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective psi_neg_psi

name: TheoremA.Coding.psi_map_VZ
statement: theorem psi_map_VZ (s : ℤ) {x : Fc ℓ} (hx : x ∈ VZ ℓ) : psi s x ∈ VZ ℓ
proof:
:= by
  have : VZ ℓ ≤ (VZ ℓ).comap (psi s) := by
    rw [VZ, Subgroup.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
    show psi s (vv r : Fc ℓ) ∈ VZ ℓ
    rw [psi_vv]; exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨_, rfl⟩
  exact this hx

name: TheoremA.Coding.conj_EPsi
statement:
theorem conj_EPsi (x : Fc ℓ) :
    (t * of x * t⁻¹ : EPsi ℓ) = of (psi 1 x)
proof:
:=
  (equiv_eq_conj (φ := phiPsi ℓ) (⟨x, Subgroup.mem_top x⟩ : (⊤ : Subgroup (Fc ℓ)))).symm

name: TheoremA.Coding.hb_VZ
statement: theorem hb_VZ : HB R (VZ ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_Fc (R := R) (ℓ := ℓ)
  have htop : Group.FG (⊤ : Subgroup (Fc ℓ)) := (Group.fg_iff_subgroup_fg ⊤).2 (Group.fg_def.1 fg_Fc)
  obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_hnn c1 c2 (phiPsi ℓ) htop
  let V : Subgroup (EPsi ℓ) := Subgroup.closure {of dd, t}
  have hV : V.FG := by
    classical
    exact Subgroup.isMulFG_iff.mpr ⟨{of dd, t}, by simp [V]⟩
  refine ⟨EPsi ℓ, inferInstance, e1, e2, of, of_injective _, V, hV, ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hsub : V ≤ Subgroup.closure ((of '' (VZ ℓ : Set (Fc ℓ))) ∪ {t}) := by
      apply Subgroup.closure_mono
      rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
      · exact Or.inl ⟨dd, by rw [← vv_zero]; exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨0, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inr rfl
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwx⟩ := mem_of_mem_closure_invariant _ (VZ ℓ)
      (fun a ha => psi_map_VZ 1 ha)
      (fun b hb => by
        have key : psi 1 (((phiPsi ℓ).symm b : (⊤ : Subgroup (Fc ℓ))) : Fc ℓ) = (b : Fc ℓ) :=
          congrArg Subtype.val ((phiPsi ℓ).apply_symm_apply b)
        rw [← psi_neg_psi (((phiPsi ℓ).symm b : (⊤ : Subgroup (Fc ℓ))) : Fc ℓ), key]
        exact psi_map_VZ (-1) hb)
      (of x) (hsub hx) ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [of_injective _ hwx] at hw
    exact hw
  · rw [VZ, Subgroup.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
    show (of (vv r) : EPsi ℓ) ∈ V
    induction r using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [vv_zero]; exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
    | succ r ih =>
      rw [← psi_vv, ← conj_EPsi]
      exact V.mul_mem (V.mul_mem (Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)) ih)
        (V.inv_mem (Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)))
    | pred r ih =>
      have h := conj_EPsi (ℓ := ℓ) (vv (-(r : ℤ) - 1))
      rw [psi_vv, show -(r : ℤ) - 1 + 1 = -r by ring] at h
      have : (of (vv (-(r : ℤ) - 1)) : EPsi ℓ) = t⁻¹ * of (vv (-(r : ℤ))) * t := by
        rw [← h]; group
      rw [this]
      exact V.mul_mem (V.mul_mem (V.inv_mem (Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp))) ih)
        (Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp))

name: TheoremA.Coding.phiTw_apply
statement:
theorem phiTw_apply (x : Fc ℓ) :
    ((phiTw j ⟨kappa yU x, x, rfl⟩ : (kappa (yT j)).range) : KF (FreeGroup (Fin ℓ) × J)) =
      kappa (yT j) x
proof:
:= by
  have h : (MonoidHom.ofInjective (kappa_yU_injective (ℓ := ℓ) (J := J))).symm
      ⟨kappa yU x, x, rfl⟩ = x := by
    rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_eq]; rfl
  simp only [phiTw, MulEquiv.trans_apply, h]
  rfl

name: TheoremA.Coding.conj_MTw
statement:
theorem conj_MTw (x : Fc ℓ) :
    (t * of (kappa yU x) * t⁻¹ : MTw j) = of (kappa (yT j) x)
proof:
:= by
  have := equiv_eq_conj (φ := phiTw j)
    (⟨kappa yU x, x, rfl⟩ : (kappa (yU (ℓ := ℓ) (J := J))).range)
  rw [← this, phiTw_apply]

name: TheoremA.Coding.classCR_isFP_two_KF
statement:
theorem classCR_isFP_two_KF (h1 : ClassCR R J) (h2 : IsFP 2 J) :
    ClassCR R (KF (FreeGroup (Fin ℓ) × J)) ∧ IsFP 2 (KF (FreeGroup (Fin ℓ) × J))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_freeGroup (R := R) 3
  obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_freeGroup (R := R) ℓ
  obtain ⟨p1, p2⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_prod b1 b2 h1 h2
  exact classCR_isFP_two_coprodI a1 a2 p1 p2

name: TheoremA.Coding.classCR_isFP_two_MTw
statement:
theorem classCR_isFP_two_MTw (h1 : ClassCR R J) (h2 : IsFP 2 J) :
    ClassCR R (MTw j) ∧ IsFP 2 (MTw j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k1, k2⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_KF (ℓ := ℓ) h1 h2
  have hfg : Group.FG (kappa (yU (ℓ := ℓ) (J := J))).range := by
    rw [Group.fg_iff_subgroup_fg, MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
    exact Subgroup.fg_map' _ (Group.fg_def.1 fg_Fc)
  exact classCR_isFP_two_hnn k1 k2 (phiTw j) hfg

name: TheoremA.Coding.hb_VS
statement:
theorem hb_VS (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (h1 : ClassCR R J) (h2 : IsFP 2 J) (hD : ∀ s, Ys j s = 1 ↔ s ∈ S)
    (h0 : (0 : ℤ) ∈ S) : HB R (VS ℓ S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m1, m2⟩ := classCR_isFP_two_MTw j h1 h2
  let ι' : Fc ℓ →* MTw j := (of : _ →* MTw j).comp (kappa yU)
  have hι' : Function.Injective ι' := (of_injective _).comp kappa_yU_injective
  have hM : EmbedsSuitable R (MTw j) := ⟨MTw j, inferInstance, m1, m2, MonoidHom.id _,
    Function.injective_id⟩
  have hA := HB.transfer fg_Fc (hb_VZ (R := R) (ℓ := ℓ)) ι' hι' hM
  have hB := hA.map_equiv (MulAut.conj (t : MTw j))
  have hC : HB R ι'.range := HB.of_fg hM (by
    rw [MonoidHom.range_eq_map ι']; exact Subgroup.fg_map' _ (Group.fg_def.1 fg_Fc))
  have hE := (hB.inf hC).comap ι' hι'
  convert hE using 1
  ext y
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_comap, Subgroup.mem_inf, Subgroup.mem_map, MonoidHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨⟨ι' y, ⟨y, VS_le_VZ S hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, y, rfl⟩
    show t * ι' y * t⁻¹ = ι' y
    simp only [ι', MonoidHom.comp_apply]
    rw [conj_MTw, kappa_eq_of_mem_VS j hD hy]
  · rintro ⟨⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hxy⟩, -⟩
    change t * ι' x * t⁻¹ = ι' y at hxy
    simp only [ι', MonoidHom.comp_apply] at hxy
    rw [conj_MTw] at hxy
    have h3 := of_injective _ hxy
    have hxy' : x = y := by
      have := congrArg retr h3
      rwa [retr_apply_kappa _ (fun i => rfl), retr_apply_kappa _ (fun i => rfl)] at this
    subst hxy'
    exact mem_VS_of_kappa_eq hℓ j hD h0 hx h3

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeι₁_injective
statement: theorem ropeι₁_injective : Function.Injective (ropeι₁ N gC)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.fst h)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeι₂_injective
statement: theorem ropeι₂_injective : Function.Injective (ropeι₂ N gC hg)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.fst h)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropePhi_apply
statement:
theorem ropePhi_apply (l : ropeL N gC) :
    (ropePhi N gC hg ⟨ropeι₁ N gC l, ⟨l, rfl⟩⟩ : B × RopeQ N) = ropeι₂ N gC hg l
proof:
:= by
  have : (MonoidHom.ofInjective (ropeι₁_injective N gC)).symm ⟨ropeι₁ N gC l, ⟨l, rfl⟩⟩ = l :=
    (MulEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 (Subtype.ext (MonoidHom.ofInjective_apply _).symm)
  simp only [ropePhi, MulEquiv.trans_apply, this, MonoidHom.ofInjective_apply]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeK_conj
statement:
theorem ropeK_conj (l : ropeL N gC) :
    (t * of ((l : B), (1 : RopeQ N)) * t⁻¹ : RopeK N gC hg) =
      of ((l : B), ropeAlpha N gC hg l)
proof:
:= by
  have := equiv_eq_conj (φ := ropePhi N gC hg) ⟨ropeι₁ N gC l, ⟨l, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [ropePhi_apply] at this
  exact this.symm

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeQ_injective
statement:
theorem ropeQ_injective :
    Function.Injective ((of : B × RopeQ N →* RopeK N gC hg).comp (MonoidHom.inr B (RopeQ N)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidHom.coe_comp]
  exact (of_injective (φ := ropePhi N gC hg)).comp (fun _ _ h => congrArg Prod.snd h)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.eval_ropeXw
statement:
theorem eval_ropeXw (i : Fin d) : FreeGroup.lift (relGens ψ (ropeI N gC hg) (ropeY N gC hg))
    (ropeXw N gC ψ i).eval = ropeI N gC hg (ropeXB N gC i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ropeXw, RawWord.eval_rename, lift_relGens_castAdd, wordFor_spec]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.eval_ropeYw
statement:
theorem eval_ropeYw (i : Fin d) : FreeGroup.lift (relGens ψ (ropeI N gC hg) (ropeY N gC hg))
    (ropeYw N gC ψ i).eval = ropeI N gC hg (ropeYB N gC i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ropeYw, RawWord.eval_rename, lift_relGens_castAdd, wordFor_spec]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.relGens_ropeBL
statement:
theorem relGens_ropeBL (j : Fin n) :
    relGens ψ (ropeI N gC hg) (ropeY N gC hg) (ropeBL d j) = ropeI N gC hg (ψ (PresentedGroup.of j))
proof:
:= by
  simp [relGens, ropeBL]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.relGens_ropeZL
statement:
theorem relGens_ropeZL (i : Fin d) :
    relGens ψ (ropeI N gC hg) (ropeY N gC hg) (ropeZL n i) =
      of ((1 : B), ((FreeGroup.of i : FreeGroup (Fin d)) : RopeQ N))
proof:
:= by
  simp [relGens, ropeZL, ropeY]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.relGens_ropeSL
statement:
theorem relGens_ropeSL :
    relGens ψ (ropeI N gC hg) (ropeY N gC hg) (ropeSL n d) = t
proof:
:= by
  simp [relGens, ropeSL, ropeY]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeI_apply
statement: theorem ropeI_apply (b : B) : ropeI N gC hg b = of (b, 1)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeI_mul_z
statement:
theorem ropeI_mul_z (b : B) (q : RopeQ N) :
    ropeI N gC hg b * of ((1 : B), q) = (of (b, q) : RopeK N gC hg)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ropeI_apply, ← map_mul, Prod.mk_mul_mk, mul_one, one_mul]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeRels_hold
statement:
theorem ropeRels_hold : ∀ u ∈ ropeRels N gC ψ,
    FreeGroup.lift (relGens ψ (ropeI N gC hg) (ropeY N gC hg)) u.eval = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  simp only [ropeRels, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_ofFn,
    List.mem_finRange, true_and] at hu
  rcases hu with (⟨j, i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩) | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · simp only [ropeCommRel, RawWord.eval_append, RawWord.eval_pos, RawWord.eval_neg, map_mul,
      map_inv, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, relGens_ropeBL, relGens_ropeZL]
    rw [ropeI_apply, ← commutatorElement_def, commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute]
    exact Commute.map (Prod.ext (by simp) (by simp)) _
  · simp only [ropeXRel, RawWord.eval_append, RawWord.eval_pos, RawWord.eval_neg,
      RawWord.eval_inv, map_mul, map_inv, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, relGens_ropeSL,
      relGens_ropeZL, eval_ropeXw]
    rw [ropeI_mul_z, ropeI_apply,
      ropeK_conj N gC hg ⟨ropeXB N gC i, ropeXB_mem N gC i⟩, ropeAlpha_x, mul_inv_cancel]
  · simp only [ropeYRel, RawWord.eval_append, RawWord.eval_pos, RawWord.eval_neg,
      RawWord.eval_inv, map_mul, map_inv, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, relGens_ropeSL,
      eval_ropeYw]
    rw [ropeI_apply,
      ropeK_conj N gC hg ⟨ropeYB N gC i, ropeYB_mem N gC i⟩, ropeAlpha_y, mul_inv_cancel]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeRel_one
statement:
theorem ropeRel_one {u : RawWord (Fin (n + (d + 1)))} (hu : u ∈ ropeRels N gC ψ) :
    PresentedGroup.mk (relExt S (d + 1) (ropeRels N gC ψ)) u.eval = 1
proof:
:=
  PresentedGroup.one_of_mem (Or.inr ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeP_comm
statement:
theorem ropeP_comm (j : Fin n) (i : Fin d) :
    Commute (PresentedGroup.of (ropeBL d j) : RopeP N gC ψ) (ropeZP N gC ψ i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ropeRel_one N gC ψ (u := ropeCommRel j i) (by
    simp [ropeRels, List.mem_flatMap])
  simp only [ropeCommRel, RawWord.eval_append, RawWord.eval_pos, RawWord.eval_neg, map_mul,
    map_inv] at h
  rw [← commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute, commutatorElement_def]
  exact h

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeP_x
statement:
theorem ropeP_x (i : Fin d) : ropeSP N gC ψ * ropeBP N gC ψ (ropeXB N gC i) * (ropeSP N gC ψ)⁻¹ =
    ropeBP N gC ψ (ropeXB N gC i) * ropeZP N gC ψ i
proof:
:= by
  have h := ropeRel_one N gC ψ (u := ropeXRel N gC ψ i) (by simp [ropeRels])
  simp only [ropeXRel, ropeXw, RawWord.eval_append, RawWord.eval_pos, RawWord.eval_neg,
    RawWord.eval_inv, RawWord.eval_rename, map_mul, map_inv] at h
  rw [ropeBP, ← wordFor_spec ψ (ropeXB N gC i), relBase_mk]
  exact mul_inv_eq_one.1 h

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeP_y
statement:
theorem ropeP_y (i : Fin d) : ropeSP N gC ψ * ropeBP N gC ψ (ropeYB N gC i) * (ropeSP N gC ψ)⁻¹ =
    ropeBP N gC ψ (ropeYB N gC i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ropeRel_one N gC ψ (u := ropeYRel N gC ψ i) (by simp [ropeRels])
  simp only [ropeYRel, ropeYw, RawWord.eval_append, RawWord.eval_pos, RawWord.eval_neg,
    RawWord.eval_inv, RawWord.eval_rename, map_mul, map_inv] at h
  rw [ropeBP, ← wordFor_spec ψ (ropeYB N gC i), relBase_mk]
  exact mul_inv_eq_one.1 h

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeP_comm_gen_zeta
statement:
theorem ropeP_comm_gen_zeta (j : Fin n) (g : FreeGroup (Fin d)) :
    Commute (PresentedGroup.of (ropeBL d j) : RopeP N gC ψ) (ropeZeta N gC ψ g)
proof:
:= by
  have : (MulAut.conj (PresentedGroup.of (ropeBL d j) : RopeP N gC ψ)).toMonoidHom.comp (ropeZeta N gC ψ) =
      ropeZeta N gC ψ := by
    refine FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun i => ?_
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply, ropeZeta,
      FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
    rw [(ropeP_comm N gC ψ j i).eq, mul_inv_cancel_right]
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun this g
  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply] at h
  exact mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul.1 h

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeP_comm_bz
statement:
theorem ropeP_comm_bz (b : B) (g : FreeGroup (Fin d)) :
    Commute (ropeBP N gC ψ b) (ropeZeta N gC ψ g)
proof:
:= by
  have : (MulAut.conj (ropeZeta N gC ψ g)).toMonoidHom.comp (ropeBP N gC ψ) = ropeBP N gC ψ := by
    refine hom_ext_presentation ψ fun j => ?_
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply, ropeBP,
      relBase_gen]
    have c := ropeP_comm_gen_zeta N gC ψ j g
    simp only [ropeBL] at c
    rw [← c.eq, mul_inv_cancel_right]
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun this b
  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply] at h
  exact (mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul.1 h).symm

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeZeta_eq_one
statement: theorem ropeZeta_eq_one (r : FreeGroup (Fin d)) (hr : r ∈ N) : ropeZeta N gC ψ r = 1
proof:
:= by
  let bx := (ropeBP N gC ψ).comp (ropeXHom N gC)
  let by' := (ropeBP N gC ψ).comp (ropeYHom N gC)
  let h₁ := (MulAut.conj (ropeSP N gC ψ)).toMonoidHom.comp bx
  let h₂ := (bx.noncommCoprod (ropeZeta N gC ψ) (fun a b => ropeP_comm_bz N gC ψ _ b)).comp
    ((MonoidHom.id _).prod (MonoidHom.id _))
  let h₃ := (MulAut.conj (ropeSP N gC ψ)).toMonoidHom.comp by'
  have e₁₂ : h₁ = h₂ := by
    refine FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun i => ?_
    simp only [h₁, h₂, bx, MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply,
      MonoidHom.prod_apply, MonoidHom.id_apply, MonoidHom.noncommCoprod_apply, ropeXHom_of,
      ropeZeta, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
    exact ropeP_x N gC ψ i
  have e₃₄ : h₃ = by' := by
    refine FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun i => ?_
    simp only [h₃, by', MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply,
      ropeYHom_of]
    exact ropeP_y N gC ψ i
  have k₁ := DFunLike.congr_fun e₁₂ r
  have k₂ := DFunLike.congr_fun e₃₄ r
  simp only [h₁, h₂, h₃, bx, by', MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom,
    MulAut.conj_apply, MonoidHom.prod_apply, MonoidHom.id_apply,
    MonoidHom.noncommCoprod_apply] at k₁ k₂
  rw [ropeYHom_eq_of_mem N gC r hr] at k₂
  rw [k₂] at k₁
  exact mul_eq_left.1 k₁.symm

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeZetaQ_mk
statement:
theorem ropeZetaQ_mk (g : FreeGroup (Fin d)) :
    ropeZetaQ N gC ψ (g : RopeQ N) = ropeZeta N gC ψ g
proof: := QuotientGroup.lift_mk _ _ _

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeP_comm_bq
statement:
theorem ropeP_comm_bq (b : B) (q : RopeQ N) :
    Commute (ropeBP N gC ψ b) (ropeZetaQ N gC ψ q)
proof:
:= by
  induction q using QuotientGroup.induction_on with
  | H g => rw [ropeZetaQ_mk]; exact ropeP_comm_bz N gC ψ b g

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeβ₀_apply
statement:
theorem ropeβ₀_apply (b : B) (q : RopeQ N) :
    ropeβ₀ N gC ψ (b, q) = ropeBP N gC ψ b * ropeZetaQ N gC ψ q
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ropeβ₀_conj
statement:
theorem ropeβ₀_conj (l : ropeL N gC) :
    ropeSP N gC ψ * ropeBP N gC ψ l * (ropeSP N gC ψ)⁻¹ =
      ropeβ₀ N gC ψ (ropeι₂ N gC hg l)
proof:
:= by
  let F₁ := (MulAut.conj (ropeSP N gC ψ)).toMonoidHom.comp
    ((ropeBP N gC ψ).comp (ropeL N gC).subtype)
  let F₂ := (ropeβ₀ N gC ψ).comp (ropeι₂ N gC hg)
  have e : F₁ = F₂ := by
    refine MonoidHom.eq_of_eqOn_dense (ropeL_closure_gens N gC) ?_
    rintro ⟨x, hxL⟩ hx
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Subgroup.coe_subtype, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_range] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · simp only [F₁, F₂, MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply,
        Subgroup.coe_subtype, ropeι₂, MonoidHom.prod_apply, ropeβ₀_apply]
      rw [ropeP_x, ropeAlpha_x, ropeZetaQ_mk]
      simp [ropeZeta, ropeZP]
    · simp only [F₁, F₂, MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply,
        Subgroup.coe_subtype, ropeι₂, MonoidHom.prod_apply, ropeβ₀_apply]
      rw [ropeP_y, ropeAlpha_y, map_one, mul_one]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun e l

name: TheoremA.RelPres.rope_trick
statement:
theorem rope_trick {R : Set ℕ} {d : ℕ} (N : Subgroup (FreeGroup (Fin d))) [N.Normal]
    (hN : HB R N) : ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Group K), ClassCR R K ∧ IsFP 2 K ∧
      ∃ f : FreeGroup (Fin d) ⧸ N →* K, Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, _, hBC, hBF, gC, hg⟩ := hN.exists_centralizing_embedding
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := hBC
  let Φ := ropePresEquiv N gC hg ψ
  exact ⟨RopeK N gC hg, inferInstance, classCR_of_relPres he _ Φ,
    isFP_two_of_relPres ψ hBF _ Φ, _, ropeQ_injective N gC hg⟩

name: TheoremA.NF.lprod_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem lprod_nil : lprod ([] : List (Σ i, M i)) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.NF.lprod_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem lprod_cons (l : Σ i, M i) (L : List (Σ i, M i)) :
    lprod (l :: L) = CoprodI.of l.2 * lprod L
proof: := by simp [lprod]

name: TheoremA.NF.lprod_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem lprod_append (L L' : List (Σ i, M i)) :
    lprod (L ++ L') = lprod L * lprod L'
proof: := by simp [lprod]

name: TheoremA.NF.prod_toWord'
statement: theorem prod_toWord' (L : List (Σ i, M i)) (h : Red L) : (toWord' L h).prod = lprod L
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.NF.eq_of_lprod_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_lprod_eq {L L' : List (Σ i, M i)} (h : Red L) (h' : Red L')
    (he : lprod L = lprod L') : L = L'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : toWord' L h = toWord' L' h' := CoprodI.Word.equiv.symm.injective he
  exact congrArg CoprodI.Word.toList this

name: TheoremA.NF.exists_red
statement: theorem exists_red (x : CoprodI M) : ∃ L : List (Σ i, M i), Red L ∧ lprod L = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact ⟨(CoprodI.Word.equiv x).toList, ⟨(CoprodI.Word.equiv x).ne_one,
    (CoprodI.Word.equiv x).chain_ne⟩, CoprodI.Word.equiv.symm_apply_apply x⟩

name: TheoremA.NF.red_nil
statement: theorem red_nil : Red ([] : List (Σ i, M i))
proof: := ⟨by simp, List.IsChain.nil⟩

name: TheoremA.NF.red_singleton
statement: theorem red_singleton {i : ι} (m : M i) (hm : m ≠ 1) : Red [(⟨i, m⟩ : Σ i, M i)]
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simpa using hm, List.isChain_singleton _⟩

name: TheoremA.NF.Red.tail
statement: theorem Red.tail {l : Σ i, M i} {L : List (Σ i, M i)} (h : Red (l :: L)) : Red L
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x hx => h.1 x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx), h.2.tail⟩

name: TheoremA.NF.cmap_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem cmap_of (f : ∀ i, M i →* N i) {i : ι} (m : M i) :
    cmap f (CoprodI.of m) = CoprodI.of (f i m)
proof: := by simp [cmap]

name: TheoremA.NF.cmap_lprod
statement:
theorem cmap_lprod (f : ∀ i, M i →* N i) (L : List (Σ i, M i)) :
    cmap f (lprod L) = lprod (lmap f L)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp [lmap]
  | cons l L ih => simp [lmap, ih] at *

name: TheoremA.NF.red_lmap
statement:
theorem red_lmap {f : ∀ i, M i →* N i} (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f i))
    {L : List (Σ i, M i)} (h : Red L) : Red (lmap f L)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro l hl
    obtain ⟨l₀, hl₀, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hl
    exact fun h1 => h.1 l₀ hl₀ ((hf l₀.1) (by simpa using h1))
  · exact List.isChain_map_of_isChain (fun l : Σ i, M i => (⟨l.1, f l.1 l.2⟩ : Σ i, N i))
      (fun a b hab => hab) h.2

name: TheoremA.NF.lmap_injective
statement:
theorem lmap_injective {f : ∀ i, M i →* N i} (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f i)) :
    Function.Injective (lmap f)
proof:
:= by
  intro L L' h
  apply List.map_injective_iff.2 _ h
  rintro ⟨i, m⟩ ⟨j, m'⟩ he
  simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq] at he
  obtain ⟨rfl, he⟩ := he
  rw [heq_iff_eq] at he
  rw [hf i he]

name: TheoremA.NF.cmap_injective
statement:
theorem cmap_injective {f : ∀ i, M i →* N i} (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f i)) :
    Function.Injective (cmap f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩ := exists_red x
  obtain ⟨L', hL', rfl⟩ := exists_red y
  rw [cmap_lprod, cmap_lprod] at hxy
  rw [lmap_injective hf (eq_of_lprod_eq (red_lmap hf hL) (red_lmap hf hL') hxy)]

name: TheoremA.NF.mem_range_cmap_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_cmap_iff {f : ∀ i, M i →* N i} (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f i))
    {L : List (Σ i, N i)} (hL : Red L) :
    lprod L ∈ (cmap f).range ↔ ∀ l ∈ L, l.2 ∈ (f l.1).range
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀, rfl⟩ := exists_red x
    rw [cmap_lprod] at hx
    rw [← eq_of_lprod_eq (red_lmap hf hL₀) hL hx]
    intro l hl
    obtain ⟨l₀, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hl
    exact ⟨l₀.2, rfl⟩
  · intro h
    induction L with
    | nil => exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    | cons l L ih =>
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ih hL.tail (fun l' hl' => h l' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl'))
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h l (List.mem_cons_self)
      refine ⟨CoprodI.of m * y, ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, hy, cmap_of, hm, lprod_cons]

name: TheoremA.NF.lprod_optF
statement: theorem lprod_optF (a : P false) : lprod (optF a) = CoprodI.of a
proof:
:= by
  unfold optF; split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: TheoremA.NF.lprod_altL
statement:
theorem lprod_altL (a₀ : P false) (L : List (P true × P false)) :
    lprod (altL a₀ L) = altProd a₀ L
proof:
:= by
  induction L generalizing a₀ with
  | nil => simp [altL, altProd, lprod_optF]
  | cons p L ih => simp [altL, altProd, lprod_optF, ih, mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.NF.altL_head
statement:
theorem altL_head (a₀ : P false) (L : List (P true × P false)) (ha : a₀ ≠ 1) :
    (altL a₀ L).head? = some ⟨false, a₀⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases L <;> simp [altL, optF, ha]

name: TheoremA.NF.red_altL
statement:
theorem red_altL : ∀ (a₀ : P false) (L : List (P true × P false)), AltOK L → Red (altL a₀ L)
  | a₀, [], _ => by
    unfold altL optF; split_ifs with h
    · exact red_nil
    · exact red_singleton _ h
  | a₀, [p], h => by
    have h1 : p.1 ≠ 1
proof:
:= h
    rw [altL, altL]
    unfold optF
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro l hl
      split_ifs at hl with h2 h3 <;>
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.mem_cons,
          List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hl <;>
        rcases hl with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> assumption
    · split_ifs <;> simp
  | a₀, p :: q :: L, h => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
    have ih := red_altL p.2 (q :: L) h3
    have hhead := altL_head p.2 (q :: L) h2
    rw [altL]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro l hl
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hl with hl | hl
      · unfold optF at hl; split_ifs at hl with h4
        · simp at hl
        · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hl; subst hl; exact h4
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hl with rfl | hl
        · exact h1
        · exact ih.1 l hl
    · have hc : (⟨true, p.1⟩ :: altL p.2 (q :: L) : List (Σ b, P b)).IsChain
          (fun l l' => l.1 ≠ l'.1) := by
        obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T, altL p.2 (q :: L) = ⟨false, p.2⟩ :: T := by
          cases hA : altL p.2 (q :: L) with
          | nil => rw [hA] at hhead; simp at hhead
          | cons x T => rw [hA] at hhead; simp at hhead; exact ⟨T, by rw [← hhead]⟩
        rw [hT] at ih ⊢
        exact List.IsChain.cons_cons (by simp) ih.2
      unfold optF; split_ifs
      · simpa using hc
