      · exact List.IsChain.cons_cons (by simp) hc

name: TheoremA.NF.trueLetters_append
statement:
theorem trueLetters_append (L L' : List (Σ b, P b)) :
    trueLetters (L ++ L') = trueLetters L ++ trueLetters L'
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons l L ih => rcases l with ⟨_ | _, x⟩ <;> simp [trueLetters, ih]

name: TheoremA.NF.trueLetters_optF
statement: theorem trueLetters_optF (a : P false) : trueLetters (optF a) = []
proof:
:= by
  unfold optF; split_ifs <;> rfl

name: TheoremA.NF.trueLetters_altL
statement:
theorem trueLetters_altL (a₀ : P false) (L : List (P true × P false)) :
    trueLetters (altL a₀ L) = L.map Prod.fst
proof:
:= by
  induction L generalizing a₀ with
  | nil => simp [altL, trueLetters_optF]
  | cons p L ih => simp [altL, trueLetters_append, trueLetters_optF, trueLetters, ih]

name: TheoremA.NF.eq_of_altProd_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_altProd_eq {a₀ a₀' : P false} {L L' : List (P true × P false)} (h : AltOK L)
    (h' : AltOK L') (he : altProd a₀ L = altProd a₀' L') : L.map Prod.fst = L'.map Prod.fst
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lprod_altL, ← lprod_altL] at he
  have := eq_of_lprod_eq (red_altL _ _ h) (red_altL _ _ h') he
  rw [← trueLetters_altL a₀, this, trueLetters_altL]

name: TheoremA.NF.altProd_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem altProd_not_mem_range {a₀ : P false} {L : List (P true × P false)} (h : AltOK L)
    (hL : L ≠ []) (a : P false) : altProd a₀ L ≠ CoprodI.of a
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have he' : altProd a₀ L = altProd a [] := he
  rw [← lprod_altL, ← lprod_altL] at he'
  have := eq_of_lprod_eq (red_altL _ _ h) (red_altL a [] trivial) he'
  have h2 := congrArg trueLetters this
  rw [trueLetters_altL, trueLetters_altL] at h2
  exact hL (List.map_eq_nil_iff.1 h2)

name: TheoremA.NF.letters_reduce_subset
statement:
theorem letters_reduce_subset (L : List (X × Bool)) :
    ∀ p ∈ FreeGroup.reduce L, p ∈ L
proof:
:=
  fun _ hp => (FreeGroup.reduce.red).sublist.subset hp

name: TheoremA.NF.mem_closure_of_iff
statement:
theorem mem_closure_of_iff (A : Set X) (x : FreeGroup X) :
    x ∈ Subgroup.closure (FreeGroup.of '' A) ↔ ∀ p ∈ x.toWord, p.1 ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    induction hx using Subgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hy
      intro p hp
      rw [FreeGroup.toWord_of] at hp
      simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hp
      subst hp; exact ha
    | one => simp
    | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
      intro p hp
      rw [FreeGroup.toWord_mul] at hp
      rcases List.mem_append.1 (letters_reduce_subset _ p hp) with h | h
      · exact hy p h
      · exact hz p h
    | inv y _ hy =>
      intro p hp
      rw [FreeGroup.toWord_inv] at hp
      simp only [FreeGroup.invRev, List.mem_reverse, List.mem_map] at hp
      obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := hp
      exact hy q hq
  · intro h
    rw [← FreeGroup.mk_toWord (x := x)]
    suffices H : ∀ L : List (X × Bool), (∀ p ∈ L, p.1 ∈ A) →
        FreeGroup.mk L ∈ Subgroup.closure (FreeGroup.of '' A) from H _ h
    intro L hL
    induction L with
    | nil => exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    | cons p L ih =>
      rw [← List.singleton_append, ← FreeGroup.mul_mk]
      refine Subgroup.mul_mem _ ?_ (ih fun q hq => hL q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq))
      obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
      have ha : a ∈ A := hL (a, b) List.mem_cons_self
      cases b
      · have : (FreeGroup.mk [(a, false)] : FreeGroup X) = (FreeGroup.of a)⁻¹ := by
          show _ = (FreeGroup.mk [(a, true)])⁻¹
          rw [FreeGroup.inv_mk]; rfl
        rw [this]
        exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩)
      · exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.NF.closure_of_inf_closure_of
statement:
theorem closure_of_inf_closure_of (A B : Set X) :
    Subgroup.closure (FreeGroup.of '' A) ⊓ Subgroup.closure (FreeGroup.of '' B) =
      Subgroup.closure (FreeGroup.of '' (A ∩ B))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_inf, mem_closure_of_iff, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h p hp => ⟨h.1 p hp, h.2 p hp⟩, fun h => ⟨fun p hp => (h p hp).1,
    fun p hp => (h p hp).2⟩⟩

name: TheoremA.Britton.wprod_nil
statement: theorem wprod_nil (h : G) : wprod φ h [] = of h
proof: := by simp [wprod]

name: TheoremA.Britton.wprod_cons
statement:
theorem wprod_cons (h : G) (x : ℤˣ × G) (l : List (ℤˣ × G)) :
    wprod φ h (x :: l) = of h * (t ^ (x.1 : ℤ) * of x.2) * wprod φ 1 l
proof:
:= by
  simp [wprod, mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Britton.wprod_append
statement:
theorem wprod_append (h : G) (l₁ l₂ : List (ℤˣ × G)) :
    wprod φ h (l₁ ++ l₂) = wprod φ h l₁ * wprod φ 1 l₂
proof:
:= by
  simp [wprod, mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Britton.of_mul_wprod
statement:
theorem of_mul_wprod (k h : G) (l : List (ℤˣ × G)) :
    (of k : HNNExtension G A B φ) * wprod φ h l = wprod φ (k * h) l
proof:
:= by
  simp [wprod, mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Britton.wprod_concat_mul_of
statement:
theorem wprod_concat_mul_of (h : G) (L : List (ℤˣ × G)) (b : ℤˣ × G) (k : G) :
    wprod φ h (L ++ [b]) * of k = wprod φ h (L ++ [(b.1, b.2 * k)])
proof:
:= by
  simp [wprod, mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Britton.eq_nil_or_append_singleton
statement:
theorem eq_nil_or_append_singleton {α : Type*} (l : List α) :
    l = [] ∨ ∃ L b, l = L ++ [b]
proof:
:= by
  rcases l.eq_nil_or_concat with h | ⟨L, b, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr ⟨L, b, by simp [h]⟩

name: TheoremA.Britton.units_eq_neg_of_ne
statement: theorem units_eq_neg_of_ne {u v : ℤˣ} (h : u ≠ v) : v = -u
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or u with rfl | rfl <;> rcases Int.units_eq_one_or v with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp_all

name: TheoremA.Britton.isChain_of_no_pinch
statement:
theorem isChain_of_no_pinch : ∀ (l : List (ℤˣ × G)),
    (∀ l₁ u g g' l₂, l = l₁ ++ (u, g) :: (-u, g') :: l₂ → g ∉ toSubgroup A B u) →
    l.IsChain (fun a b => a.2 ∈ toSubgroup A B a.1 → a.1 = b.1)
  | [], _ => List.IsChain.nil
  | [_], _ => List.isChain_singleton _
  | a :: b :: l, H => by
    rw [List.isChain_cons_cons]
    refine ⟨fun ha => ?_, isChain_of_no_pinch (b :: l) fun l₁ u g g' l₂ h => ?_⟩
    · by_contra hne
      have hb
proof:
:= units_eq_neg_of_ne hne
      exact H [] a.1 a.2 b.2 l (by rw [← hb]; rfl) ha
    · exact H (a :: l₁) u g g' l₂ (by rw [h]; rfl)

name: TheoremA.Britton.exists_pinch
statement:
theorem exists_pinch {h : G} {l : List (ℤˣ × G)} (hl : l ≠ [])
    (hr : wprod φ h l ∈ (of : G →* HNNExtension G A B φ).range) :
    ∃ l₁ u g g' l₂, l = l₁ ++ (u, g) :: (-u, g') :: l₂ ∧ g ∈ toSubgroup A B u
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  push_neg at hne
  have hc := isChain_of_no_pinch l hne
  exact hl (ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range φ ⟨h, l, hc⟩ hr)

name: TheoremA.Britton.exists_wprod
statement:
theorem exists_wprod (x : HNNExtension G A B φ) : ∃ h l, wprod φ h l = x ∧
    l.IsChain (fun a b => a.2 ∈ toSubgroup A B a.1 → a.1 = b.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := TransversalPair.nonempty G A B
  exact ⟨((NormalWord.equiv φ d) x).head, ((NormalWord.equiv φ d) x).toList,
    (NormalWord.equiv φ d).symm_apply_apply x, ((NormalWord.equiv φ d) x).chain⟩

name: TheoremA.Britton.pinch_eq
statement:
theorem pinch_eq (u : ℤˣ) (g : G) (hg : g ∈ toSubgroup A B u) :
    ((u = 1 ∧ ∃ h : g ∈ A, (t ^ (u : ℤ) * of g * t ^ ((-u : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : HNNExtension G A B φ) =
        of (φ ⟨g, h⟩ : G)) ∨
      (u = -1 ∧ ∃ h : g ∈ B, (t ^ (u : ℤ) * of g * t ^ ((-u : ℤˣ) : ℤ) :
        HNNExtension G A B φ) = of (φ.symm ⟨g, h⟩ : G)))
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or u with rfl | rfl
  · exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, hg, by simpa using (equiv_eq_conj (φ := φ) ⟨g, hg⟩).symm⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, hg, by simpa using (equiv_symm_eq_conj (φ := φ) ⟨g, hg⟩).symm⟩

name: TheoremA.Britton.exists_mem_of_reduce
statement:
theorem exists_mem_of_reduce (W₀ : Subgroup G) (Good : G → List (ℤˣ × G) → Prop)
    (hnil : ∀ h, Good h [] → h ∈ W₀)
    (hred : ∀ h l₁ u g g' l₂, Good h (l₁ ++ (u, g) :: (-u, g') :: l₂) → g ∈ toSubgroup A B u →
      ∃ h' l', Good h' l' ∧ l'.length < (l₁ ++ (u, g) :: (-u, g') :: l₂).length ∧
        wprod φ h' l' = wprod φ h (l₁ ++ (u, g) :: (-u, g') :: l₂)) :
    ∀ h l, Good h l → wprod φ h l ∈ (of : G →* HNNExtension G A B φ).range →
      ∃ w ∈ W₀, (of w : HNNExtension G A B φ) = wprod φ h l
proof:
:= by
  intro h l
  induction hlen : l.length using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing h l with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro hg hr
  by_cases hl : l = []
  · subst hl; exact ⟨h, hnil h hg, (wprod_nil φ h).symm⟩
  · obtain ⟨l₁, u, g, g', l₂, rfl, hmem⟩ := exists_pinch φ hl hr
    obtain ⟨h', l', hg', hlt, heq⟩ := hred h l₁ u g g' l₂ hg hmem
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hweq⟩ := ih l'.length (hlen ▸ hlt) h' l' rfl hg' (heq ▸ hr)
    exact ⟨w, hw, hweq.trans heq⟩

name: TheoremA.Britton.wprod_pinch
statement:
theorem wprod_pinch (h : G) (l₁ : List (ℤˣ × G)) (u : ℤˣ) (g g' : G) (l₂ : List (ℤˣ × G))
    (k : G) (hk : (t ^ (u : ℤ) * of g * t ^ ((-u : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : HNNExtension G A B φ) = of k) :
    wprod φ h (l₁ ++ (u, g) :: (-u, g') :: l₂) = wprod φ h l₁ * of (k * g') * wprod φ 1 l₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [wprod_append, wprod_cons, wprod_cons, map_mul, ← hk]
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Britton.mem_of_mem_closure_invariant
statement:
theorem mem_of_mem_closure_invariant (W₀ : Subgroup G)
    (hA : ∀ a : A, (a : G) ∈ W₀ → (φ a : G) ∈ W₀)
    (hB : ∀ b : B, (b : G) ∈ W₀ → (φ.symm b : G) ∈ W₀) (x : HNNExtension G A B φ)
    (hx : x ∈ Subgroup.closure ((of '' (W₀ : Set G)) ∪ {t}))
    (hxr : x ∈ (of : G →* HNNExtension G A B φ).range) :
    ∃ w ∈ W₀, (of w : HNNExtension G A B φ) = x
proof:
:= by
  let Good : G → List (ℤˣ × G) → Prop := fun h l => h ∈ W₀ ∧ ∀ p ∈ l, p.2 ∈ W₀
  have hrep : ∃ h l, Good h l ∧ wprod φ h l = x := by
    clear hxr
    induction hx using Subgroup.closure_induction_left with
    | one => exact ⟨1, [], ⟨W₀.one_mem, by simp⟩, by simp [wprod]⟩
    | mul_left y hy z _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨h, l, ⟨hh, hl⟩, rfl⟩ := ih
      rcases hy with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ | rfl
      · exact ⟨w * h, l, ⟨W₀.mul_mem hw hh, hl⟩, (of_mul_wprod φ w h l).symm⟩
      · refine ⟨1, (1, h) :: l, ⟨W₀.one_mem, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · rintro p (_ | ⟨_, hp⟩); exacts [hh, hl p hp]
        · rw [wprod_cons]; simp [wprod, mul_assoc]
    | inv_mul_cancel y hy z _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨h, l, ⟨hh, hl⟩, rfl⟩ := ih
      rcases hy with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ | rfl
      · exact ⟨w⁻¹ * h, l, ⟨W₀.mul_mem (W₀.inv_mem hw) hh, hl⟩, by
          rw [← of_mul_wprod, map_inv]⟩
      · refine ⟨1, (-1, h) :: l, ⟨W₀.one_mem, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · rintro p (_ | ⟨_, hp⟩); exacts [hh, hl p hp]
        · rw [wprod_cons]; simp [wprod, mul_assoc]
  obtain ⟨h, l, hg, rfl⟩ := hrep
  refine exists_mem_of_reduce φ W₀ Good (fun h hh => hh.1) ?_ h l hg hxr
  intro h l₁ u g g' l₂ ⟨hh, hl⟩ hgu
  have hgW : g ∈ W₀ := hl (u, g) (by simp)
  have hg'W : g' ∈ W₀ := hl (-u, g') (by simp)
  obtain ⟨k, hkW, hk⟩ : ∃ k ∈ W₀, (t ^ (u : ℤ) * of g * t ^ ((-u : ℤˣ) : ℤ) :
      HNNExtension G A B φ) = of k := by
    rcases pinch_eq φ u g hgu with ⟨-, h1, e⟩ | ⟨-, h1, e⟩
    · exact ⟨_, hA ⟨g, h1⟩ hgW, e⟩
    · exact ⟨_, hB ⟨g, h1⟩ hgW, e⟩
  rw [wprod_pinch φ h l₁ u g g' l₂ k hk]
  have hl₁ : ∀ p ∈ l₁, p.2 ∈ W₀ := fun p hp => hl p (by simp [hp])
  have hl₂ : ∀ p ∈ l₂, p.2 ∈ W₀ := fun p hp => hl p (by simp [hp])
  rcases eq_nil_or_append_singleton l₁ with rfl | ⟨L, b, rfl⟩
  · refine ⟨h * (k * g'), l₂, ⟨W₀.mul_mem hh (W₀.mul_mem hkW hg'W), hl₂⟩, by simp, ?_⟩
    rw [wprod_nil, ← map_mul, of_mul_wprod, mul_one]
  · refine ⟨h, L ++ [(b.1, b.2 * (k * g'))] ++ l₂, ⟨hh, ?_⟩, by simp, ?_⟩
    · intro p hp
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hp
      rcases hp with (hp | rfl) | hp
      · exact hl₁ p (by simp [hp])
      · exact W₀.mul_mem (hl₁ b (by simp)) (W₀.mul_mem hkW hg'W)
      · exact hl₂ p hp
    · rw [wprod_append, wprod_concat_mul_of]

name: TheoremA.Britton.pairList_nil
statement: theorem pairList_nil : pairList ([] : List (G × G)) = []
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Britton.pairList_cons
statement:
theorem pairList_cons (p : G × G) (m : List (G × G)) :
    pairList (p :: m) = ((1 : ℤˣ), p.1) :: ((-1 : ℤˣ), p.2) :: pairList m
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Britton.pairList_append
statement:
theorem pairList_append (m₁ m₂ : List (G × G)) :
    pairList (m₁ ++ m₂) = pairList m₁ ++ pairList m₂
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairList]

name: TheoremA.Britton.pairList_decomp
statement:
theorem pairList_decomp : ∀ (m : List (G × G)) (l₁ l₂ : List (ℤˣ × G)) (a b : ℤˣ × G),
    pairList m = l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂ →
    (∃ m₁ p m₂, m = m₁ ++ p :: m₂ ∧ l₁ = pairList m₁ ∧ a = (1, p.1) ∧ b = (-1, p.2) ∧
        l₂ = pairList m₂) ∨
    (∃ m₁ p q m₂, m = m₁ ++ p :: q :: m₂ ∧ l₁ = pairList m₁ ++ [(1, p.1)] ∧ a = (-1, p.2) ∧
        b = (1, q.1) ∧ l₂ = (-1, q.2) :: pairList m₂)
  | [], l₁, l₂, a, b, h => by cases l₁ <;> simp [pairList_nil] at h
  | p :: m, [], l₂, a, b, h => by
    rw [pairList_cons] at h
    simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
proof:
:= h
    exact Or.inl ⟨[], p, m, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | p :: m, [c], l₂, a, b, h => by
    rw [pairList_cons] at h
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, h⟩ := h
    cases m with
    | nil => simp [pairList_nil] at h
    | cons q m' =>
      rw [pairList_cons] at h
      simp only [List.cons.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
      exact Or.inr ⟨[], p, q, m', rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | p :: m, c :: d :: l₁, l₂, a, b, h => by
    rw [pairList_cons] at h
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, h⟩ := h
    rcases pairList_decomp m l₁ l₂ a b h with ⟨m₁, q, m₂, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ |
      ⟨m₁, q, r, m₂, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨p :: m₁, q, m₂, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨p :: m₁, q, r, m₂, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.Britton.toSubgroup_self
statement: theorem toSubgroup_self (u : ℤˣ) : toSubgroup V V u = V
proof:
:= by
  unfold toSubgroup; split_ifs <;> rfl

name: TheoremA.Britton.conj_centralizing
statement:
theorem conj_centralizing (u : ℤˣ) (g : G) (hg : g ∈ V) :
    (t ^ (u : ℤ) * of g * t ^ ((-u : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : HNNExtension G V V (MulEquiv.refl V)) = of g
proof:
:= by
  rcases pinch_eq (MulEquiv.refl V) u g (by rw [toSubgroup_self]; exact hg) with
    ⟨-, _, e⟩ | ⟨-, _, e⟩ <;> simpa using e

name: TheoremA.Britton.mem_of_mem_closure_centralizing
statement:
theorem mem_of_mem_closure_centralizing (X W₀ : Subgroup G) (hXV : X ⊓ V ≤ W₀)
    (hWV : W₀ ⊓ V ≤ X) (x : HNNExtension G V V (MulEquiv.refl V))
    (hx : x ∈ Subgroup.closure ((of '' (W₀ : Set G)) ∪
      ((fun y => t * of y * t⁻¹) '' (X : Set G))))
    (hxr : x ∈ (of : G →* HNNExtension G V V (MulEquiv.refl V)).range) :
    ∃ w ∈ W₀, (of w : HNNExtension G V V (MulEquiv.refl V)) = x
proof:
:= by
  let φ := MulEquiv.refl V
  let Good : G → List (ℤˣ × G) → Prop := fun h l => h ∈ W₀ ∧
    ∃ m : List (G × G), l = pairList m ∧ ∀ p ∈ m, p.1 ∈ X ∧ p.2 ∈ W₀
  have hrep : ∃ h l, Good h l ∧ wprod φ h l = x := by
    clear hxr
    induction hx using Subgroup.closure_induction_left with
    | one => exact ⟨1, [], ⟨W₀.one_mem, [], rfl, by simp⟩, by simp [wprod]⟩
    | mul_left y hy z _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨h, l, ⟨hh, m, rfl, hm⟩, rfl⟩ := ih
      rcases hy with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ | ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨w * h, _, ⟨W₀.mul_mem hw hh, m, rfl, hm⟩, (of_mul_wprod φ w h _).symm⟩
      · refine ⟨1, pairList ((y, h) :: m), ⟨W₀.one_mem, (y, h) :: m, rfl, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · rintro p (_ | ⟨_, hp⟩); exacts [⟨hy, hh⟩, hm p hp]
        · rw [pairList_cons, wprod_cons, wprod_cons]; simp [wprod, mul_assoc]; try rfl
    | inv_mul_cancel y hy z _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨h, l, ⟨hh, m, rfl, hm⟩, rfl⟩ := ih
      rcases hy with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ | ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨w⁻¹ * h, _, ⟨W₀.mul_mem (W₀.inv_mem hw) hh, m, rfl, hm⟩, by
          rw [← of_mul_wprod, map_inv]⟩
      · refine ⟨1, pairList ((y⁻¹, h) :: m), ⟨W₀.one_mem, (y⁻¹, h) :: m, rfl, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · rintro p (_ | ⟨_, hp⟩); exacts [⟨X.inv_mem hy, hh⟩, hm p hp]
        · rw [pairList_cons, wprod_cons, wprod_cons]; simp [wprod, mul_assoc]; try rfl
  obtain ⟨h, l, hg, rfl⟩ := hrep
  refine exists_mem_of_reduce φ W₀ Good (fun h hh => hh.1) ?_ h l hg hxr
  rintro h l₁ u g g' l₂ ⟨hh, m, hml, hm⟩ hgu
  rw [toSubgroup_self] at hgu
  rcases pairList_decomp m l₁ l₂ (u, g) (-u, g') hml.symm with
    ⟨m₁, p, m₂, rfl, rfl, hua, hub, rfl⟩ | ⟨m₁, p, q, m₂, rfl, rfl, hua, hub, rfl⟩
  · 
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hua hub
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hua
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := hub
    have hp := hm p (by simp)
    have hpW : p.1 ∈ W₀ := hXV ⟨hp.1, hgu⟩
    rw [wprod_pinch φ h _ 1 p.1 p.2 _ p.1 (conj_centralizing V 1 p.1 hgu)]
    have hm₁ : ∀ r ∈ m₁, r.1 ∈ X ∧ r.2 ∈ W₀ := fun r hr => hm r (by simp [hr])
    have hm₂ : ∀ r ∈ m₂, r.1 ∈ X ∧ r.2 ∈ W₀ := fun r hr => hm r (by simp [hr])
    rcases eq_nil_or_append_singleton m₁ with rfl | ⟨M, r, rfl⟩
    · refine ⟨h * (p.1 * p.2), pairList m₂, ⟨W₀.mul_mem hh (W₀.mul_mem hpW hp.2), m₂, rfl, hm₂⟩,
        by simp [pairList_nil], ?_⟩
      rw [pairList_nil, wprod_nil, ← map_mul, of_mul_wprod, mul_one]
    · have hr := hm₁ r (by simp)
      refine ⟨h, pairList (M ++ (r.1, r.2 * (p.1 * p.2)) :: m₂),
        ⟨hh, M ++ (r.1, r.2 * (p.1 * p.2)) :: m₂, rfl, ?_⟩,
        by simp [pairList_append, pairList_cons, pairList_nil], ?_⟩
      · intro s hs
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at hs
        rcases hs with hs | rfl | hs
        · exact hm₁ s (by simp [hs])
        · exact ⟨hr.1, W₀.mul_mem hr.2 (W₀.mul_mem hpW hp.2)⟩
        · exact hm₂ s hs
      · rw [pairList_append, pairList_append, pairList_cons, pairList_cons, pairList_nil]
        have e1 : pairList M ++ [((1 : ℤˣ), r.1), ((-1 : ℤˣ), r.2)] =
            (pairList M ++ [((1 : ℤˣ), r.1)]) ++ [((-1 : ℤˣ), r.2)] := by simp
        have e2 : pairList M ++ ((1 : ℤˣ), r.1) :: ((-1 : ℤˣ), r.2 * (p.1 * p.2)) ::
            pairList m₂ = ((pairList M ++ [((1 : ℤˣ), r.1)]) ++
              [((-1 : ℤˣ), r.2 * (p.1 * p.2))]) ++ pairList m₂ := by simp
        rw [e1, wprod_concat_mul_of, e2, wprod_append]
  · 
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hua hub
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hua
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := hub
    have hp := hm p (by simp)
    have hq := hm q (by simp)
    have hpX : p.2 ∈ X := hWV ⟨hp.2, hgu⟩
    have hm₁ : ∀ r ∈ m₁, r.1 ∈ X ∧ r.2 ∈ W₀ := fun r hr => hm r (by simp [hr])
    have hm₂ : ∀ r ∈ m₂, r.1 ∈ X ∧ r.2 ∈ W₀ := fun r hr => hm r (by simp [hr])
    refine ⟨h, pairList (m₁ ++ (p.1 * p.2 * q.1, q.2) :: m₂),
      ⟨hh, m₁ ++ (p.1 * p.2 * q.1, q.2) :: m₂, rfl, ?_⟩,
      by simp [pairList_append, pairList_cons], ?_⟩
    · intro s hs
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at hs
      rcases hs with hs | rfl | hs
      · exact hm₁ s (by simp [hs])
      · exact ⟨X.mul_mem (X.mul_mem hp.1 hpX) hq.1, hq.2⟩
      · exact hm₂ s hs
    · rw [wprod_pinch φ h _ (-1) p.2 q.1 _ p.2 (conj_centralizing V (-1) p.2 hgu)]
      rw [pairList_append, pairList_cons, wprod_append, wprod_append, wprod_cons, wprod_cons,
        wprod_cons]
      simp [mul_assoc, wprod_nil]

name: TheoremA.Britton.hnnMap_of
statement: theorem hnnMap_of (g : G) : hnnMap φ φ' f hfA hφ (of g) = of (f g)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hnnMap]

name: TheoremA.Britton.hnnMap_t
statement: theorem hnnMap_t : hnnMap φ φ' f hfA hφ t = t
proof:
:= by
  simp [hnnMap]

name: TheoremA.Britton.hnnMap_wprod
statement:
theorem hnnMap_wprod (h : G) (l : List (ℤˣ × G)) :
    hnnMap φ φ' f hfA hφ (wprod φ h l) = wprod φ' (f h) (l.map fun p => (p.1, f p.2))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wprod, map_mul, hnnMap_of, map_list_prod, List.map_map]
  congr 2
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro x _
  simp [hnnMap_of, hnnMap_t]

name: TheoremA.Britton.hnnMap_injective
statement:
theorem hnnMap_injective (hf : Function.Injective f) (hA' : ∀ g, f g ∈ A' → g ∈ A)
    (hB' : ∀ g, f g ∈ B' → g ∈ B) : Function.Injective (hnnMap φ φ' f hfA hφ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨h, l, rfl, hc⟩ := exists_wprod φ x
  rw [hnnMap_wprod] at hx
  have hc' : (l.map fun p => (p.1, f p.2)).IsChain
      (fun a b => a.2 ∈ toSubgroup A' B' a.1 → a.1 = b.1) := by
    rw [List.isChain_map]
    refine hc.imp fun a b hab ha => hab ?_
    rcases Int.units_eq_one_or a.1 with h1 | h1 <;> rw [h1] at ha ⊢
    · exact hA' _ ha
    · exact hB' _ ha
  have hnil := ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range φ'
    ⟨f h, l.map fun p => (p.1, f p.2), hc'⟩ ⟨1, by rw [map_one]; exact hx.symm⟩
  simp only [List.map_eq_nil_iff] at hnil
  subst hnil
  simp only [List.map_nil, wprod_nil] at hx
  rw [wprod_nil]
  have : f h = 1 := of_injective (φ := φ') (by rw [hx, map_one])
  rw [hf (this.trans (map_one f).symm), map_one]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.coprodToProd_surjective
statement: theorem coprodToProd_surjective : Function.Surjective (coprodToProd (B₀ := B₀) (B₁ := B₁))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  exact ⟨Monoid.Coprod.inl x * Monoid.Coprod.inr y, by simp [coprodToProd]⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.prodBase_inl_gen
statement:
theorem prodBase_inl_gen (j : Fin n₀) :
    prodBase ψ₀ ψ₁ (Monoid.Coprod.inl (ψ₀ (of j))) = of (lftL n₀ n₁ j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coprodPresEquiv_of_castAdd ψ₀ ψ₁ j, prodBase, relBase_gen]; rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.prodBase_inr_gen
statement:
theorem prodBase_inr_gen (j : Fin n₁) :
    prodBase ψ₀ ψ₁ (Monoid.Coprod.inr (ψ₁ (of j))) = of (rgtL n₀ n₁ j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coprodPresEquiv_of_natAdd ψ₀ ψ₁ j, prodBase, relBase_gen]; rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.prodBase_commute
statement:
theorem prodBase_commute (x : B₀) (y : B₁) :
    Commute (prodBase ψ₀ ψ₁ (Monoid.Coprod.inl x)) (prodBase ψ₀ ψ₁ (Monoid.Coprod.inr y))
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := closure_range_presentation ψ₀
  have h1 := closure_range_presentation ψ₁
  have key2 : ∀ x ∈ Set.range fun j => ψ₀ (of j), ∀ y : B₁,
      Commute (prodBase ψ₀ ψ₁ (Monoid.Coprod.inl x)) (prodBase ψ₀ ψ₁ (Monoid.Coprod.inr y)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨j₀, rfl⟩ y
    have hy : y ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range fun j => ψ₁ (of j)) := h1 ▸ Subgroup.mem_top y
    induction hy using Subgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨j₁, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [prodBase_inl_gen, prodBase_inr_gen]
      have hmem : (commRel (lftL n₀ n₁ j₀) (rgtL n₀ n₁ j₁)).eval ∈
          relExt (coprodRels S₀ S₁) 0 (prodRelators n₀ n₁) :=
        Or.inr ⟨_, List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨j₀, List.mem_finRange _,
          List.mem_map.2 ⟨j₁, List.mem_finRange _, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
      have h := PresentedGroup.one_of_mem hmem
      rw [eval_commRel, map_commutatorElement] at h
      exact commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute.1 h
    | one => simp only [map_one]; exact Commute.one_right _
    | mul y z _ _ ihy ihz => rw [map_mul, map_mul]; exact ihy.mul_right ihz
    | inv y _ ih => rw [map_inv, map_inv]; exact ih.inv_right
  have hx : x ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range fun j => ψ₀ (of j)) := h0 ▸ Subgroup.mem_top x
  induction hx using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact key2 x hx y
  | one => simp only [map_one]; exact Commute.one_left _
  | mul x z _ _ ihx ihz => rw [map_mul, map_mul]; exact ihx.mul_left ihz
  | inv x _ ih => rw [map_inv, map_inv]; exact ih.inv_left

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ClassCR.prod
statement:
theorem ClassCR.prod {R : Set ℕ} {B₀ B₁ : Type u} [Group B₀] [Group B₁] (h₀ : ClassCR R B₀)
    (h₁ : ClassCR R B₁) : ClassCR R (B₀ × B₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₀, e₀, he₀, ⟨ψ₀⟩⟩ := h₀
  obtain ⟨n₁, e₁, he₁, ⟨ψ₁⟩⟩ := h₁
  exact classCR_of_relPres' (he₀.coprodEnum he₁) (enumRelators_coprodEnum e₀ e₁) _
    (prodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.isFP_two_prod_of_pres
proof:
:=
  isFP_two_of_relPres (coprodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁) (isFP_two_coprod_of_pres ψ₀ ψ₁ h₀ h₁) _
    (prodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.classCR_isFP_two_prod
statement:
theorem classCR_isFP_two_prod {R : Set ℕ} {B₀ B₁ : Type u} [Group B₀] [Group B₁]
    (h₀ : ClassCR R B₀) (h₀' : IsFP 2 B₀) (h₁ : ClassCR R B₁) (h₁' : IsFP 2 B₁) :
    ClassCR R (B₀ × B₁) ∧ IsFP 2 (B₀ × B₁)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h₀.prod h₁, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n₀, e₀, he₀, ⟨ψ₀⟩⟩ := h₀
  obtain ⟨n₁, e₁, he₁, ⟨ψ₁⟩⟩ := h₁
  exact isFP_two_prod_of_pres ψ₀ ψ₁ h₀' h₁'

name: TheoremA.RelPres.classCR_isFP_two_coprod
statement:
theorem classCR_isFP_two_coprod {R : Set ℕ} {B₀ B₁ : Type u} [Group B₀] [Group B₁]
    (h₀ : ClassCR R B₀) (h₀' : IsFP 2 B₀) (h₁ : ClassCR R B₁) (h₁' : IsFP 2 B₁) :
    ClassCR R (Monoid.Coprod B₀ B₁) ∧ IsFP 2 (Monoid.Coprod B₀ B₁)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h₀.coprod h₁, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n₀, e₀, he₀, ⟨ψ₀⟩⟩ := h₀
  obtain ⟨n₁, e₁, he₁, ⟨ψ₁⟩⟩ := h₁
  exact isFP_two_coprod_of_pres ψ₀ ψ₁ h₀' h₁'

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Amalg.inl_comp
statement: theorem Amalg.inl_comp : (Amalg.inl f₀ f₁).comp f₀ = Amalg.base f₀ f₁
proof:
:=
  Monoid.PushoutI.of_comp_eq_base (φ := amalgHom f₀ f₁) false

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Amalg.inr_comp
statement: theorem Amalg.inr_comp : (Amalg.inr f₀ f₁).comp f₁ = Amalg.base f₀ f₁
proof:
:=
  Monoid.PushoutI.of_comp_eq_base (φ := amalgHom f₀ f₁) true

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Amalg.inl_apply
statement: theorem Amalg.inl_apply (d : D) : Amalg.inl f₀ f₁ (f₀ d) = Amalg.base f₀ f₁ d
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (Amalg.inl_comp f₀ f₁) d

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Amalg.inr_apply
statement: theorem Amalg.inr_apply (d : D) : Amalg.inr f₀ f₁ (f₁ d) = Amalg.base f₀ f₁ d
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (Amalg.inr_comp f₀ f₁) d

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Amalg.lift_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem Amalg.lift_inl {K : Type*} [Group K] (g₀ : B₀ →* K) (g₁ : B₁ →* K)
    (h : g₀.comp f₀ = g₁.comp f₁) (x : B₀) :
    Amalg.lift f₀ f₁ g₀ g₁ h (Amalg.inl f₀ f₁ x) = g₀ x
proof:
:=
  Monoid.PushoutI.lift_of (φ := amalgHom f₀ f₁) (amalgLiftFam g₀ g₁) (g₀.comp f₀) _
    (i := false) x

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Amalg.lift_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem Amalg.lift_inr {K : Type*} [Group K] (g₀ : B₀ →* K) (g₁ : B₁ →* K)
    (h : g₀.comp f₀ = g₁.comp f₁) (x : B₁) :
    Amalg.lift f₀ f₁ g₀ g₁ h (Amalg.inr f₀ f₁ x) = g₁ x
proof:
:=
  Monoid.PushoutI.lift_of (φ := amalgHom f₀ f₁) (amalgLiftFam g₀ g₁) (g₀.comp f₀) _
    (i := true) x

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Amalg.hom_ext
proof:
:=
  Monoid.PushoutI.hom_ext_nonempty (fun b => match b with | true => h₁ | false => h₀)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.amalgHom_injective
statement:
theorem amalgHom_injective (h₀ : Function.Injective f₀) (h₁ : Function.Injective f₁) :
    ∀ b, Function.Injective (amalgHom f₀ f₁ b)
  | true => h₁
  | false => h₀

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Amalg.inl_injective
statement:
theorem Amalg.inl_injective (h₀ : Function.Injective f₀) (h₁ : Function.Injective f₁) :
    Function.Injective (Amalg.inl f₀ f₁)
proof:
:=
  Monoid.PushoutI.of_injective (amalgHom_injective h₀ h₁) false

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Amalg.inr_injective
statement:
theorem Amalg.inr_injective (h₀ : Function.Injective f₀) (h₁ : Function.Injective f₁) :
    Function.Injective (Amalg.inr f₀ f₁)
proof:
:=
  Monoid.PushoutI.of_injective (amalgHom_injective h₀ h₁) true

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Amalg.base_injective
statement:
theorem Amalg.base_injective (h₀ : Function.Injective f₀) (h₁ : Function.Injective f₁) :
    Function.Injective (Amalg.base f₀ f₁)
proof:
:=
  Monoid.PushoutI.base_injective (amalgHom_injective h₀ h₁)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Amalg.range_inl_inf_range_inr
statement:
theorem Amalg.range_inl_inf_range_inr (h₀ : Function.Injective f₀)
    (h₁ : Function.Injective f₁) :
    (Amalg.inl f₀ f₁).range ⊓ (Amalg.inr f₀ f₁).range = (Amalg.base f₀ f₁).range
proof:
:=
  Monoid.PushoutI.inf_of_range_eq_base_range (amalgHom_injective h₀ h₁) Bool.false_ne_true

name: TheoremA.RelPres.coprodPres_mk_castAdd
statement:
theorem coprodPres_mk_castAdd (x : FreeGroup (Fin n₀)) :
    coprodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁ (PresentedGroup.mk _ (FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd n₁) x)) =
      Monoid.Coprod.inl (ψ₀ (PresentedGroup.mk S₀ x))
proof:
:= by
  have : ((coprodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁ : _ →* Monoid.Coprod B₀ B₁).comp
      ((PresentedGroup.mk (coprodRels S₀ S₁)).comp (FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd n₁)))) =
      (Monoid.Coprod.inl : B₀ →* _).comp ((ψ₀ : _ →* B₀).comp (PresentedGroup.mk S₀)) :=
    FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun j => by
      simpa [PresentedGroup.of] using coprodPresEquiv_of_castAdd ψ₀ ψ₁ j
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this x

name: TheoremA.RelPres.coprodPres_mk_natAdd
statement:
theorem coprodPres_mk_natAdd (x : FreeGroup (Fin n₁)) :
    coprodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁ (PresentedGroup.mk _ (FreeGroup.map (Fin.natAdd n₀) x)) =
      Monoid.Coprod.inr (ψ₁ (PresentedGroup.mk S₁ x))
proof:
:= by
  have : ((coprodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁ : _ →* Monoid.Coprod B₀ B₁).comp
      ((PresentedGroup.mk (coprodRels S₀ S₁)).comp (FreeGroup.map (Fin.natAdd n₀)))) =
      (Monoid.Coprod.inr : B₁ →* _).comp ((ψ₁ : _ →* B₁).comp (PresentedGroup.mk S₁)) :=
    FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun j => by
      simpa [PresentedGroup.of] using coprodPresEquiv_of_natAdd ψ₀ ψ₁ j
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this x

name: TheoremA.RelPres.eval_amalgRelator
statement:
theorem eval_amalgRelator (j : Fin m) :
    (amalgRelator f₀ f₁ ψ₀ ψ₁ d j).eval = FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd 0)
      (FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd n₁) (wordFor ψ₀ (f₀ (d j))).eval *
        (FreeGroup.map (Fin.natAdd n₀) (wordFor ψ₁ (f₁ (d j))).eval)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [amalgRelator, RawWord.eval_rename, RawWord.eval_append, RawWord.eval_inv, map_mul,
    map_inv]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.amalgBase_gen_eq
statement:
theorem amalgBase_gen_eq (j : Fin m) :
    amalgBase f₀ f₁ ψ₀ ψ₁ d (Monoid.Coprod.inl (f₀ (d j))) =
      amalgBase f₀ f₁ ψ₀ ψ₁ d (Monoid.Coprod.inr (f₁ (d j)))
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : (amalgRelator f₀ f₁ ψ₀ ψ₁ d j).eval ∈
      relExt (coprodRels S₀ S₁) 0 (amalgRelators f₀ f₁ ψ₀ ψ₁ d) :=
    Or.inr ⟨_, List.mem_ofFn.2 ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have h := PresentedGroup.one_of_mem hmem
  rw [eval_amalgRelator, ← relBase_mk (coprodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁)] at h
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv, coprodPres_mk_castAdd, coprodPres_mk_natAdd, wordFor_spec] at h
  exact mul_inv_eq_one.1 h

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ClassCR.amalg
statement:
theorem ClassCR.amalg {R : Set ℕ} {B₀ B₁ : Type u} [Group B₀] [Group B₁] {D : Type v} [Group D]
    (h₀ : ClassCR R B₀) (h₁ : ClassCR R B₁) (hD : Group.FG D) (f₀ : D →* B₀) (f₁ : D →* B₁) :
    ClassCR R (Amalg f₀ f₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₀, e₀, he₀, ⟨ψ₀⟩⟩ := h₀
  obtain ⟨n₁, e₁, he₁, ⟨ψ₁⟩⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨m, d, hd⟩ := exists_fin_generating_tuple hD
  exact classCR_of_relPres' (he₀.coprodEnum he₁) (enumRelators_coprodEnum e₀ e₁) _
    (amalgPresEquiv f₀ f₁ ψ₀ ψ₁ d hd)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.isFP_two_amalg_of_pres
statement:
theorem isFP_two_amalg_of_pres {B₀ B₁ : Type u} [Group B₀] [Group B₁] {D : Type v} [Group D]
    {n₀ n₁ : ℕ} {S₀ : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n₀))} {S₁ : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n₁))}
    (ψ₀ : PresentedGroup S₀ ≃* B₀) (ψ₁ : PresentedGroup S₁ ≃* B₁) (h₀ : IsFP 2 B₀)
    (h₁ : IsFP 2 B₁) (hD : Group.FG D) (f₀ : D →* B₀) (f₁ : D →* B₁) :
    IsFP 2 (Amalg f₀ f₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, d, hd⟩ := exists_fin_generating_tuple hD
  exact isFP_two_of_relPres (coprodPresEquiv ψ₀ ψ₁) (isFP_two_coprod_of_pres ψ₀ ψ₁ h₀ h₁) _
    (amalgPresEquiv f₀ f₁ ψ₀ ψ₁ d hd)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.classCR_isFP_two_amalg
statement:
theorem classCR_isFP_two_amalg {R : Set ℕ} {B₀ B₁ : Type u} [Group B₀] [Group B₁] {D : Type v}
    [Group D] (h₀ : ClassCR R B₀) (h₀' : IsFP 2 B₀) (h₁ : ClassCR R B₁) (h₁' : IsFP 2 B₁)
    (hD : Group.FG D) (f₀ : D →* B₀) (f₁ : D →* B₁) :
    ClassCR R (Amalg f₀ f₁) ∧ IsFP 2 (Amalg f₀ f₁)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h₀.amalg h₁ hD f₀ f₁, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n₀, e₀, he₀, ⟨ψ₀⟩⟩ := h₀
  obtain ⟨n₁, e₁, he₁, ⟨ψ₁⟩⟩ := h₁
  exact isFP_two_amalg_of_pres ψ₀ ψ₁ h₀' h₁' hD f₀ f₁

name: TheoremA.presSubstHom_compat
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_presGens]
  exact PresentedGroup.toGroup.of _

name: TheoremA.relatorBoundary_subst_mem_span
statement:
theorem relatorBoundary_subst_mem_span {S : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n))}
    {S' : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m))} (θ : FreeGroup (Fin n) →* FreeGroup (Fin m))
    (h : ∀ r ∈ S, θ r ∈ S') (T : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)))
    (hT : ∀ r ∈ S, wordBoundary (presGens S) r ∈
      Submodule.span (ZG (PresentedGroup S)) (wordBoundary (presGens S) '' T))
    {r : FreeGroup (Fin n)} (hr : r ∈ S) :
    wordBoundary (presGens S') (θ r) ∈
      Submodule.span (ZG (PresentedGroup S')) (wordBoundary (presGens S') '' (θ '' T))
proof:
:=
  wordBoundary_subst_mem_span (presSubstHom θ h) (presGens S) (presGens S') θ
    (presSubstHom_compat θ h) T (hT r hr)

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_presentedGroup_subst_union_finite
statement:
theorem isFP_two_presentedGroup_subst_union_finite (S : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)))
    (θ : FreeGroup (Fin n) →* FreeGroup (Fin m)) (U : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m)))
    (hU : U.Finite) (hS : IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S)) :
    IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup (θ '' S ∪ U))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hTfin, hTS, hT⟩ := (isFP_two_iff_all_relator_boundaries_mem_finite_span S).mp hS
  have hθ : ∀ r ∈ S, θ r ∈ θ '' S ∪ U := fun r hr => Or.inl ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  refine (isFP_two_iff_all_relator_boundaries_mem_finite_span _).mpr
    ⟨θ '' T ∪ U, (hTfin.image θ).union hU, Set.union_subset_union (Set.image_mono hTS) le_rfl,
      ?_⟩
  rintro _ (⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ | hu)
  · exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono Set.subset_union_left)
      (relatorBoundary_subst_mem_span θ hθ T hT hr)
  · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, Or.inr hu, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_presentedGroup_union_finite
statement:
theorem isFP_two_presentedGroup_union_finite (S U : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n))) (hU : U.Finite)
    (hS : IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S)) : IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup (S ∪ U))
proof:
:= by
  have := isFP_two_presentedGroup_subst_union_finite S (MonoidHom.id _) U hU hS
  rwa [MonoidHom.coe_id, Set.image_id] at this

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_presentedGroup_castAdd_union_finite
statement:
theorem isFP_two_presentedGroup_castAdd_union_finite (k : ℕ) (S : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)))
    (U : Set (FreeGroup (Fin (n + k)))) (hU : U.Finite) (hS : IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S)) :
    IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup (FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd k) '' S ∪ U))
proof:
:=
  isFP_two_presentedGroup_subst_union_finite S (FreeGroup.map (Fin.castAdd k)) U hU hS

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_presentedGroup_two_sources_union_finite
statement:
theorem isFP_two_presentedGroup_two_sources_union_finite {n₀ n₁ : ℕ}
    (S₀ : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n₀))) (S₁ : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n₁)))
    (θ₀ : FreeGroup (Fin n₀) →* FreeGroup (Fin m)) (θ₁ : FreeGroup (Fin n₁) →* FreeGroup (Fin m))
    (U : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m))) (hU : U.Finite)
    (h₀ : IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S₀)) (h₁ : IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S₁)) :
    IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup (θ₀ '' S₀ ∪ θ₁ '' S₁ ∪ U))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀fin, hT₀S, hT₀⟩ := (isFP_two_iff_all_relator_boundaries_mem_finite_span S₀).mp h₀
  obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁fin, hT₁S, hT₁⟩ := (isFP_two_iff_all_relator_boundaries_mem_finite_span S₁).mp h₁
  have hθ₀ : ∀ r ∈ S₀, θ₀ r ∈ θ₀ '' S₀ ∪ θ₁ '' S₁ ∪ U :=
    fun r hr => Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
  have hθ₁ : ∀ r ∈ S₁, θ₁ r ∈ θ₀ '' S₀ ∪ θ₁ '' S₁ ∪ U :=
    fun r hr => Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
  refine (isFP_two_iff_all_relator_boundaries_mem_finite_span _).mpr
    ⟨θ₀ '' T₀ ∪ θ₁ '' T₁ ∪ U, ((hT₀fin.image θ₀).union (hT₁fin.image θ₁)).union hU,
      Set.union_subset_union
        (Set.union_subset_union (Set.image_mono hT₀S) (Set.image_mono hT₁S)) le_rfl, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ((⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ | ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩) | hu)
  · exact Submodule.span_mono
      (Set.image_mono (Set.subset_union_left.trans Set.subset_union_left))
      (relatorBoundary_subst_mem_span θ₀ hθ₀ T₀ hT₀ hr)
  · exact Submodule.span_mono
      (Set.image_mono (Set.subset_union_right.trans Set.subset_union_left))
      (relatorBoundary_subst_mem_span θ₁ hθ₁ T₁ hT₁ hr)
  · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, Or.inr hu, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.boundaryAct_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem boundaryAct_apply (V : Type v) [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZG G) V] (g : G)
    (w : Multiplicative V) :
    boundaryAct V g w = Multiplicative.ofAdd (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G g • w.toAdd)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.BdExt.left_mul
statement:
theorem BdExt.left_mul {V : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZG G) V] (a b : BdExt G V) :
    (a * b).left.toAdd = a.left.toAdd + MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G a.right • b.left.toAdd
proof:
:= by
  rw [SemidirectProduct.mul_left]; rfl

name: TheoremA.BdExt.map_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem BdExt.map_left {V W : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZG G) V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZG G) W] (f : V →ₗ[ZG G] W) (a : BdExt G V) :
    (BdExt.map f a).left.toAdd = f a.left.toAdd
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.BdExt.map_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem BdExt.map_right {V W : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZG G) V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZG G) W] (f : V →ₗ[ZG G] W) (a : BdExt G V) :
    (BdExt.map f a).right = a.right
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.right_wordHom
statement:
theorem right_wordHom (x : Fin n → G) (u : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    (wordHom x u).right = FreeGroup.lift x u
proof:
:= by
  have : SemidirectProduct.rightHom.comp (wordHom x) = FreeGroup.lift x := by
    ext i; simp [wordHom]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this u

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_one
statement: @[simp] theorem wordBoundary_one (x : Fin n → G) : wordBoundary x 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordBoundary]

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordBoundary_of (x : Fin n → G) (i : Fin n) :
    wordBoundary x (FreeGroup.of i) = stdBasis G i
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordBoundary, wordHom]

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_mul
statement:
theorem wordBoundary_mul (x : Fin n → G) (u w : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    wordBoundary x (u * w) =
      wordBoundary x u + MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G (FreeGroup.lift x u) • wordBoundary x w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wordBoundary, map_mul, BdExt.left_mul, right_wordHom]

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_inv
statement:
theorem wordBoundary_inv (x : Fin n → G) (u : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    wordBoundary x u⁻¹ =
      -(MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G (FreeGroup.lift x u)⁻¹ • wordBoundary x u)
proof:
:= by
  have h := wordBoundary_mul x u⁻¹ u
  rw [inv_mul_cancel, wordBoundary_one, map_inv] at h
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h.symm

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_of_inv
statement:
theorem wordBoundary_of_inv (x : Fin n → G) (i : Fin n) :
    wordBoundary x (FreeGroup.of i)⁻¹ = -(MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G (x i)⁻¹ • stdBasis G i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordBoundary_inv, wordBoundary_of, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]

name: TheoremA.genBoundary_wordBoundary
statement:
theorem genBoundary_wordBoundary (x : Fin n → G) (u : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    genBoundary x (wordBoundary x u) = gm1 (FreeGroup.lift x u)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using FreeGroup.induction_on with
  | one => rw [wordBoundary_one, map_zero, map_one, gm1, map_one, sub_self]
  | of i => rw [wordBoundary_of, genBoundary_single, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
  | inv_of i _ =>
    rw [wordBoundary_of_inv, map_neg, map_smul, genBoundary_single, (FreeGroup.lift x).map_inv,
      FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
    simp only [gm1, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one, mul_one]
    abel
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [wordBoundary_mul, map_add, map_smul, ha, hb, map_mul]
    simp only [gm1, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub, map_mul, mul_one]
    abel

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_conj
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordBoundary_mul, wordBoundary_mul, wordBoundary_inv, map_mul, hr, mul_one,
    smul_neg, smul_smul, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one, one_smul]
  abel

name: TheoremA.rawBoundary_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem rawBoundary_nil (x : Fin n → G) : rawBoundary x [] = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [rawBoundary]

name: TheoremA.rawBoundary_append
statement:
theorem rawBoundary_append (x : Fin n → G) (v w : RawWord (Fin n)) :
    rawBoundary x (v ++ w) = rawBoundary x v +
      MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G (FreeGroup.lift x (RawWord.eval v)) • rawBoundary x w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rawBoundary, RawWord.eval_append, wordBoundary_mul]

name: TheoremA.rawBoundary_inv
statement:
theorem rawBoundary_inv (x : Fin n → G) (w : RawWord (Fin n)) :
    rawBoundary x (RawWord.inv w) =
      -(MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G (FreeGroup.lift x (RawWord.eval w))⁻¹ • rawBoundary x w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rawBoundary, RawWord.eval_inv, wordBoundary_inv]

name: TheoremA.rawBoundary_pos
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawBoundary_pos (x : Fin n → G) (i : Fin n) :
    rawBoundary x [(i, true)] = stdBasis G i
proof:
:= by
  simp [rawBoundary]

name: TheoremA.rawBoundary_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawBoundary_neg (x : Fin n → G) (i : Fin n) :
    rawBoundary x [(i, false)] = -(MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G (x i)⁻¹ • stdBasis G i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rawBoundary, RawWord.eval_neg, wordBoundary_of_inv]

name: TheoremA.genBoundary_rawBoundary
statement:
theorem genBoundary_rawBoundary (x : Fin n → G) (w : RawWord (Fin n)) :
    genBoundary x (rawBoundary x w) = gm1 (FreeGroup.lift x (RawWord.eval w))
proof:
:=
  genBoundary_wordBoundary x _

name: TheoremA.exists_finset_subset_span_eq_of_fg
statement:
theorem exists_finset_subset_span_eq_of_fg {R M : Type*} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Module R M] {U : Set M} (h : (Submodule.span R U).FG) :
    ∃ U₀ : Finset M, ↑U₀ ⊆ U ∧ Submodule.span R (U₀ : Set M) = Submodule.span R U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h
  have key : ∀ y ∈ s, ∃ T : Finset M, ↑T ⊆ U ∧ y ∈ Submodule.span R (T : Set M) :=
    fun y hy => Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span (hs ▸ Submodule.subset_span hy)
  choose T hTU hyT using key
  have hsub : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ s), (T y hy : Set M) ⊆ ↑(s.attach.biUnion fun z => T z.1 z.2) :=
    fun y hy => by
      intro m hm
      simp only [Finset.coe_biUnion, Finset.coe_attach, Set.mem_univ, Set.iUnion_true,
        Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hm⟩
  refine ⟨s.attach.biUnion fun z => T z.1 z.2, ?_, le_antisymm (Submodule.span_mono ?_) ?_⟩
  · intro m hm
    simp only [Finset.coe_biUnion, Finset.coe_attach, Set.mem_univ, Set.iUnion_true,
      Set.mem_iUnion] at hm
    obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hm⟩ := hm
    exact hTU y hy hm
  · intro m hm
    simp only [Finset.coe_biUnion, Finset.coe_attach, Set.mem_univ, Set.iUnion_true,
      Set.mem_iUnion] at hm
    obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hm⟩ := hm
    exact hTU y hy hm
  · rw [← hs, Submodule.span_le]
    intro y hy
    exact Submodule.span_mono (hsub y hy) (hyT y hy)

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_iff_finite_relator_boundaries
statement:
theorem isFP_two_iff_finite_relator_boundaries :
    IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S) ↔
      ∃ T : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)), T.Finite ∧ T ⊆ S ∧
        LinearMap.ker (genBoundary (presGens S)) =
          Submodule.span (ZG (PresentedGroup S)) (wordBoundary (presGens S) '' T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isFP_two_iff_fg_ker_genBoundary _ (PresentedGroup.closure_range_of S)]
  constructor
  · intro hfg
    rw [ker_genBoundary_eq_span_relatorBoundary] at hfg ⊢
    obtain ⟨U₀, hU₀, hspan⟩ := exists_finset_subset_span_eq_of_fg hfg
    obtain ⟨T, hTS, rfl⟩ := Finset.subset_set_image_iff.mp hU₀
    exact ⟨T, T.finite_toSet, hTS, by rw [← hspan, Finset.coe_image]⟩
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, -, hker⟩
    rw [hker]
    exact Submodule.fg_span (hT.image _)

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_iff_all_relator_boundaries_mem_finite_span
statement:
theorem isFP_two_iff_all_relator_boundaries_mem_finite_span :
    IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S) ↔
      ∃ T : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)), T.Finite ∧ T ⊆ S ∧
        ∀ r ∈ S, wordBoundary (presGens S) r ∈
          Submodule.span (ZG (PresentedGroup S)) (wordBoundary (presGens S) '' T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isFP_two_iff_finite_relator_boundaries]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, hTS, hker⟩
    refine ⟨T, hT, hTS, fun r hr => ?_⟩
    rw [← hker, ker_genBoundary_eq_span_relatorBoundary]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, hTS, hmem⟩
    refine ⟨T, hT, hTS, ?_⟩
    rw [ker_genBoundary_eq_span_relatorBoundary]
    refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono hTS))
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    exact hmem r hr

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_presentedGroup_of_finite
statement: theorem isFP_two_presentedGroup_of_finite (hS : S.Finite) : IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S)
proof:
:=
  (isFP_two_iff_finite_relator_boundaries S).mpr
    ⟨S, hS, subset_rfl, ker_genBoundary_eq_span_relatorBoundary S⟩

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_mul_of_lift_eq_one
statement:
theorem wordBoundary_mul_of_lift_eq_one {u : FreeGroup (Fin n)} (w : FreeGroup (Fin n))
    (hu : FreeGroup.lift x u = 1) :
    wordBoundary x (u * w) = wordBoundary x u + wordBoundary x w
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordBoundary_mul, hu, map_one, one_smul]

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_inv_of_lift_eq_one
statement:
theorem wordBoundary_inv_of_lift_eq_one {u : FreeGroup (Fin n)} (hu : FreeGroup.lift x u = 1) :
    wordBoundary x u⁻¹ = -wordBoundary x u
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordBoundary_inv, hu, inv_one, map_one, one_smul]

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_commutator_of_lift_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  have hu' : FreeGroup.lift x u⁻¹ = 1 := by rw [map_inv, hu, inv_one]
  have hw' : FreeGroup.lift x w⁻¹ = 1 := by rw [map_inv, hw, inv_one]
  have huw : FreeGroup.lift x (u * w) = 1 := by rw [map_mul, hu, hw, one_mul]
  have huwu : FreeGroup.lift x (u * w * u⁻¹) = 1 := by rw [map_mul, huw, hu', one_mul]
  rw [commutatorElement_def, wordBoundary_mul_of_lift_eq_one x _ huwu,
    wordBoundary_mul_of_lift_eq_one x _ huw, wordBoundary_mul_of_lift_eq_one x _ hu,
    wordBoundary_inv_of_lift_eq_one x hu, wordBoundary_inv_of_lift_eq_one x hw]
  abel

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_mem_span_of_mem_normalClosure
statement:
theorem wordBoundary_mem_span_of_mem_normalClosure (T : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)))
    (hT : ∀ r ∈ T, FreeGroup.lift x r = 1) {u : FreeGroup (Fin n)}
    (hu : u ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure T) :
    wordBoundary x u ∈ Submodule.span (ZG G) (wordBoundary x '' T)
proof:
:= by
  have hker : Subgroup.normalClosure T ≤ (FreeGroup.lift x).ker :=
    Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal (fun r hr => (FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.2 (hT r hr))
  rw [Subgroup.normalClosure] at hu hker
  induction hu using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem v hv =>
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hc⟩ := Group.mem_conjugatesOfSet_iff.1 hv
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := isConj_iff.1 hc
    rw [wordBoundary_conj x c (hT r hr)]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
  | one => simp
  | mul a b ha hb iha ihb =>
    rw [wordBoundary_mul_of_lift_eq_one x _ ((FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.1 (hker ha))]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ iha ihb
  | inv a ha iha =>
    rw [wordBoundary_inv_of_lift_eq_one x ((FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.1 (hker ha))]
    exact Submodule.neg_mem _ iha

name: TheoremA.commutator_le_ker
statement:
theorem commutator_le_ker (K : Subgroup (FreeGroup (Fin n)))
    (hK : K ≤ (FreeGroup.lift x).ker) : ⁅K, K⁆ ≤ (FreeGroup.lift x).ker
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.commutator_le.2 fun a ha b hb => by
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, map_commutatorElement, (FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.1 (hK ha),
      (FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.1 (hK hb), commutatorElement_one_left]

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_eq_zero_of_mem_commutator
statement:
theorem wordBoundary_eq_zero_of_mem_commutator (K : Subgroup (FreeGroup (Fin n)))
    (hK : K ≤ (FreeGroup.lift x).ker) {u : FreeGroup (Fin n)} (hu : u ∈ ⁅K, K⁆) :
    wordBoundary x u = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ⁅K, K⁆ ≤ (FreeGroup.lift x).ker := commutator_le_ker x K hK
  rw [Subgroup.commutator_def] at hu hle
  induction hu using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem v hv =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hv
    exact wordBoundary_commutator_of_lift_eq_one x ((FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.1 (hK ha))
      ((FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.1 (hK hb))
  | one => simp
  | mul a b ha hb iha ihb =>
    rw [wordBoundary_mul_of_lift_eq_one x _ ((FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.1 (hle ha)), iha, ihb,
      add_zero]
  | inv a ha iha =>
    rw [wordBoundary_inv_of_lift_eq_one x ((FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.1 (hle ha)), iha, neg_zero]

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_mem_span_of_mem_sup_commutator
statement:
theorem wordBoundary_mem_span_of_mem_sup_commutator (T : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)))
    (hT : ∀ r ∈ T, FreeGroup.lift x r = 1) (K : Subgroup (FreeGroup (Fin n)))
    (hK : K ≤ (FreeGroup.lift x).ker) {u : FreeGroup (Fin n)}
    (hu : u ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure T ⊔ ⁅K, K⁆) :
    wordBoundary x u ∈ Submodule.span (ZG G) (wordBoundary x '' T)
proof:
:= by
  let W : Subgroup (FreeGroup (Fin n)) :=
    { carrier := {u | FreeGroup.lift x u = 1 ∧
        wordBoundary x u ∈ Submodule.span (ZG G) (wordBoundary x '' T)}
      one_mem' := ⟨map_one _, by simp⟩
      mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => ⟨by rw [map_mul, ha.1, hb.1, one_mul], by
        rw [wordBoundary_mul_of_lift_eq_one x _ ha.1]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ ha.2 hb.2⟩
      inv_mem' := fun {a} ha => ⟨by rw [map_inv, ha.1, inv_one], by
        rw [wordBoundary_inv_of_lift_eq_one x ha.1]; exact Submodule.neg_mem _ ha.2⟩ }
  have h1 : Subgroup.normalClosure T ≤ W := fun v hv =>
    ⟨(FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.1 (Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
        (fun r hr => (FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.2 (hT r hr)) hv),
      wordBoundary_mem_span_of_mem_normalClosure x T hT hv⟩
  have h2 : ⁅K, K⁆ ≤ W := fun v hv =>
    ⟨(FreeGroup.lift x).mem_ker.1 (commutator_le_ker x K hK hv), by
      rw [wordBoundary_eq_zero_of_mem_commutator x K hK hv]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _⟩
  exact (sup_le h1 h2 hu).2

name: TheoremA.ker_lift_presGens
statement:
theorem ker_lift_presGens (S : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n))) :
    (FreeGroup.lift (presGens S)).ker = Subgroup.normalClosure S
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_presGens]
  exact QuotientGroup.ker_mk' _

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_presentedGroup_of_subset_sup_commutator
statement:
theorem isFP_two_presentedGroup_of_subset_sup_commutator (S T : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)))
    (hT : T.Finite) (hTS : T ⊆ S)
    (h : S ⊆ (Subgroup.normalClosure T ⊔
      ⁅Subgroup.normalClosure S, Subgroup.normalClosure S⁆ : Subgroup (FreeGroup (Fin n)))) :
    IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S)
proof:
:= by
  have hker := (ker_lift_presGens S).symm.le
  have hT1 : ∀ r ∈ T, FreeGroup.lift (presGens S) r = 1 := fun r hr =>
    (FreeGroup.lift (presGens S)).mem_ker.1 (hker (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (hTS hr)))
  refine (isFP_two_iff_all_relator_boundaries_mem_finite_span S).2 ⟨T, hT, hTS, fun r hr => ?_⟩
  exact wordBoundary_mem_span_of_mem_sup_commutator _ T hT1 _ hker (h hr)

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_presentedGroup_of_perfect_extension
statement:
theorem isFP_two_presentedGroup_of_perfect_extension (S₀ S : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)))
    (hS₀S : S₀ ⊆ S) (hS₀ : IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S₀))
    (h : S ⊆ (Subgroup.normalClosure S₀ ⊔
      ⁅Subgroup.normalClosure S, Subgroup.normalClosure S⁆ : Subgroup (FreeGroup (Fin n)))) :
    IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hTfin, hTS₀, hT⟩ := (isFP_two_iff_all_relator_boundaries_mem_finite_span S₀).1 hS₀
  have hid : ∀ r ∈ S₀, (MonoidHom.id (FreeGroup (Fin n))) r ∈ S := fun r hr => hS₀S hr
  have hT' : ∀ r ∈ S₀, wordBoundary (presGens S) r ∈
      Submodule.span (ZG (PresentedGroup S)) (wordBoundary (presGens S) '' T) := by
    intro r hr
    have := relatorBoundary_subst_mem_span (MonoidHom.id _) hid T hT hr
    simpa using this
  have hker := (ker_lift_presGens S).symm.le
  have hS₀1 : ∀ r ∈ S₀, FreeGroup.lift (presGens S) r = 1 := fun r hr =>
    (FreeGroup.lift (presGens S)).mem_ker.1 (hker (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (hS₀S hr)))
  refine (isFP_two_iff_all_relator_boundaries_mem_finite_span S).2
    ⟨T, hTfin, hTS₀.trans hS₀S, fun r hr => ?_⟩
  have h1 := wordBoundary_mem_span_of_mem_sup_commutator _ S₀ hS₀1 _ hker (h hr)
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ h1
  rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  exact hT' s hs

name: TheoremA.genBoundary_apply
statement:
theorem genBoundary_apply {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → G) (v : FreeMod G n) :
    genBoundary x v = ∑ i, v i * gm1 (x i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [genBoundary, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: TheoremA.genBoundary_single
statement:
theorem genBoundary_single {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → G) (i : Fin n) :
    genBoundary x (Pi.single i 1) = gm1 (x i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [genBoundary_apply]
  simp [Pi.single_apply]

name: TheoremA.augZG_surjective
statement: theorem augZG_surjective : Function.Surjective (augZG : ZG G →+* ℤ)
proof:
:=
  fun m => ⟨MonoidAlgebra.single 1 m, augZG_single 1 m⟩

name: TheoremA.augZG_smul
statement: theorem augZG_smul (l a : ZG G) : augZG (l • a) = augZG l * augZG a
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul]

name: TheoremA.augZG_of_smul
statement: theorem augZG_of_smul (g : G) (a : ZG G) : augZG (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G g • a) = augZG a
proof:
:= by
  rw [augZG_smul]; simp

name: TheoremA.augZG_gm1
statement: theorem augZG_gm1 (g : G) : augZG (gm1 g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [gm1]

name: TheoremA.augZG_genBoundary
statement:
theorem augZG_genBoundary {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → G) (v : FreeMod G n) :
    augZG (genBoundary x v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [genBoundary_apply, map_sum]
  simp [augZG_gm1]

name: TheoremA.gm1_mem_range_genBoundary
statement:
theorem gm1_mem_range_genBoundary {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → G) {g : G}
    (hg : g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range x)) : gm1 g ∈ LinearMap.range (genBoundary x)
proof:
:= by
  induction hg using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨Pi.single i 1, genBoundary_single x i⟩
  | one => rw [gm1, map_one, sub_self]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | mul a b _ _ ha hb =>
    have : gm1 (a * b) = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G a • gm1 b + gm1 a := by
      simp only [gm1, map_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub, mul_one]; abel
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hb) ha
  | inv a _ ha =>
    have : gm1 a⁻¹ = -(MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G a⁻¹ • gm1 a) := by
      simp only [gm1, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one, mul_one]; abel
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.neg_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha)

name: TheoremA.sub_augZG_mem_range_genBoundary
statement:
theorem sub_augZG_mem_range_genBoundary {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → G)
    (hx : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤) (a : ZG G) :
    a - MonoidAlgebra.single 1 (augZG a) ∈ LinearMap.range (genBoundary x)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb =>
    have : a + b - MonoidAlgebra.single 1 (augZG (a + b)) =
        (a - MonoidAlgebra.single 1 (augZG a)) + (b - MonoidAlgebra.single 1 (augZG b)) := by
      rw [map_add, MonoidAlgebra.single_add]; abel
    rw [this]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb
  | single g m =>
    have : (MonoidAlgebra.single g m : ZG G) - MonoidAlgebra.single 1 (augZG (MonoidAlgebra.single g m)) =
        (MonoidAlgebra.single 1 m : ZG G) • gm1 g := by
      rw [augZG_single, smul_eq_mul, gm1, mul_sub, mul_one, MonoidAlgebra.of_apply,
        MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul, mul_one]
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (gm1_mem_range_genBoundary x (hx ▸ Subgroup.mem_top g))

name: TheoremA.mem_range_genBoundary_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_genBoundary_iff {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → G)
    (hx : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤) (a : ZG G) :
    a ∈ LinearMap.range (genBoundary x) ↔ augZG a = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩; exact augZG_genBoundary x v
  · intro ha
    have := sub_augZG_mem_range_genBoundary x hx a
    rwa [ha, MonoidAlgebra.single_zero, sub_zero] at this

name: TheoremA.range_genBoundary_eq_ker_augZG
statement:
theorem range_genBoundary_eq_ker_augZG {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → G)
    (hx : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤) :
    (LinearMap.range (genBoundary x)).toAddSubgroup = (augZG : ZG G →+* ℤ).toAddMonoidHom.ker
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  exact mem_range_genBoundary_iff x hx a

name: TheoremA.coeffMap_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeffMap_of (f : H →* K) (h : H) :
    coeffMap f (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ H h) = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ K (f h)
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeffMap, MonoidAlgebra.of_apply]

name: TheoremA.boundarySubst_apply
statement:
theorem boundarySubst_apply (f : H →* K) (y : Fin m → K)
    (θ : FreeGroup (Fin n) →* FreeGroup (Fin m)) (v : FreeMod H n) :
    boundarySubst f y θ v = ∑ i, coeffMap f (v i) • wordBoundary y (θ (FreeGroup.of i))
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.boundarySubst_smul
statement:
theorem boundarySubst_smul (f : H →* K) (y : Fin m → K)
    (θ : FreeGroup (Fin n) →* FreeGroup (Fin m)) (a : ZG H) (v : FreeMod H n) :
    boundarySubst f y θ (a • v) = coeffMap f a • boundarySubst f y θ v
proof:
:=
  (boundarySubst f y θ).map_smulₛₗ a v

name: TheoremA.boundarySubst_stdBasis
statement:
@[simp] theorem boundarySubst_stdBasis (f : H →* K) (y : Fin m → K)
    (θ : FreeGroup (Fin n) →* FreeGroup (Fin m)) (i : Fin n) :
    boundarySubst f y θ (stdBasis H i) = wordBoundary y (θ (FreeGroup.of i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [boundarySubst_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro j _ hji
    simp [stdBasis, hji]
  · simp

name: TheoremA.lift_comp_of_compat
statement:
theorem lift_comp_of_compat (f : H →* K) (x : Fin n → H) (y : Fin m → K)
    (θ : FreeGroup (Fin n) →* FreeGroup (Fin m))
    (hB : ∀ i, f (x i) = FreeGroup.lift y (θ (FreeGroup.of i))) (u : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    f (FreeGroup.lift x u) = FreeGroup.lift y (θ u)
proof:
:= by
  have : f.comp (FreeGroup.lift x) = (FreeGroup.lift y).comp θ := by
    ext i; simpa using hB i
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this u

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_substitution
statement:
theorem wordBoundary_substitution (f : H →* K) (x : Fin n → H) (y : Fin m → K)
    (θ : FreeGroup (Fin n) →* FreeGroup (Fin m))
    (hB : ∀ i, f (x i) = FreeGroup.lift y (θ (FreeGroup.of i))) (u : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    boundarySubst f y θ (wordBoundary x u) = wordBoundary y (θ u)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using FreeGroup.induction_on with
  | one => simp
  | of i => simp
  | inv_of i _ =>
    rw [wordBoundary_of_inv, map_neg, boundarySubst_smul, boundarySubst_stdBasis, coeffMap_of,
      f.map_inv, hB, θ.map_inv, wordBoundary_inv]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [wordBoundary_mul, map_add, boundarySubst_smul, ha, hb, coeffMap_of,
      lift_comp_of_compat f x y θ hB, map_mul, wordBoundary_mul]

name: TheoremA.boundarySubstitution_mem_span
statement:
theorem boundarySubstitution_mem_span (f : H →* K) (x : Fin n → H) (y : Fin m → K)
    (θ : FreeGroup (Fin n) →* FreeGroup (Fin m))
    (hB : ∀ i, f (x i) = FreeGroup.lift y (θ (FreeGroup.of i)))
    (T : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n))) {z : FreeMod H n}
    (hz : z ∈ Submodule.span (ZG H) (wordBoundary x '' T)) :
    boundarySubst f y θ z ∈ Submodule.span (ZG K) (wordBoundary y '' (θ '' T))
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Submodule.span (ZG H) (wordBoundary x '' T) ≤
      (Submodule.span (ZG K) (wordBoundary y '' (θ '' T))).comap (boundarySubst f y θ) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, wordBoundary_substitution f x y θ hB]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨θ r, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  exact hle hz

name: TheoremA.wordBoundary_subst_mem_span
statement:
theorem wordBoundary_subst_mem_span (f : H →* K) (x : Fin n → H) (y : Fin m → K)
    (θ : FreeGroup (Fin n) →* FreeGroup (Fin m))
    (hB : ∀ i, f (x i) = FreeGroup.lift y (θ (FreeGroup.of i)))
    (T : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n))) {r : FreeGroup (Fin n)}
    (hr : wordBoundary x r ∈ Submodule.span (ZG H) (wordBoundary x '' T)) :
    wordBoundary y (θ r) ∈ Submodule.span (ZG K) (wordBoundary y '' (θ '' T))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wordBoundary_substitution f x y θ hB]
  exact boundarySubstitution_mem_span f x y θ hB T hr

name: TheoremA.lift_presGens
statement: theorem lift_presGens : FreeGroup.lift (presGens S) = PresentedGroup.mk S
proof:
:= by
  ext i; rfl

name: TheoremA.relatorSpan_le_ker
statement: theorem relatorSpan_le_ker : relatorSpan S ≤ LinearMap.ker (genBoundary (presGens S))
proof:
:= by
  rw [relatorSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, genBoundary_wordBoundary, lift_presGens,
    PresentedGroup.one_of_mem hr, gm1, map_one, sub_self]

name: TheoremA.relQuotHom_eq
statement: theorem relQuotHom_eq : relQuotHom S = (BdExt.map (relatorSpan S).mkQ).comp (wordHom (presGens S))
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  · simp [relQuotHom, wordHom]
  · simp [relQuotHom, wordHom]

name: TheoremA.relQuotHom_left
statement:
theorem relQuotHom_left (u : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    (relQuotHom S u).left.toAdd = (relatorSpan S).mkQ (relBoundary S u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [relQuotHom_eq]; rfl

name: TheoremA.relQuotHom_right
statement:
theorem relQuotHom_right (u : FreeGroup (Fin n)) :
    (relQuotHom S u).right = PresentedGroup.mk S u
proof:
:= by
  rw [relQuotHom_eq, MonoidHom.comp_apply, BdExt.map_right, right_wordHom, lift_presGens]

name: TheoremA.relQuotHom_rel
statement:
theorem relQuotHom_rel : ∀ r ∈ S, FreeGroup.lift (fun i =>
    (⟨Multiplicative.ofAdd ((relatorSpan S).mkQ (stdBasis (PresentedGroup S) i)), presGens S i⟩ :
      BdExt (PresentedGroup S) (RelQuot S))) r = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  change relQuotHom S r = 1
  apply SemidirectProduct.ext
  · change Multiplicative.ofAdd (relQuotHom S r).left.toAdd = Multiplicative.ofAdd 0
    rw [relQuotHom_left, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
    congr 1
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  · rw [relQuotHom_right, PresentedGroup.one_of_mem hr]; rfl

name: TheoremA.relSection_right
statement: theorem relSection_right (g : PresentedGroup S) : (relSection S g).right = g
proof:
:= by
  have : SemidirectProduct.rightHom.comp (relSection S) = MonoidHom.id _ := by
    apply PresentedGroup.ext
    intro i
    simp [relSection, PresentedGroup.toGroup.of]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this g

name: TheoremA.relCocycle_mul
statement:
theorem relCocycle_mul (g h : PresentedGroup S) :
    relCocycle S (g * h) = relCocycle S g + MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ _ g • relCocycle S h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relCocycle, map_mul, BdExt.left_mul, relSection_right]

name: TheoremA.relCocycle_one
statement: theorem relCocycle_one : relCocycle S 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [relCocycle]

name: TheoremA.relCocycle_gen
statement:
theorem relCocycle_gen (i : Fin n) :
    relCocycle S (presGens S i) = (relatorSpan S).mkQ (stdBasis (PresentedGroup S) i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [relCocycle, relSection, PresentedGroup.toGroup.of]

name: TheoremA.relCocycleLin_single
statement:
theorem relCocycleLin_single (g : PresentedGroup S) (m : ℤ) :
    relCocycleLin S (MonoidAlgebra.single g m) = m • relCocycle S g
proof:
:= by
  simp [relCocycleLin]

name: TheoremA.relCocycleLin_genBoundary
statement:
theorem relCocycleLin_genBoundary (z : FreeMod (PresentedGroup S) n) :
    relCocycleLin S (genBoundary (presGens S) z) = (relatorSpan S).mkQ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hz : z = ∑ i, Pi.single i (z i) := (Finset.univ_sum_single z).symm
  rw [hz, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  induction z i using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add a c ha hc =>
    rw [Pi.single_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hc]
  | single g m =>
    have hsingle : (Pi.single i (MonoidAlgebra.single g m) : FreeMod (PresentedGroup S) n) =
        (MonoidAlgebra.single g m : ZG (PresentedGroup S)) • stdBasis (PresentedGroup S) i := by
      ext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj; simp
      · simp [hj]
    have hd : genBoundary (presGens S) (Pi.single i (MonoidAlgebra.single g m)) =
        MonoidAlgebra.single (g * presGens S i) m - MonoidAlgebra.single g m := by
      rw [hsingle, map_smul, genBoundary_single, gm1, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub, mul_one,
        MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, mul_one]
    have hsm : (MonoidAlgebra.single g m : ZG (PresentedGroup S)) =
        m • MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ _ g := by
      rw [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, MonoidAlgebra.smul_single', mul_one]
    rw [hd, map_sub, relCocycleLin_single, relCocycleLin_single, relCocycle_mul, relCocycle_gen,
      hsingle, map_smul, hsm, smul_assoc, smul_add, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: TheoremA.ker_genBoundary_eq_span_relatorBoundary
statement:
theorem ker_genBoundary_eq_span_relatorBoundary :
    LinearMap.ker (genBoundary (presGens S)) =
      Submodule.span (ZG (PresentedGroup S)) (wordBoundary (presGens S) '' S)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun z hz => ?_) (relatorSpan_le_ker S)
  have h := relCocycleLin_genBoundary S z
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hz, map_zero, eq_comm, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_of_fg_ker_genBoundary
statement:
theorem isFP_two_of_fg_ker_genBoundary {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → G)
    (hx : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤) (hK : (LinearMap.ker (genBoundary x)).FG) :
    IsFP 2 G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, k, hk⟩ := Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.mp hK
  refine (genFPData x hx).isFP_succ (n := 0) m (Fintype.linearCombination (ZG G) k) ?_
  rw [Fintype.range_linearCombination, hk]
  ext v
  show genBoundary x v = 0 ↔ (freeModOneEquiv G).symm (genBoundary x v) = 0
  simp

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_of_span
statement:
theorem isFP_two_of_span {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → G) (hx : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤)
    {m : ℕ} (k : Fin m → FreeMod G n)
    (hk : Submodule.span (ZG G) (Set.range k) = LinearMap.ker (genBoundary x)) : IsFP 2 G
proof:
:=
  isFP_two_of_fg_ker_genBoundary x hx (hk ▸ Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_range k))

name: TheoremA.fg_range_freeMod
statement:
theorem fg_range_freeMod {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module (ZG G) M] {q : ℕ}
    (f : FreeMod G q →ₗ[ZG G] M) : (LinearMap.range f).FG
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map]
  exact Module.Finite.fg_top.map f

name: TheoremA.fg_ker_genBoundary_of_isFP_two
statement:
theorem fg_ker_genBoundary_of_isFP_two {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → G)
    (hx : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤) (hG : IsFP 2 G) :
    (LinearMap.ker (genBoundary x)).FG
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, d, ε, hinv, hsurj, h0, hex⟩ := hG
  let R : Res G 0 := ⟨c, d, ε, hinv, hsurj, h0 (by omega), fun i hi => absurd hi (by omega)⟩
  have hεs : ∀ (l : ZG G) v, ε (l • v) = augZG l * ε v := R.ε_smul
  have hεd : ∀ v, ε (d 0 v) = 0 := R.ε_d
  have hker0 : ∀ v, ε v = 0 → v ∈ LinearMap.range (d 0) := by
    intro v hv
    have : v ∈ ε.ker := hv
    rw [h0 (by omega)] at this; exact this
  set d₁ := genBoundary x with hd₁
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hsurj 1
  let α : ZG G →ₗ[ZG G] FreeMod G (c 0) := LinearMap.toSpanSingleton (ZG G) _ p
  let β : FreeMod G (c 0) →ₗ[ZG G] ZG G :=
    Fintype.linearCombination (ZG G) fun j => MonoidAlgebra.single 1 (ε (Pi.single j 1))
  have hαapp : ∀ l, α l = l • p := fun l => rfl
  have hεα : ∀ l, ε (α l) = augZG l := by intro l; rw [hαapp, hεs, hp, mul_one]
  have hβaug : ∀ v, augZG (β v) = ε v := by
    intro v
    conv_rhs => rw [eq_sum_single v]
    simp [β, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, map_sum, hεs]
  have hβα : ∀ l, β (α l) = l * β p := by
    intro l; rw [hαapp, LinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have ha : ∀ i, ∃ a, d 0 a = α (d₁ (Pi.single i 1)) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hker0 (α (d₁ (Pi.single i 1))) (by rw [hεα]; exact augZG_genBoundary x _)
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩
  choose a ha using ha
  have hb : ∀ j, ∃ b, d₁ b = β (d 0 (Pi.single j 1)) := by
    intro j
    have : β (d 0 (Pi.single j 1)) ∈ LinearMap.range d₁ := by
      rw [hd₁, mem_range_genBoundary_iff x hx, hβaug, hεd]
    exact this
  choose b hb using hb
  let α₁ : FreeMod G n →ₗ[ZG G] FreeMod G (c 1) := Fintype.linearCombination (ZG G) a
  let β₁ : FreeMod G (c 1) →ₗ[ZG G] FreeMod G n := Fintype.linearCombination (ZG G) b
  have hα₁ : ∀ v, d 0 (α₁ v) = α (d₁ v) := by
    intro v
    rw [show α₁ v = ∑ i, v i • a i from Fintype.linearCombination_apply _ _ _]
    conv_rhs => rw [eq_sum_single v]
    simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.map_smul, ha]
  have hβ₁ : ∀ w, d₁ (β₁ w) = β (d 0 w) := by
    intro w
    rw [show β₁ w = ∑ j, w j • b j from Fintype.linearCombination_apply _ _ _]
    conv_rhs => rw [eq_sum_single w]
    simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.map_smul, hb]
  
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ : 1 - β p ∈ LinearMap.range d₁ := by
    rw [hd₁, mem_range_genBoundary_iff x hx, map_sub, hβaug, hp, map_one, sub_self]
  let T : FreeMod G n →ₗ[ZG G] FreeMod G n :=
    LinearMap.id - β₁ ∘ₗ α₁ - LinearMap.toSpanSingleton (ZG G) _ s₀ ∘ₗ d₁
  have hTapp : ∀ v, T v = v - β₁ (α₁ v) - d₁ v • s₀ := fun v => rfl
  have hT : ∀ v, d₁ (T v) = 0 := by
    intro v
    rw [hTapp, map_sub, map_sub, hβ₁, hα₁, hβα, LinearMap.map_smul, hs₀, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_sub, mul_one]
    abel
  
  let N₁ : Submodule (ZG G) (FreeMod G n) := Submodule.span (ZG G) (Set.range fun i => T (Pi.single i 1))
  let N₂ : Submodule (ZG G) (FreeMod G n) := (LinearMap.ker (d 0)).map β₁
  have hK : LinearMap.ker d₁ = N₁ ⊔ N₂ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro v hv
      have hv' : d₁ v = 0 := hv
      have hsplit : v = T v + β₁ (α₁ v) := by rw [hTapp, hv', zero_smul]; abel
      rw [hsplit]
      refine Submodule.add_mem_sup ?_ ⟨α₁ v, ?_, rfl⟩
      · have := semilinear_mem_span (RingHom.id (ZG G)) T.toAddMonoidHom
          (fun l w => by simp) v
        simpa using this
      · show d 0 (α₁ v) = 0
        rw [hα₁, hv', map_zero]
    · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
      · rw [Submodule.span_le]
        rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact hT _
      · rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        show d₁ (β₁ w) = 0
        rw [hβ₁, show d 0 w = 0 from hw, map_zero]
  have hker1 : LinearMap.ker (d 0) = LinearMap.range (d 1) := hex 0 (by omega)
  rw [hK]
  refine (Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_range _)).sup ?_
  exact (hker1 ▸ fg_range_freeMod (d 1)).map β₁

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_iff_fg_ker_genBoundary
statement:
theorem isFP_two_iff_fg_ker_genBoundary {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → G)
    (hx : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤) :
    IsFP 2 G ↔ (LinearMap.ker (genBoundary x)).FG
proof:
:=
  ⟨fg_ker_genBoundary_of_isFP_two x hx, isFP_two_of_fg_ker_genBoundary x hx⟩

name: TheoremA.isFP_two_quotient_of_perfect
statement:
theorem isFP_two_quotient_of_perfect {P : Type*} [Group P] (hP : IsFP 2 P) (N : Subgroup P)
    [N.Normal] (hN : N ≤ ⁅N, N⁆) : IsFP 2 (P ⧸ N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Group.isMulFG_iff.mp (hP.fg_of_le (by norm_num))
  let m := s.card
  let x : Fin m → P := fun i => (s.equivFin.symm i : P)
  have hx : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← hs]
    congr 1
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Finset.mem_coe, x]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact (s.equivFin.symm i).2
    · intro hy; exact ⟨s.equivFin ⟨y, hy⟩, by simp⟩
  let π : FreeGroup (Fin m) →* P := FreeGroup.lift x
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π := by
    rw [← MonoidHom.range_eq_top, FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure, hx]
  let K : Subgroup (FreeGroup (Fin m)) := π.ker
  let M : Subgroup (FreeGroup (Fin m)) := N.comap π
  have hK : Subgroup.normalClosure (K : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m))) = K :=
    Subgroup.normalClosure_eq_self K
  have hM : Subgroup.normalClosure (M : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m))) = M :=
    Subgroup.normalClosure_eq_self M
  
  let e₀ : PresentedGroup (K : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m))) ≃* P :=
    (QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq hK).trans (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective π hπ)
  
  let ψ : FreeGroup (Fin m) →* P ⧸ N := (QuotientGroup.mk' N).comp π
  have hψ : Function.Surjective ψ := (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N).comp hπ
  have hψker : ψ.ker = M := by
    rw [← MonoidHom.comap_ker, QuotientGroup.ker_mk']
  let e : PresentedGroup (M : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m))) ≃* P ⧸ N :=
    (QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq (hM.trans hψker.symm)).trans
      (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective ψ hψ)
  have hK2 : IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup (K : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m)))) := (IsFP.congr e₀).2 hP
  have hKM : (K : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m))) ⊆ M := fun y hy => by
    change π y ∈ N
    rw [(π.mem_ker).1 hy]
    exact N.one_mem
  have hcond : (M : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m))) ⊆
      (Subgroup.normalClosure (K : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m))) ⊔
        ⁅Subgroup.normalClosure (M : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m))),
          Subgroup.normalClosure (M : Set (FreeGroup (Fin m)))⁆ : Subgroup _) := by
    rw [hK, hM]
    intro y hy
    have hmap : Subgroup.map π M = N := Subgroup.map_comap_eq_self_of_surjective hπ N
    have h1 : π y ∈ Subgroup.map π ⁅M, M⁆ := by
      rw [Subgroup.map_commutator, hmap]
      exact hN hy
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcy⟩ := h1
    have : y = (y * c⁻¹) * c := by group
    rw [this]
    refine Subgroup.mul_mem_sup ?_ hc
    change π (y * c⁻¹) = 1
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, hcy, mul_inv_cancel]
  exact (IsFP.congr e).1 (isFP_two_presentedGroup_of_perfect_extension _ _ hKM hK2 hcond)

name: TheoremA.cosetMap_single
statement:
theorem cosetMap_single (a : G) (m : ℤ) :
    cosetMap H (MonoidAlgebra.single a m) = Finsupp.single (a : G ⧸ H) m
proof:
:=
  by simp [cosetMap]

name: TheoremA.cosetMap_of_mul
statement:
theorem cosetMap_of_mul (g : G) (f : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) :
    cosetMap H (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G g * f) = cosetTransl H g (cosetMap H f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using MonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of a =>
    rw [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul,
      cosetMap_single, cosetMap_single]
    simp [cosetTransl, MulAction.Quotient.smul_mk]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [mul_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]
  | smul r x hx => rw [mul_smul_comm, map_zsmul, map_zsmul, hx, map_zsmul]

name: TheoremA.cosetTest_apply
statement:
theorem cosetTest_apply (v : FreeMod G k) :
    cosetTest H w v = ∑ i, w i • cosetMap H (v i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cosetTest, AddMonoidHom.finset_sum_apply]

name: TheoremA.cosetTest_of_smul
statement:
theorem cosetTest_of_smul (g : G) (v : FreeMod G k) :
    cosetTest H w (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G g • v) = cosetTransl H g (cosetTest H w v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cosetTest_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, cosetMap_of_mul, map_sum, map_zsmul]

name: TheoremA.cosetTest_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cosetTest_smul_eq_zero {v : FreeMod G k} (hv : cosetTest H w v = 0)
    (r : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) : cosetTest H w (r • v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction r using MonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of g => rw [cosetTest_of_smul, hv, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [add_smul, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul m x hx => rw [smul_assoc, map_zsmul, hx, smul_zero]

name: TheoremA.mem_vecSupport
statement:
theorem mem_vecSupport {k : ℕ} {v : FreeMod G k} {i : Fin k} {a : G} (ha : a ∈ (v i).coeff.support) :
    a ∈ vecSupport v
proof:
:=
  Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, ha⟩

name: TheoremA.cosetTest_of_support_le
statement:
theorem cosetTest_of_support_le {k : ℕ} (ε : FreeMod G k →+ ℤ)
    (hε : ∀ (g : G) (x : FreeMod G k), ε (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G g • x) = ε x)
    (H : Subgroup G) (v : FreeMod G k) (hv : ∀ a ∈ vecSupport v, a ∈ H) :
    cosetTest H (fun i => ε (Pi.single i 1)) v = Finsupp.single ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) (ε v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdecomp : v = ∑ i, ∑ a ∈ (v i).coeff.support,
      Pi.single i (MonoidAlgebra.single a ((v i).coeff a) : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single v]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    conv_lhs => rw [← MonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single (v i)]
    rw [Finsupp.sum]
    exact map_sum (AddMonoidHom.single (fun _ => MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) i) _ _
  have hterm : ∀ i, ∀ a ∈ H, ∀ m : ℤ,
      cosetTest H (fun i => ε (Pi.single i 1))
        (Pi.single i (MonoidAlgebra.single a m : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)) =
      Finsupp.single ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H)
        (ε (Pi.single i (MonoidAlgebra.single a m : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G))) := by
    intro i a ha m
    have hsplit : (Pi.single i (MonoidAlgebra.single a m : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) : FreeMod G k) =
        m • (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G a • (Pi.single i 1 : FreeMod G k)) := by
      ext j : 1
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        simp [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply]
      · simp [hj]
    have haH : ((a : G) : G ⧸ H) = ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) :=
      QuotientGroup.eq.2 (by simpa using ha)
    have h2 : (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G a • (Pi.single i 1 : FreeMod G k)) =
        Pi.single i (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G a) := by
      ext j : 1
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj; simp
      · simp [hj]
    rw [hsplit, map_zsmul, map_zsmul, hε, cosetTest_apply, h2,
      Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun b _ hb => by simp [hb]) (by simp)]
    simp [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, cosetMap_single, haH, Finsupp.smul_single, mul_comm]
  conv_lhs => rw [hdecomp]
  conv_rhs => rw [hdecomp]
  simp only [map_sum, Finsupp.single_finset_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
  exact hterm i a (hv a (mem_vecSupport ha)) _

name: TheoremA.IsFP.fg
statement: theorem IsFP.fg (h : IsFP 1 G) : Group.FG G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, d, ε, hε, hsurj, hker, -⟩ := h
  have hker' := hker one_pos
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsurj 1
  let kk : Fin (c 1) → FreeMod G (c 0) := fun j => d 0 (Pi.single j 1)
  let A : Finset G := vecSupport u ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion fun j => vecSupport (kk j)
  let H : Subgroup G := Subgroup.closure (A : Set G)
  let w : Fin (c 0) → ℤ := fun i => ε (Pi.single i 1)
  have hmemker : ∀ y ∈ LinearMap.range (d 0), ε y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have : y ∈ ε.ker := by rw [hker']; exact hy
    exact this
  have hkk : ∀ j, cosetTest H w (kk j) = 0 := by
    intro j
    rw [cosetTest_of_support_le ε hε H (kk j) (fun a ha => Subgroup.subset_closure
      (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, ha⟩))),
      hmemker _ (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _), Finsupp.single_zero]
  have hrange : ∀ z : FreeMod G (c 1), cosetTest H w (d 0 z) = 0 := by
    intro z
    have hz : z = ∑ j, z j • (Pi.single j 1 : FreeMod G (c 1)) := by
      ext j : 1
      simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    rw [hz, map_sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul]
    exact cosetTest_smul_eq_zero H w (hkk j) _
  have hu' : cosetTest H w u = Finsupp.single ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) 1 := by
    rw [cosetTest_of_support_le ε hε H u (fun a ha => Subgroup.subset_closure
      (Finset.mem_union_left _ ha)), hu]
  have hall : ∀ g : G, g ∈ H := by
    intro g
    have h0 : ε (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G g • u - u) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, hε, sub_self]
    have h1 : MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G g • u - u ∈ LinearMap.range (d 0) := by
      have : MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ G g • u - u ∈ ε.ker := h0
      rw [hker'] at this
      exact this
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h1
    have h2 := hrange z
    rw [hz, map_sub, cosetTest_of_smul, hu', sub_eq_zero] at h2
    simp only [cosetTransl, Finsupp.mapDomain.addMonoidHom_apply, Finsupp.mapDomain_single] at h2
    have h3 := (Finsupp.single_left_inj one_ne_zero).1 h2
    rw [MulAction.Quotient.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, QuotientGroup.eq] at h3
    simpa using h3
  exact Group.fg_iff.2 ⟨A, eq_top_iff.2 fun g _ => hall g, A.finite_toSet⟩

name: TheoremA.IsFP.one_of_le
statement: theorem IsFP.one_of_le {n : ℕ} (h : IsFP n G) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : IsFP 1 G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, d, ε, hε, hsurj, hker, -⟩ := h
  exact ⟨c, d, ε, hε, hsurj, fun _ => hker (by omega), fun i hi => by omega⟩

name: TheoremA.IsFP.fg_of_le
statement: theorem IsFP.fg_of_le {n : ℕ} (h : IsFP n G) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : Group.FG G
proof:
:=
  (h.one_of_le hn).fg

name: TheoremA.Leary.flagLoopL_length
statement: theorem flagLoopL_length : flagLoopL.length = 4
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Leary.Ys_jDet
statement:
theorem Ys_jDet (S : Set ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    Ys (jDet S) n = (flagLoopL.map fun e => flagL.xJ S e ^ n).prod
proof:
:= by
  have : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin 4 => jDet S i ^ n) = flagLoopL.map fun e => flagL.xJ S e ^ n := by
    rw [← List.ofFn_get flagLoopL, List.map_ofFn]
    rfl
  rw [Ys, this]

name: TheoremA.Leary.jDet_forward
statement: theorem jDet_forward {S : Set ℤ} {n : ℤ} (hn : n ∈ S) : Ys (jDet S) n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ys_jDet]
  exact loop_eq_one_of_mem flagL_wf hn _ flagLoop_isWalk

name: TheoremA.Leary.jDet_eq_one_iff_mem_NS
statement:
theorem jDet_eq_one_iff_mem_NS (S : Set ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    Ys (jDet S) n = 1 ↔ rho flagL_wf n (piVal flagLoopL) ∈ NS flagL_wf S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ys_jDet]
  exact loop_eq_one_iff flagL_wf S n _ flagLoop_isWalk

name: TheoremA.Leary.jDet_iff_of_separation
statement:
theorem jDet_iff_of_separation (hSep : FlagSeparation) {S : Set ℤ} (h0 : (0 : ℤ) ∈ S) (n : ℤ) :
    Ys (jDet S) n = 1 ↔ n ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, jDet_forward⟩
  by_contra hn
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hn h0
  exact hSep S n hn0 hn ((jDet_eq_one_iff_mem_NS S n).1 h)

name: TheoremA.Leary.hb_VS_of_separation
statement:
theorem hb_VS_of_separation (hSep : FlagSeparation) {R : Set ℕ} {S : Set ℤ}
    (hS : IntEnumerable R S) (h0 : (0 : ℤ) ∈ S) : HB R (VS 4 S)
proof:
:=
  hb_VS (jDet S) (by norm_num) (classCR_JGrp hS) (isFP_two_JGrp_flagL S)
