    (jDet_iff_of_separation hSep h0) h0

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.flagL_isGraph
statement:
theorem flagL_isGraph : IsGraph flagL.Adj where
  symm
proof:
:= by
    rintro a b ⟨e, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨flagL.rev e, flagL_rev_src e, flagL_rev_tgt e⟩
  irrefl := by
    rintro a ⟨e, h1, h2⟩
    exact flagL_no_loop e (h1.trans h2.symm)

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.tau_edge
statement: theorem tau_edge (a : Fin flagL.m) : tau (flagL.src a) (flagL.tgt a) = flagPerm a
proof:
:= by
  have h : flagL.Adj (flagL.src a) (flagL.tgt a) := ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [tau, dif_pos h]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Classical.choose_spec h
  rw [flagL_edge_unique _ _ h1 h2]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.tau_self
statement: theorem tau_self (x : Fin flagL.nv) : tau x x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tau, dif_neg (flagL_isGraph.irrefl x)]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.flagPerm_rev'
statement: theorem flagPerm_rev' (a : Fin flagL.m) : flagPerm (flagL.rev a) = (flagPerm a)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right (flagPerm_rev a)

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.tau_mul_tau_symm
statement: theorem tau_mul_tau_symm {x y : Fin flagL.nv} (h : R x y) : tau x y * tau y x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with rfl | ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rw [tau_self, mul_one]
  · have h := tau_edge (flagL.rev a)
    rw [flagL_rev_src, flagL_rev_tgt] at h
    rw [tau_edge, h, flagPerm_rev', mul_inv_cancel]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.tau_tri
statement:
theorem tau_tri {x y z : Fin flagL.nv} (hxy : R x y) (hyz : R y z) (hxz : R x z) :
    tau x y * tau y z = tau x z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases e1 : x = y
  · subst e1; rw [tau_self, one_mul]
  by_cases e2 : y = z
  · subst e2; rw [tau_self, mul_one]
  by_cases e3 : x = z
  · subst e3; rw [tau_mul_tau_symm hxy, tau_self]
  obtain ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩ := hxy.resolve_left e1
  obtain ⟨b, hb1, rfl⟩ := hyz.resolve_left e2
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := hxz.resolve_left e3
  have hcyc := flagL_cycle_rel flagPerm flagPerm_rev' flagPerm_tri (a := a) (b := b)
    (c := flagL.rev c) hb1.symm (by rw [flagL_rev_src, hc2]) (by rw [flagL_rev_tgt, hc1])
  rw [tau_edge, ← hb1, tau_edge, ← hc1, ← hc2, tau_edge]
  rw [flagPerm_rev'] at hcyc
  calc flagPerm a * flagPerm b = flagPerm a * flagPerm b * (flagPerm c)⁻¹ * flagPerm c := by
        group
    _ = flagPerm c := by rw [hcyc, one_mul]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.g_mem
statement: theorem g_mem {K : Finset (Fin flagL.nv)} {v : Fin flagL.nv} (hv : v ∈ K) : g v ∈ clSub K
proof:
:=
  subset_closure ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.R_of_mem
proof:
:=
  ivert_adj_of_rest_eq hK
    (by rw [rest_of_mem_closure flagL_isGraph hh₁, rest_of_mem_closure flagL_isGraph hh₂]) hs ht

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.cv_mem
statement: theorem cv_mem {p : PosL} (hp : height p.1 ≠ 0) : cv p ∈ Ivert flagL.Adj p.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := ivert_nonempty p.2 hp
  rw [cv, dif_pos h]
  exact h.some_mem

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.cv_R
proof:
:=
  R_of_mem hK hh₁ hh₂ p (cv_mem hp₁) (cv_mem hp₂)

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.isCl_edge
statement: theorem isCl_edge (a : Fin flagL.m) : IsCl {flagL.src a, flagL.tgt a}
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : flagL.Adj (flagL.src a) (flagL.tgt a) := ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩
  have h2 := flagL_isGraph.symm _ _ h1
  intro u hu v hv
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hu hv
  rcases hu with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;> simp_all

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.g_commute
statement: theorem g_commute {u v : Fin flagL.nv} (h : flagL.Adj u v) : Commute (g u) (g v)
proof:
:=
  gen_commute flagL_isGraph h

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.height_g_zpow
statement:
theorem height_g_zpow (v : Fin flagL.nv) (k : ℤ) (p : PosL) :
    height ((g v ^ k) p).1 = height p.1 + k
proof:
:=
  height_gen_zpow flagL_isGraph v k p

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.height_beta
statement: theorem height_beta (a : Fin flagL.m) (p : PosL) : height (beta a p).1 = height p.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [beta, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, height_gen, height_gen_inv]; ring

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.beta_mem
statement:
theorem beta_mem {K : Finset (Fin flagL.nv)} {a : Fin flagL.m} (hs : flagL.src a ∈ K)
    (ht : flagL.tgt a ∈ K) : beta a ∈ clSub K
proof:
:=
  mul_mem (g_mem hs) (inv_mem (g_mem ht))

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.beta_rev
statement: theorem beta_rev (a : Fin flagL.m) : beta (flagL.rev a) = (beta a)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [beta, beta, flagL_rev_src, flagL_rev_tgt, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.height_prod_beta
statement:
theorem height_prod_beta (es : List (Fin flagL.m)) (p : PosL) :
    height ((es.map beta).prod p).1 = height p.1
proof:
:= by
  induction es with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e es ih => rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, height_beta, ih]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.prod_beta_mem
statement:
theorem prod_beta_mem {K : Finset (Fin flagL.nv)} {es : List (Fin flagL.m)}
    (hes : ∀ e ∈ es, flagL.src e ∈ K ∧ flagL.tgt e ∈ K) : (es.map beta).prod ∈ clSub K
proof:
:= by
  apply list_prod_mem
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
  exact beta_mem (hes e he).1 (hes e he).2

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.F_F_rev
statement: theorem F_F_rev (hn : n ≠ 0) (a : Fin flagL.m) (x : Om) : F n a (F n (flagL.rev a) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, f⟩ := x
  simp only [F]
  have hb : beta a (beta (flagL.rev a) p) = p := by
    rw [beta_rev]; exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  refine Prod.ext hb ?_
  simp only [kappa, hb, height_beta]
  split_ifs with h
  · have hR : R (cv p) (cv (beta (flagL.rev a) p)) := by
      have := cv_R (isCl_edge a) (one_mem _) (beta_mem (K := {flagL.src a, flagL.tgt a})
        (a := flagL.rev a) (by simp [flagL_rev_src]) (by simp [flagL_rev_tgt])) (p := p)
        (by simpa [h] using hn) (by rw [height_beta, h]; exact hn)
      simpa using this
    change (tau (cv p) (cv (beta (flagL.rev a) p)) * tau (cv (beta (flagL.rev a) p)) (cv p)) f = f
    rw [tau_mul_tau_symm hR]; rfl
  · rfl

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.Fperm_apply
statement: theorem Fperm_apply (hn : n ≠ 0) (a : Fin flagL.m) (x : Om) : Fperm hn a x = F n a x
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.Fperm_rev
statement: theorem Fperm_rev (hn : n ≠ 0) (a : Fin flagL.m) : Fperm hn (flagL.rev a) = (Fperm hn a)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one]
  refine Equiv.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Fperm_apply, Fperm_apply]
  have := F_F_rev hn (flagL.rev a) x
  rwa [flagL_rev_rev] at this

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.prod_Fperm
statement:
theorem prod_Fperm (hn : n ≠ 0) {K : Finset (Fin flagL.nv)} (hK : IsCl K) :
    ∀ {es : List (Fin flagL.m)}, (∀ e ∈ es, flagL.src e ∈ K ∧ flagL.tgt e ∈ K) →
      ∀ (p : PosL) (f : Fin 5), (es.map (Fperm hn)).prod (p, f) =
        ((es.map beta).prod p,
          (if height p.1 = n then tau (cv ((es.map beta).prod p)) (cv p) else 1) f)
  | [], _, p, f => by
    simp [tau_self]
  | e :: es, hes, p, f => by
    have ih
proof:
:= prod_Fperm hn hK (es := es) (fun e' he' => hes e' (by simp [he'])) p f
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, ih, Fperm_apply, F]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
    simp only [kappa, height_prod_beta]
    split_ifs with h
    · have hn' : height p.1 ≠ 0 := by rw [h]; exact hn
      have hQ := prod_beta_mem (K := K) (es := es) (fun e' he' => hes e' (by simp [he']))
      have he := beta_mem (hes e (by simp)).1 (hes e (by simp)).2
      have h1 : height ((beta e * (es.map beta).prod) p).1 ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, height_beta, height_prod_beta]; exact hn'
      have h2 : height (((es.map beta).prod) p).1 ≠ 0 := by rw [height_prod_beta]; exact hn'
      have h3 : height ((1 : Equiv.Perm PosL) p).1 ≠ 0 := hn'
      have r12 := cv_R hK (mul_mem he hQ) hQ h1 h2
      have r23 := cv_R hK hQ (one_mem _) h2 h3
      have r13 := cv_R hK (mul_mem he hQ) (one_mem _) h1 h3
      simp only [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.one_apply] at r12 r23 r13
      rw [← tau_tri r12 r23 r13]
      rfl
    · rfl

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.prod_Fperm_eq_one
statement:
theorem prod_Fperm_eq_one (hn : n ≠ 0) {K : Finset (Fin flagL.nv)} (hK : IsCl K)
    {es : List (Fin flagL.m)} (hes : ∀ e ∈ es, flagL.src e ∈ K ∧ flagL.tgt e ∈ K)
    (h1 : (es.map beta).prod = 1) : (es.map (Fperm hn)).prod = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Equiv.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨p, f⟩ := x
  rw [prod_Fperm hn hK hes, h1]
  simp [tau_self]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.isCl_tri
statement:
theorem isCl_tri {t : Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m} (ht : t ∈ flagL.tri) :
    IsCl {flagL.src t.1, flagL.src t.2.1, flagL.src t.2.2}
proof:
:= by
  have a1 : flagL.Adj (flagL.src t.1) (flagL.src t.2.1) := ⟨t.1, rfl, flagL_tri_ab t ht⟩
  have a2 : flagL.Adj (flagL.src t.2.1) (flagL.src t.2.2) := ⟨t.2.1, rfl, flagL_tri_bc t ht⟩
  have a3 : flagL.Adj (flagL.src t.2.2) (flagL.src t.1) := ⟨t.2.2, rfl, flagL_tri_ca t ht⟩
  have b1 := flagL_isGraph.symm _ _ a1
  have b2 := flagL_isGraph.symm _ _ a2
  have b3 := flagL_isGraph.symm _ _ a3
  intro u hu v hv
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hu hv
  rcases hu with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp_all

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.tri_edges_mem
statement:
theorem tri_edges_mem {t : Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m} (ht : t ∈ flagL.tri) :
    ∀ e ∈ [t.1, t.2.1, t.2.2], flagL.src e ∈ ({flagL.src t.1, flagL.src t.2.1, flagL.src t.2.2} :
      Finset (Fin flagL.nv)) ∧ flagL.tgt e ∈ ({flagL.src t.1, flagL.src t.2.1, flagL.src t.2.2} :
      Finset (Fin flagL.nv))
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at he
  rcases he with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · simp [flagL_tri_ab t ht]
  · simp [flagL_tri_bc t ht]
  · simp [flagL_tri_ca t ht]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.beta_tri
statement:
theorem beta_tri {t : Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m} (ht : t ∈ flagL.tri) :
    ([t.1, t.2.1, t.2.2].map beta).prod = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one, beta,
    flagL_tri_ab t ht, flagL_tri_bc t ht, flagL_tri_ca t ht]
  group

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.beta_tri_rev
statement:
theorem beta_tri_rev {t : Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m} (ht : t ∈ flagL.tri) :
    ([t.2.2, t.2.1, t.1].map beta).prod = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one, beta,
    flagL_tri_ab t ht, flagL_tri_bc t ht, flagL_tri_ca t ht]
  set x := g (flagL.src t.1)
  set y := g (flagL.src t.2.1)
  set z := g (flagL.src t.2.2)
  have hxy : Commute x y := g_commute ⟨t.1, rfl, flagL_tri_ab t ht⟩
  have hyz : Commute y z := g_commute ⟨t.2.1, rfl, flagL_tri_bc t ht⟩
  have hzx : Commute z x := g_commute ⟨t.2.2, rfl, flagL_tri_ca t ht⟩
  have e1 : x⁻¹ * y = y * x⁻¹ := hxy.inv_left.eq
  have e2 : x⁻¹ * z⁻¹ = z⁻¹ * x⁻¹ := hzx.symm.inv_inv.eq
  have e3 : y * z⁻¹ = z⁻¹ * y := hyz.inv_right.eq
  calc z * x⁻¹ * (y * z⁻¹ * (x * y⁻¹)) = z * (x⁻¹ * y) * z⁻¹ * x * y⁻¹ := by group
    _ = z * y * (x⁻¹ * z⁻¹) * x * y⁻¹ := by rw [e1]; group
    _ = z * (y * z⁻¹) * y⁻¹ := by rw [e2]; group
    _ = 1 := by rw [e3]; group

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.psi_xP
statement: theorem psi_xP (hn : n ≠ 0) (a : Fin flagL.m) : psi hn (flagL.xP a) = Fperm hn a
proof:
:=
  PresentedGroup.toGroup.of _

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.psi_powVal
statement:
theorem psi_powVal (hn : n ≠ 0) (m : ℤ) (w : List (Fin flagL.m)) :
    psi hn (flagL.powVal m w) = (w.map fun e => Fperm hn e ^ m).prod
proof:
:= by
  simp only [powVal, map_list_prod, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro e _
  simp [psi_xP]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.edge_mem_K
statement:
theorem edge_mem_K (e : Fin flagL.m) :
    ∀ a ∈ ({e} : Set (Fin flagL.m)) ∪ {flagL.rev e}, flagL.src a ∈
      ({flagL.src e, flagL.tgt e} : Finset (Fin flagL.nv)) ∧
      flagL.tgt a ∈ ({flagL.src e, flagL.tgt e} : Finset (Fin flagL.nv))
proof:
:= by
  rintro a (rfl | rfl)
  · simp
  · simp [flagL_rev_src, flagL_rev_tgt]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.Fperm_zpow
statement:
theorem Fperm_zpow (hn : n ≠ 0) (e : Fin flagL.m) (k : ℤ) (p : PosL) (f : Fin 5) :
    (Fperm hn e ^ k) (p, f) = ((beta e ^ k) p,
      (if height p.1 = n then tau (cv ((beta e ^ k) p)) (cv p) else 1) f)
proof:
:= by
  have hK := isCl_edge e
  obtain ⟨j, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg k
  · have hes : ∀ a ∈ List.replicate j e, flagL.src a ∈
        ({flagL.src e, flagL.tgt e} : Finset (Fin flagL.nv)) ∧
        flagL.tgt a ∈ ({flagL.src e, flagL.tgt e} : Finset (Fin flagL.nv)) := by
      intro a ha
      rw [List.eq_of_mem_replicate ha]
      simp
    have h := prod_Fperm hn hK hes p f
    rw [List.map_replicate, List.prod_replicate, List.map_replicate, List.prod_replicate] at h
    simpa only [zpow_natCast] using h
  · have hes : ∀ a ∈ List.replicate j (flagL.rev e), flagL.src a ∈
        ({flagL.src e, flagL.tgt e} : Finset (Fin flagL.nv)) ∧
        flagL.tgt a ∈ ({flagL.src e, flagL.tgt e} : Finset (Fin flagL.nv)) := by
      intro a ha
      rw [List.eq_of_mem_replicate ha]
      simp [flagL_rev_src, flagL_rev_tgt]
    have h := prod_Fperm hn hK hes p f
    rw [List.map_replicate, List.prod_replicate, List.map_replicate, List.prod_replicate,
      Fperm_rev, beta_rev] at h
    simpa only [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_pow] using h

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.beta_zpow_mul
statement:
theorem beta_zpow_mul (e : Fin flagL.m) (m : ℤ) :
    beta e ^ m * g (flagL.tgt e) ^ m = g (flagL.src e) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Commute (g (flagL.src e)) (g (flagL.tgt e))⁻¹ :=
    (g_commute ⟨e, rfl, rfl⟩).inv_right
  rw [beta, hc.mul_zpow, inv_zpow, inv_mul_cancel_right]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.isCl_single
statement: theorem isCl_single (v : Fin flagL.nv) : IsCl {v}
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu w hw
  simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hu hw
  exact Or.inl (hu.trans hw.symm)

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.walk_cone
statement:
theorem walk_cone (hn : n ≠ 0) (m : ℤ) : ∀ (x : Fin flagL.nv) (w : List (Fin flagL.m))
    (y : Fin flagL.nv), IsWalk flagL x w y → ∀ (z : PosL) (r : Fin flagL.nv),
    (height ((g y ^ m) z).1 = n → r ∈ Ivert flagL.Adj z.1) → ∀ f : Fin 5,
    (w.map fun e => Fperm hn e ^ m).prod ((g y ^ m) z, f) = ((g x ^ m) z,
      (if height ((g y ^ m) z).1 = n then tau (cv ((g x ^ m) z)) r * tau r (cv ((g y ^ m) z))
        else 1) f)
  | x, [], y, h, z, r, hr, f => by
    change x = y at h
    subst h
    simp only [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, Equiv.Perm.one_apply]
    split_ifs with hh
    · have hq : height ((g x ^ m) z).1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by rw [hh]; exact hn
      have hR : R (cv ((g x ^ m) z)) r := by
        have := R_of_mem (isCl_single x) (zpow_mem (g_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self x)) m)
          (one_mem _) z (cv_mem hq) (hr hh)
        simpa using this
      rw [tau_mul_tau_symm hR]; rfl
    · rfl
  | x, e :: w, y, h, z, r, hr, f => by
    obtain ⟨hx, hw⟩ := h
    subst hx
    have ih := walk_cone hn m (flagL.tgt e) w y hw z r hr f
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, ih, Fperm_zpow,
      ← Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, beta_zpow_mul]
    refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
    have hh : height ((g (flagL.tgt e) ^ m) z).1 = height ((g y ^ m) z).1 := by
      rw [height_g_zpow, height_g_zpow]
    simp only [hh]
    split_ifs with h1
    · have hq : ∀ v, height ((g v ^ m) z).1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro v; rw [height_g_zpow, ← height_g_zpow y, h1]; exact hn
      have hK := isCl_edge e
      have m1 := zpow_mem (g_mem (K := {flagL.src e, flagL.tgt e})
        (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) m
      have m2 := zpow_mem (g_mem (K := {flagL.src e, flagL.tgt e})
        (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))) m
      have r12 := cv_R hK m1 m2 (hq _) (hq _)
      have r2r : R (cv ((g (flagL.tgt e) ^ m) z)) r := by
        simpa using R_of_mem hK m2 (one_mem _) z (cv_mem (hq _)) (hr h1)
      have r1r : R (cv ((g (flagL.src e) ^ m) z)) r := by
        simpa using R_of_mem hK m1 (one_mem _) z (cv_mem (hq _)) (hr h1)
      rw [← tau_tri r12 r2r r1r]
      simp only [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    · rfl

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.height_emptyPos
statement: theorem height_emptyPos : height (emptyPos flagL.Adj).1 = 0
proof: := height_proj_nil

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.cv_base
statement: theorem cv_base (hn : n ≠ 0) (v : Fin flagL.nv) : cv ((g v ^ n) (emptyPos flagL.Adj)) = v
proof:
:= by
  have hh : height ((g v ^ n) (emptyPos flagL.Adj)).1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [height_g_zpow, height_emptyPos, zero_add]; exact hn
  have hrest : rest {v} ((g v ^ n) (emptyPos flagL.Adj)).1 = fun _ _ => [] := by
    rw [rest_of_mem_closure flagL_isGraph (zpow_mem (g_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self v)) n)]
    exact rest_proj_nil _
  exact ivert_subset_of_rest_nil hrest (cv_mem hh)

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.walk_base
statement:
theorem walk_base (hn : n ≠ 0) : ∀ (x : Fin flagL.nv) (w : List (Fin flagL.m))
    (y : Fin flagL.nv), IsWalk flagL x w y → ∀ f : Fin 5,
    (w.map fun e => Fperm hn e ^ n).prod ((g y ^ n) (emptyPos flagL.Adj), f) =
      ((g x ^ n) (emptyPos flagL.Adj), (w.map flagPerm).prod f)
  | x, [], y, h, f => by
    change x = y at h
    subst h
    simp
  | x, e :: w, y, h, f => by
    obtain ⟨hx, hw⟩
proof:
:= h
    subst hx
    have ih := walk_base hn (flagL.tgt e) w y hw f
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, ih, Fperm_zpow,
      ← Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, beta_zpow_mul]
    refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
    have hh : height ((g (flagL.tgt e) ^ n) (emptyPos flagL.Adj)).1 = n := by
      rw [height_g_zpow, height_emptyPos, zero_add]
    simp only [hh, if_true, cv_base hn, tau_edge, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons,
      Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.psi_comp_rho
statement:
theorem psi_comp_rho (hn : n ≠ 0) {m : ℤ} (hm : m ≠ n) :
    (psi hn).comp (rho flagL_wf m) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply PresentedGroup.ext
  intro e
  rw [MonoidHom.comp_apply, rho_of, MonoidHom.one_apply, ← mkP_fundCycle, mkP_loopPow,
    psi_powVal]
  have hw := isWalk_fundCycle flagL_wf flagL_connected e
  refine Equiv.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨p, f⟩ := x
  set z := (g flagL.root ^ m)⁻¹ p with hzdef
  have hz : (g flagL.root ^ m) z = p := by simp [z]
  by_cases hp : height p.1 = n
  · have hz0 : height z.1 ≠ 0 := by
      have := height_g_zpow flagL.root m z
      rw [hz, hp] at this
      intro h0; rw [h0] at this; exact hm (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := ivert_nonempty z.2 hz0
    have h := walk_cone hn m _ _ _ hw z r (fun _ => hr) f
    rw [hz, if_pos hp] at h
    rw [h, Equiv.Perm.one_apply]
    have hq : height p.1 ≠ 0 := by rw [hp]; exact hn
    have hR : R (cv p) r := by
      have := R_of_mem (isCl_single flagL.root)
        (zpow_mem (g_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self flagL.root)) m) (one_mem _) z
        (by rw [hz]; exact cv_mem hq) hr
      simpa [hz] using this
    rw [tau_mul_tau_symm hR]; rfl
  · have h := walk_cone hn m _ _ _ hw z flagL.root (fun h => absurd (hz ▸ h) hp) f
    rw [hz, if_neg hp] at h
    rw [h]; rfl

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.flagLoop_perm_ne_one
statement: theorem flagLoop_perm_ne_one : (flagLoopL.map flagPerm).prod ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h1
  revert h1
  decide +kernel

name: TheoremA.Leary.Detection.psi_rho_loop_ne_one
statement: theorem psi_rho_loop_ne_one (hn : n ≠ 0) : psi hn (rho flagL_wf n (piVal flagLoopL)) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rho_loop flagL_wf n _ flagLoop_isWalk, psi_powVal]
  intro h
  apply flagLoop_perm_ne_one
  refine Equiv.ext fun f => ?_
  have := walk_base hn _ _ _ flagLoop_isWalk f
  rw [h, Equiv.Perm.one_apply, Prod.mk.injEq] at this
  exact this.2.symm

name: TheoremA.Leary.flagSeparation
statement: theorem flagSeparation : FlagSeparation
proof:
:= by
  intro S n hn hnS hmem
  apply psi_rho_loop_ne_one hn
  have hle : NS flagL_wf S ≤ (psi hn).ker := by
    unfold NS
    apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_range] at hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm, y, rfl⟩ := hx
    have hmn : m ≠ n := fun h => hnS (h ▸ hm)
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, MonoidHom.mem_ker, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, psi_comp_rho hn hmn,
      MonoidHom.one_apply]
  exact hle hmem

name: TheoremA.Leary.learyDetectionFlag
statement: theorem learyDetectionFlag : LearyDetectionFlag
proof:
:=
  learyDetection_of_flagSeparation flagSeparation

name: TheoremA.Leary.isPerfect_presentedGroup_of_abelianization
statement:
theorem isPerfect_presentedGroup_of_abelianization {α : Type*} (rels : Set (FreeGroup α))
    (h : ∀ a, Abelianization.of (PresentedGroup.of a : PresentedGroup rels) = 1) :
    IsPerfectGroup (PresentedGroup rels)
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  have hle : closure (Set.range (PresentedGroup.of (rels := rels))) ≤
      commutator (PresentedGroup rels) := by
    rw [closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rw [← Abelianization.ker_of]
    exact h a
  rw [PresentedGroup.closure_range_of, commutator_def] at hle
  exact hle trivial

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.piGrp_rel
statement:
theorem piGrp_rel {r : FreeGroup (Fin D.m)} (hr : r ∈ D.piRels) :
    FreeGroup.lift (fun a => (PresentedGroup.of a : D.PiGrp)) r = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hl : FreeGroup.lift (fun a => (PresentedGroup.of a : D.PiGrp)) =
      PresentedGroup.mk D.piRels := by ext i; rfl
  rw [hl]
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff r).2 (subset_normalClosure hr)

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.piGrp_mul_rev
statement:
theorem piGrp_mul_rev (a : Fin D.m) :
    (PresentedGroup.of a : D.PiGrp) * PresentedGroup.of (D.rev a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using D.piGrp_rel (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨a, rfl⟩))

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.piGrp_tree
statement: theorem piGrp_tree {a : Fin D.m} (ha : a ∈ D.tree) : (PresentedGroup.of a : D.PiGrp) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using D.piGrp_rel (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩))

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.piGrp_tri
statement:
theorem piGrp_tri {t} (ht : t ∈ D.tri) :
    (PresentedGroup.of t.1 : D.PiGrp) * PresentedGroup.of t.2.1 * PresentedGroup.of t.2.2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using D.piGrp_rel (Or.inr ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.PerfCert.sound
statement:
theorem sound (hC : ∀ a, C.justOK a = true) (hr : ∀ a, e a + e (D.rev a) = 0)
    (htree : ∀ a ∈ D.tree, e a = 0) (htri : ∀ t ∈ D.tri, e t.1 + e t.2.1 + e t.2.2 = 0) :
    ∀ a, e a = (C.val a).1 • e C.base0 + (C.val a).2 • e C.base1
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  induction hn : C.rank a using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing a with
  | _ n ih =>
  have ih' : ∀ b, C.rank b < C.rank a →
      e b = (C.val b).1 • e C.base0 + (C.val b).2 • e C.base1 :=
    fun b hb => ih _ (hn ▸ hb) b rfl
  have h := hC a
  unfold justOK at h
  split_ifs at h with h0 h1 h10 h2
  · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    rw [htree a h.1, h.2]; simp
  · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    rw [h.2, h.1]; simp
  · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    rw [h.2, h.1]; simp
  · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    have hv := h.2
    have i1 := ih' _ h.1
    have hra := hr a
    have c1 : (C.val a).1 = -(C.val (D.rev a)).1 := by rw [hv]; rfl
    have c2 : (C.val a).2 = -(C.val (D.rev a)).2 := by rw [hv]; rfl
    linear_combination (norm := module) hra - i1 - c1 • e C.base0 - c2 • e C.base1
  · revert h
    rcases ht : D.tri[(C.just a).2.1]? with _ | t
    · simp
    · intro h
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨hs, hp⟩ := h
      have htm : t ∈ D.tri := List.mem_of_getElem? ht
      have hsum := htri t htm
      have s1 : (C.val t.1).1 + (C.val t.2.1).1 + (C.val t.2.2).1 = 0 := by
        have := congrArg Prod.fst hs; simpa [triSum] using this
      have s2 : (C.val t.1).2 + (C.val t.2.1).2 + (C.val t.2.2).2 = 0 := by
        have := congrArg Prod.snd hs; simpa [triSum] using this
      unfold posOK at hp
      split_ifs at hp
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hp
        obtain ⟨⟨rfl, r2⟩, r3⟩ := hp
        have i2 := ih' _ r2; have i3 := ih' _ r3
        linear_combination (norm := module) hsum - i2 - i3 - s1 • e C.base0 - s2 • e C.base1
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hp
        obtain ⟨⟨rfl, r2⟩, r3⟩ := hp
        have i2 := ih' _ r2; have i3 := ih' _ r3
        linear_combination (norm := module) hsum - i2 - i3 - s1 • e C.base0 - s2 • e C.base1
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hp
        obtain ⟨⟨rfl, r2⟩, r3⟩ := hp
        have i2 := ih' _ r2; have i3 := ih' _ r3
        linear_combination (norm := module) hsum - i2 - i3 - s1 • e C.base0 - s2 • e C.base1

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.PerfCert.sv_add
statement: theorem sv_add (x y : ℤ × ℤ) : sv (C := C) e (x + y) = sv (C := C) e x + sv (C := C) e y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sv, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, add_smul]; abel

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.PerfCert.sv_smul
statement: theorem sv_smul (c : ℤ) (x : ℤ × ℤ) : sv (C := C) e (c • x) = c • sv (C := C) e x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sv, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, smul_add]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.PerfCert.sv_zero
statement: theorem sv_zero : sv (C := C) e 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [sv]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.PerfCert.sv_relSum
statement:
theorem sv_relSum (hC : ∀ a, C.justOK a = true) (hr : ∀ a, e a + e (D.rev a) = 0)
    (htree : ∀ a ∈ D.tree, e a = 0) (htri : ∀ t ∈ D.tri, e t.1 + e t.2.1 + e t.2.2 = 0)
    (i : ℕ) : sv (C := C) e (C.relSum i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold relSum
  rcases ht : D.tri[i]? with _ | t
  · exact sv_zero e
  · have htm : t ∈ D.tri := List.mem_of_getElem? ht
    have hs := sound e hC hr htree htri
    simp only [triSum, sv_add]
    unfold sv
    rw [← hs, ← hs, ← hs]
    exact htri t htm

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.PerfCert.sv_combo
statement:
theorem sv_combo (hC : ∀ a, C.justOK a = true) (hr : ∀ a, e a + e (D.rev a) = 0)
    (htree : ∀ a ∈ D.tree, e a = 0) (htri : ∀ t ∈ D.tri, e t.1 + e t.2.1 + e t.2.2 = 0)
    (L : List (ℕ × ℤ)) : sv (C := C) e (C.combo L) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => exact sv_zero e
  | cons p L ih =>
    simp only [combo, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at ih ⊢
    rw [sv_add, ih, sv_smul, sv_relSum e hC hr htree htri, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.PerfCert.all_zero
statement:
theorem all_zero (hC : C.Valid) (hr : ∀ a, e a + e (D.rev a) = 0)
    (htree : ∀ a ∈ D.tree, e a = 0) (htri : ∀ t ∈ D.tri, e t.1 + e t.2.1 + e t.2.2 = 0) :
    ∀ a, e a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hC
  have g0 : e C.base0 = 0 := by
    have := sv_combo e h1 hr htree htri C.cert0
    rw [h2] at this; simpa [sv] using this
  have g1 : e C.base1 = 0 := by
    have := sv_combo e h1 hr htree htri C.cert1
    rw [h3] at this; simpa [sv] using this
  intro a
  rw [sound e h1 hr htree htri a, g0, g1]; simp

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.PerfCert.isPerfect
statement: theorem isPerfect (hC : C.Valid) : IsPerfectGroup D.PiGrp
proof:
:= by
  apply isPerfect_presentedGroup_of_abelianization
  let e : Fin D.m → Additive (Abelianization D.PiGrp) := fun i =>
    Additive.ofMul (Abelianization.of (PresentedGroup.of i : D.PiGrp))
  have hr : ∀ a, e a + e (D.rev a) = 0 := fun a => by
    simp only [e, ← ofMul_mul, ← map_mul]
    rw [D.piGrp_mul_rev a]; rfl
  have htree : ∀ a ∈ D.tree, e a = 0 := fun a ha => by
    simp only [e]; rw [D.piGrp_tree ha]; rfl
  have htri : ∀ t ∈ D.tri, e t.1 + e t.2.1 + e t.2.2 = 0 := fun t h => by
    simp only [e, ← ofMul_mul, ← map_mul]
    rw [D.piGrp_tri h]; rfl
  intro a
  exact all_zero e hC hr htree htri a

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.isWalk_append
statement:
theorem isWalk_append : ∀ {u : Fin D.nv} {w : List (Fin D.m)} {v x : Fin D.nv}
    {w' : List (Fin D.m)}, IsWalk D u w v → IsWalk D v w' x → IsWalk D u (w ++ w') x
  | u, [], v, x, w', h, h' => by
    change u = v at h; subst h; exact h'
  | u, a :: w, v, x, w', h, h' => ⟨h.1, isWalk_append h.2 h'⟩

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.isWalk_revPath
statement:
theorem isWalk_revPath (hD : D.WF) : ∀ {u : Fin D.nv} {w : List (Fin D.m)} {v : Fin D.nv},
    IsWalk D u w v → IsWalk D v (D.revPath w) u
  | u, [], v, h => by change u = v at h; subst h; exact rfl
  | u, a :: w, v, h => by
    have ih
proof:
:= isWalk_revPath hD h.2
    have e : D.revPath (a :: w) = D.revPath w ++ [D.rev a] := by simp [revPath]
    rw [e]
    refine isWalk_append ih ⟨hD.rev_src a, ?_⟩
    change D.tgt (D.rev a) = u
    rw [hD.rev_tgt, h.1]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.isWalk_fundCycle
statement:
theorem isWalk_fundCycle (hD : D.WF) (hconn : ∀ v, IsWalk D D.root (D.path v) v) (a : Fin D.m) :
    IsWalk D D.root (D.fundCycle a) D.root
proof:
:=
  isWalk_append (isWalk_append (hconn _) ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) (isWalk_revPath hD (hconn _))

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.NS_mono
statement: theorem NS_mono (hD : D.WF) {S S' : Set ℤ} (h : S ⊆ S') : NS hD S ≤ NS hD S'
proof:
:=
  normalClosure_mono (Set.biUnion_subset_biUnion_left h)

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.mem_nc_jRels_iff
statement:
theorem mem_nc_jRels_iff (hD : D.WF) (S : Set ℤ) (r : FreeGroup (Fin D.m)) :
    r ∈ normalClosure (D.jRels S) ↔ D.mkP r ∈ NS hD S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_normalClosure_jRels hD S]
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨r, h, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨r', hr', he⟩
  have h1 : D.mkP (r'⁻¹ * r) = 1 := by rw [map_mul, map_inv, he, inv_mul_cancel]
  have h2 : r'⁻¹ * r ∈ normalClosure (D.jRels S) :=
    normalClosure_mono Set.subset_union_left ((QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).1 h1)
  simpa using mul_mem hr' h2

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.powVal_mem_NS
statement:
theorem powVal_mem_NS (hD : D.WF) {S : Set ℤ} {n : ℤ} (hn : n ∈ S) {v : Fin D.nv}
    {w : List (Fin D.m)} (hw : IsWalk D v w v) : D.powVal n w ∈ NS hD S
proof:
:= by
  have h := rho_walk hD n v w v hw
  have hmem : rho hD n (piVal w) ∈ NS hD S :=
    subset_normalClosure (Set.mem_biUnion hn ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  rw [h] at hmem
  have := (NS_normal hD S).conj_mem _ hmem (D.gP n v)⁻¹
  simpa [mul_assoc] using this

name: TheoremA.Leary.cycFormB_eq
statement: theorem cycFormB_eq : cycFormB = true
proof: := by decide +kernel

name: TheoremA.Leary.revN_lt
statement: theorem revN_lt {a : Nat} (ha : a < 432) : revN a < 432
proof:
:= by
  unfold revN; split_ifs <;> omega

name: TheoremA.Leary.rev_val
statement: theorem rev_val (a : Fin flagL.m) : (flagL.rev a).val = revN a.val
proof:
:= by
  show (Fin.ofNat 432 (if a.val % 2 = 0 then a.val + 1 else a.val - 1)).val = _
  rw [Fin.val_ofNat]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (revN_lt a.isLt)

name: TheoremA.Leary.flagL_cycle_form
statement:
theorem flagL_cycle_form (a b c : Fin flagL.m) (hab : flagL.tgt a = flagL.src b)
    (hbc : flagL.tgt b = flagL.src c) (hca : flagL.tgt c = flagL.src a) :
    ∃ t ∈ flagL.tri, (a = t.1 ∧ b = t.2.1 ∧ c = t.2.2) ∨ (a = t.2.1 ∧ b = t.2.2 ∧ c = t.1) ∨
      (a = t.2.2 ∧ b = t.1 ∧ c = t.2.1) ∨
      (a = flagL.rev t.2.2 ∧ b = flagL.rev t.2.1 ∧ c = flagL.rev t.1) ∨
      (a = flagL.rev t.2.1 ∧ b = flagL.rev t.1 ∧ c = flagL.rev t.2.2) ∨
      (a = flagL.rev t.1 ∧ b = flagL.rev t.2.2 ∧ c = flagL.rev t.2.1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := cycFormB_eq
  simp only [cycFormB, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true',
    beq_eq_false_iff_ne, List.any_eq_true] at h
  have hab' := congrArg Fin.val hab; have hbc' := congrArg Fin.val hbc
  have hca' := congrArg Fin.val hca
  rw [tgt_val, src_val] at hab' hbc' hca'
  have hb : b.val ∈ outN (tgtN a.val) := by rw [hab']; exact mem_outN b
  have hc : c.val ∈ outN (tgtN b.val) := by rw [hbc']; exact mem_outN c
  rcases h a.val a.isLt b.val hb c.val hc with h' | ⟨r, hr, hp⟩
  · exact absurd hca' h'
  · have hr' : ((Fin.ofNat 432 r.1, Fin.ofNat 432 r.2.1, Fin.ofNat 432 r.2.2) :
        Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m) ∈ flagL.tri := by
      simp only [flagL, List.mem_map]; exact ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨_, hr', ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨l1, l2, l3⟩ := tri_lt hr
    have v1 : (Fin.ofNat 432 r.1 : Fin flagL.m).val = r.1 := by
      rw [Fin.val_ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt l1]
    have v2 : (Fin.ofNat 432 r.2.1 : Fin flagL.m).val = r.2.1 := by
      rw [Fin.val_ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt l2]
    have v3 : (Fin.ofNat 432 r.2.2 : Fin flagL.m).val = r.2.2 := by
      rw [Fin.val_ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt l3]
    simp only [formB, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at hp
    rw [← v1, ← v2, ← v3, ← rev_val, ← rev_val, ← rev_val] at hp
    simp only [← Fin.ext_iff, and_assoc, or_assoc] at hp
    exact hp

name: TheoremA.Leary.flagL_cycle_rel
statement:
theorem flagL_cycle_rel {G : Type*} [Group G] (f : Fin flagL.m → G)
    (hrev : ∀ a, f (flagL.rev a) = (f a)⁻¹)
    (htri : ∀ t ∈ flagL.tri, f t.1 * f t.2.1 * f t.2.2 = 1) {a b c : Fin flagL.m}
    (hab : flagL.tgt a = flagL.src b) (hbc : flagL.tgt b = flagL.src c)
    (hca : flagL.tgt c = flagL.src a) : f a * f b * f c = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, h⟩ := flagL_cycle_form a b c hab hbc hca
  have e := htri t ht
  set x := f t.1; set y := f t.2.1; set z := f t.2.2
  rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact e
  · calc y * z * x = x⁻¹ * (x * y * z) * x := by group
      _ = 1 := by rw [e]; group
  · calc z * x * y = (x * y)⁻¹ * (x * y * z) * (x * y) := by group
      _ = 1 := by rw [e]; group
  · rw [hrev, hrev, hrev]
    calc z⁻¹ * y⁻¹ * x⁻¹ = (x * y * z)⁻¹ := by group
      _ = 1 := by rw [e]; group
  · rw [hrev, hrev, hrev]
    calc y⁻¹ * x⁻¹ * z⁻¹ = z * (x * y * z)⁻¹ * z⁻¹ := by group
      _ = 1 := by rw [e]; group
  · rw [hrev, hrev, hrev]
    calc x⁻¹ * z⁻¹ * y⁻¹ = (y * z) * (x * y * z)⁻¹ * (y * z)⁻¹ := by group
      _ = 1 := by rw [e]; group

name: TheoremA.Leary.learyRels_subset
statement: theorem learyRels_subset (S : Set ℤ) : flagL.learyRels S ⊆ normalClosure (flagL.jRels S)
proof:
:= by
  rintro r (((⟨a, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, b, c, ⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩, rfl⟩) | ⟨a, b, c, ⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩, rfl⟩) |
    ⟨n, hn, v, w, hw, rfl⟩)
  · exact subset_normalClosure (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨a, rfl⟩)))
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_nc_jRels_iff flagL_wf]
    have : flagL.mkP (flagL.fe a * flagL.fe b * flagL.fe c) = 1 := by
      simp only [map_mul]
      exact flagL_cycle_rel flagL.xP flagL.xP_rev (fun t ht => flagL.tri_mul ht) h1 h2 h3
    rw [this]; exact one_mem _
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_nc_jRels_iff flagL_wf]
    have : flagL.mkP ((flagL.fe a)⁻¹ * (flagL.fe b)⁻¹ * (flagL.fe c)⁻¹) = 1 := by
      simp only [map_mul, map_inv]
      exact flagL_cycle_rel (fun a => (flagL.xP a)⁻¹) (fun a => by simp only [flagL.xP_rev])
        (fun t ht => flagL.tri_mul_inv ht) h1 h2 h3
    rw [this]; exact one_mem _
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_nc_jRels_iff flagL_wf, mkP_loopPow]
    exact powVal_mem_NS flagL_wf hn hw

name: TheoremA.Leary.jRels_subset
statement: theorem jRels_subset (S : Set ℤ) : flagL.jRels S ⊆ normalClosure (flagL.learyRels S)
proof:
:= by
  rintro r (((⟨a, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩) | ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩) | ⟨n, hn, a, rfl⟩)
  · exact subset_normalClosure (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨a, rfl⟩)))
  · exact subset_normalClosure (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨_, _, _,
      ⟨flagL_tri_ab t ht, flagL_tri_bc t ht, flagL_tri_ca t ht, t, ht, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)))
  · exact subset_normalClosure (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨_, _, _,
      ⟨flagL_tri_ab t ht, flagL_tri_bc t ht, flagL_tri_ca t ht, t, ht, rfl⟩, rfl⟩))
  · exact subset_normalClosure
      (Or.inr ⟨n, hn, _, _, isWalk_fundCycle flagL_wf flagL_connected a, rfl⟩)

name: TheoremA.Leary.nc_learyRels_eq
statement:
theorem nc_learyRels_eq (S : Set ℤ) :
    normalClosure (flagL.learyRels S) = normalClosure (flagL.jRels S)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (normalClosure_le_normal (learyRels_subset S))
    (normalClosure_le_normal (jRels_subset S))

name: TheoremA.Leary.learyEquivJ_mk
statement:
theorem learyEquivJ_mk (S : Set ℤ) (r : FreeGroup (Fin flagL.m)) :
    learyEquivJ S (PresentedGroup.mk _ r) = PresentedGroup.mk _ r
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Leary.learyEquivJ_of
statement:
theorem learyEquivJ_of (S : Set ℤ) (a : Fin flagL.m) :
    learyEquivJ S (PresentedGroup.of a) = PresentedGroup.of a
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Leary.mk_jRels_loopPow
statement:
theorem mk_jRels_loopPow (S : Set ℤ) (w : List (Fin flagL.m)) (n : ℤ) :
    PresentedGroup.mk (flagL.jRels S) (flagL.loopPow w n) = (w.map fun e => flagL.xJ S e ^ n).prod
proof:
:= by
  simp only [loopPow, map_list_prod, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: TheoremA.Leary.learyEquivJ_loopPow
statement:
theorem learyEquivJ_loopPow (S : Set ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    learyEquivJ S (PresentedGroup.mk _ (flagL.loopPow flagLoopL n)) = Ys (jDet S) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [learyEquivJ_mk, mk_jRels_loopPow, Ys_jDet]

name: TheoremA.Leary.mk_leary_loop_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem mk_leary_loop_eq_one_iff (S : Set ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    PresentedGroup.mk (flagL.learyRels S) (flagL.loopPow flagLoopL n) = 1 ↔
      rho flagL_wf n (piVal flagLoopL) ∈ NS flagL_wf S
proof:
:= by
  refine Iff.trans (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := normalClosure (flagL.learyRels S))
    (flagL.loopPow flagLoopL n)) ?_
  rw [nc_learyRels_eq, mem_nc_jRels_iff flagL_wf, mkP_loopPow,
    ← rho_loop flagL_wf n _ flagLoop_isWalk]

name: TheoremA.Leary.flagSeparation_of_learyDetection
statement: theorem flagSeparation_of_learyDetection (h : LearyDetectionFlag) : FlagSeparation
proof:
:= by
  intro S n hn0 hnS hmem
  have h' := (mk_leary_loop_eq_one_iff (insert 0 S) n).2
    (NS_mono flagL_wf (Set.subset_insert _ _) hmem)
  rcases (h (insert 0 S) (Set.mem_insert _ _) n).1 h' with h1 | h1
  · exact hn0 h1
  · exact hnS h1

name: TheoremA.Leary.learyDetection_of_flagSeparation
statement: theorem learyDetection_of_flagSeparation (h : FlagSeparation) : LearyDetectionFlag
proof:
:= by
  intro S h0 n
  rw [mk_leary_loop_eq_one_iff]
  refine ⟨fun hm => ?_, fun hn => subset_normalClosure (Set.mem_biUnion hn ⟨_, rfl⟩)⟩
  by_contra hn
  exact h S n (by rintro rfl; exact hn h0) hn hm

name: TheoremA.Leary.learyDetection_iff_flagSeparation
statement: theorem learyDetection_iff_flagSeparation : LearyDetectionFlag ↔ FlagSeparation
proof:
:=
  ⟨flagSeparation_of_learyDetection, learyDetection_of_flagSeparation⟩

name: TheoremA.Leary.piVal_append
statement:
theorem piVal_append {D : EdgeData} (u v : List (Fin D.m)) :
    piVal (u ++ v) = piVal u * piVal v
proof:
:= by
  simp [piVal, List.prod_append]

name: TheoremA.Leary.piVal_cons
statement:
theorem piVal_cons {D : EdgeData} (a : Fin D.m) (v : List (Fin D.m)) :
    piVal (a :: v) = (PresentedGroup.of a : D.PiGrp) * piVal v
proof:
:= by
  simp [piVal]

name: TheoremA.Leary.pi_of_rev
statement:
theorem pi_of_rev (a : Fin flagL.m) :
    (PresentedGroup.of (flagL.rev a) : flagL.PiGrp) = (PresentedGroup.of a)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right ?_
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := normalClosure flagL.piRels) (flagL.fe a * flagL.fe (flagL.rev a))).2
    (subset_normalClosure (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨a, rfl⟩)))

name: TheoremA.Leary.pi_tri
statement:
theorem pi_tri {t} (ht : t ∈ flagL.tri) :
    (PresentedGroup.of t.1 : flagL.PiGrp) * PresentedGroup.of t.2.1 * PresentedGroup.of t.2.2 = 1
proof:
:=
  (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := normalClosure flagL.piRels)
    (flagL.fe t.1 * flagL.fe t.2.1 * flagL.fe t.2.2)).2 (subset_normalClosure (Or.inr ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩))

name: TheoremA.Leary.piVal_step_flagL
statement:
theorem piVal_step_flagL {w w' : List (Fin flagL.m)} (h : EdgeStep flagL w w') :
    piVal w = piVal w'
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | backtrack u v a =>
    rw [piVal_append, piVal_append, piVal_cons, piVal_cons, pi_of_rev, mul_inv_cancel_left]
  | triangle u v a b c h =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩ := h
    have e := flagL_cycle_rel (fun a => (PresentedGroup.of a : flagL.PiGrp)) pi_of_rev
      (fun t ht => pi_tri ht) h1 h2 h3
    rw [piVal_append, piVal_append, piVal_cons, piVal_cons, piVal_cons, pi_of_rev,
      ← eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left e, mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Leary.piVal_eq_of_homotopic
statement:
theorem piVal_eq_of_homotopic {w w' : List (Fin flagL.m)} (h : EdgeHomotopic flagL w w') :
    piVal w = piVal w'
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel _ _ h => exact piVal_step_flagL h
  | refl => rfl
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2

name: TheoremA.Leary.flagLoop_not_homotopic_nil
statement: theorem flagLoop_not_homotopic_nil : ¬ EdgeHomotopic flagL flagLoopL []
proof:
:= fun h =>
  flagLoop_ne_one (by rw [piVal_eq_of_homotopic h]; simp [piVal])

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.shortRels_finite
statement: theorem shortRels_finite : D.shortRels.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ((Set.Finite.union ?_ ?_).union ?_)
  · exact (Set.finite_range fun a => D.fe a * D.fe (D.rev a)).subset (by
      rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact ⟨a, rfl⟩)
  · exact ((D.tri.finite_toSet).image fun t => D.fe t.1 * D.fe t.2.1 * D.fe t.2.2).subset (by
      rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩; exact ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)
  · exact ((D.tri.finite_toSet).image
      fun t => (D.fe t.1)⁻¹ * (D.fe t.2.1)⁻¹ * (D.fe t.2.2)⁻¹).subset (by
      rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩; exact ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.isFP_two_PGrp
statement: theorem isFP_two_PGrp : IsFP 2 D.PGrp
proof:
:=
  isFP_two_presentedGroup_of_finite _ D.shortRels_finite

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.PGrp_rel
statement:
theorem PGrp_rel {r : FreeGroup (Fin D.m)} (hr : r ∈ D.shortRels) :
    FreeGroup.lift D.xP r = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hl : FreeGroup.lift D.xP = PresentedGroup.mk D.shortRels := by
    ext i; rfl
  have : FreeGroup.lift D.xP r = (QuotientGroup.mk r : D.PGrp) := by
    rw [hl]; rfl
  rw [this, QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff]
  exact Subgroup.subset_normalClosure hr

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.xP_mul_rev
statement: theorem xP_mul_rev (a : Fin D.m) : D.xP a * D.xP (D.rev a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := D.PGrp_rel (r := D.fe a * D.fe (D.rev a)) (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨a, rfl⟩))
  simpa using this

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.xP_rev
statement: theorem xP_rev (a : Fin D.m) : D.xP (D.rev a) = (D.xP a)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right (D.xP_mul_rev a)

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.tri_mul
statement: theorem tri_mul {t} (ht : t ∈ D.tri) : D.xP t.1 * D.xP t.2.1 * D.xP t.2.2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := D.PGrp_rel (r := D.fe t.1 * D.fe t.2.1 * D.fe t.2.2) (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩))
  simpa using this

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.tri_mul_inv
statement:
theorem tri_mul_inv {t} (ht : t ∈ D.tri) :
    (D.xP t.1)⁻¹ * (D.xP t.2.1)⁻¹ * (D.xP t.2.2)⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := D.PGrp_rel (r := (D.fe t.1)⁻¹ * (D.fe t.2.1)⁻¹ * (D.fe t.2.2)⁻¹) (Or.inr ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)
  simpa using this

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.tri_commute
statement: theorem tri_commute {t} (ht : t ∈ D.tri) : Commute (D.xP t.1) (D.xP t.2.1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := D.tri_mul ht
  have h2 := D.tri_mul_inv ht
  set a := D.xP t.1; set b := D.xP t.2.1; set c := D.xP t.2.2
  have e1 : c = (a * b)⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h1
  have e2 : c⁻¹ = (a⁻¹ * b⁻¹)⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h2
  have e3 : c = a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ := inv_inj.mp e2
  have e4 : a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹ := by rw [← e3, e1, mul_inv_rev]
  exact Commute.inv_inv_iff.mp e4

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.tri_zpow
statement:
theorem tri_zpow {t} (ht : t ∈ D.tri) (n : ℤ) :
    D.xP t.1 ^ n * D.xP t.2.1 ^ n * D.xP t.2.2 ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hc : D.xP t.2.2 = (D.xP t.1 * D.xP t.2.1)⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right (D.tri_mul ht)
  rw [hc, ← (D.tri_commute ht).mul_zpow, inv_zpow, mul_inv_cancel]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.xP_rev_zpow
statement: theorem xP_rev_zpow (a : Fin D.m) (n : ℤ) : D.xP (D.rev a) ^ n = (D.xP a ^ n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [xP_rev, inv_zpow]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.powVal_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem powVal_nil (n : ℤ) : D.powVal n [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.powVal_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem powVal_cons (n : ℤ) (a : Fin D.m) (w : List (Fin D.m)) :
    D.powVal n (a :: w) = D.xP a ^ n * D.powVal n w
proof: := by simp [powVal]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.powVal_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem powVal_append (n : ℤ) (v w : List (Fin D.m)) :
    D.powVal n (v ++ w) = D.powVal n v * D.powVal n w
proof: := by simp [powVal]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.powVal_revPath
statement:
theorem powVal_revPath (n : ℤ) (w : List (Fin D.m)) :
    D.powVal n (D.revPath w) = (D.powVal n w)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [revPath]
  | cons a w ih =>
    simp only [revPath, List.map_cons, List.reverse_cons, powVal_append, powVal_cons,
      powVal_nil, mul_one] at ih ⊢
    rw [ih, xP_rev_zpow, mul_inv_rev]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.zP_rel
statement:
theorem zP_rel (hD : D.WF) (n : ℤ) {r : FreeGroup (Fin D.m)} (hr : r ∈ D.piRels) :
    FreeGroup.lift (D.zP n) r = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hr with (⟨a, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩) | ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  · simp only [map_mul, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, zP, hD.rev_src, hD.rev_tgt, D.xP_rev_zpow]
    group
  · simp only [FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, zP, gP]
    rcases hD.tree_path a ha with h | h
    · rw [h, powVal_append, powVal_cons, powVal_nil, mul_one]; group
    · rw [h, powVal_append, powVal_cons, powVal_nil, mul_one, xP_rev_zpow]; group
  · simp only [map_mul, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, zP]
    rw [hD.tri_ab t ht, hD.tri_bc t ht, hD.tri_ca t ht]
    have h := D.tri_zpow ht n
    calc D.gP n (D.src t.1) * D.xP t.1 ^ n * (D.gP n (D.src t.2.1))⁻¹ *
          (D.gP n (D.src t.2.1) * D.xP t.2.1 ^ n * (D.gP n (D.src t.2.2))⁻¹) *
          (D.gP n (D.src t.2.2) * D.xP t.2.2 ^ n * (D.gP n (D.src t.1))⁻¹)
        = D.gP n (D.src t.1) * (D.xP t.1 ^ n * D.xP t.2.1 ^ n * D.xP t.2.2 ^ n) *
          (D.gP n (D.src t.1))⁻¹ := by group
      _ = 1 := by rw [h]; group

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.rho_of
statement:
theorem rho_of (hD : D.WF) (n : ℤ) (a : Fin D.m) :
    rho hD n (PresentedGroup.of a) = D.zP n a
proof:
:=
  PresentedGroup.toGroup.of _

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.rho_walk
statement:
theorem rho_walk (hD : D.WF) (n : ℤ) : ∀ (u : Fin D.nv) (w : List (Fin D.m)) (v : Fin D.nv),
    IsWalk D u w v → rho hD n (piVal w) = D.gP n u * D.powVal n w * (D.gP n v)⁻¹
  | u, [], v, h => by
    change u = v at h; subst h; simp [piVal]
  | u, a :: w, v, h => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩
proof:
:= h
    have ih := rho_walk hD n (D.tgt a) w v h2
    have : piVal (a :: w) = (PresentedGroup.of a : D.PiGrp) * piVal w := by simp [piVal]
    rw [this, map_mul, ih, rho_of, zP, h1, powVal_cons]
    group

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.rho_loop
statement:
theorem rho_loop (hD : D.WF) (n : ℤ) (w : List (Fin D.m)) (hw : IsWalk D D.root w D.root) :
    rho hD n (piVal w) = D.powVal n w
proof:
:= by
  rw [rho_walk hD n _ w _ hw, gP, hD.path_root]; simp

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.qS_of
statement:
theorem qS_of (S : Set ℤ) (a : Fin D.m) :
    D.qS S (PresentedGroup.of a) = PresentedGroup.of a
proof:
:=
  PresentedGroup.toGroup.of _

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.qS_surjective
statement: theorem qS_surjective (S : Set ℤ) : Function.Surjective (D.qS S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff, ← PresentedGroup.closure_range_of,
    Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨PresentedGroup.of a, D.qS_of S a⟩

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.mkP_loopPow
statement: theorem mkP_loopPow (w : List (Fin D.m)) (n : ℤ) : D.mkP (D.loopPow w n) = D.powVal n w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [loopPow, powVal, map_list_prod, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.mkP_fundCycle
statement:
theorem mkP_fundCycle (n : ℤ) (a : Fin D.m) :
    D.mkP (D.loopPow (D.fundCycle a) n) = D.zP n a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkP_loopPow, fundCycle, powVal_append, powVal_append, powVal_revPath, zP, gP, gP]
  simp

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.mkP_surjective
statement: theorem mkP_surjective : Function.Surjective D.mkP
proof: := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.map_normalClosure_jRels
statement:
theorem map_normalClosure_jRels (hD : D.WF) (S : Set ℤ) :
    (normalClosure (D.jRels S)).map D.mkP = NS hD S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subgroup.map_normalClosure _ _ mkP_surjective]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply normalClosure_le_normal
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr | ⟨n, hn, a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · have h1 : D.mkP r = 1 := (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff r).2 (subset_normalClosure hr)
      rw [h1]
      exact one_mem _
    · rw [mkP_fundCycle, ← rho_of hD]
      exact subset_normalClosure (Set.mem_biUnion hn ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  · haveI : (normalClosure (D.mkP '' D.jRels S)).Normal := normalClosure_normal
    apply normalClosure_le_normal
    simp only [Set.iUnion_subset_iff]
    intro n hn
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have hy : y ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range PresentedGroup.of) := by
      rw [PresentedGroup.closure_range_of]; trivial
    have : y ∈ (normalClosure (D.mkP '' D.jRels S)).comap (rho hD n) := by
      refine (Subgroup.closure_le _).2 ?_ hy
      rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
      show (PresentedGroup.of a : D.PiGrp) ∈
        (normalClosure (D.mkP '' D.jRels S)).comap (rho hD n)
      rw [Subgroup.mem_comap, rho_of, ← mkP_fundCycle]
      exact subset_normalClosure ⟨_, Or.inr ⟨n, hn, a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact this

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.qS_mkP
statement:
theorem qS_mkP (S : Set ℤ) (r : FreeGroup (Fin D.m)) :
    D.qS S (D.mkP r) = PresentedGroup.mk (D.jRels S) r
proof:
:= by
  induction r using FreeGroup.induction_on with
  | one => simp
  | of a => exact D.qS_of S a
  | inv_of a ih => rw [map_inv, map_inv, ih, map_inv]
  | mul x y hx hy => rw [map_mul, map_mul, hx, hy, map_mul]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.mk_jRels_eq_one
statement:
theorem mk_jRels_eq_one (S : Set ℤ) {r : FreeGroup (Fin D.m)} (hr : r ∈ D.jRels S) :
    PresentedGroup.mk (D.jRels S) r = 1
proof:
:=
  (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff r).2 (subset_normalClosure hr)

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.NS_le_ker
statement: theorem NS_le_ker (hD : D.WF) (S : Set ℤ) : NS hD S ≤ (D.qS S).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply normalClosure_le_normal
  simp only [Set.iUnion_subset_iff]
  intro n hn
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hy : y ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range PresentedGroup.of) := by
    rw [PresentedGroup.closure_range_of]; trivial
  have : y ∈ (D.qS S).ker.comap (rho hD n) := by
    refine (Subgroup.closure_le _).2 ?_ hy
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Subgroup.mem_comap, rho_of, ← mkP_fundCycle, MonoidHom.mem_ker, qS_mkP]
    exact D.mk_jRels_eq_one S (Or.inr ⟨n, hn, a, rfl⟩)
  exact Subgroup.mem_comap.mp this

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.jToQuot_of
statement:
theorem jToQuot_of (hD : D.WF) (S : Set ℤ) (a : Fin D.m) :
    jToQuot hD S (PresentedGroup.of a) = QuotientGroup.mk (D.xP a)
proof:
:=
  PresentedGroup.toGroup.of _

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.jToQuot_qS
statement:
theorem jToQuot_qS (hD : D.WF) (S : Set ℤ) (x : D.PGrp) :
    jToQuot hD S (D.qS S x) = QuotientGroup.mk x
proof:
:= by
  have : (jToQuot hD S).comp (D.qS S) = QuotientGroup.mk' (NS hD S) := by
    apply PresentedGroup.ext
    intro a
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, qS_of, jToQuot_of]
    rfl
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this x

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.jEquiv_of
statement:
theorem jEquiv_of (hD : D.WF) (S : Set ℤ) (a : Fin D.m) :
    jEquiv hD S (PresentedGroup.of a) = QuotientGroup.mk (D.xP a)
proof:
:=
  jToQuot_of hD S a

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.jEquiv_qS
statement:
theorem jEquiv_qS (hD : D.WF) (S : Set ℤ) (x : D.PGrp) :
    jEquiv hD S (D.qS S x) = QuotientGroup.mk x
proof:
:=
  jToQuot_qS hD S x

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.ker_qS
statement: theorem ker_qS (hD : D.WF) (S : Set ℤ) : (D.qS S).ker = NS hD S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, ← (jEquiv hD S).map_eq_one_iff, jEquiv_qS, QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.isFP_two_JGrp
statement:
theorem isFP_two_JGrp (hD : D.WF) (hPi : IsPerfectGroup D.PiGrp) (S : Set ℤ) :
    IsFP 2 (D.JGrp S)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsFP 2 (D.PGrp ⧸ NS hD S) :=
    isFP_two_quotient_of_perfect D.isFP_two_PGrp _
      (normalClosure_ranges_perfect' hPi S (rho hD))
  exact IsFP.of_mulEquiv (jEquiv hD S).symm h1

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.qS_powVal
statement:
theorem qS_powVal (S : Set ℤ) (n : ℤ) (w : List (Fin D.m)) :
    D.qS S (D.powVal n w) = (w.map fun e => D.xJ S e ^ n).prod
proof:
:= by
  simp only [powVal, map_list_prod, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro e _
  simp [qS_of]

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.loop_eq_one_of_mem
statement:
theorem loop_eq_one_of_mem (hD : D.WF) {S : Set ℤ} {n : ℤ} (hn : n ∈ S) (w : List (Fin D.m))
    (hw : IsWalk D D.root w D.root) : (w.map fun e => D.xJ S e ^ n).prod = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← qS_powVal, ← rho_loop hD n w hw, ← MonoidHom.mem_ker, ker_qS hD]
  exact subset_normalClosure (Set.mem_biUnion hn ⟨_, rfl⟩)

name: TheoremA.Leary.EdgeData.loop_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem loop_eq_one_iff (hD : D.WF) (S : Set ℤ) (n : ℤ) (w : List (Fin D.m))
    (hw : IsWalk D D.root w D.root) :
    (w.map fun e => D.xJ S e ^ n).prod = 1 ↔ rho hD n (piVal w) ∈ NS hD S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← qS_powVal, ← rho_loop hD n w hw, ← MonoidHom.mem_ker, ker_qS hD]

name: TheoremA.Leary.range_le_commutator_of_perfect
statement:
theorem range_le_commutator_of_perfect {A P : Type*} [Group A] [Group P] (hA : IsPerfectGroup A)
    (f : A →* P) {N : Subgroup P} (hN : f.range ≤ N) : f.range ≤ ⁅N, N⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
  calc Subgroup.map f (⊤ : Subgroup A) ≤ Subgroup.map f ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup A), ⊤⁆ :=
        Subgroup.map_mono hA
    _ = ⁅Subgroup.map f (⊤ : Subgroup A), Subgroup.map f (⊤ : Subgroup A)⁆ :=
        Subgroup.map_commutator _ _ _
    _ ≤ ⁅N, N⁆ := by
      rw [← MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mono hN hN

name: TheoremA.Leary.normalClosure_ranges_perfect
statement:
theorem normalClosure_ranges_perfect {P : Type*} [Group P] {ι : Type*} {A : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, Group (A i)] (hA : ∀ i, IsPerfectGroup (A i)) (f : ∀ i, A i →* P) :
    normalClosure (⋃ i, Set.range (f i)) ≤
      ⁅normalClosure (⋃ i, Set.range (f i)), normalClosure (⋃ i, Set.range (f i))⁆
proof:
:= by
  set N := normalClosure (⋃ i, Set.range (f i))
  haveI : N.Normal := normalClosure_normal
  haveI : (⁅N, N⁆).Normal := Subgroup.commutator_normal N N
  apply normalClosure_le_normal
  refine Set.iUnion_subset fun i => ?_
  have hle : (f i).range ≤ N := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact subset_normalClosure (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, a, rfl⟩)
  intro x hx
  exact range_le_commutator_of_perfect (hA i) (f i) hle hx

name: TheoremA.Leary.normalClosure_ranges_perfect'
statement:
theorem normalClosure_ranges_perfect' {P A : Type*} [Group P] [Group A] (hA : IsPerfectGroup A)
    {σ : Type*} (S : Set σ) (f : σ → A →* P) :
    normalClosure (⋃ s ∈ S, Set.range (f s)) ≤
      ⁅normalClosure (⋃ s ∈ S, Set.range (f s)), normalClosure (⋃ s ∈ S, Set.range (f s))⁆
proof:
:= by
  have h := normalClosure_ranges_perfect (A := fun _ : S => A) (fun _ => hA)
    (fun s : S => f s.1)
  have hset : (⋃ s ∈ S, Set.range (f s)) = ⋃ s : S, Set.range (f s.1) := by
    ext x; simp
  rw [hset]; exact h

name: TheoremA.Leary.isFP_two_quotient_normalClosure_ranges
proof:
:=
  isFP_two_quotient_of_perfect hP _ (normalClosure_ranges_perfect hA f)

name: TheoremA.Leary.flagL_m

name: TheoremA.Leary.flagL_rev_src

name: TheoremA.Leary.flagL_rev_tgt

name: TheoremA.Leary.flagL_forall_tri
statement:
theorem flagL_forall_tri {P : Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m × Fin flagL.m → Prop} [DecidablePred P]
    (h : (flagTri.all fun t =>
      decide (P (Fin.ofNat 432 t.1, Fin.ofNat 432 t.2.1, Fin.ofNat 432 t.2.2))) = true) :
    ∀ t ∈ flagL.tri, P t
proof:
:= by

  simp only [flagL, List.mem_map] at ht

name: TheoremA.Leary.flagL_tri_ab

name: TheoremA.Leary.piToA5_piVal
statement:

    piToA5 (EdgeData.piVal (D := flagL) w) = (w.map flagPerm).prod
proof:

  | nil => simp [EdgeData.piVal]
  | cons a w ih =>
