proof:
:=
  PresentedGroup.ext fun a => by simp

name: TheoremA.RelPres.omegaIncl_injective
statement: theorem omegaIncl_injective (n c : ℕ) : Function.Injective (omegaIncl R n c)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have := congrArg (omegaProj R n c) h
  simpa [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, omegaProj_comp_omegaIncl] using this

name: TheoremA.RelPres.famOf_of_congr
statement:
theorem famOf_of_congr {n c n' c' a' : ℕ} (a : Fin n) (h : a' < n') (hn : n' = n)
    (hc : c' = c) (ha : a' = a.val) :
    famOf R n' c' (PresentedGroup.of ⟨a', h⟩) = famOf R n c (PresentedGroup.of a)
proof:
:= by
  subst hn hc ha; rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.freeGen_tag
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeGen_tag (n c : ℕ) (a : Fin n) :
    freeGen R (tag n c a) = famOf R n c (PresentedGroup.of a)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : ValidLabel (tag n c a) := validLabel_tag.2 a.2
  rw [freeGen, dif_pos hv]
  exact famOf_of_congr a _ (labelN_tag _ _ _) (labelC_tag _ _ _) (labelA_tag _ _ _)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.omegaToFreeProd_gen
statement: @[simp] theorem omegaToFreeProd_gen (q : ℕ) : omegaToFreeProd R (Omega.gen R q) = freeGen R q
proof:
:=
  PresentedGroup.toGroup.of _

name: TheoremA.RelPres.freeProdToOmega_famOf
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeProdToOmega_famOf (n c : ℕ) (x : famGroup R n c) :
    freeProdToOmega R (famOf R n c x) = omegaIncl R n c x
proof:
:=
  Monoid.CoprodI.lift_of _ x

name: TheoremA.RelPres.freeProdToOmega_freeGen
statement: theorem freeProdToOmega_freeGen (q : ℕ) : freeProdToOmega R (freeGen R q) = Omega.gen R q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ValidLabel q
  · rw [freeGen, dif_pos h, freeProdToOmega_famOf, omegaIncl_of]
    simp only [tag_label]
  · rw [freeGen, dif_neg h, map_one, Omega.gen_eq_one_of_not_validLabel h]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.omegaToFreeProd_comp_omegaIncl
statement:
theorem omegaToFreeProd_comp_omegaIncl (n c : ℕ) :
    (omegaToFreeProd R).comp (omegaIncl R n c) = famOf R n c
proof:
:=
  PresentedGroup.ext fun a => by simp

name: TheoremA.RelPres.freeProdToOmega_comp_omegaToFreeProd
statement:
theorem freeProdToOmega_comp_omegaToFreeProd :
    (freeProdToOmega R).comp (omegaToFreeProd R) = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:=
  PresentedGroup.ext fun q => by
    change freeProdToOmega R (omegaToFreeProd R (Omega.gen R q)) = Omega.gen R q
    rw [omegaToFreeProd_gen, freeProdToOmega_freeGen]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.omegaToFreeProd_comp_freeProdToOmega
statement:
theorem omegaToFreeProd_comp_freeProdToOmega :
    (omegaToFreeProd R).comp (freeProdToOmega R) = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine Monoid.CoprodI.ext_hom _ _ fun i => ?_
  change (omegaToFreeProd R).comp ((freeProdToOmega R).comp (famOf R i.1 i.2)) =
    (MonoidHom.id _).comp (famOf R i.1 i.2)
  rw [show (freeProdToOmega R).comp (famOf R i.1 i.2) = omegaIncl R i.1 i.2 from
    MonoidHom.ext fun x => freeProdToOmega_famOf _ _ x, omegaToFreeProd_comp_omegaIncl,
    MonoidHom.id_comp]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.omegaEquivFreeProd_gen
statement:
@[simp] theorem omegaEquivFreeProd_gen (q : ℕ) :
    omegaEquivFreeProd R (Omega.gen R q) = freeGen R q
proof:
:=
  omegaToFreeProd_gen q

name: TheoremA.RelPres.omegaEquivFreeProd_omegaIncl
statement:
@[simp] theorem omegaEquivFreeProd_omegaIncl (n c : ℕ) (x : famGroup R n c) :
    omegaEquivFreeProd R (omegaIncl R n c x) = famOf R n c x
proof:
:= by
  change omegaToFreeProd R (omegaIncl R n c x) = _
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, omegaToFreeProd_comp_omegaIncl]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.omegaEquivFreeProd_symm_famOf
statement:
@[simp] theorem omegaEquivFreeProd_symm_famOf (n c : ℕ) (x : famGroup R n c) :
    (omegaEquivFreeProd R).symm (famOf R n c x) = omegaIncl R n c x
proof:
:=
  freeProdToOmega_famOf n c x

name: TheoremA.RelPres.ClassCR.exists_injective_hom_omega
statement:
theorem ClassCR.exists_injective_hom_omega {X : Type u} [Group X] (h : ClassCR R X) :
    ∃ f : X →* Omega R, Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, c, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := h.exists_famGroup_equiv
  exact ⟨(omegaIncl R n c).comp ψ.symm.toMonoidHom,
    (omegaIncl_injective n c).comp ψ.symm.injective⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.list_all_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem list_all_eq_foldl {β : Type*} (l : List β) (p : β → Bool) (b : Bool) :
    l.foldl (fun s x => s && p x) b = (b && l.all p)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing b with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x l ih => simp [ih, Bool.and_assoc]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.primrec_list_all
proof:
:= by
  have h := Primrec.list_foldl (f := f) (g := fun _ => true)
    (h := fun a (q : Bool × β) => q.1 && p a q.2) hf (Primrec.const true)
    (Primrec.and.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
      (hp.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))).to₂
  refine h.of_eq fun a => ?_
  rw [list_all_eq_foldl]; simp

name: TheoremA.RelPres.primrec_checkCore
statement:
theorem primrec_checkCore :
    Primrec fun v : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × List CertNode × List ℕ =>
      checkCore v.1.1 v.1.2.1 v.1.2.2 v.2.1 v.2.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold checkCore headOf
  apply Primrec.and.comp
  · iterate 30 (try prim_round)
  · refine primrec_list_all (Primrec.list_range.comp (Primrec.list_length.comp
      (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))) ?_
    apply Primrec.nodeOk_comp
    all_goals iterate 20 (try prim_round)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.Primrec.checkCore_comp
statement:
theorem Primrec.checkCore_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α] {c x y : α → ℕ}
    {L : α → List CertNode} {A : α → List ℕ} (hc : Primrec c) (hx : Primrec x) (hy : Primrec y)
    (hL : Primrec L) (hA : Primrec A) :
    Primrec fun a => checkCore (c a) (x a) (y a) (L a) (A a)
proof:
:=
  primrec_checkCore.comp ((hc.pair (hx.pair hy)).pair (hL.pair hA))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RecursiveIn.of_primrec
statement:
theorem RecursiveIn.of_primrec {O : Set (ℕ →. ℕ)} {g : ℕ → ℕ} (hg : Primrec g) :
    RecursiveIn O fun n => (Part.some (g n))
proof:
:=
  RecursiveIn.of_partrec (Partrec.nat_iff.1 hg.to_comp.partrec)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.map_getD_range
statement:
theorem map_getD_range (l : List ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (List.range l.length).map (fun j => F (l.getD j 0)) = l.map F
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro j h1 h2
    simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by simpa using h1)]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.recursiveIn_mapChi
statement:
theorem recursiveIn_mapChi {g : ℕ → List ℕ} (hg : Primrec g) :
    RecursiveIn (oracle R) fun n => Part.some (Encodable.encode ((g n).map (chiNat R)))
proof:
:= by
  let Q : ℕ → ℕ := fun q => (g (Nat.unpair q).1).getD (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair q).2).1 0
  have hQ : Primrec Q := (Primrec.list_getD 0).comp (hg.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair))
    (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair)))
  let S : ℕ → ℕ := fun r => Encodable.encode
    (decodeNatList (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair r).1).2).2 ++ [(Nat.unpair r).2])
  have hS : Primrec S := Primrec.encode.comp (Primrec.list_append.comp
    (primrec_decodeNatList.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp
      (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair)))))) (Primrec.list_cons.comp
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair) (Primrec.const [])))
  have hH : RecursiveIn (oracle R) fun q => Part.some (S (Nat.pair q (chiNat R (Q q)))) := by
    have h1 : RecursiveIn (oracle R) fun q => chi R (Q q) :=
      RecursiveIn.comp_primrec (RecursiveIn.oracle (O := oracle R) (chi R) rfl) hQ
    have h2 := RecursiveIn.pair (RecursiveIn.of_primrec (O := oracle R) Primrec.id) h1
    have h3 := RecursiveIn.comp (RecursiveIn.of_primrec (O := oracle R) hS) h2
    convert h3 using 1
    funext q
    simp [chi_eq_some, Seq.seq]
  have hP := RecursiveIn.prec (RecursiveIn.zero (O := oracle R)) hH
  have hpr : Primrec fun n => Nat.pair n (g n).length :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.comp Primrec.id (Primrec.list_length.comp hg)
  have hF := RecursiveIn.comp_primrec hP hpr
  convert hF using 1
  funext n
  simp only [Nat.unpair_pair]
  have key : ∀ k, (Nat.rec (0 : Part ℕ) (fun y IH => IH >>= fun i =>
      Part.some (S (Nat.pair (Nat.pair n (Nat.pair y i))
        (chiNat R (Q (Nat.pair n (Nat.pair y i))))))) k : Part ℕ) =
      Part.some (Encodable.encode ((List.range k).map fun j => chiNat R ((g n).getD j 0))) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append]
      simp only at ih ⊢
      rw [ih]
      simp [S, Q, Nat.unpair_pair]
  rw [← map_getD_range]
  exact (key _).symm

name: TheoremA.RelPres.answers_eq
statement:
theorem answers_eq (R : Set ℕ) (L : List CertNode) :

name: TheoremA.RelPres.primrec_certInputs
statement: theorem primrec_certInputs : Primrec certInputs
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_map (primrec_nodesOf.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp
    (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair))))))
    (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd) :
      Primrec fun q : ℕ × CertNode => q.2.2.1).to₂

name: TheoremA.RelPres.primrec_checkG
statement: theorem primrec_checkG : Primrec checkG
proof:
:= by
  unfold checkG
  refine primrec_toNat.comp (Primrec.checkCore_comp ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_)
  · exact Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair))
  · exact Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp
      (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair))))
  · exact Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp
      (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair))))))
  · exact primrec_nodesOf.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp
      (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp
        (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair)))))))
  · exact primrec_decodeNatList.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.checkFn_eq
statement:
theorem checkFn_eq (R : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    checkFn R n = Part.some (checkG (Nat.pair n
      (Encodable.encode ((certInputs n).map (chiNat R)))))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [checkFn, check, checkG, Nat.unpair_pair, decodeNatList_encode, certInputs,
    answers_eq]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.recursiveIn_checkFn
statement: theorem recursiveIn_checkFn : RecursiveIn (oracle R) (checkFn R)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := RecursiveIn.pair (RecursiveIn.of_primrec (O := oracle R) Primrec.id)
    (recursiveIn_mapChi (R := R) primrec_certInputs)
  have h3 := RecursiveIn.comp (RecursiveIn.of_primrec (O := oracle R) primrec_checkG) h2
  convert h3 using 1
  funext n
  rw [checkFn_eq]
  simp [Seq.seq]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.decodeRawWordNat_encode
statement:
@[simp] theorem decodeRawWordNat_encode (w : RawWord ℕ) :
    decodeRawWordNat (encodeRawWordNat w) = some w
proof: := Encodable.encodek w

name: TheoremA.RelPres.primrec_encodeRawWordNat
statement: theorem primrec_encodeRawWordNat : Primrec encodeRawWordNat
proof: := Primrec.encode

name: TheoremA.RelPres.primrec_decodeRawWordNat
statement: theorem primrec_decodeRawWordNat : Primrec decodeRawWordNat
proof: := Primrec.decode

name: TheoremA.RelPres.encodeRawWordNat_injective
statement: theorem encodeRawWordNat_injective : Function.Injective encodeRawWordNat
proof:
:=
  Encodable.encode_injective

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.boundedB_iff
statement: theorem boundedB_iff (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord ℕ) : boundedB n w = true ↔ bounded n w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [boundedB, bounded]
  | cons p w ih =>
    simp only [boundedB, List.foldr_cons, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at ih ⊢
    rw [ih]; simp [bounded]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.finOpt_eq_decode₂
statement: theorem finOpt_eq_decode₂ (n a : ℕ) : finOpt n a = Encodable.decode₂ (Fin n) a
proof:
:= by
  unfold finOpt
  split_ifs with h
  · exact (Encodable.mem_decode₂.2 rfl).symm
  · rcases hx : Encodable.decode₂ (Fin n) a with _ | x
    · rfl
    · have := Encodable.mem_decode₂.1 hx
      exact absurd (this ▸ x.2) h

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.up_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem up_nil (n : ℕ) : up n [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.bounded_up
statement: theorem bounded_up (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord (Fin n)) : bounded n (up n w)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  simp only [up, rename, List.mem_map] at hp
  obtain ⟨q, -, rfl⟩ := hp
  exact q.1.2

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.filterMap_letterDown_up
statement:
theorem filterMap_letterDown_up (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord (Fin n)) :
    (up n w).filterMap (letterDown n) = w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p w ih =>
    simp only [up, rename, List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
    rw [List.filterMap_cons_some (b := p)]
    · rw [ih]
    · simp [letterDown, finOpt, p.1.2]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.down_up
statement: @[simp] theorem down_up (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord (Fin n)) : down n (up n w) = some w
proof:
:= by
  simp [down, bounded_up, filterMap_letterDown_up]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.up_filterMap_letterDown
statement:
theorem up_filterMap_letterDown (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord ℕ) (h : bounded n w) :
    up n (w.filterMap (letterDown n)) = w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p w ih =>
    have hp : p.1 < n := h p (by simp)
    have hw : bounded n w := fun q hq => h q (by simp [hq])
    rw [List.filterMap_cons_some (b := (⟨p.1, hp⟩, p.2))]
    · simp only [up, rename, List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
      rw [ih hw]
    · simp [letterDown, finOpt, hp]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.up_of_down_eq_some
statement:
theorem up_of_down_eq_some {n : ℕ} {w : RawWord ℕ} {v : RawWord (Fin n)}
    (h : down n w = some v) : up n v = w
proof:
:= by
  unfold down at h
  split_ifs at h with hb
  cases h
  exact up_filterMap_letterDown n w hb

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.down_isSome_iff
statement: theorem down_isSome_iff (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord ℕ) : (down n w).isSome ↔ bounded n w
proof:
:= by
  unfold down; split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.down_eq_none_iff
statement: theorem down_eq_none_iff (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord ℕ) : down n w = none ↔ ¬ bounded n w
proof:
:= by
  unfold down; split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.down_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem down_eq_some_iff (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord ℕ) (v : RawWord (Fin n)) :
    down n w = some v ↔ up n v = w
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact up_of_down_eq_some
  · rintro rfl; exact down_up n v

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.down_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem down_nil (n : ℕ) : down n [] = some []
proof: := down_up n []

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.up_injective
statement: theorem up_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (up n)
proof:
:= by
  intro v v' h
  have := down_up n v
  rw [h, down_up] at this
  exact (Option.some.inj this).symm

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.eval_up
statement:
theorem eval_up (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord (Fin n)) :
    eval (up n w) = FreeGroup.map Fin.val (eval w)
proof: := eval_rename _ _

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.primrec_boundedB
statement: theorem primrec_boundedB : Primrec₂ boundedB
proof:
:= by
  have : Primrec fun a : ℕ × RawWord ℕ =>
      a.2.foldr (fun p b => (fun a q => decide (q.1.1 < a.1) && q.2) a (p, b)) true :=
    Primrec.list_foldr Primrec.snd (Primrec.const true)
      (Primrec.and.comp
        (Primrec.nat_lt.comp (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
          (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)).decide
        (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂
  exact this.of_eq fun a => rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.primrec_up
statement: theorem primrec_up (n : ℕ) : Primrec (up n)
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_map Primrec.id
    (Primrec.pair (Primrec.fin_val.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.primrec_letterDown
statement: theorem primrec_letterDown (n : ℕ) : Primrec (letterDown n)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Primrec fun p : ℕ × Bool => finOpt n p.1 := by
    simp only [finOpt_eq_decode₂]
    exact Primrec.decode₂.comp Primrec.fst
  exact Primrec.option_map h1 (Primrec.pair Primrec.snd (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)).to₂

name: TheoremA.RelPres.RawWord.primrec_down
statement: theorem primrec_down (n : ℕ) : Primrec (down n)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Primrec fun w : RawWord ℕ => w.filterMap (letterDown n) :=
    Primrec.listFilterMap Primrec.id ((primrec_letterDown n).comp Primrec.snd).to₂
  have hb : Primrec fun w => boundedB n w := primrec_boundedB.comp (Primrec.const n) Primrec.id
  have := Primrec.cond hb (Primrec.option_some.comp hf) (Primrec.const none)
  refine this.of_eq fun w => ?_
  unfold down
  by_cases h : bounded n w
  · simp [h, (boundedB_iff n w).2 h]
  · have : boundedB n w = false := by
      rw [← Bool.not_eq_true, boundedB_iff]; exact h
    simp [h, this]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.primrec_restrictCode
statement: theorem primrec_restrictCode : Primrec₂ restrictCode
proof:
:= by
  have := Primrec.option_bind (primrec_decodeRawWordNat.comp Primrec.snd)
    (Primrec.cond (primrec_boundedB.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd)
      (Primrec.option_some.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.const none)).to₂
  refine this.of_eq fun a => ?_
  simp only [restrictCode]
  congr 1; funext w
  by_cases h : bounded a.1 w
  · simp [h, (boundedB_iff _ w).2 h]
  · have : boundedB a.1 w = false := by
      rw [← Bool.not_eq_true, boundedB_iff]; exact h
    simp [h, this]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.restrictCode_eq
statement:
theorem restrictCode_eq (n z : ℕ) :
    restrictCode n z = ((decodeRawWordNat z).bind (down n)).map (up n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold restrictCode
  cases decodeRawWordNat z with
  | none => rfl
  | some w =>
    simp only [Option.bind_some]
    by_cases h : bounded n w
    · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 ((down_isSome_iff n w).2 h)
      simp [h, hv, up_of_down_eq_some hv]
    · simp [h, (down_eq_none_iff n w).2 h]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.primrec_natCodeOfFinCode
statement: theorem primrec_natCodeOfFinCode (n : ℕ) : Primrec (natCodeOfFinCode n)
proof:
:=
  Primrec.option_map Primrec.decode
    (primrec_encodeRawWordNat.comp ((primrec_up n).comp Primrec.snd)).to₂

name: TheoremA.RelPres.primrec_finCodeOfNatCode
statement: theorem primrec_finCodeOfNatCode (n : ℕ) : Primrec (finCodeOfNatCode n)
proof:
:=
  Primrec.option_map (Primrec.option_bind primrec_decodeRawWordNat
      ((primrec_down n).comp Primrec.snd).to₂)
    (Primrec.encode.comp Primrec.snd).to₂

name: TheoremA.RelPres.natCodeOfFinCode_encode
statement:
@[simp] theorem natCodeOfFinCode_encode (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord (Fin n)) :
    natCodeOfFinCode n (Encodable.encode w) = some (encodeRawWordNat (up n w))
proof:
:= by
  simp [natCodeOfFinCode]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.finCodeOfNatCode_encode_up
statement:
@[simp] theorem finCodeOfNatCode_encode_up (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord (Fin n)) :
    finCodeOfNatCode n (encodeRawWordNat (up n w)) = some (Encodable.encode w)
proof:
:= by
  simp [finCodeOfNatCode]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.finCodeOfNatCode_encode_of_not_bounded
statement:
theorem finCodeOfNatCode_encode_of_not_bounded (n : ℕ) (w : RawWord ℕ) (h : ¬ bounded n w) :
    finCodeOfNatCode n (encodeRawWordNat w) = none
proof:
:= by
  simp [finCodeOfNatCode, (down_eq_none_iff n w).2 h]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hClaim_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem hClaim_zero (p x y : ℕ) : HClaim R (p, x, y, 0) ↔ y ∈ eval R (decode p) x
proof:
:= by
  simp [HClaim]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.hClaim_ne_zero
statement:
theorem hClaim_ne_zero {p x y m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) : HClaim R (p, x, y, m) ↔
    ∀ k < y, ∃ v ∈ eval R (decode (codeArg p)) (Nat.pair x k), v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [HClaim, hm]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.eq_of_codeTag_eq
statement: theorem eq_of_codeTag_eq {p k : ℕ} (hk : k < 5) (h : codeTag p = k) : p = k
proof:
:= by
  unfold codeTag at h; split_ifs at h <;> omega

name: TheoremA.RelPres.localCheck_sound
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q₁, x₁, y₁, m₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨q₂, x₂, y₂, m₂⟩ := h₂
  unfold localCheck at hc
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm
    rw [hClaim_zero]
    have ht := codeTag_lt p
    obtain ⟨t, htt⟩ : ∃ t, codeTag p = t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [htt] at ht
    interval_cases t
    · simp [htt] at hc
      obtain rfl := eq_of_codeTag_eq (by norm_num) htt
      simp [decode_zero, hc]
    · simp [htt] at hc
      obtain rfl := eq_of_codeTag_eq (by norm_num) htt
      simp [decode_one, hc]
    · simp [htt] at hc
      obtain rfl := eq_of_codeTag_eq (by norm_num) htt
      simp [decode_two, hc]
    · simp [htt] at hc
      obtain rfl := eq_of_codeTag_eq (by norm_num) htt
      simp [decode_three, hc]
    · simp [htt] at hc
      obtain rfl := eq_of_codeTag_eq (by norm_num) htt
      simp [decode_four, hc, chi_eq_some]
    · simp [htt] at hc
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hc
      have c1 := H₁ h1
      have c2 := H₂ h2
      rw [hClaim_zero] at c1 c2
      rw [decode_of_tag_pair htt, mem_eval_pair]
      exact ⟨_, c1, _, c2, rfl⟩
    · simp [htt] at hc
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := hc
      have c1 := H₁ h1
      have c2 := H₂ h2
      rw [hClaim_zero] at c1 c2
      rw [decode_of_tag_comp htt, mem_eval_comp]
      exact ⟨_, c1, c2⟩
    · simp [htt] at hc
      rw [decode_of_tag_prec htt]
      split_ifs at hc with hn
      · obtain ⟨h1, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := hc
        have c1 := H₁ h1
        rw [hClaim_zero] at c1
        have e := eval_prec_zero (R := R) (decode (Nat.unpair (codeArg p)).1)
          (decode (Nat.unpair (codeArg p)).2) (Nat.unpair x).1
        rw [← hn, Nat.pair_unpair] at e
        rw [e]
        exact c1
      · obtain ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := hc
        have c1 := H₁ h1
        have c2 := H₂ h2
        rw [hClaim_zero, decode_of_tag_prec htt] at c1
        rw [hClaim_zero] at c2
        have hx : x = Nat.pair (Nat.unpair x).1 ((Nat.unpair x).2 - 1 + 1) := by
          rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn), Nat.pair_unpair]
        rw [hx, mem_eval_prec_succ]
        exact ⟨_, c1, c2⟩
    · simp [htt] at hc
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := hc
      have c1 := H₁ h1
      have c2 := H₂ h2
      rw [hClaim_ne_zero one_ne_zero] at c1
      rw [hClaim_zero] at c2
      rw [decode_of_tag_rfind htt, mem_eval_rfind]
      exact ⟨c2, c1⟩
  · simp [hm] at hc
    rw [hClaim_ne_zero hm]
    obtain ⟨-, hy⟩ := hc
    rcases hy with rfl | ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, hv⟩
    · intro k hk; omega
    · have c1 := H₁ h1
      have c2 := H₂ h2
      rw [hClaim_ne_zero one_ne_zero] at c1
      rw [hClaim_zero] at c2
      intro k hk
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (y - 1) with hk' | hk'
      · exact c1 k hk'
      · obtain rfl : k = y - 1 := by omega
        exact ⟨_, c2, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.1 hv⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.good_sound
statement:
theorem good_sound {L : List CertNode} (hL : Good R L) :
    ∀ i < L.length, HClaim R (headOf (L.getD i dfltNode))
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ i ih =>
    intro hi
    have hok := hL i hi
    unfold nodeOk at hok
    rcases hnd : L.getD i dfltNode with ⟨p, x, y, m, r₁, r₂⟩
    rw [hnd] at hok
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hok
    obtain ⟨⟨hr₁, hr₂⟩, hc⟩ := hok
    exact localCheck_sound hc (fun h => ih _ (by omega) (by omega))
      (fun h => ih _ (by omega) (by omega))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.answers_getD
statement:
theorem answers_getD (R : Set ℕ) (L : List CertNode) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < L.length) :
    (answers R L).getD i 0 = chiNat R (L.getD i dfltNode).2.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [answers, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.check_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem check_eq_true_iff {c x y cert : ℕ} :
    check R c x y cert = true ↔
      Good R (nodesOf cert) ∧ 0 < (nodesOf cert).length ∧
        headOf ((nodesOf cert).getD ((nodesOf cert).length - 1) dfltNode) = (c, x, y, 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold check checkCore Good
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h0, hh⟩, hall⟩
    exact ⟨fun i hi => by rw [← answers_getD R _ hi]; exact hall i hi, h0, hh⟩
  · rintro ⟨hall, h0, hh⟩
    exact ⟨⟨h0, hh⟩, fun i hi => by rw [answers_getD R _ hi]; exact hall i hi⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.mem_eval_of_check
statement:
theorem mem_eval_of_check {c x y cert : ℕ} (h : check R c x y cert = true) :
    y ∈ eval R (decode c) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hg, h0, hh⟩ := check_eq_true_iff.1 h
  have := good_sound hg _ (Nat.sub_lt h0 Nat.one_pos)
  rw [hh, hClaim_zero] at this
  exact this

name: TheoremA.RelPres.nodeOk_append_left
statement:
theorem nodeOk_append_left (a : ℕ) {L : List CertNode} (M : List CertNode) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < L.length) : nodeOk a (L ++ M) i = nodeOk a L i
proof:
:= by
  unfold nodeOk
  rw [List.getD_append _ _ _ _ hi, List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by omega),
    List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by omega)]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.nodeOk_append_right
statement:
theorem nodeOk_append_right (a : ℕ) (L : List CertNode) {M : List CertNode} {i : ℕ}
    (h : nodeOk a M i = true) : nodeOk a (L ++ M) (L.length + i) = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold nodeOk at h ⊢
  have e : (L ++ M).getD (L.length + i) dfltNode = M.getD i dfltNode := by
    rw [List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [e]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩ := h
  refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by omega), List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
  have e1 : L.length + i - (M.getD i dfltNode).2.2.2.2.1 - L.length =
      i - (M.getD i dfltNode).2.2.2.2.1 := by omega
  have e2 : L.length + i - (M.getD i dfltNode).2.2.2.2.2 - L.length =
      i - (M.getD i dfltNode).2.2.2.2.2 := by omega
  rw [e1, e2]
  exact h3

name: TheoremA.RelPres.good_append
statement: theorem good_append {L M : List CertNode} (hL : Good R L) (hM : Good R M) : Good R (L ++ M)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rw [List.length_append] at hi
  by_cases h : i < L.length
  · rw [List.getD_append _ _ _ _ h, nodeOk_append_left _ _ h]
    exact hL i h
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, i = L.length + j := ⟨i - L.length, by omega⟩
    rw [List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact nodeOk_append_right _ _ (hM j (by omega))

name: TheoremA.RelPres.good_snoc
statement:
theorem good_snoc {L : List CertNode} {nd : CertNode} (hL : Good R L)
    (h : nodeOk (chiNat R nd.2.1) (L ++ [nd]) L.length = true) : Good R (L ++ [nd])
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hi
  by_cases h' : i < L.length
  · rw [List.getD_append _ _ _ _ h', nodeOk_append_left _ _ h']
    exact hL i h'
  · obtain rfl : i = L.length := by omega
    rw [List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, List.getD_cons_zero]
    exact h

name: TheoremA.RelPres.certifies_leaf
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i hi => ?_, by simp, rfl⟩
  obtain rfl : i = 0 := by simpa using hi
  simpa [nodeOk, headOf] using hc

name: TheoremA.RelPres.certifies_one
statement:
theorem certifies_one {L₁ : List CertNode} {h₁ : NodeHead} (c₁ : Certifies R L₁ h₁)
    {p x y m : ℕ} (hc : localCheck (p, x, y, m, 1, 0) h₁ (p, x, y, m) (chiNat R x) = true) :
    Certifies R (L₁ ++ [(p, x, y, m, 1, 0)]) (p, x, y, m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₁, l₁, e₁⟩ := c₁
  refine ⟨good_snoc g₁ ?_, by simp, ?_⟩
  · unfold nodeOk
    rw [List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, List.getD_cons_zero]
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by omega), Nat.sub_zero,
      List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, List.getD_cons_zero, e₁]
    exact hc
  · simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rw [List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, List.getD_cons_zero]
    rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.certifies_two
statement:
theorem certifies_two {L₁ L₂ : List CertNode} {h₁ h₂ : NodeHead} (c₁ : Certifies R L₁ h₁)
    (c₂ : Certifies R L₂ h₂) {p x y m : ℕ}
    (hc : localCheck (p, x, y, m, L₂.length + 1, 1) h₁ h₂ (chiNat R x) = true) :
    Certifies R (L₁ ++ L₂ ++ [(p, x, y, m, L₂.length + 1, 1)]) (p, x, y, m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₁, l₁, e₁⟩ := c₁
  obtain ⟨g₂, l₂, e₂⟩ := c₂
  refine ⟨good_snoc (good_append g₁ g₂) ?_, by simp, ?_⟩
  · unfold nodeOk
    rw [List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, List.getD_cons_zero]
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.length_append]
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    have i1 : L₁.length + L₂.length - (L₂.length + 1) = L₁.length - 1 := by omega
    rw [i1, List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by simp; omega), List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by omega), e₁]
    rw [List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
      List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
    have i2 : L₁.length + L₂.length - 1 - L₁.length = L₂.length - 1 := by omega
    rw [i2, e₂]
    exact hc
  · simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rw [List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by simp), List.length_append, Nat.sub_self,
      List.getD_cons_zero]
    rfl

name: TheoremA.classCR_isFP_two_extendEnum
statement:
theorem classCR_isFP_two_extendEnum {R : Set ℕ} {n m : ℕ} {e : ℕ →. RawWord (Fin n)}
    (he : IsEnumerator R e) (hFP : IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup (enumRelators e)))
    (ρ : Fin n → Fin m) (hs : List (RawWord (Fin m))) :
    ClassCR R (PresentedGroup (enumRelators (extendEnum e ρ hs))) ∧
      IsFP 2 (PresentedGroup (enumRelators (extendEnum e ρ hs)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨m, extendEnum e ρ hs, he.extendEnum ρ hs, ⟨MulEquiv.refl _⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [enumRelators_extendEnum]
  exact isFP_two_presentedGroup_subst_union_finite _ (FreeGroup.map ρ) _
    ((List.finite_toSet hs).image _) hFP

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_recursive
statement: theorem eval_recursive (c : OracleCode) : RecursiveIn (oracle R) (eval R c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | zero => exact RecursiveIn.zero
  | succ => exact RecursiveIn.succ
  | left => exact RecursiveIn.left
  | right => exact RecursiveIn.right
  | query => exact RecursiveIn.oracle _ rfl
  | pair f g ihf ihg => exact RecursiveIn.pair ihf ihg
  | comp f g ihf ihg => exact RecursiveIn.comp ihf ihg
  | prec f g ihf ihg => exact RecursiveIn.prec ihf ihg
  | rfind f ihf => exact RecursiveIn.rfind ihf

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.exists_code
statement: theorem exists_code {f : ℕ →. ℕ} (hf : RecursiveIn (oracle R) f) : ∃ c, eval R c = f
proof:
:= by
  induction hf with
  | zero => exact ⟨zero, rfl⟩
  | succ => exact ⟨succ, rfl⟩
  | left => exact ⟨left, rfl⟩
  | right => exact ⟨right, rfl⟩
  | oracle g hg =>
    have hg' : g = chi R := hg
    exact ⟨query, hg'.symm⟩
  | pair _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    obtain ⟨c₁, rfl⟩ := ih₁
    obtain ⟨c₂, rfl⟩ := ih₂
    exact ⟨pair c₁ c₂, rfl⟩
  | comp _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    obtain ⟨c₁, rfl⟩ := ih₁
    obtain ⟨c₂, rfl⟩ := ih₂
    exact ⟨comp c₁ c₂, rfl⟩
  | prec _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    obtain ⟨c₁, rfl⟩ := ih₁
    obtain ⟨c₂, rfl⟩ := ih₂
    exact ⟨prec c₁ c₂, rfl⟩
  | rfind _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨c₁, rfl⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨rfind c₁, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.recursiveIn_iff_exists_code
statement:
theorem recursiveIn_iff_exists_code {f : ℕ →. ℕ} :
    RecursiveIn (oracle R) f ↔ ∃ c, eval R c = f
proof:
:=
  ⟨exists_code, fun ⟨c, hc⟩ => hc ▸ eval_recursive c⟩

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.primrec_codeTag
statement: theorem primrec_codeTag : Primrec codeTag
proof:
:=
  Primrec.ite (Primrec.nat_lt.comp Primrec.id (Primrec.const 5)) Primrec.id
    (Primrec.nat_add.comp (Primrec.nat_mod.comp (Primrec.nat_sub.comp Primrec.id
      (Primrec.const 5)) (Primrec.const 4)) (Primrec.const 5))

proof:
:=
  Primrec.nat_div.comp (Primrec.nat_sub.comp Primrec.id (Primrec.const 5)) (Primrec.const 4)

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_of_tag_pair
statement:
theorem decode_of_tag_pair {n : ℕ} (h : codeTag n = 5) :
    decode n = pair (decode (Nat.unpair (codeArg n)).1) (decode (Nat.unpair (codeArg n)).2)
proof:
:= by

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.codeTag_encode_pair
statement: @[simp] theorem codeTag_encode_pair (f g : OracleCode) : codeTag (encode (pair f g)) = 5
proof:

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.codeTag_encode_comp
statement: @[simp] theorem codeTag_encode_comp (f g : OracleCode) : codeTag (encode (comp f g)) = 6
proof:

@[simp] theorem codeArg_encode_pair (f g : OracleCode) :

proof:

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.codeArg_encode_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem codeArg_encode_comp (f g : OracleCode) :

:= by

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_encode
statement: @[simp] theorem decode_encode (c : OracleCode) : decode (encode c) = c
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | zero => exact decode_zero
  | succ => exact decode_one
  | left => exact decode_two
  | right => exact decode_three
  | query => exact decode_four
  | pair f g ihf ihg =>
    rw [decode_of_tag_pair (codeTag_encode_pair f g)]; simp [ihf, ihg]
  | comp f g ihf ihg =>
    rw [decode_of_tag_comp (codeTag_encode_comp f g)]; simp [ihf, ihg]
  | prec f g ihf ihg =>
    rw [decode_of_tag_prec (codeTag_encode_prec f g)]; simp [ihf, ihg]
  | rfind f ihf =>
    rw [decode_of_tag_rfind (codeTag_encode_rfind f)]; simp [ihf]

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.encode_decode
statement: @[simp] theorem encode_decode (n : ℕ) : encode (decode n) = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    by_cases h : n < 5
    · interval_cases n
      · rw [decode_zero]; rfl
      · rw [decode_one]; rfl
      · rw [decode_two]; rfl
      · rw [decode_three]; rfl
      · rw [decode_four]; rfl
    · have h0 := codeArg_lt h
      have h1 : (Nat.unpair (codeArg n)).1 < n := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.unpair_left_le _) h0
      have h2 : (Nat.unpair (codeArg n)).2 < n := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.unpair_right_le _) h0
      have ht := codeTag_lt n
      have hge : 5 ≤ codeTag n := by unfold codeTag; split_ifs; omega
      have key : ∀ k, k < 4 → codeTag n = k + 5 → 4 * codeArg n + (k + 5) = n := by
        intro k _ hk; unfold codeTag codeArg at *; split_ifs at hk; omega
      rcases (by omega : codeTag n = 5 ∨ codeTag n = 6 ∨ codeTag n = 7 ∨ codeTag n = 8)
        with h5 | h5 | h5 | h5
      · rw [decode_of_tag_pair h5]
        simp only [encode, ih _ h1, ih _ h2, Nat.pair_unpair]
        exact key 0 (by omega) h5
      · rw [decode_of_tag_comp h5]
        simp only [encode, ih _ h1, ih _ h2, Nat.pair_unpair]
        exact key 1 (by omega) h5
      · rw [decode_of_tag_prec h5]
        simp only [encode, ih _ h1, ih _ h2, Nat.pair_unpair]
        exact key 2 (by omega) h5
      · rw [decode_of_tag_rfind h5]
        simp only [encode, ih _ h0]
        have := key 3 (by omega) h5
        omega

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.encode_injective
statement: theorem encode_injective : Function.Injective encode
proof: := equivNat.injective

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.decode_surjective

proof: := equivNat.symm.surjective

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_zero (x : ℕ) : eval R zero x = Part.some 0
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_succ (x : ℕ) : eval R succ x = Part.some (x + 1)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_left
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_left (x : ℕ) : eval R left x = Part.some (Nat.unpair x).1
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.RelPres.OracleCode.eval_right
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_right (x : ℕ) : eval R right x = Part.some (Nat.unpair x).2
proof: := rfl

statement: @[simp] theorem eval_query (x : ℕ) : eval R query x = chi R x
