proof:
:= by
  simp [Ppow, powSubst]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.zpow_pow_ten
statement: theorem zpow_pow_ten {G : Type*} [Group G] (g : G) (s : ℤ) : (g ^ 10) ^ s = g ^ (10 * s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [zpow_mul]; norm_cast

name: TheoremA.Kernel.Ppow_vv
statement: theorem Ppow_vv (s : ℤ) : Ppow (vv s) = vv (10 * s)
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : Ppow (c0 : Fc 4) = c0 ^ 10 := Ppow_of (Sum.inl 0)
  have hdd : Ppow (dd : Fc 4) = dd := by rw [dd, Ppow_of]; simp [kPow]
  have hee : Ppow (ee : Fc 4) = ee ^ 10 := Ppow_of (Sum.inl 2)
  have hcc : ∀ i : Fin 4, Ppow (cc i) = cc i ^ 10 := fun i => Ppow_of (Sum.inr i)
  have hCs : Ppow (Cs s : Fc 4) = Cs (10 * s) := by
    simp only [Cs, map_list_prod, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def, map_zpow, hcc, zpow_pow_ten]
  simp only [vv, map_mul, map_zpow, hc0, hdd, hee, hCs, zpow_pow_ten]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.phiC_vv
statement: theorem phiC_vv (δ s : ℤ) : phiC δ (vv s) = vv (10 * s + δ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [phiC, Ppow_vv, psi_vv]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.psi_psi_neg
statement: theorem psi_psi_neg (δ : ℤ) (x : Fc 4) : psi (-δ) (psi δ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, psi_comp, add_neg_cancel, psi_zero]; rfl

name: TheoremA.Kernel.psi_neg_psi'
statement: theorem psi_neg_psi' (δ : ℤ) (x : Fc 4) : psi δ (psi (-δ) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, psi_comp, neg_add_cancel, psi_zero]; rfl

name: TheoremA.Kernel.psi_vhom
statement:
theorem psi_vhom (c : ℤ) (y : FreeGroup ℤ) :
    psi c ((vhom : FreeGroup ℤ →* Fc 4) y) = vhom (shiftZ c y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply (vhom : FreeGroup ℤ →* Fc 4)]
  congr 1
  exact FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun s => by simp [vhom, shiftZ, psi_vv]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.shiftZ_shiftZ
statement: theorem shiftZ_shiftZ (c c' : ℤ) (y : FreeGroup ℤ) : shiftZ c (shiftZ c' y) = shiftZ (c' + c) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  exact FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun s => by simp [shiftZ, add_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.shiftZ_zero
statement: theorem shiftZ_zero (y : FreeGroup ℤ) : shiftZ 0 y = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [show shiftZ 0 = MonoidHom.id _ from FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun s => by simp [shiftZ]]; rfl

name: TheoremA.Kernel.Ys_jTen
statement: theorem Ys_jTen (s : ℤ) : Ys jTen s = Multiplicative.ofAdd (s : ZMod 10)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ys, List.prod_ofFn]
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single (0 : Fin 4)]
  · rw [show jTen 0 = Multiplicative.ofAdd 1 from rfl, ← ofAdd_zsmul, zsmul_one]
  · intro i _ hi; rw [show jTen i = 1 from if_neg hi, one_zpow]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: TheoremA.Kernel.Ys_jTen_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem Ys_jTen_eq_one_iff (s : ℤ) : Ys jTen s = 1 ↔ s ∈ {s : ℤ | 10 ∣ s}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ys_jTen, Set.mem_setOf_eq, ← ofAdd_zero, Multiplicative.ofAdd.injective.eq_iff]
  exact_mod_cast ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd s 10

name: TheoremA.Kernel.jTen_pow_ten
statement: theorem jTen_pow_ten (i : Fin 4) : jTen i ^ 10 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold jTen; split_ifs <;> decide

name: TheoremA.Kernel.kappa_comp_Ppow
statement:
theorem kappa_comp_Ppow :
    (kappa (yT jTen)).comp Ppow = (kappa (yU (J := Multiplicative (ZMod 10)))).comp Ppow
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun x => ?_
  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, Ppow_of, map_pow]
  rcases x with k | i
  · simp [kappa]
  · simp only [kappa, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, Sum.elim_inr, ← map_pow]
    congr 1
    show (FreeGroup.of i, jTen i) ^ 10 = (FreeGroup.of i, (1 : Multiplicative (ZMod 10))) ^ 10
    rw [Prod.pow_mk, Prod.pow_mk, jTen_pow_ten, one_pow]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.range_Ppow_inf_VZ_le
statement: theorem range_Ppow_inf_VZ_le : Ppow.range ⊓ VZ 4 ≤ VS 4 {s : ℤ | 10 ∣ s}
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨⟨y, rfl⟩, hx⟩
  refine mem_VS_of_kappa_eq (by norm_num) jTen Ys_jTen_eq_one_iff (by simp) hx ?_
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, kappa_comp_Ppow]; rfl

name: TheoremA.Kernel.kBig_pos
statement: theorem kBig_pos (x : Fin 3 ⊕ (Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 4)) : 0 < kBig x
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with k | y
  · simp [kBig]
  · exact kPow_pos y

name: TheoremA.Kernel.PsiB_iC
statement: theorem PsiB_iC (δ : ℤ) (x : Fc 4) : PsiB δ (iC x) = iC (psi δ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply iC]
  congr 1
  exact FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun y => by simp [PsiB, iC]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.PsiB_iAB
statement: theorem PsiB_iAB (δ : ℤ) (x : FreeGroup (Fin 2)) : PsiB δ (iAB x) = iAB x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  exact FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun i => by simp [PsiB, iAB]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.PsiB_hB
statement: theorem PsiB_hB (δ : ℤ) : PsiB δ hB = hB
proof: := by simp [PsiB, hB]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.PsiB_neg_PsiB
statement: theorem PsiB_neg_PsiB (δ : ℤ) (x : FB) : PsiB (-δ) (PsiB δ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [show (PsiB (-δ)).comp (PsiB δ) = MonoidHom.id FB from FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun y => by
    rcases y with k | y
    · simp [PsiB]
    · simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, PsiB, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, Sum.elim_inr]
      rw [show (FreeGroup.lift (Sum.elim (fun i => FreeGroup.of (Sum.inl i)) fun x =>
          iC (psi (-δ) (FreeGroup.of x)))) = PsiB (-δ) from rfl, PsiB_iC, psi_psi_neg]
      simp [iC]]
  rfl

name: TheoremA.Kernel.tauB_iAB
statement: theorem tauB_iAB (g : FreeGroup (Fin 2)) (x : FreeGroup (Fin 2)) : tauB g (iAB x) = iAB x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  exact FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun i => by fin_cases i <;> simp [tauB, iAB, aB, bB]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.tauB_hB
statement: theorem tauB_hB (g : FreeGroup (Fin 2)) : tauB g hB = iAB g * hB
proof: := by simp [tauB, hB]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.tauB_iC
statement: theorem tauB_iC (g : FreeGroup (Fin 2)) (x : Fc 4) : tauB g (iC x) = iC x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  exact FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun y => by simp [tauB, iC]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.tauB_inv_tauB
statement: theorem tauB_inv_tauB (g : FreeGroup (Fin 2)) (x : FB) : tauB g⁻¹ (tauB g x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [show (tauB g⁻¹).comp (tauB g) = MonoidHom.id FB from FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun y => by
    rcases y with k | y
    · fin_cases k
      · simp [tauB, aB]
      · simp [tauB, bB]
      · show tauB g⁻¹ (tauB g hB) = hB
        rw [tauB_hB, map_mul, tauB_iAB,
          tauB_hB, map_inv]
        group
    · simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MonoidHom.id_apply]
      rw [show (FreeGroup.of (Sum.inr y) : FB) = iC (FreeGroup.of y) from rfl, tauB_iC, tauB_iC]]
  rfl

name: TheoremA.Kernel.Pbig_iAB
statement: theorem Pbig_iAB (x : FreeGroup (Fin 2)) : Pbig (iAB x) = iAB x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  exact FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun i => by simp [Pbig, powSubst, iAB, kBig]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.Pbig_hB
statement: theorem Pbig_hB : Pbig hB = hB
proof: := by simp [Pbig, powSubst, hB, kBig]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.Pbig_iC
statement: theorem Pbig_iC (x : Fc 4) : Pbig (iC x) = iC (Ppow x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply iC]
  congr 1
  exact FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun y => by simp [Pbig, Ppow, powSubst, iC, kBig]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.phiL_injective
statement: theorem phiL_injective (p : Fin 2 × Bool) : Function.Injective (phiL p)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := tauB (RawWord.eval [p])⁻¹) (tauB_inv_tauB _)).comp
    ((Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := PsiB (-(digit p : ℤ))) (PsiB_neg_PsiB _)).comp
      (powSubst_injective kBig kBig_pos))

name: TheoremA.Kernel.phiL_iAB
statement: theorem phiL_iAB (p : Fin 2 × Bool) (x : FreeGroup (Fin 2)) : phiL p (iAB x) = iAB x
proof:
:= by
  simp [phiL, Pbig_iAB, PsiB_iAB, tauB_iAB]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.phiL_hB
statement: theorem phiL_hB (p : Fin 2 × Bool) : phiL p hB = iAB (RawWord.eval [p]) * hB
proof:
:= by
  simp [phiL, Pbig_hB, PsiB_hB, tauB_hB]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.phiL_iC
statement: theorem phiL_iC (p : Fin 2 × Bool) (x : Fc 4) : phiL p (iC x) = iC (phiC (digit p : ℤ) x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [phiL, Pbig_iC, PsiB_iC, tauB_iC, phiC]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.phiL_gw
statement: theorem phiL_gw (p : Fin 2 × Bool) (w : RawWord (Fin 2)) : phiL p (gw w) = gw (w ++ [p])
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gw, map_mul, phiL_iAB, phiL_hB, phiL_iC, phiC_vv, RawWord.eval_append,
    code_append_single]
  push_cast
  group

name: TheoremA.Kernel.pC_phiL
statement: theorem pC_phiL (p : Fin 2 × Bool) (x : FB) : pC (phiL p x) = phiC (digit p : ℤ) (pC x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply (phiC (digit p : ℤ))]
  congr 1
  refine FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun y => ?_
  rcases y with k | y
  · fin_cases k
    · show pC (phiL p (iAB (FreeGroup.of 0))) = phiC (digit p : ℤ) (pC (iAB (FreeGroup.of 0)))
      rw [phiL_iAB, pC_iAB, map_one]
    · show pC (phiL p (iAB (FreeGroup.of 1))) = phiC (digit p : ℤ) (pC (iAB (FreeGroup.of 1)))
      rw [phiL_iAB, pC_iAB, map_one]
    · show pC (phiL p hB) = phiC (digit p : ℤ) (pC hB)
      rw [phiL_hB, map_mul, pC_iAB, pC_hB, map_one, one_mul]
  · show pC (phiL p (iC (FreeGroup.of y))) = phiC (digit p : ℤ) (pC (iC (FreeGroup.of y)))
    rw [phiL_iC, pC_iC, pC_iC]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.gammaC_comp_map
statement:
theorem gammaC_comp_map (p : Fin 2 × Bool) :
    gammaC.comp (FreeGroup.map fun w : RawWord (Fin 2) => w ++ [p]) = (phiL p).comp gammaC
proof:
:=
  FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun w => by simp [gammaC, phiL_gw]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.Gcode_map_le
statement: theorem Gcode_map_le (p : Fin 2 × Bool) : Gcode.map (phiL p) ≤ Gcode
proof:
:= by
  rw [Gcode, MonoidHom.map_closure, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨w, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [phiL_gw]
  exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.Kernel.Gcode_inf_range_le
statement: theorem Gcode_inf_range_le (p : Fin 2 × Bool) : Gcode ⊓ (phiL p).range ≤ Gcode.map (phiL p)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hxG, z, rfl⟩
  rw [← range_gammaC] at hxG
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hxG
  set δ : ℤ := (digit p : ℤ) with hδ
  have h1 : (vhom : FreeGroup ℤ →* Fc 4) (codeMap u) = psi δ (Ppow (pC z)) := by
    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← pC_comp_gammaC, MonoidHom.comp_apply, hu, pC_phiL]; rfl
  have h2 : (vhom : FreeGroup ℤ →* Fc 4) (shiftZ (-δ) (codeMap u)) ∈ Ppow.range := by
    rw [← psi_vhom, h1, psi_psi_neg]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have h3 : (vhom : FreeGroup ℤ →* Fc 4) (shiftZ (-δ) (codeMap u)) ∈ VZ 4 := by
    rw [← range_vhom]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have h4 := mem_closure_of_vhom_mem_VS (range_Ppow_inf_VZ_le ⟨h2, h3⟩)
  have h5 : codeMap u ∈ Subgroup.closure (FreeGroup.of '' {s : ℤ | 10 ∣ s - δ}) := by
    have : (Subgroup.closure (FreeGroup.of '' {s : ℤ | 10 ∣ s})).map (shiftZ δ) ≤
        Subgroup.closure (FreeGroup.of '' {s : ℤ | 10 ∣ s - δ}) := by
      rw [MonoidHom.map_closure, Subgroup.closure_le]
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨s + δ, ?_, by simp [shiftZ]⟩
      simpa using hs
    have h := this ⟨_, h4, rfl⟩
    rwa [shiftZ_shiftZ, neg_add_cancel, shiftZ_zero] at h
  have h6 := mem_closure_of_codeMap_mem h5
  have h7 : u ∈ (FreeGroup.map fun w : RawWord (Fin 2) => w ++ [p]).range := by
    rw [show (FreeGroup.map fun w : RawWord (Fin 2) => w ++ [p]) =
      FreeGroup.lift (FreeGroup.of ∘ fun w : RawWord (Fin 2) => w ++ [p]) from
        FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ fun w => by simp,
      FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure]
    refine Subgroup.closure_mono ?_ h6
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    have hw' : code w % 10 = digit p := by
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
      have := digit_le p
      omega
    obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ := (mod_ten_code_eq_digit_iff w p).1 hw'
    exact ⟨u', rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u₀, rfl⟩ := h7
  refine ⟨gammaC u₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← range_gammaC]; exact ⟨u₀, rfl⟩
  · rw [← hu, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← gammaC_comp_map]; rfl

name: TheoremA.Kernel.mem_letters
statement: theorem mem_letters (p : Fin 2 × Bool) : p ∈ letters
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
  fin_cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [letters]

name: TheoremA.Kernel.gw_mem_of_closed
statement:
theorem gw_mem_of_closed (L : Subgroup FB) (h0 : gw [] ∈ L)
    (hL : ∀ p : Fin 2 × Bool, L.map (phiL p) ≤ L) (w : RawWord (Fin 2)) : gw w ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  induction w using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => exact h0
  | append_singleton u p ih =>
    rw [← phiL_gw]; exact hL p ⟨_, ih, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.Kernel.hb_Gcode
statement: theorem hb_Gcode (R : Set ℕ) : HB R Gcode
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine hb_of_saturated fg_FB (classCR_isFP_two_FB (R := R)).1 (classCR_isFP_two_FB (R := R)).2
    Gcode
    (letters.map phiL) ?_ ?_ ?_ {gw []} ?_ ?_
  · intro φ hφ
    obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hφ
    exact phiL_injective p
  · intro φ hφ
    obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hφ
    exact Gcode_map_le p
  · intro φ hφ
    obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hφ
    exact Gcode_inf_range_le p
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst hx
    exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨[], rfl⟩
  · intro L h0 hL
    rw [Gcode, Subgroup.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact gw_mem_of_closed L (h0 (by simp))
      (fun p => hL (phiL p) (List.mem_map.2 ⟨p, mem_letters p, rfl⟩)) w

name: TheoremA.L42.fL_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem fL_apply (i : ℕ) (x : F R i) : fL C α β i x = Hm R α β (YY C α β i) i 0 (x ⊗ₜ C.x0)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.gL_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem gL_apply (i : ℕ) (x : F R i) : gL C α β i x = Hm R α β (YY C α β i) 0 i (C.x0 ⊗ₜ x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.hΔ_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem hΔ_apply (i : ℕ) (x : F R i) :
    hΔ C α β i x = hTot α β (k + 3) (YY C α β i) (Δ C i x)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.τ1_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem τ1_apply (i : ℕ) (x : F R i) : τ1 C i x = contrR R i (Δ C i x i 0)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.τ2_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem τ2_apply (i : ℕ) (x : F R i) : τ2 C i x = contrL R i (Δ C i x 0 i)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.idLift_isChainLift
statement:
theorem idLift_isChainLift (R : Res B k) :
    IsChainLift R (MonoidHom.id B) (fun i => AddMonoidHom.id (F R i)) where
  semilinear i l x
proof:
:= by simp
  comm i _ x := rfl
  aug x := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.fL_isChainLift
statement:
theorem fL_isChainLift : IsChainLift R α (fL C α β) where
  semilinear i
proof:
:= semilinear_of_group α _ fun g x => by
    have e : (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • x) ⊗ₜ C.x0 = act R i 0 g 1 (x ⊗ₜ C.x0) := by
      rw [act, map_tmul, gsm_apply, gsm_apply, map_one, one_smul]
    rw [fL_apply, e, Hm_act R hαβ, map_one, mul_one]; rfl
  comm i hi x := by
    rw [fL_apply, fL_apply, YY_chain C α β hαβ i hi, bd, bdL_succ, bdR_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
    rfl
  aug x := by
    rw [fL_apply, ε_hExt_eq α β hαβ (YY_aug C α β), εε_tmul, C.hx0, mul_one]

name: TheoremA.L42.gL_isChainLift
statement:
theorem gL_isChainLift : IsChainLift R β (gL C α β) where
  semilinear i
proof:
:= semilinear_of_group β _ fun g x => by
    have e : C.x0 ⊗ₜ (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • x) = act R 0 i 1 g (C.x0 ⊗ₜ x) := by
      rw [act, map_tmul, gsm_apply, gsm_apply, map_one, one_smul]
    rw [gL_apply, e, Hm_act R hαβ, map_one, one_mul]; rfl
  comm i hi x := by
    rw [gL_apply, gL_apply, YY_chain C α β hαβ i hi, bd, bdL_zero, bdR_succ, pow_zero, one_smul,
      zero_add]
    rfl
  aug x := by
    rw [gL_apply, ε_hExt_eq α β hαβ (YY_aug C α β), εε_tmul, C.hx0, one_mul]

name: TheoremA.L42.hΔ_isChainLift
statement:
theorem hΔ_isChainLift (δ : B →* B) (hδ : ∀ b, δ b = α b * β b) :
    IsChainLift R δ (hΔ C α β) where
  semilinear i
proof:
:= semilinear_of_group δ _ fun g x => by
    rw [hΔ_apply, hΔ_apply, Δ_of, hTot_act α β hαβ, hδ]
  comm i hi x := by
    rw [hΔ_apply, hΔ_apply, ← Δ_chain C i hi, hTot_D α β (k + 2) _ (YY_off C α β i) (by omega),
      hTot, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
    rw [YY_chain C α β hαβ i hi]
  aug x := by
    rw [hΔ_apply, hTot_single α β _ (by omega) _ (YY_off C α β 0), ε_hExt_eq α β hαβ (YY_aug C α β),
      Δ_aug]

name: TheoremA.L42.τ1_isChainLift
statement:
theorem τ1_isChainLift : IsChainLift R (MonoidHom.id B) (τ1 C) where
  semilinear i
proof:
:= semilinear_of_group _ _ fun g x => by
    rw [τ1_apply, τ1_apply, Δ_of, actQ_apply, contrR_act]; rfl
  comm i hi x := by
    rw [τ1_apply, τ1_apply, ← Δ_chain C i hi, D_apply, map_add, map_zsmul, contrR_dL, contrR_dR,
      smul_zero, add_zero]
  aug x := by
    rw [τ1_apply, ε_contrR, Δ_aug]

name: TheoremA.L42.τ2_isChainLift
statement:
theorem τ2_isChainLift : IsChainLift R (MonoidHom.id B) (τ2 C) where
  semilinear i
proof:
:= semilinear_of_group _ _ fun g x => by
    rw [τ2_apply, τ2_apply, Δ_of, actQ_apply, contrL_act]; rfl
  comm i hi x := by
    rw [τ2_apply, τ2_apply, ← Δ_chain C i hi, D_apply, map_add, map_zsmul, contrL_dR, contrL_dL,
      zero_add, pow_zero, one_smul]
  aug x := by
    rw [τ2_apply, ε_contrL, Δ_aug]

name: TheoremA.L42.hTot_sub
statement:
theorem hTot_sub (L : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (z w : Qm R) :
    hTot α β L Y (z - w) = hTot α β L Y z - hTot α β L Y w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hTot, Pi.sub_apply, map_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: TheoremA.L42.hTot_act
statement:
theorem hTot_act (hαβ : ∀ b c, Commute (α b) (β c)) (L : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (b c : B)
    (z : Qm R) :
    hTot α β L Y (actQ R b c z) = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B (α b * β c) • hTot α β L Y z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hTot, actQ_apply, Hm_act R hαβ, Finset.smul_sum]

name: TheoremA.L42.hTot_D
statement:
theorem hTot_D (L : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (hY : OffZero R Y) (hn : n + 1 ≤ L) (z : Qm R) :
    hTot α β (L + 1) Y (D R z) =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (L + 1), ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (L + 1), bd R α β Y p q (z p q)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hTot, D_apply, map_add, map_zsmul, bd, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  · rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_comm (f := fun p q => bdL R α β Y p q (z p q))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ', bdL_zero, add_zero,
      Hm_off R α β hY (by omega), add_zero]
    rfl
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ', bdR_zero, smul_zero, add_zero,
      Hm_off R α β hY (by omega), smul_zero, add_zero]
    rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.hTot_two
statement:
theorem hTot_two (L : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (z : Qm R) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmL : m < L)
    (hz : ∀ p q, ¬ (p = m ∧ q = 0) → ¬ (p = 0 ∧ q = m) → z p q = 0) :
    hTot α β L Y z = Hm R α β Y m 0 (z m 0) + Hm R α β Y 0 m (z 0 m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hTot, ← Finset.sum_product']
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_add_of_mem (m, 0) (0, m) (by simp; omega) (by simp; omega)
    (by simp; omega)]
  rintro ⟨p, q⟩ _ ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rw [hz p q (fun h => h1 (by rw [h.1, h.2])) (fun h => h2 (by rw [h.1, h.2])), map_zero]

name: TheoremA.L42.hTot_single
statement:
theorem hTot_single (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (Y : Lvl R 0) (hY : OffZero R Y) (z : Qm R) :
    hTot α β L Y z = Hm R α β Y 0 0 (z 0 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hTot, ← Finset.sum_product']
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0, 0)]
  · rintro ⟨p, q⟩ _ h
    rw [Hm_off R α β hY (fun h' => h (by simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]; omega))]
  · intro h; exact absurd (by simp; omega) h

name: TheoremA.L42.contrR_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem contrR_tmul (p : ℕ) (x : F R p) (y : F R 0) :
    contrR R p (x ⊗ₜ y) = R.ε y • x
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.contrL_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem contrL_tmul (q : ℕ) (x : F R 0) (y : F R q) :
    contrL R q (x ⊗ₜ y) = R.ε x • y
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.contrR_act
statement:
theorem contrR_act (p : ℕ) (b c : B) (t : T R p 0) :
    contrR R p (act R p 0 b c t) = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B b • contrR R p t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]
  | tmul x y => simp only [act, map_tmul, gsm_apply, contrR_tmul, R.ε_inv, smul_comm _ (R.ε y)]

name: TheoremA.L42.contrL_act
statement:
theorem contrL_act (q : ℕ) (b c : B) (t : T R 0 q) :
    contrL R q (act R 0 q b c t) = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B c • contrL R q t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]
  | tmul x y => simp only [act, map_tmul, gsm_apply, contrL_tmul, R.ε_inv, smul_comm _ (R.ε x)]

name: TheoremA.L42.contrR_dL
statement:
theorem contrR_dL (p : ℕ) (t : T R (p + 1) 0) :
    contrR R p (dL R p 0 t) = R.d p (contrR R (p + 1) t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | tmul x y => simp [-zsmul_eq_mul, map_zsmul]

name: TheoremA.L42.contrR_dR
statement: theorem contrR_dR (p : ℕ) (t : T R p 1) : contrR R p (dR R p 0 t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | tmul x y =>
    simp only [map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply, contrR_tmul]
    rw [show R.ε (dZ R 0 y) = 0 from R.ε_d y, zero_smul]

name: TheoremA.L42.contrL_dR
statement:
theorem contrL_dR (q : ℕ) (t : T R 0 (q + 1)) :
    contrL R q (dR R 0 q t) = R.d q (contrL R (q + 1) t)
proof:
:= by

name: TheoremA.L42.contrL_dL
statement: theorem contrL_dL (q : ℕ) (t : T R 1 q) : contrL R q (dL R 0 q t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with

  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | tmul x y =>
    simp only [map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply, contrL_tmul]
    rw [show R.ε (dZ R 0 x) = 0 from R.ε_d x, zero_smul]

name: TheoremA.L42.ε_contrR
statement: theorem ε_contrR (t : T R 0 0) : R.ε (contrR R 0 t) = εε R t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with

  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: TheoremA.L42.ε_contrL
statement: theorem ε_contrL (t : T R 0 0) : R.ε (contrL R 0 t) = εε R t
proof:

name: TheoremA.L42.contrR_tmul_x0
statement:
theorem contrR_tmul_x0 (p : ℕ) (t : T R p 0) :
    contrR R p t ⊗ₜ C.x0 = map LinearMap.id (ιε C) t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, add_tmul, hx, hy]
  | tmul x y => simp only [contrR_tmul, map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply, ιε_apply, smul_tmul]

name: TheoremA.L42.x0_tmul_contrL
statement:
theorem x0_tmul_contrL (q : ℕ) (t : T R 0 q) :
    C.x0 ⊗ₜ contrL R q t = map (ιε C) LinearMap.id t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, tmul_add, hx, hy]
  | tmul x y => simp only [contrL_tmul, map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply, ιε_apply, tmul_smul,
      smul_tmul']

name: TheoremA.image_fg
statement:
theorem image_fg {R : Res B k} {θ : B →* B} {φ : ∀ i, FreeMod B (R.c i) →+ FreeMod B (R.c i)}
    (hφ : IsChainLift R θ φ) (N : Submodule (ZG B) (FreeMod B (R.c (k + 1)))) (hN : N.FG)
    (hNS : N ≤ R.S) : ∃ N' : Submodule (ZG B) (FreeMod B (R.c (k + 1))), N'.FG ∧ N' ≤ R.S ∧
      ∀ c ∈ N, φ (k + 1) c ∈ N'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hN
  refine ⟨Submodule.span (ZG B) (φ (k + 1) '' s), Submodule.fg_span (s.finite_toSet.image _), ?_,
    fun c hc => ?_⟩
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hxS : R.d k x = 0 := hNS (Submodule.subset_span hx)
    show R.d k (φ (k + 1) x) = 0
    rw [← hφ.comm k le_rfl, hxS, map_zero]
  · induction hc using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
    | smul l x _ hx => rw [hφ.semilinear]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: TheoremA.L42.Nprod_fg
statement: theorem Nprod_fg : (Nprod C α β).FG
proof:
:= by
  let G : ℕ → ℕ → Set (F R (k + 1)) := fun P Q =>
    Set.range (fun ab : Fin (R.c P) × Fin (R.c Q) =>
      bd R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) P Q (Pi.single ab.1 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single ab.2 1))
  have hG : ∀ P Q, (G P Q).Finite := fun P Q => Set.finite_range _
  have hfin : (⋃ P ∈ (↑(Finset.range (k + 3)) : Set ℕ),
      ⋃ Q ∈ (↑(Finset.range (k + 3)) : Set ℕ), G P Q).Finite :=
    Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _) fun P _ =>
      Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _) fun Q _ => hG P Q
  refine Submodule.fg_span (hfin.subset ?_)
  rintro x ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hPQ, a, b, rfl⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_range]
  exact ⟨P, by omega, Q, by omega, (a, b), rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.L42.Nprod_le_S
statement: theorem Nprod_le_S : Nprod C α β ≤ R.S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nprod, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hPQ, a, b, rfl⟩
  exact d_bd R α β _ _ (YY_chain C α β hαβ k le_rfl) P Q (by omega) (by omega) _

name: TheoremA.L42.bd_mem_Nprod
statement:
theorem bd_mem_Nprod (P Q : ℕ) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) (hPQ : P + Q = k + 2) (t : T R P Q) :
    bd R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) P Q t ∈ Nprod C α β
proof:
:= by
  let N := Nprod C α β
  let ψ : T R P Q →+ F R (k + 1) :=
    { toFun := bd R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) P Q
      map_zero' := by simp [bd]
      map_add' := bd_add R α β _ P Q }
  have := tensor_hom_ext R
    (fun b c => DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom (F R (k + 1) ⧸ N) (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B (α b * β c)))
    (φ := N.mkQ.toAddMonoidHom.comp ψ) (ψ := 0)
    (fun b c t => by
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, ψ, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk,
        ZeroHom.coe_mk, bd_act R hαβ, map_smul, DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom_apply])
    (fun b c t => by simp)
    (fun a b => by
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, ψ, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk,
        ZeroHom.coe_mk, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
        Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hPQ, a, b, rfl⟩)
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f t) this
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, ψ, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk,
    ZeroHom.coe_mk, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: TheoremA.L42.bd_zero_arg
statement: theorem bd_zero_arg {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (p q : ℕ) : bd R α β Y p q 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [bd]

name: TheoremA.L42.kunneth
statement:
theorem kunneth (hk : 1 ≤ k) (s : F R (k + 1)) (hs : R.d k s = 0) :
    hΔ C α β (k + 1) s - fL C α β (k + 1) (τ1 C (k + 1) s) - gL C α β (k + 1) (τ2 C (k + 1) s)
      ∈ Nprod C α β
proof:
:= by
  set y := Δ C (k + 1) s with hydef
  have hy : D R y = 0 := by rw [hydef, Δ_chain C k le_rfl, hs, map_zero]
  have hydeg : IsDeg (k + 1) y := Δ_deg C (k + 1) s
  set w := Sig C y with hwdef
  have hSD : Sig C (D R y) = 0 := by rw [hy, map_zero]
  
  have hDw : ∀ p q, ¬ (p = k + 1 ∧ q = 0) → ¬ (p = 0 ∧ q = k + 1) → (y - D R w) p q = 0 := by
    intro p q h1 h2
    rw [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
    by_cases hpq : p + q = k + 1
    · rcases p with _ | p
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, q = i + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
        have := homotopy_zero_succ C y i (by omega)
        rw [hSD, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero] at this
        exact this.symm
      · have := homotopy_succ C y p q (by omega)
        rw [hSD, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero] at this
        exact this.symm
    · rw [hydeg p q hpq, ((hydeg.Sig C).D) p q hpq]
  
  set u := y (k + 1) 0
  let π : F R (k + 1) →ₗ[ℤ] F R (k + 1) := LinearMap.id - C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k
  have hπ : dZ R k ∘ₗ π = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    have h1 := C.ci k' (by omega) (dZ R (k' + 1) x)
    have h2 : dZ R k' (dZ R (k' + 1) x) = 0 := R.d_d k' (by omega) x
    rw [h2, map_zero, add_zero] at h1
    simp only [π, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, map_sub, h1,
      sub_self, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  have hcornerL : (y - D R w) (k + 1) 0 =
      map LinearMap.id (ιε C) u + dR R (k + 1) 0 (map π (C.σ 0) u) := by
    have hw : D R w (k + 1) 0 = map (C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k) LinearMap.id u := by
      have := homotopy_top C y 0
      rwa [hSD, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero] at this
    have hdL : dL R k 0 u = -(((-1 : ℤ) ^ k) • dR R k 0 (y k 1)) := by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hy k) 0
      rw [D_apply, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at this
      exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left this
    have e1 : dR R (k + 1) 0 (map π (C.σ 0) u) = map π (dZ R 0 ∘ₗ C.σ 0) u := by
      rw [map_map, LinearMap.id_comp]
    have e2 := map_id_add π (dZ R 0 ∘ₗ C.σ 0) (ιε C) u
    rw [c0' C] at e2
    have e3 := map_add_id π (C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k) LinearMap.id u
    rw [show π + C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k = LinearMap.id from sub_add_cancel _ _, map_id,
      LinearMap.id_apply] at e3
    have e4 := map_add_id π (C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k) (ιε C) u
    rw [show π + C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k = LinearMap.id from sub_add_cancel _ _] at e4
    have e5 : map (C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k) (ιε C) u = 0 := by
      have : map (C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k) (ιε C) u = map (C.σ k) (ιε C) (dL R k 0 u) := by
        rw [map_map, LinearMap.comp_id]
      rw [this, hdL, map_neg, map_zsmul, map_map, LinearMap.comp_id, ιε_dZ, map_zero_right,
        LinearMap.zero_apply, smul_zero, neg_zero]
    show u - D R w (k + 1) 0 = _
    rw [hw, e1, eq_sub_of_add_eq e2, eq_sub_of_add_eq e4, e5, eq_sub_of_add_eq e3]
    abel
  
  set v := y 0 (k + 1)
  have hcornerR : (y - D R w) 0 (k + 1) = map (ιε C) LinearMap.id v := by
    have hw : D R w 0 (k + 1) = map (dZ R 0 ∘ₗ C.σ 0) LinearMap.id v +
        map (ιε C) (C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k) v := by
      have := homotopy_zero_top C y
      rwa [hSD, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero] at this
    have hdR : dR R 0 k v = -dL R 0 k (y 1 k) := by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hy 0) k
      rw [D_apply, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, pow_zero, one_smul] at this
      exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right this
    have f5 : map (ιε C) (C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k) v = 0 := by
      have : map (ιε C) (C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k) v = map (ιε C) (C.σ k) (dR R 0 k v) := by
        rw [map_map, LinearMap.comp_id]
      rw [this, hdR, map_neg, map_map, LinearMap.comp_id, ιε_dZ, map_zero_left, LinearMap.zero_apply,
        neg_zero]
    have f6 := map_add_id (dZ R 0 ∘ₗ C.σ 0) (ιε C) LinearMap.id v
    rw [c0' C, map_id, LinearMap.id_apply] at f6
    show v - D R w 0 (k + 1) = _
    rw [hw, f5, add_zero, sub_eq_iff_eq_add]
    exact f6.symm.trans (add_comm _ _)
  
  have htot : hΔ C α β (k + 1) s = hTot α β (k + 3) (YY C α β (k + 1)) (D R w) +
      (Hm R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) (k + 1) 0 ((y - D R w) (k + 1) 0) +
        Hm R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) 0 (k + 1) ((y - D R w) 0 (k + 1))) := by
    rw [← hTot_two α β (k + 3) _ (y - D R w) (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega) hDw, hTot_sub,
      hΔ_apply, ← hydef]
    abel
  have hf : fL C α β (k + 1) (τ1 C (k + 1) s) =
      Hm R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) (k + 1) 0 (map LinearMap.id (ιε C) u) := by
    rw [fL_apply, τ1_apply, contrR_tmul_x0]
  have hg : gL C α β (k + 1) (τ2 C (k + 1) s) =
      Hm R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) 0 (k + 1) (map (ιε C) LinearMap.id v) := by
    rw [gL_apply, τ2_apply, x0_tmul_contrL]
  have hcorr : Hm R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) (k + 1) 0 (dR R (k + 1) 0 (map π (C.σ 0) u)) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1)) • bd R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) (k + 1) 1 (map π (C.σ 0) u) := by
    have hdL0 : dL R k 1 (map π (C.σ 0) u) = 0 := by
      rw [map_map, hπ, map_zero_left, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    have hbd : bd R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) (k + 1) 1 (map π (C.σ 0) u) =
        Hm R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) k 1 (dL R k 1 (map π (C.σ 0) u)) +
          ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1)) • Hm R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) (k + 1) 0
            (dR R (k + 1) 0 (map π (C.σ 0) u)) := rfl
    rw [hbd, hdL0, map_zero]
    generalize Hm R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) (k + 1) 0 (dR R (k + 1) 0 (map π (C.σ 0) u)) = X
    rw [zero_add, smul_smul, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow, one_smul]
  rw [htot, hcornerL, hcornerR, map_add, hf, hg, hcorr]
  have hmem1 : hTot α β (k + 3) (YY C α β (k + 1)) (D R w) ∈ Nprod C α β := by
    rw [hTot_D α β (k + 2) _ (YY_off C α β (k + 1)) (by omega)]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun P _ => Submodule.sum_mem _ fun Q _ => ?_
    by_cases hPQ : P + Q = k + 1 + 1
    · rcases P with _ | P
      · rw [show Q = k + 2 by omega, hwdef, Sig_zero_succ, C.σ_top (k + 1) (by omega),
          map_zero_right, LinearMap.zero_apply, bd_zero_arg]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · rcases Q with _ | Q
        · rw [show P = k + 1 by omega, hwdef, Sig_succ, C.σ_top (k + 1) (by omega),
            map_zero_left, LinearMap.zero_apply, bd_zero_arg]
          exact Submodule.zero_mem _
        · exact bd_mem_Nprod C α β hαβ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) _
    · rw [bd_off R α β (YY_off C α β (k + 1)) hPQ]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  have hmem2 : ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1)) • bd R α β (YY C α β (k + 1)) (k + 1) 1 (map π (C.σ 0) u) ∈
      Nprod C α β :=
    Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (bd_mem_Nprod C α β hαβ _ _ (by omega) le_rfl (by omega) _)
  convert Submodule.add_mem _ hmem1 hmem2 using 1
  abel

name: TheoremA.lemma42
statement: theorem lemma42 : Lemma42.{u}
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk B _ R α β δ hαβ hδ Φα Φβ Φδ hα hβ hδl
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := L42.exists_contr R
  have hf := L42.fL_isChainLift C α β hαβ
  have hg := L42.gL_isChainLift C α β hαβ
  have hh := L42.hΔ_isChainLift C α β hαβ δ hδ
  obtain ⟨N3, h3fg, h3S, h3⟩ := comparison R δ _ Φδ hh hδl
  obtain ⟨N4, h4fg, h4S, h4⟩ := comparison R α _ Φα hf hα
  obtain ⟨N5, h5fg, h5S, h5⟩ := comparison R β _ Φβ hg hβ
  obtain ⟨C1, h1fg, h1S, h1⟩ := comparison R _ _ _ (L42.τ1_isChainLift C)
    (L42.idLift_isChainLift R)
  obtain ⟨C2, h2fg, h2S, h2⟩ := comparison R _ _ _ (L42.τ2_isChainLift C)
    (L42.idLift_isChainLift R)
  obtain ⟨Nf, hffg, hfS, hfN⟩ := image_fg hf C1 h1fg h1S
  obtain ⟨Ng, hgfg, hgS, hgN⟩ := image_fg hg C2 h2fg h2S
  refine ⟨N3 ⊔ L42.Nprod C α β ⊔ Nf ⊔ N4 ⊔ Ng ⊔ N5,
    ((((h3fg.sup (L42.Nprod_fg C α β)).sup hffg).sup h4fg).sup hgfg).sup h5fg,
    sup_le (sup_le (sup_le (sup_le (sup_le h3S (L42.Nprod_le_S C α β hαβ)) hfS) h4S) hgS) h5S,
    fun s hs => ?_⟩
  have hs' : R.d k s = 0 := hs
  have e : Φδ (k + 1) s - Φα (k + 1) s - Φβ (k + 1) s =
      -(L42.hΔ C α β (k + 1) s - Φδ (k + 1) s) +
      (L42.hΔ C α β (k + 1) s - L42.fL C α β (k + 1) (L42.τ1 C (k + 1) s) -
        L42.gL C α β (k + 1) (L42.τ2 C (k + 1) s)) +
      L42.fL C α β (k + 1) (L42.τ1 C (k + 1) s - s) +
      (L42.fL C α β (k + 1) s - Φα (k + 1) s) +
      L42.gL C α β (k + 1) (L42.τ2 C (k + 1) s - s) +
      (L42.gL C α β (k + 1) s - Φβ (k + 1) s) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub]; abel
  rw [e]
  refine Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _
    (Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_
  · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_left
      (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.neg_mem _ (h3 s hs))))))
  · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_left
      (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_right (L42.kunneth C α β hαβ hk s hs')))))
  · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_left
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (hfN _ (h1 s hs)))))
  · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_right (h4 s hs)))
  · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_right (hgN _ (h2 s hs)))
  · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (h5 s hs)

name: TheoremA.of_smul_single_eq
statement:
theorem of_smul_single_eq {c : ℕ} (g : B) (n : ℤ) (i : Fin c) :
    (MonoidAlgebra.single g n : ZG B) • (Pi.single i 1 : FreeMod B c) =
      n • (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • (Pi.single i 1 : FreeMod B c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← smul_assoc]; congr 1; simp

name: TheoremA.freeMod_hom_ext
statement:
theorem freeMod_hom_ext {c : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] {φ ψ : FreeMod B c →+ M}
    (h : ∀ i g, φ (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • (Pi.single i 1 : FreeMod B c)) =
      ψ (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • (Pi.single i 1 : FreeMod B c))) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [eq_sum_single x, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  induction x i using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [add_smul, map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | single g n => rw [of_smul_single_eq, map_zsmul, map_zsmul, h]

name: TheoremA.semilinear_of_group
statement:
theorem semilinear_of_group {c : ℕ} {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module (ZG B) N] (θ : B →* B)
    (φ : FreeMod B c →+ N)
    (h : ∀ g x, φ (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • x) = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B (θ g) • φ x)
    (l : ZG B) (x : FreeMod B c) : φ (l • x) = hat θ l • φ x
proof:
:= by
  induction l using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [add_smul, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, add_smul]
  | single g n =>
    have e1 : (MonoidAlgebra.single g n : ZG B) • x = n • (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • x) := by
      rw [← smul_assoc]; congr 1; simp
    have e2 : hat θ (MonoidAlgebra.single g n) = n • MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B (θ g) := by
      simp [hat]
    rw [e1, map_zsmul, h, e2, smul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.hat_of
statement:
theorem hat_of (θ : B →* B) (g : B) :
    hat θ (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g) = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B (θ g)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hat]

name: TheoremA.hat_id
statement: theorem hat_id (l : ZG B) : hat (MonoidHom.id B) l = l
proof:
:= by
  induction l using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, ha, hb]
  | single g n => simp [hat]

name: TheoremA.L42.tensor_hom_ext
statement:
theorem tensor_hom_ext {p q : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] (A : B → B → M →+ M)
    {φ ψ : T R p q →+ M} (hφ : ∀ b c t, φ (act R p q b c t) = A b c (φ t))
    (hψ : ∀ b c t, ψ (act R p q b c t) = A b c (ψ t))
    (h : ∀ i j, φ (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1) = ψ (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1)) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun t => ?_
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | tmul x y =>
    have step1 : ∀ i g (y : F R q),
        φ ((MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • (Pi.single i 1 : F R p)) ⊗ₜ y) =
        ψ ((MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • (Pi.single i 1 : F R p)) ⊗ₜ y) := by
      intro i g y
      have := freeMod_hom_ext
        (φ := φ.comp (TensorProduct.mk ℤ (F R p) (F R q)
          (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • (Pi.single i 1 : F R p))).toAddMonoidHom)
        (ψ := ψ.comp (TensorProduct.mk ℤ (F R p) (F R q)
          (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • (Pi.single i 1 : F R p))).toAddMonoidHom) (fun j g' => by
          have e : (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • (Pi.single i 1 : F R p)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
              (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g' • (Pi.single j 1 : F R q)) =
              act R p q g g' (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1) := rfl
          simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, mk_apply]
          rw [e, hφ, hψ, h])
      exact congrArg (fun f => f y) this
    have := freeMod_hom_ext
      (φ := φ.comp ((TensorProduct.mk ℤ (F R p) (F R q)).flip y).toAddMonoidHom)
      (ψ := ψ.comp ((TensorProduct.mk ℤ (F R p) (F R q)).flip y).toAddMonoidHom)
      (fun i g => by
        simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, LinearMap.flip_apply,
          mk_apply]
        exact step1 i g y)
    exact congrArg (fun f => f x) this

name: TheoremA.L42.commute_hat
statement: theorem commute_hat (a a' : ZG B) : Commute (hat α a) (hat β a')
proof:
:= by
  induction a using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact ha.add_left hb
  | single g n =>
    induction a' using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact ha.add_right hb
    | single g' n' =>
      simp only [hat, MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainRingHom_apply, MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single]
      show _ * _ = _ * _
      rw [MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, (hαβ g g').eq,
        mul_comm n n']

name: TheoremA.L42.hExt_tmul
statement:
theorem hExt_tmul {p q : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module (ZG B) M]
    (Y : Fin (R.c p) → Fin (R.c q) → M) (x : F R p) (y : F R q) :
    hExt R α β Y (x ⊗ₜ y) = ∑ i, ∑ j, (hat α (x i) * hat β (y j)) • Y i j
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.hExt_basis
statement:
theorem hExt_basis {p q : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module (ZG B) M]
    (Y : Fin (R.c p) → Fin (R.c q) → M) (i : Fin (R.c p)) (j : Fin (R.c q)) :
    hExt R α β Y (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1) = Y i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [hExt_tmul]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb; simp [hb]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb; simp [hb]
  · simp

name: TheoremA.L42.hExt_act
statement:
theorem hExt_act {p q : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module (ZG B) M]
    (Y : Fin (R.c p) → Fin (R.c q) → M) (b c : B) (t : T R p q) :
    hExt R α β Y (act R p q b c t) = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B (α b * β c) • hExt R α β Y t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]
  | tmul x y =>
    have key : ∀ a a' : ZG B, hat α (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B b * a) * hat β (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B c * a')
        = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B (α b * β c) * (hat α a * hat β a') := by
      intro a a'
      have hc := (commute_hat α β hαβ a (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B c)).eq
      rw [hat_of] at hc
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, hat_of, hat_of, map_mul, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (hat α a), hc]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    simp only [act, map_tmul, gsm_apply, hExt_tmul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, key, mul_smul,
      Finset.smul_sum]

name: TheoremA.L42.ρ_of
statement: theorem ρ_of (g : B) (z : Qm R) : ρ R (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g) z = actQ R g g z
proof:
:= by
  simp [ρ]

name: TheoremA.L42.ΔExt_single
statement:
theorem ΔExt_single {n : ℕ} (y : Fin (R.c n) → Qm R) (j : Fin (R.c n)) :
    ΔExt R y (Pi.single j 1) = y j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ΔExt, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb; simp [hb]
  · simp

name: TheoremA.L42.ΔExt_of
statement:
theorem ΔExt_of {n : ℕ} (y : Fin (R.c n) → Qm R) (g : B) (x : F R n) :
    ΔExt R y (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • x) = actQ R g g (ΔExt R y x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ΔExt, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul,
    Module.End.mul_apply, ρ_of, map_sum]

name: TheoremA.L42.diag_hom_ext
statement:
theorem diag_hom_ext {n : ℕ} {φ ψ : F R n →+ Qm R}
    (hφ : ∀ g x, φ (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • x) = actQ R g g (φ x))
    (hψ : ∀ g x, ψ (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • x) = actQ R g g (ψ x))
    (h : ∀ j, φ (Pi.single j 1) = ψ (Pi.single j 1)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  freeMod_hom_ext fun i g => by rw [hφ, hψ, h]

name: TheoremA.L42.ε_hExt_eq
statement:
theorem ε_hExt_eq {Y : Lvl R 0} (hαβ : ∀ b c, Commute (α b) (β c))
    (haug : ∀ i j, R.ε (Y 0 0 i j) = R.ε (Pi.single i 1) * R.ε (Pi.single j 1)) (t : T R 0 0) :
    R.ε (Hm R α β Y 0 0 t) = εε R t
proof:
:= by
  have := tensor_hom_ext R (fun _ _ => AddMonoidHom.id ℤ)
    (φ := R.ε.comp (Hm R α β Y 0 0)) (ψ := (εε R).toAddMonoidHom)
    (fun b c t => by
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, Hm_act R hαβ, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
      exact R.ε_inv _ _)
    (fun b c t => by
      induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at *
      | tmul x y =>
        simp only [LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, act, map_tmul, gsm_apply, εε_tmul,
          AddMonoidHom.id_apply, R.ε_inv])
    (fun i j => by simp [hExt_basis, haug])
  exact congrArg (fun f => f t) this

name: TheoremA.L42.YY_succ_apply
statement:
theorem YY_succ_apply (n p q : ℕ) (i : Fin (R.c p)) (j : Fin (R.c q)) :
    YY C α β (n + 1) p q i j =
      if h : p + q = n + 1 ∧
          ∃ y, R.d n y = bd R α β (YY C α β n) p q (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1)
      then h.2.choose else 0
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.YY_off
statement: theorem YY_off (n : ℕ) : OffZero R (YY C α β n)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rcases p with _ | p
    · rcases q with _ | q
      · omega
      · rfl
    · rfl
  · funext i j
    rw [YY_succ_apply, dif_neg (fun h => hpq h.1)]
    rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.YY_aug
statement: theorem YY_aug (i j) : R.ε (YY C α β 0 0 0 i j) = R.ε (Pi.single i 1) * R.ε (Pi.single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  show R.ε ((R.ε (Pi.single i 1) * R.ε (Pi.single j 1)) • C.x0) = _
  rw [map_zsmul, C.hx0, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: TheoremA.L42.ε_bd0
statement:
theorem ε_bd0 (hαβ : ∀ b c, Commute (α b) (β c)) (p q : ℕ) (t : T R p q) :
    R.ε (bd R α β (YY C α β 0) p q t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∀ p q (t : T R p q), R.ε (bdL R α β (YY C α β 0) p q t) = 0 := by
    intro p q t
    rcases p with _ | p
    · simp
    · by_cases h : p = 0 ∧ q = 0
      · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
        rw [bdL_succ, ε_hExt_eq α β hαβ (YY_aug C α β), εε_dL]
      · rw [bdL_succ, Hm_off R α β (YY_off C α β 0) (by omega), map_zero]
  have hR : ∀ p q (t : T R p q), R.ε (bdR R α β (YY C α β 0) p q t) = 0 := by
    intro p q t
    rcases q with _ | q
    · simp
    · by_cases h : p = 0 ∧ q = 0
      · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
        rw [bdR_succ, ε_hExt_eq α β hαβ (YY_aug C α β), εε_dR]
      · rw [bdR_succ, Hm_off R α β (YY_off C α β 0) (by omega), map_zero]
  simp only [bd, map_add, map_zsmul, hL, hR, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: TheoremA.L42.YY_chain
statement:
theorem YY_chain (hαβ : ∀ b c, Commute (α b) (β c)) :
    ∀ n, n ≤ k → ∀ p q (t : T R p q),
      R.d n (Hm R α β (YY C α β (n + 1)) p q t) = bd R α β (YY C α β n) p q t
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro _ p q
    refine chain_of_basis R hαβ _ _ p q fun i j => ?_
    by_cases hpq : p + q = 0 + 1
    · have hex : ∃ y, R.d 0 y = bd R α β (YY C α β 0) p q (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1) := by
        have : bd R α β (YY C α β 0) p q (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1) ∈ R.ε.ker :=
          ε_bd0 C α β hαβ p q _
        rw [R.exact0] at this
        exact this
      have h : p + q = 0 + 1 ∧ ∃ y, R.d 0 y =
          bd R α β (YY C α β 0) p q (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1) := ⟨hpq, hex⟩
      rw [YY_succ_apply, dif_pos h]
      exact h.2.choose_spec
    · rw [YY_off C α β 1 p q hpq, bd_off R α β (YY_off C α β 0) hpq]
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hn p q
    refine chain_of_basis R hαβ _ _ p q fun i j => ?_
    by_cases hpq : p + q = n + 1 + 1
    · have hex : ∃ y, R.d (n + 1) y =
          bd R α β (YY C α β (n + 1)) p q (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1) := by
        have : bd R α β (YY C α β (n + 1)) p q (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1) ∈
            LinearMap.ker (R.d n) :=
          d_bd R α β _ _ (ih (by omega)) p q (by omega) (by omega) _
        rw [R.exact n (by omega)] at this
        exact this
      have h : p + q = n + 1 + 1 ∧ ∃ y, R.d (n + 1) y =
          bd R α β (YY C α β (n + 1)) p q (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1) := ⟨hpq, hex⟩
      rw [YY_succ_apply, dif_pos h]
      exact h.2.choose_spec
    · rw [YY_off C α β (n + 1 + 1) p q hpq, bd_off R α β (YY_off C α β (n + 1)) hpq]
      simp

name: TheoremA.L42.bdL_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem bdL_zero {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (q : ℕ) (t : T R 0 q) : bdL R α β Y 0 q t = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.bdL_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem bdL_succ {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (p q : ℕ) (t : T R (p + 1) q) :
    bdL R α β Y (p + 1) q t = Hm R α β Y p q (dL R p q t)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.bdR_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem bdR_zero {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (p : ℕ) (t : T R p 0) : bdR R α β Y p 0 t = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.bdR_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem bdR_succ {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (p q : ℕ) (t : T R p (q + 1)) :
    bdR R α β Y p (q + 1) t = Hm R α β Y p q (dR R p q t)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.bd_add
statement:
theorem bd_add {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (p q : ℕ) (t t' : T R p q) :
    bd R α β Y p q (t + t') = bd R α β Y p q t + bd R α β Y p q t'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bd, map_add, smul_add]; abel

name: TheoremA.L42.Hm_off
statement:
theorem Hm_off {n : ℕ} {Y : Lvl R n} (hY : OffZero R Y) {p q : ℕ} (h : p + q ≠ n) (t : T R p q) :
    Hm R α β Y p q t = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | tmul x y => simp [hExt_tmul, hY p q h]

name: TheoremA.L42.bd_off
statement:
theorem bd_off {n : ℕ} {Y : Lvl R n} (hY : OffZero R Y) {p q : ℕ} (h : p + q ≠ n + 1)
    (t : T R p q) : bd R α β Y p q t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with _ | p <;> rcases q with _ | q
  · simp [bd]
  · simp [bd, Hm_off R α β hY (show 0 + q ≠ n by omega)]
  · simp [bd, Hm_off R α β hY (show p + 0 ≠ n by omega)]
  · simp [bd, Hm_off R α β hY (show p + (q + 1) ≠ n by omega),
      Hm_off R α β hY (show p + 1 + q ≠ n by omega)]

name: TheoremA.L42.εε_tmul
statement: @[simp] theorem εε_tmul (x y : F R 0) : εε R (x ⊗ₜ y) = R.ε x * R.ε y
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.εε_dL
statement: theorem εε_dL (t : T R 1 0) : εε R (dL R 0 0 t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | tmul x y => simp [R.ε_d]

name: TheoremA.L42.εε_dR
statement: theorem εε_dR (t : T R 0 1) : εε R (dR R 0 0 t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | tmul x y => simp [R.ε_d]

name: TheoremA.L42.Hm_act
statement:
theorem Hm_act {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (p q : ℕ) (b c : B) (t : T R p q) :
    Hm R α β Y p q (act R p q b c t) = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B (α b * β c) • Hm R α β Y p q t
proof:
:=
  hExt_act R α β hαβ _ b c t

name: TheoremA.L42.bd_act
statement:
theorem bd_act {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (p q : ℕ) (b c : B) (t : T R p q) :
    bd R α β Y p q (act R p q b c t) = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B (α b * β c) • bd R α β Y p q t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bd, smul_add]
  congr 1
  · rcases p with _ | p
    · simp
    · simp only [bdL_succ, dL_act, Hm_act R hαβ]
  · rw [smul_comm (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B _) ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p)]
    congr 1
    rcases q with _ | q
    · simp
    · simp only [bdR_succ, dR_act, Hm_act R hαβ]

name: TheoremA.L42.chain_of_basis
statement:
theorem chain_of_basis {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (Y' : Lvl R (n + 1)) (p q : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i j, R.d n (Y' p q i j) = bd R α β Y p q (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1))
    (t : T R p q) : R.d n (Hm R α β Y' p q t) = bd R α β Y p q t
proof:
:= by
  let φ : T R p q →+ F R n := (R.d n).toAddMonoidHom.comp (Hm R α β Y' p q)
  let ψ : T R p q →+ F R n :=
    { toFun := bd R α β Y p q
      map_zero' := by simp [bd]
      map_add' := bd_add R α β Y p q }
  have := tensor_hom_ext R (fun b c => DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom _ (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B (α b * β c)))
    (φ := φ) (ψ := ψ)
    (fun b c t => by simp [φ, Hm_act R hαβ])
    (fun b c t => by simp [ψ, bd_act R hαβ])
    (fun i j => by simp [φ, ψ, hExt_basis, h])
  exact congrArg (fun f => f t) this

name: TheoremA.L42.bdL_dL
statement:
theorem bdL_dL {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (p q : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ k) (t : T R (p + 1) q) :
    bdL R α β Y p q (dL R p q t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with _ | p
  · rfl
  · rw [bdL_succ, dL_dL R p q (by omega), map_zero]

name: TheoremA.L42.bdR_dR
statement:
theorem bdR_dR {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (p q : ℕ) (hq : q ≤ k) (t : T R p (q + 1)) :
    bdR R α β Y p q (dR R p q t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases q with _ | q
  · rfl
  · rw [bdR_succ, dR_dR R p q (by omega), map_zero]

name: TheoremA.L42.d_bd
statement:
theorem d_bd {n : ℕ} (Y : Lvl R n) (Y' : Lvl R (n + 1))
    (hch : ∀ p q t, R.d n (Hm R α β Y' p q t) = bd R α β Y p q t) (p q : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ k + 1)
    (hq : q ≤ k + 1) (t : T R p q) : R.d n (bd R α β Y' p q t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with _ | p <;> rcases q with _ | q
  · simp [bd]
  · simp only [bd, bdL_zero, bdR_succ, pow_zero, one_smul, zero_add]
    rw [hch, bd, bdR_dR R α β Y 0 q (by omega), bdL_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  · simp only [bd, bdL_succ, bdR_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
    rw [hch, bd, bdL_dL R α β Y p 0 (by omega), bdR_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  · simp only [bd, bdL_succ, bdR_succ, map_add, map_zsmul]
    rw [hch, hch, bd, bd, bdL_dL R α β Y p (q + 1) (by omega),
      bdR_dR R α β Y (p + 1) q (by omega), bdR_succ, bdL_succ, dL_dR, sign_succ]
    simp only [smul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
    exact add_neg_cancel _

name: TheoremA.L42.D_apply
statement:
theorem D_apply (z : Qm R) (p q : ℕ) :
    D R z p q = dL R p q (z (p + 1) q) + ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p) • dR R p q (z p (q + 1))
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.gsm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem gsm_apply (p : ℕ) (g : B) (x : F R p) :
    gsm R p g x = MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • x
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.actQ_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem actQ_apply (b c : B) (z : Qm R) (p q : ℕ) :
    actQ R b c z p q = act R p q b c (z p q)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.dZ_gsm
statement:
theorem dZ_gsm (p : ℕ) (g : B) (x : F R (p + 1)) :
    dZ R p (gsm R (p + 1) g x) = gsm R p g (dZ R p x)
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: TheoremA.L42.dL_act
statement:
theorem dL_act (p q : ℕ) (b c : B) (t : T R (p + 1) q) :
    dL R p q (act R (p + 1) q b c t) = act R p q b c (dL R p q t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: TheoremA.L42.dR_act
statement:
theorem dR_act (p q : ℕ) (b c : B) (t : T R p (q + 1)) :
    dR R p q (act R p (q + 1) b c t) = act R p q b c (dR R p q t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: TheoremA.L42.D_actQ
statement: theorem D_actQ (b c : B) (z : Qm R) : D R (actQ R b c z) = actQ R b c (D R z)
proof:
:= by
  funext p q
  simp only [D_apply, actQ_apply, dL_act, dR_act, map_add, map_zsmul]

name: TheoremA.L42.act_mul
statement:
theorem act_mul (p q : ℕ) (b c b' c' : B) (t : T R p q) :
    act R p q (b * b') (c * c') t = act R p q b c (act R p q b' c' t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y => simp only [map_tmul, gsm_apply, map_mul, mul_smul]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: TheoremA.L42.act_one
statement: theorem act_one (p q : ℕ) (t : T R p q) : act R p q 1 1 t = t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y => simp only [map_tmul, gsm_apply, map_one, one_smul]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: TheoremA.L42.dL_dL
statement: theorem dL_dL (p q : ℕ) (hp : p < k) (t : T R (p + 2) q) : dL R p q (dL R (p + 1) q t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← map_comp]
  have : dZ R p ∘ₗ dZ R (p + 1) = 0 := by ext x; simp [R.d_d p hp]
  rw [this, LinearMap.id_comp]; simp

name: TheoremA.L42.dR_dR
statement: theorem dR_dR (p q : ℕ) (hq : q < k) (t : T R p (q + 2)) : dR R p q (dR R p (q + 1) t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← map_comp]
  have : dZ R q ∘ₗ dZ R (q + 1) = 0 := by ext x; simp [R.d_d q hq]
  rw [this, LinearMap.id_comp]; simp

name: TheoremA.L42.dL_dR
statement:
theorem dL_dR (p q : ℕ) (t : T R (p + 1) (q + 1)) :
    dL R p q (dR R (p + 1) q t) = dR R p q (dL R p (q + 1) t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← map_comp, ← map_comp]
  rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.εZ_dZ
statement: theorem εZ_dZ (x : F R 1) : εZ R (dZ R 0 x) = 0
proof: := R.ε_d x

name: TheoremA.L42.εZ_gsm
statement: theorem εZ_gsm (g : B) (x : F R 0) : εZ R (gsm R 0 g x) = εZ R x
proof: := R.ε_inv g x

name: TheoremA.L42.exists_contr
statement: theorem exists_contr : Nonempty (Contr R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0⟩ := R.ε_surj 1
  
  have key : ∀ n, n ≤ k + 1 → ∃ σ : ∀ p, F R p →ₗ[ℤ] F R (p + 1),
      (∀ p, n ≤ p → σ p = 0) ∧ (1 ≤ n → ∀ x, dZ R 0 (σ 0 x) + R.ε x • x0 = x) ∧
      (∀ i, i + 1 < n → ∀ x : F R (i + 1), dZ R (i + 1) (σ (i + 1) x) + σ i (dZ R i x) = x) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro _; exact ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ _ => rfl, fun h => by omega, fun i hi => by omega⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro hn
      obtain ⟨σ, htop, h0, hi⟩ := ih (by omega)
      classical
      cases n with
      | zero =>
        
        have hmem : ∀ x : F R 0, x - R.ε x • x0 ∈ LinearMap.range (dZ R 0) := by
          intro x
          have : x - R.ε x • x0 ∈ R.ε.ker := by
            show R.ε _ = 0
            rw [map_sub, map_zsmul, hx0]; simp
          rw [R.exact0] at this
          obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := this
          exact ⟨y, hy⟩
        let g : F R 0 →ₗ[ℤ] LinearMap.range (dZ R 0) :=
          LinearMap.codRestrict _ (LinearMap.id - (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ _ x0) ∘ₗ εZ R)
            (fun x => by simpa using hmem x)
        obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (dZ R 0).rangeRestrict g
          (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict _)
        refine ⟨Function.update (β := fun p => F R p →ₗ[ℤ] F R (p + 1)) σ 0 h, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro p hp
          rw [Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]; exact htop p (by omega)
        · intro _ x
          rw [Function.update_self]
          have := congrArg (fun f => (f x : F R 0)) hh
          simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rangeRestrict, LinearMap.codRestrict_apply,
            g] at this
          rw [this]; simp
        · intro i hi; omega
      | succ n =>
        
        have hmem : ∀ x : F R (n + 1), x - σ n (dZ R n x) ∈ LinearMap.range (dZ R (n + 1)) := by
          intro x
          have hker : x - σ n (dZ R n x) ∈ LinearMap.ker (R.d n) := by
            show R.d n _ = 0
            rw [map_sub]
            cases n with
            | zero =>
              have := h0 (by omega) (dZ R 0 x)
              have he : R.ε (dZ R 0 x) = 0 := R.ε_d x
              rw [he, zero_smul, add_zero] at this
              change R.d 0 x - dZ R 0 (σ 0 (dZ R 0 x)) = 0
              rw [this]; exact sub_self _
            | succ n' =>
              have := hi n' (by omega) (dZ R (n' + 1) x)
              have hdd : dZ R n' (dZ R (n' + 1) x) = 0 := R.d_d n' (by omega) x
              rw [hdd, map_zero, add_zero] at this
              change R.d (n' + 1) x - dZ R (n' + 1) (σ (n' + 1) (dZ R (n' + 1) x)) = 0
              rw [this]; exact sub_self _
          rw [R.exact n (by omega)] at hker
          obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hker
          exact ⟨y, hy⟩
        let g : F R (n + 1) →ₗ[ℤ] LinearMap.range (dZ R (n + 1)) :=
          LinearMap.codRestrict _ (LinearMap.id - σ n ∘ₗ dZ R n) (fun x => by simpa using hmem x)
        obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (dZ R (n + 1)).rangeRestrict g
          (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict _)
        refine ⟨Function.update (β := fun p => F R p →ₗ[ℤ] F R (p + 1)) σ (n + 1) h, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro p hp
          rw [Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]; exact htop p (by omega)
        · intro _ x
          rw [Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]; exact h0 (by omega) x
        · intro i hi' x
          by_cases hin : i = n
          · subst hin
            rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
            have := congrArg (fun f => (f x : F R (i + 1))) hh
            simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rangeRestrict, LinearMap.codRestrict_apply,
              g] at this
            rw [this]; simp
          · rw [Function.update_of_ne (by omega), Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
            exact hi i (by omega) x
  obtain ⟨σ, htop, h0, hi⟩ := key (k + 1) le_rfl
  exact ⟨⟨x0, hx0, σ, fun p hp => htop p hp, h0 (by omega), fun i hi' => hi i (by omega)⟩⟩

name: TheoremA.L42.E00_deg
statement: theorem E00_deg : IsDeg 0 (E00 C)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst hp
    have hq : q ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp [E00, hq]
  · simp [E00, hp]

name: TheoremA.L42.E00_zero_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem E00_zero_zero : E00 C 0 0 = C.x0 ⊗ₜ C.x0
proof: := by simp [E00]

name: TheoremA.L42.Δ_of
statement:
theorem Δ_of (n : ℕ) (g : B) (x : F R n) :
    Δ C n (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • x) = actQ R g g (Δ C n x)
proof:
:= by
  cases n <;> exact ΔExt_of R _ g x

name: TheoremA.L42.Δ_succ_single
statement:
theorem Δ_succ_single (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (R.c (n + 1))) :
    Δ C (n + 1) (Pi.single j 1) = Sig C (Δ C n (R.d n (Pi.single j 1)))
proof:
:=
  ΔExt_single R _ j

name: TheoremA.L42.Δ_zero_single
statement:
theorem Δ_zero_single (j : Fin (R.c 0)) :
    Δ C 0 (Pi.single j 1) = R.ε (Pi.single j 1) • E00 C
proof:
:=
  ΔExt_single R _ j

name: TheoremA.L42.isDeg_of_basis
statement:
theorem isDeg_of_basis {n : ℕ} (φ : F R n →+ Qm R)
    (hφ : ∀ g x, φ (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ B g • x) = actQ R g g (φ x))
    (hb : ∀ j, IsDeg n (φ (Pi.single j 1))) (x : F R n) : IsDeg n (φ x)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  let ev : Qm R →+ T R p q := (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun q => T R p q) q).comp
    (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun p => ∀ q, T R p q) p)
  have := freeMod_hom_ext (φ := ev.comp φ) (ψ := 0) (fun i g => by
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hφ, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, ev,
      Pi.evalAddMonoidHom_apply, actQ_apply, hb i p q hpq, map_zero])
  exact congrArg (fun f => f x) this

name: TheoremA.L42.Δ_deg
statement: theorem Δ_deg : ∀ n (x : F R n), IsDeg n (Δ C n x)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine isDeg_of_basis _ (Δ_of C 0) fun j => ?_
    rw [Δ_zero_single]
    intro p q hpq
    simp [E00_deg C p q hpq]
  | succ n ih =>
    refine isDeg_of_basis _ (Δ_of C (n + 1)) fun j => ?_
    rw [Δ_succ_single]
    exact (ih _).Sig C

name: TheoremA.L42.εε_act
statement: theorem εε_act (b : B) (t : T R 0 0) : εε R (act R 0 0 b b t) = εε R t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | tmul x y => simp only [act, map_tmul, gsm_apply, εε_tmul, R.ε_inv]

name: TheoremA.L42.Δ_aug
statement: theorem Δ_aug (x : F R 0) : εε R (Δ C 0 x 0 0) = R.ε x
proof:
:= by
  let ev : Qm R →+ ℤ := (εε R).toAddMonoidHom.comp
    ((Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun q => T R 0 q) 0).comp
      (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun p => ∀ q, T R p q) 0))
  have := freeMod_hom_ext (φ := ev.comp (Δ C 0)) (ψ := R.ε) (fun i g => by
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, Δ_of, ev, Pi.evalAddMonoidHom_apply, actQ_apply,
      LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, εε_act, Δ_zero_single, R.ε_inv]
    simp [C.hx0, -zsmul_eq_mul])
  exact congrArg (fun f => f x) this

name: TheoremA.L42.map_ιε_ιε
statement: theorem map_ιε_ιε (t : T R 0 0) : map (ιε C) (ιε C) t = εε R t • (C.x0 ⊗ₜ C.x0)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_smul]
  | tmul x y =>
    rw [map_tmul, ιε_apply, ιε_apply, εε_tmul, tmul_smul, ← smul_tmul', smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: TheoremA.L42.Δ_chain
statement: theorem Δ_chain : ∀ n, n ≤ k → ∀ x, D R (Δ C (n + 1) x) = Δ C n (R.d n x)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro _ x
    have := diag_hom_ext R (φ := (D R).comp (Δ C 1)) (ψ := (Δ C 0).comp (R.d 0).toAddMonoidHom)
      (fun g x => by simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, Δ_of, D_actQ])
      (fun g x => by
        simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, map_smul, Δ_of])
      (fun j => by
        simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, Δ_succ_single, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe]
        refine D_Sig_deg0 C (Δ_deg C 0 _) ?_
        rw [map_ιε_ιε, Δ_aug, R.ε_d, zero_smul])
    exact congrArg (fun f => f x) this
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hn x
    have := diag_hom_ext R (φ := (D R).comp (Δ C (n + 2)))
      (ψ := (Δ C (n + 1)).comp (R.d (n + 1)).toAddMonoidHom)
      (fun g x => by simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, Δ_of, D_actQ])
      (fun g x => by
        simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, map_smul, Δ_of])
      (fun j => by
        simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, Δ_succ_single, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe]
        refine D_Sig_of_cycle C (Δ_deg C (n + 1) _) ?_ (by omega) hn
        rw [ih (by omega), R.d_d n (by omega), map_zero])
    exact congrArg (fun f => f x) this

name: TheoremA.L42.ιε_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem ιε_apply (x : F R 0) : ιε C x = R.ε x • C.x0
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.c0'
statement: theorem c0' : dZ R 0 ∘ₗ C.σ 0 + ιε C = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, ιε_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
  exact C.c0 x

name: TheoremA.L42.ci'
statement:
theorem ci' (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k) :
    dZ R (i + 1) ∘ₗ C.σ (i + 1) + C.σ i ∘ₗ dZ R i = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
  exact C.ci i hi x

name: TheoremA.L42.ιε_dZ
statement: theorem ιε_dZ : ιε C ∘ₗ dZ R 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, ιε_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  rw [show R.ε (dZ R 0 x) = 0 from R.ε_d x, zero_smul]

name: TheoremA.L42.ιε_ιε
statement: theorem ιε_ιε : ιε C ∘ₗ ιε C = ιε C
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, ιε_apply, map_zsmul, C.hx0, one_smul]

name: TheoremA.L42.Sig_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem Sig_succ (z : Qm R) (p q : ℕ) :
    Sig C z (p + 1) q = map (C.σ p) LinearMap.id (z p q)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.Sig_zero_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem Sig_zero_succ (z : Qm R) (q : ℕ) :
    Sig C z 0 (q + 1) = map (ιε C) (C.σ q) (z 0 q)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.Sig_zero_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem Sig_zero_zero (z : Qm R) : Sig C z 0 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.IsDeg.Sig
statement: theorem IsDeg.Sig {n : ℕ} {z : Qm R} (h : IsDeg n z) : IsDeg (n + 1) (Sig C z)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  rcases p with _ | p <;> rcases q with _ | q
  · rfl
  · simp [h 0 q (by omega)]
  · simp [h p 0 (by omega)]
  · simp [h p (q + 1) (by omega)]

name: TheoremA.L42.IsDeg.D
statement: theorem IsDeg.D {n : ℕ} {z : Qm R} (h : IsDeg (n + 1) z) : IsDeg n (D R z)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  simp [D_apply, h (p + 1) q (by omega), h p (q + 1) (by omega)]

name: TheoremA.L42.IsDeg.actQ
statement: theorem IsDeg.actQ {n : ℕ} {z : Qm R} (h : IsDeg n z) (b c : B) : IsDeg n (actQ R b c z)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq; simp [h p q hpq]

name: TheoremA.L42.sign_succ
statement:
theorem sign_succ (i : ℕ) {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] (x : M) :
    ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (i + 1)) • x = -(((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_smul]

name: TheoremA.L42.map_add_id
statement:
theorem map_add_id {M N P : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup P]
    (a b : M →ₗ[ℤ] P) (g : N →ₗ[ℤ] N) (t : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    map a g t + map b g t = map (a + b) g t
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add_left]; rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.map_id_add
statement:
theorem map_id_add {M N P : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup P]
    (f : M →ₗ[ℤ] M) (a b : N →ₗ[ℤ] P) (t : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    map f a t + map f b t = map f (a + b) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add_right]; rfl

name: TheoremA.L42.homotopy_succ
statement:
theorem homotopy_succ (z : Qm R) (i q : ℕ) (hi : i < k) :
    D R (Sig C z) (i + 1) q + Sig C (D R z) (i + 1) q = z (i + 1) q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [D_apply, Sig_succ, map_add, map_zsmul, map_map, LinearMap.comp_id,
    LinearMap.id_comp, sign_succ]
  have key := map_add_id (dZ R (i + 1) ∘ₗ C.σ (i + 1)) (C.σ i ∘ₗ dZ R i) LinearMap.id (z (i + 1) q)
  rw [ci' C i hi, map_id, LinearMap.id_apply] at key
  convert key using 1; abel

name: TheoremA.L42.homotopy_zero_succ
statement:
theorem homotopy_zero_succ (z : Qm R) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k) :
    D R (Sig C z) 0 (i + 1) + Sig C (D R z) 0 (i + 1) = z 0 (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [D_apply, Sig_succ, Sig_zero_succ, map_add, map_map, LinearMap.comp_id,
    LinearMap.id_comp, pow_zero, one_smul, ιε_dZ, map_zero_left, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add]
  have k1 := map_id_add (ιε C) (dZ R (i + 1) ∘ₗ C.σ (i + 1)) (C.σ i ∘ₗ dZ R i) (z 0 (i + 1))
  rw [ci' C i hi] at k1
  have k2 := map_add_id (dZ R 0 ∘ₗ C.σ 0) (ιε C) LinearMap.id (z 0 (i + 1))
  rw [c0' C, map_id, LinearMap.id_apply] at k2
  rw [← k1] at k2; convert k2 using 1; abel

name: TheoremA.L42.homotopy_zero_zero
statement:
theorem homotopy_zero_zero (z : Qm R) :
    D R (Sig C z) 0 0 = z 0 0 - map (ιε C) (ιε C) (z 0 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [D_apply, Sig_succ, Sig_zero_succ, map_map, LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.id_comp,
    pow_zero, one_smul]
  have k1 := map_id_add (ιε C) (dZ R 0 ∘ₗ C.σ 0) (ιε C) (z 0 0)
  rw [c0' C] at k1
  have k2 := map_add_id (dZ R 0 ∘ₗ C.σ 0) (ιε C) LinearMap.id (z 0 0)
  rw [c0' C, map_id, LinearMap.id_apply] at k2
  rw [← k1] at k2; rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq]; convert k2 using 1; abel

name: TheoremA.L42.homotopy_top
statement:
theorem homotopy_top (z : Qm R) (q : ℕ) :
    D R (Sig C z) (k + 1) q + Sig C (D R z) (k + 1) q =
      map (C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k) LinearMap.id (z (k + 1) q)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [D_apply, Sig_succ, map_add, map_zsmul, map_map, LinearMap.comp_id,
    LinearMap.id_comp, sign_succ, C.σ_top (k + 1) (by omega), map_zero_left,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add, map_zero]
  abel

name: TheoremA.L42.homotopy_zero_top
statement:
theorem homotopy_zero_top (z : Qm R) :
    D R (Sig C z) 0 (k + 1) + Sig C (D R z) 0 (k + 1) =
      map (dZ R 0 ∘ₗ C.σ 0) LinearMap.id (z 0 (k + 1)) +
        map (ιε C) (C.σ k ∘ₗ dZ R k) (z 0 (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [D_apply, Sig_succ, Sig_zero_succ, map_add, map_map, LinearMap.comp_id,
    pow_zero, one_smul, ιε_dZ, map_zero_left, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add,
    C.σ_top (k + 1) (by omega), map_zero_right, map_zero, add_zero]

name: TheoremA.L42.D_Sig_of_cycle
statement:
theorem D_Sig_of_cycle {n : ℕ} {z : Qm R} (hz : IsDeg n z) (hD : D R z = 0) (hn1 : 1 ≤ n)
    (hnk : n ≤ k) : D R (Sig C z) = z
proof:
:= by
  funext p q
  by_cases hpq : p + q = n
  · rcases p with _ | p
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, q = i + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
      have := homotopy_zero_succ C z i (by omega)
      rwa [hD, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero] at this
    · have := homotopy_succ C z p q (by omega)
      rwa [hD, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero] at this
  · rw [(hz.Sig C).D p q hpq, hz p q hpq]

name: TheoremA.L42.D_Sig_deg0
statement:
theorem D_Sig_deg0 {z : Qm R} (hz : IsDeg 0 z) (h00 : map (ιε C) (ιε C) (z 0 0) = 0) :
    D R (Sig C z) = z
proof:
:= by
  funext p q
  by_cases h : p = 0 ∧ q = 0
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [homotopy_zero_zero, h00, sub_zero]
  · rw [(hz.Sig C).D p q (by omega), hz p q (by omega)]

name: TheoremA.Picture.exists_pow_eq_of_sameCycle
statement: theorem exists_pow_eq_of_sameCycle (h : π.SameCycle a b) : ∃ n : ℕ, (π ^ n) a = b
proof:
:=
  h.exists_nat_pow_eq

name: TheoremA.Picture.sameCycle_swap_mul_split
statement:
theorem sameCycle_swap_mul_split (hab : a ≠ b) (h : π.SameCycle a b) :
    ¬ (swap a b * π).SameCycle a b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, (π ^ n) a = b := exists_pow_eq_of_sameCycle h
  set k := Nat.find hex with hk
  have hkb : (π ^ k) a = b := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hmin : ∀ j < k, (π ^ j) a ≠ b := fun j hj => Nat.find_min hex hj
  have hk0 : 0 < k := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0] at hkb; exact absurd hkb (by simpa using hab)
    · exact h0
  
  have harc : ∀ j < k, ((swap a b * π) ^ j) a = (π ^ j) a := by
    intro j hj
    induction j with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, ih (by omega), Perm.mul_apply, ← Perm.mul_apply π,
        ← pow_succ']
      apply swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne
      · intro hja
        
        apply hmin (k - (j + 1)) (by omega)
        have : (π ^ k) a = (π ^ (k - (j + 1))) ((π ^ (j + 1)) a) := by
          rw [← Perm.mul_apply, ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
        rw [← hkb, this, hja]
      · exact hmin (j + 1) hj
  have hper : ((swap a b * π) ^ k) a = a := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hm] at hkb ⊢
    rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, harc m (by omega), Perm.mul_apply, ← Perm.mul_apply π,
      ← pow_succ', hkb, swap_apply_right]
  intro hs
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hs.exists_nat_pow_eq
  have hq : ∀ q : ℕ, ((swap a b * π) ^ (k * q)) a = a := by
    intro q
    induction q with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ q ih => rw [Nat.mul_succ, pow_add, Perm.mul_apply, hper, ih]
  have hmod : ((swap a b * π) ^ (n % k)) a = ((swap a b * π) ^ n) a := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← Nat.mod_add_div n k, pow_add, Perm.mul_apply, hq]
  rw [← hmod, harc _ (Nat.mod_lt _ hk0)] at hn
  exact hmin _ (Nat.mod_lt _ hk0) hn

name: TheoremA.Picture.swap_mul_swap_mul
statement: theorem swap_mul_swap_mul (a b : D) (π : Perm D) : swap a b * (swap a b * π) = π
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, swap_mul_self, one_mul]

name: TheoremA.Picture.numOrbits_swap_mul_split
statement:
theorem numOrbits_swap_mul_split (hab : a ≠ b) (h : π.SameCycle a b) :
    numOrbits (swap a b * π) = numOrbits π + 1
proof:
:= by
  have := numOrbits_swap_mul (sameCycle_swap_mul_split hab h)
  rw [swap_mul_swap_mul] at this
  exact this

name: TheoremA.Picture.cycleWord_swap_mul_split
statement:
theorem cycleWord_swap_mul_split {M : Type*} [Monoid M] (f : D → M) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (h : π.SameCycle a b) :
    cycleWord π f a = cycleWord (swap a b * π) f a * cycleWord (swap a b * π) f b
proof:
:= by
  have := cycleWord_swap_mul f (sameCycle_swap_mul_split hab h)
  rwa [swap_mul_swap_mul] at this

name: TheoremA.Picture.sameCycle_swap_mul_split_iff
statement:
theorem sameCycle_swap_mul_split_iff (hab : a ≠ b) (h : π.SameCycle a b) {x y : D} :
    π.SameCycle x y ↔ (swap a b * π).SameCycle x y ∨
      (((swap a b * π).SameCycle a x ∨ (swap a b * π).SameCycle b x) ∧
        ((swap a b * π).SameCycle a y ∨ (swap a b * π).SameCycle b y))
proof:
:= by
  have := sameCycle_swap_mul_iff (π := swap a b * π) (x := x) (y := y)
    (sameCycle_swap_mul_split hab h)
  rwa [swap_mul_swap_mul] at this

name: TheoremA.Picture.numOrbits_swap_mul_le
statement:
theorem numOrbits_swap_mul_le (a b : D) (π : Perm D) :
    numOrbits (swap a b * π) ≤ numOrbits π + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst hab; rw [Equiv.swap_self]; change numOrbits π ≤ numOrbits π + 1; omega
  by_cases h : π.SameCycle a b
  · rw [numOrbits_swap_mul_split hab h]
  · have := numOrbits_swap_mul h; omega

name: TheoremA.trivCC.letterWord_eq_one
statement: theorem letterWord_eq_one (p : trivCC.Letter) : trivCC.letterWord p = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, g⟩ := p
  cases k with
  | inl a =>
    change Monoid.CoprodI.of (i := Sum.inl a) g = 1
    exact (congrArg _ (show g = 1 from rfl)).trans (map_one _)
  | inr a =>
    change Monoid.CoprodI.of (i := Sum.inr a) g = 1
    exact (congrArg _ (show g = 1 from rfl)).trans (map_one _)

name: TheoremA.trivCC.relEdge_kind
statement:
theorem relEdge_kind (b : Bool) :
    trivCC.RelEdge (kindLetter b) (kindLetter (!b)) ∨
      trivCC.RelEdge (kindLetter (!b)) (kindLetter b)
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · exact Or.inr ⟨(), (), trivial, (1 : Unit), rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨(), (), trivial, (1 : Unit), rfl, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.trivCC.kindLetter_inv
statement: theorem kindLetter_inv (b : Bool) : (kindLetter b).inv = kindLetter b
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> rfl

name: TheoremA.cycleWord_const_one
statement:
theorem cycleWord_const_one {D M : Type*} [Monoid M] (π : Perm D) (x : D) :
    cycleWord π (fun _ => (1 : M)) x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cycleWord]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.kind_pow
statement: theorem kind_pow (x : M.D) (n : ℕ) : κ ((M.σ ^ n) x) = κ x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, hκσ, ih]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.kind_eq_of_sameCycle
statement: theorem kind_eq_of_sameCycle {x y : M.D} (h : M.σ.SameCycle x y) : κ y = κ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h.exists_nat_pow_eq
  exact M.kind_pow κ hκσ x n

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.not_sameCycle_α_of_kind
statement: theorem not_sameCycle_α_of_kind (x : M.D) : ¬ M.σ.SameCycle x (M.α x)
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have := M.kind_eq_of_sameCycle κ hκσ h
  rw [hκα] at this
  cases hx : κ x <;> simp [hx] at this

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.consolidate_map
statement:
theorem consolidate_map (hdist : ¬ M.σ.SameCycle (M.α d) (M.α (M.σ d))) :
    (M.eraseEdge (swap (M.α d) (M.α (M.σ d)) * M.σ) (M.σ d)).Connected ∧
    (M.eraseEdge (swap (M.α d) (M.α (M.σ d)) * M.σ) (M.σ d)).euler = 2 ∧
    (M.eraseEdge (swap (M.α d) (M.α (M.σ d)) * M.σ) (M.σ d)).numEdges + 1 = M.numEdges
proof:
:=
  ⟨(auxPair hκσ hκα hc hs hde hk).consolidate_connected hdist,
    (auxPair hκσ hκα hc hs hde hk).consolidate_euler hdist,
    (auxPair hκσ hκα hc hs hde hk).consolidate_numEdges'⟩

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.consolidateDigon_map
statement:
theorem consolidateDigon_map (hdig : M.σ (M.α (M.σ d)) = M.α d) :
    (M.eraseEdge M.σ (M.σ d)).Connected ∧ (M.eraseEdge M.σ (M.σ d)).euler = 2 ∧
    (M.eraseEdge M.σ (M.σ d)).numEdges + 1 = M.numEdges
proof:
:=
  ⟨(auxPair hκσ hκα hc hs hde hk).consolidateDigon_connected hdig,
    (auxPair hκσ hκα hc hs hde hk).consolidateDigon_euler hdig,
    (auxPair hκσ hκα hc hs hde hk).consolidateDigon_numEdges'⟩

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.relEdge_isLeft
statement:
theorem relEdge_isLeft {p q : C.Letter} (h : C.RelEdge p q) :
    p.1.isLeft = true ∧ q.1.isLeft = false
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, t, _, a, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectPicture.toDefectData
statement:
theorem DefectPicture.toDefectData {s : V ⊕ T} {P : C.loc s} (Δ : C.DefectPicture s P)
    (hP : P ≠ 1) : C.DefectData Δ.M Δ.lab where
  connected
proof:
:= Δ.connected
  spherical := Δ.spherical
  type_σ := Δ.type_σ
  edge := Δ.edge
  exc := ⟨Δ.b, by rw [Δ.defect_word]; exact DefectPicture.cap_word_ne_one hP, fun d hd => by
    by_contra h
    exact hd (Δ.local_eq d h)⟩

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectData.type_pow
statement: theorem type_pow (d : M.D) (n : ℕ) : (lab ((M.σ ^ n) d)).1 = (lab d).1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, h.type_σ, ih]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectData.type_eq_of_sameCycle
statement: theorem type_eq_of_sameCycle {d e : M.D} (hde : M.σ.SameCycle d e) : (lab e).1 = (lab d).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hde.exists_nat_pow_eq
  exact h.type_pow d n

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectData.kind_σ
statement: theorem kind_σ (x : M.D) : (lab (M.σ x)).1.isLeft = (lab x).1.isLeft
proof: := by rw [h.type_σ]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectData.kind_α
statement: theorem kind_α (x : M.D) : (lab (M.α x)).1.isLeft = !(lab x).1.isLeft
proof:
:= by
  rcases h.edge x with he | he
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := relEdge_isLeft he
    rw [h1, h2]; rfl
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := relEdge_isLeft he
    rw [h1, h2]; rfl

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectData.not_sameCycle_α
statement: theorem not_sameCycle_α (x : M.D) : ¬ M.σ.SameCycle x (M.α x)
proof:
:=
  M.not_sameCycle_α_of_kind (fun z => (lab z).1.isLeft) h.kind_σ h.kind_α x

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectData.type_α_ne
statement: theorem type_α_ne (x : M.D) : (lab (M.α x)).1 ≠ (lab x).1
proof:
:= fun e => by
  have := h.kind_α x
  rw [e] at this
  cases hx : (lab x).1.isLeft <;> simp [hx] at this

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectData.exists_defectPicture
statement:
theorem exists_defectPicture :
    ∃ (s : V ⊕ T) (P : C.loc s) (Δ : C.DefectPicture s P), P ≠ 1 ∧ Δ.M = M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hexc⟩ := h.exc
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := exists_cycleWord_eq_letter M.σ lab (lab b).1 b (h.type_pow b)
  refine ⟨(lab b).1, Q, {
    M := M
    lab := lab
    b := b
    connected := h.connected
    spherical := h.spherical
    type_σ := h.type_σ
    type_b := rfl
    local_eq := fun d hd => by
      by_contra hne
      exact hd (hexc d hne)
    defect_word := hQ
    edge := h.edge }, fun hQ1 => hb ?_, rfl⟩
  rw [hQ, hQ1]
  exact map_one _

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.exists_isLeastDefect
statement:
theorem exists_isLeastDefect {M : CombMap} {lab : M.D → C.Letter} (h : C.DefectData M lab) :
    ∃ (M' : CombMap) (lab' : M'.D → C.Letter), C.IsLeastDefect M' lab'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ n, ∃ (M' : CombMap) (lab' : M'.D → C.Letter), C.DefectData M' lab' ∧
      M'.numEdges = n := ⟨_, M, lab, h, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨M', lab', h', hn⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  refine ⟨M', lab', h', fun M'' lab'' h'' => ?_⟩
  rw [hn]
  exact Nat.find_min' hex ⟨M'', lab'', h'', rfl⟩
