name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.exists_isLeastDefect_of_defectPicture
proof:
:=
  exists_isLeastDefect (Δ.toDefectData hP)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.IsLeastDefect.not_lt
statement:
theorem not_lt {M' : CombMap} {lab' : M'.D → C.Letter} (h' : C.DefectData M' lab') :
    ¬ M'.numEdges < M.numEdges
proof: := fun hlt => absurd (h.2 M' lab' h') (not_le.2 hlt)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eqvGen_of_sameCycle
statement: theorem eqvGen_of_sameCycle {x y : M.D} (h : M.σ.SameCycle x y) : Relation.EqvGen M.Step x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h.exists_nat_pow_eq
  clear h
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | succ n ih =>
    refine ih.trans _ _ _ (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (Or.inl ?_))
    rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.connected_of_base
statement: theorem connected_of_base (d₀ : M.D) (h : ∀ x, Relation.EqvGen M.Step d₀ x) : M.Connected
proof:
:=
  fun x y => ((h x).symm _ _).trans _ _ _ (h y)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.glue_not_sameCycle
statement:
theorem glue_not_sameCycle :
    ¬ (Perm.sumCongr M₁.σ M₂.σ).SameCycle (Sum.inl p₁) (Sum.inr p₂)
proof:
:=
  not_sameCycle_sumCongr_inl_inr

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.glue_numVertices
statement:
theorem glue_numVertices :
    (glue M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).numVertices + 1 = M₁.numVertices + M₂.numVertices
proof:
:= by
  unfold numVertices
  rw [← numOrbits_sumCongr, numOrbits_swap_mul (glue_not_sameCycle M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂)]
  rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.glue_numEdges
statement: theorem glue_numEdges : (glue M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).numEdges = M₁.numEdges + M₂.numEdges
proof:
:=
  numOrbits_sumCongr _ _

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.glue_φ
statement:
theorem glue_φ : (glue M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).φ =
    swap (Sum.inl p₁) (Sum.inr p₂) * Perm.sumCongr M₁.φ M₂.φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [φ, glue, mul_assoc, Perm.sumCongr_mul]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.glue_numFaces
statement:
theorem glue_numFaces :
    (glue M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).numFaces + 1 = M₁.numFaces + M₂.numFaces
proof:
:= by
  unfold numFaces
  rw [glue_φ, ← numOrbits_sumCongr, numOrbits_swap_mul not_sameCycle_sumCongr_inl_inr]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.glue_euler
statement: theorem glue_euler : (glue M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).euler = M₁.euler + M₂.euler - 2
proof:
:= by
  have hV := glue_numVertices M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂
  have hE := glue_numEdges M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂
  have hF := glue_numFaces M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂
  unfold euler
  omega

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.glue_sameCycle_iff
statement:
theorem glue_sameCycle_iff {x y : (glue M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).D} :
    (glue M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).σ.SameCycle x y ↔ (Perm.sumCongr M₁.σ M₂.σ).SameCycle x y ∨
      (((Perm.sumCongr M₁.σ M₂.σ).SameCycle (Sum.inl p₁) x ∨
          (Perm.sumCongr M₁.σ M₂.σ).SameCycle (Sum.inr p₂) x) ∧
        ((Perm.sumCongr M₁.σ M₂.σ).SameCycle (Sum.inl p₁) y ∨
          (Perm.sumCongr M₁.σ M₂.σ).SameCycle (Sum.inr p₂) y))
proof:
:=
  sameCycle_swap_mul_iff (glue_not_sameCycle M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.glue_eqvGen_inl
statement:
theorem glue_eqvGen_inl {x y : M₁.D} (h : Relation.EqvGen M₁.Step x y) :
    Relation.EqvGen (glue M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).Step (Sum.inl x) (Sum.inl y)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel x y h =>
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · exact eqvGen_of_sameCycle _ ((glue_sameCycle_iff M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).2
        (Or.inl (sameCycle_sumCongr_inl.2 ⟨1, by simp⟩)))
    · exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (Or.inr rfl)
  | refl => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans _ _ _ ih₂

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.glue_eqvGen_inr
statement:
theorem glue_eqvGen_inr {x y : M₂.D} (h : Relation.EqvGen M₂.Step x y) :
    Relation.EqvGen (glue M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).Step (Sum.inr x) (Sum.inr y)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel x y h =>
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · exact eqvGen_of_sameCycle _ ((glue_sameCycle_iff M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).2
        (Or.inl (sameCycle_sumCongr_inr.2 ⟨1, by simp⟩)))
    · exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (Or.inr rfl)
  | refl => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans _ _ _ ih₂

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.glue_connected
statement:
theorem glue_connected (h₁ : M₁.Connected) (h₂ : M₂.Connected) :
    (glue M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).Connected
proof:
:= by
  refine connected_of_base _ (Sum.inl p₁) ?_
  have hlink : Relation.EqvGen (glue M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂).Step (Sum.inl p₁) (Sum.inr p₂) :=
    eqvGen_of_sameCycle _ (sameCycle_swap_mul_left_right (glue_not_sameCycle M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂))
  rintro (x | x)
  · exact glue_eqvGen_inl M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂ (h₁ p₁ x)
  · exact hlink.trans _ _ _ (glue_eqvGen_inr M₁ M₂ p₁ p₂ (h₂ p₂ x))

name: TheoremA.Picture.numOrbits_eq_of_invariant
statement:
theorem numOrbits_eq_of_invariant {n N : ℕ} (π : Perm D) (f : D → Fin n) (hf : Surjective f)
    (hinv : ∀ x, f (π x) = f x) (hreach : ∀ x y, f x = f y → ∃ k : Fin N, (π ^ (k : ℕ)) x = y) :
    numOrbits π = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [numOrbits_eq_of_iff π f hf, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]
  intro x y
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hreach x y h
    exact sameCycle_of_pow_eq k hk
  · exact SameCycle.eq_of_invariant hinv

name: TheoremA.Picture.sameCycle_iff_of_invariant
statement:
theorem sameCycle_iff_of_invariant {n N : ℕ} (π : Perm D) (f : D → Fin n)
    (hinv : ∀ x, f (π x) = f x) (hreach : ∀ x y, f x = f y → ∃ k : Fin N, (π ^ (k : ℕ)) x = y)
    (x y : D) : π.SameCycle x y ↔ f x = f y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact SameCycle.eq_of_invariant hinv
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hreach x y h
    exact sameCycle_of_pow_eq k hk

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eqvGen_walk
statement:
theorem CombMap.eqvGen_walk (M : CombMap) (d : M.D) (l : List Bool) :
    Relation.EqvGen M.Step d (walk M.σ M.α d l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing d with
  | nil => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | cons b l ih =>
    refine Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ?_) (ih _)
    cases b
    · exact Or.inr rfl
    · exact Or.inl rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.connected_of_walks
statement:
theorem CombMap.connected_of_walks (M : CombMap) (d₀ : M.D) (S : List (List Bool))
    (h : ∀ x, ∃ l ∈ S, walk M.σ M.α d₀ l = x) : M.Connected
proof:
:= by
  refine M.connected_of_base d₀ fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨l, -, rfl⟩ := h x
  exact M.eqvGen_walk d₀ l

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.triangle_euler
statement: theorem triangle_euler : triangle.euler = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hV : triangle.numVertices = 3 :=
    numOrbits_eq_of_invariant (N := 2) triangle.σ ![0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 0] (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide)
  have hE : triangle.numEdges = 3 :=
    numOrbits_eq_of_invariant (N := 2) triangle.α ![0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2] (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide)
  have hF : triangle.numFaces = 2 :=
    numOrbits_eq_of_invariant (N := 3) triangle.φ ![0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1] (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide)
  simp [euler, hV, hE, hF]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.digon_euler
statement: theorem digon_euler : digon.euler = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hV : digon.numVertices = 2 :=
    numOrbits_eq_of_invariant (N := 2) digon.σ ![0, 1, 1, 0] (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have hE : digon.numEdges = 2 :=
    numOrbits_eq_of_invariant (N := 2) digon.α ![0, 0, 1, 1] (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have hF : digon.numFaces = 2 :=
    numOrbits_eq_of_invariant (N := 2) digon.φ ![0, 1, 0, 1] (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  simp [euler, hV, hE, hF]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.triangle_connected
statement: theorem triangle_connected : triangle.Connected
proof:
:=
  triangle.connected_of_walks (0 : Fin 6)
    [[], [true], [false], [true, false], [false, true], [false, true, false]] (by decide)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.digon_connected
statement: theorem digon_connected : digon.Connected
proof:
:=
  digon.connected_of_walks (0 : Fin 4) [[], [true], [false], [true, false]] (by decide)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.ne_α_of_loop
statement: theorem ne_α_of_loop : d ≠ M.α d
proof: := fun h => hloop (h ▸ Perm.SameCycle.refl _ _)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.σ_ne_α_of_loop
statement: theorem σ_ne_α_of_loop : M.σ d ≠ M.α d
proof: := fun h => hloop ⟨1, by simpa using h⟩

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.σα_ne_of_loop
statement: theorem σα_ne_of_loop : M.σ (M.α d) ≠ d
proof:
:= fun h =>
  hloop (Perm.SameCycle.symm ⟨1, by simpa using h⟩)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.delRetract_d
statement: theorem delRetract_d : M.delRetract d d = M.σ d
proof: := by simp [delRetract]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.delRetract_u
statement: theorem delRetract_u : M.delRetract d (M.α d) = M.σ (M.α d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold delRetract
  rw [if_neg (ne_α_of_loop hloop).symm, if_pos rfl]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.delRetract_of_ne
statement: theorem delRetract_of_ne {z : M.D} (h1 : z ≠ d) (h2 : z ≠ M.α d) : M.delRetract d z = z
proof:
:= by
  unfold delRetract
  rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.del_stepσ
statement:
theorem del_stepσ (y : M.D) :
    Relation.EqvGen (M.withσ (erase2 M.σ d (M.α d))).Step
      (M.delRetract d y) (M.delRetract d (M.σ y))
proof:
:= by
  have hσdu := σ_ne_α_of_loop hloop
  have hne := σα_ne_of_loop hloop
  have hSC : ∀ y z, (y ≠ d ∧ y ≠ M.α d) → (z ≠ d ∧ z ≠ M.α d) → M.σ.SameCycle y z →
      Relation.EqvGen (M.withσ (erase2 M.σ d (M.α d))).Step y z := fun y z hy hz h =>
    withσ_eqvGen_of_sameCycle ((sameCycle_erase2_iff hy.1 hy.2 hz.1 hz.2).2 h)
  have hσ1 : ∀ y, M.σ.SameCycle y (M.σ y) := fun y => ⟨1, by simp⟩
  by_cases hyd : y = d
  · subst hyd
    rw [delRetract_d, delRetract_of_ne hσd hσdu]
    exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  by_cases hyu : y = M.α d
  · subst hyu
    rw [delRetract_u hloop, delRetract_of_ne hne hleaf]
    exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  rw [delRetract_of_ne hyd hyu]
  by_cases h2 : M.σ y = d
  · rw [h2, delRetract_d]
    exact hSC _ _ ⟨hyd, hyu⟩ ⟨hσd, hσdu⟩ (by rw [← h2]; exact (hσ1 y).trans (hσ1 _))
  by_cases h3 : M.σ y = M.α d
  · rw [h3, delRetract_u hloop]
    exact hSC _ _ ⟨hyd, hyu⟩ ⟨hne, hleaf⟩ (by rw [← h3]; exact (hσ1 y).trans (hσ1 _))
  rw [delRetract_of_ne h2 h3]
  exact hSC _ _ ⟨hyd, hyu⟩ ⟨h2, h3⟩ (hσ1 y)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.del_stepα
statement:
theorem del_stepα {y : M.D} (hyd : y ≠ d) (hyu : y ≠ M.α d) :
    Relation.EqvGen (M.withσ (erase2 M.σ d (M.α d))).Step
      (M.delRetract d y) (M.delRetract d (M.α y))
proof:
:= by
  have h1' : M.α y ≠ d := fun h => hyu (by rw [← h, M.α_α])
  have h2' : M.α y ≠ M.α d := fun h => hyd (M.α.injective h)
  rw [delRetract_of_ne hyd hyu, delRetract_of_ne h1' h2']
  exact withσ_eqvGen_α y

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.del_key
statement:
theorem del_key (hφ : ¬ M.φ.SameCycle d (M.α d)) :
    Relation.EqvGen (M.withσ (erase2 M.σ d (M.α d))).Step (M.σ (M.α d)) (M.σ d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set u := M.α d with hu
  set N := M.withσ (erase2 M.σ d u) with hN
  have hne : M.σ u ≠ d := σα_ne_of_loop hloop
  have hfstep : ∀ y, y ≠ d → y ≠ u → M.φ y ≠ d → M.φ y ≠ u →
      Relation.EqvGen N.Step y (M.φ y) := by
    intro y hy1 hy2 hy3 hy4
    have ha1 : M.α y ≠ d := fun h => hy2 (by rw [hu, ← h, M.α_α])
    have ha2 : M.α y ≠ u := fun h => hy1 (M.α.injective h)
    have e : erase2 M.σ d u (M.α y) = M.φ y := erase2_apply_of_notMem ha1 ha2 hy3 hy4
    exact (withσ_eqvGen_α (σ' := erase2 M.σ d u) y).trans _ _ _
      (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (Or.inl e.symm))
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, (M.φ ^ n) (M.σ u) = d ∨ (M.φ ^ n) (M.σ u) = u := by
    have hc : M.φ.SameCycle (M.σ u) d :=
      (show M.φ.SameCycle d (M.σ u) from ⟨1, by simp [φ, hu]⟩).symm
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hc.exists_nat_pow_eq
    exact ⟨n, Or.inl hn⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hmin⟩ : ∃ n, ((M.φ ^ n) (M.σ u) = d ∨ (M.φ ^ n) (M.σ u) = u) ∧
      ∀ i < n, (M.φ ^ i) (M.σ u) ≠ d ∧ (M.φ ^ i) (M.σ u) ≠ u :=
    ⟨Nat.find hex, Nat.find_spec hex, fun i hi => by
      have := Nat.find_min hex hi
      push_neg at this
      exact this⟩
  obtain _ | m := n
  · simp only [pow_zero, Perm.one_apply] at hn
    rcases hn with h | h
    · exact absurd h hne
    · exact absurd h hleaf
  have hwalk : ∀ i ≤ m, Relation.EqvGen N.Step (M.σ u) ((M.φ ^ i) (M.σ u)) := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => intro _; exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      have hc := hmin i (by omega)
      have hc' := hmin (i + 1) (by omega)
      rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply] at hc' ⊢
      exact (ih (by omega)).trans _ _ _ (hfstep _ hc.1 hc.2 hc'.1 hc'.2)
  have hy := hwalk m le_rfl
  set y := (M.φ ^ m) (M.σ u) with hy_def
  have hφy : M.φ y = d ∨ M.φ y = u := by
    have : (M.φ ^ (m + 1)) (M.σ u) = M.φ y := by rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [← this]; exact hn
  rcases hφy with hφy | hφy
  · have hyr := hmin m (by omega)
    have ha1 : M.α y ≠ d := fun h => hyr.2 (by rw [← hy_def, hu, ← h, M.α_α])
    have ha2 : M.α y ≠ u := fun h => hyr.1 (by rw [← hy_def]; exact M.α.injective h)
    have e : erase2 M.σ d u (M.α y) = M.σ d :=
      erase2_apply_of_eq_left ha2 hφy (σ_ne_α_of_loop hloop)
    exact hy.trans _ _ _ ((withσ_eqvGen_α (σ' := erase2 M.σ d u) y).trans _ _ _
      (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (Or.inl e.symm)))
  · exfalso
    apply hφ
    have h2 : M.φ.SameCycle (M.σ u) u := ⟨(m + 1 : ℕ), by
      rw [zpow_natCast, pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply]; exact hφy⟩
    exact (show M.φ.SameCycle d (M.σ u) from ⟨1, by simp [φ, hu]⟩).trans h2

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_diffFace
statement:
theorem eraseEdge_diffFace (hc : M.Connected) (hφ : ¬ M.φ.SameCycle d (M.α d)) :
    (M.eraseEdge M.σ d).Connected ∧ (M.eraseEdge M.σ d).euler = M.euler ∧
    (M.eraseEdge M.σ d).numEdges + 1 = M.numEdges
proof:
:= by
  have hdu := ne_α_of_loop hloop
  have hσdu := σ_ne_α_of_loop hloop
  have hne := σα_ne_of_loop hloop
  
  have hA := eraseEdge_numVertices M.σ d
  have hB := numOrbits_erase2 M.σ d (M.α d)
  have h5 : erasePt M.σ d (M.α d) = M.σ (M.α d) := erasePt_apply_of_ne hdu.symm hne
  rw [if_neg hσd, h5, if_neg hleaf] at hB
  
  have hA' := eraseEdge_numFaces M.σ d
  have hB' := numOrbits_erase2 (Equiv.swap d (M.α d) * M.σ * M.α) d (M.α d)
  have hχ : Equiv.swap d (M.α d) * M.σ * M.α = swap d (M.α d) * M.φ := by
    rw [mul_assoc]; rfl
  have hχu : (Equiv.swap d (M.α d) * M.σ * M.α) (M.α d) = M.σ d := by
    change swap d (M.α d) (M.σ (M.α (M.α d))) = _
    rw [M.α_α]
    exact swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hσd hσdu
  have h5' : erasePt (Equiv.swap d (M.α d) * M.σ * M.α) d (M.α d) ≠ M.α d := by
    rw [erasePt_apply_of_ne hdu.symm (by rw [hχu]; exact hσd), hχu]
    exact hσdu
  have hχd : (Equiv.swap d (M.α d) * M.σ * M.α) d = swap d (M.α d) (M.σ (M.α d)) := rfl
  rw [if_neg h5', hχd, swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hne hleaf, if_neg hne, hχ] at hB'
  rw [hχ] at hA'
  have hs : numOrbits (swap d (M.α d) * M.φ) + 1 = M.numFaces := (numOrbits_swap_mul hφ).symm
  have hE := eraseEdge_numEdges (M := M) M.σ d
  have hconn : (M.eraseEdge M.σ d).Connected := by
    refine eraseEdge_connected_of M.σ d hc (M.delRetract d)
      (fun y hy1 hy2 => delRetract_of_ne hy1 hy2) (del_stepσ hloop hσd hleaf) fun y => ?_
    have hkey : Relation.EqvGen (M.withσ (erase2 M.σ d (M.α d))).Step
        (M.delRetract d d) (M.delRetract d (M.α d)) := by
      rw [delRetract_d, delRetract_u hloop]
      exact (del_key hloop hleaf hφ).symm _ _
    by_cases hyd : y = d
    · subst hyd; exact hkey
    by_cases hyu : y = M.α d
    · subst hyu; rw [M.α_α]; exact hkey.symm _ _
    exact del_stepα hyd hyu
  refine ⟨hconn, ?_, hE⟩
  unfold euler numVertices numFaces at *
  omega

name: TheoremA.Picture.numOrbits_subtypePerm_add
statement:
theorem numOrbits_subtypePerm_add {D : Type*} [Finite D] (π : Perm D) (p : D → Prop)
    (h : ∀ x, p (π x) ↔ p x) :
    numOrbits π = numOrbits (π.subtypePerm h) +
      numOrbits (π.subtypePerm (p := fun x => ¬ p x) fun x => not_congr (h x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← numOrbits_sumCongr]
  have hinv : ∀ {x y}, π.SameCycle x y → (p x ↔ p y) := fun hxy =>
    (SameCycle.eq_of_invariant (f := p) (fun x => propext (h x)) hxy) ▸ Iff.rfl
  let g : D → {x // p x} ⊕ {x // ¬ p x} := fun x => if hx : p x then .inl ⟨x, hx⟩ else .inr ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine numOrbits_eq_of_iff π (fun x => (⟦g x⟧ : Quotient (Perm.SameCycle.setoid _))) ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨(⟨x, hx⟩ | ⟨x, hx⟩)⟩
    · exact ⟨x, by simp [g, hx]; rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨x, by simp [g, hx]; rfl⟩
  · intro x y
    rw [Quotient.eq]
    change (Perm.sumCongr _ _).SameCycle (g x) (g y) ↔ _
    by_cases hx : p x <;> by_cases hy : p y
    · simp only [g, dif_pos hx, dif_pos hy, sameCycle_sumCongr_inl, Perm.sameCycle_subtypePerm]
    · simp only [g, dif_pos hx, dif_neg hy]
      exact ⟨fun h => absurd h not_sameCycle_sumCongr_inl_inr,
        fun h => absurd ((hinv h).1 hx) hy⟩
    · simp only [g, dif_neg hx, dif_pos hy]
      exact ⟨fun h => absurd h not_sameCycle_sumCongr_inr_inl,
        fun h => absurd ((hinv h).2 hy) hx⟩
    · simp only [g, dif_neg hx, dif_neg hy, sameCycle_sumCongr_inr, Perm.sameCycle_subtypePerm]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.not_invariant_σ
statement: theorem not_invariant_σ (hσ : ∀ x, p (M.σ x) ↔ p x) : ∀ x, ¬ p (M.σ x) ↔ ¬ p x
proof: := fun x => not_congr (hσ x)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.not_invariant_α
statement: theorem not_invariant_α (hα : ∀ x, p (M.α x) ↔ p x) : ∀ x, ¬ p (M.α x) ↔ ¬ p x
proof: := fun x => not_congr (hα x)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.invariant_φ
statement: theorem invariant_φ (hσ : ∀ x, p (M.σ x) ↔ p x) (hα : ∀ x, p (M.α x) ↔ p x) : ∀ x, p (M.φ x) ↔ p x
proof: := fun x => (hσ _).trans (hα x)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.restrict_φ
statement: theorem restrict_φ (hσ : ∀ x, p (M.σ x) ↔ p x) (hα : ∀ x, p (M.α x) ↔ p x) : (M.restrict p hσ hα).φ = M.φ.subtypePerm (invariant_φ p hσ hα)
proof:
:= by
  ext x; rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.euler_restrict_add
statement:
theorem euler_restrict_add (hσ : ∀ x, p (M.σ x) ↔ p x) (hα : ∀ x, p (M.α x) ↔ p x) : M.euler = (M.restrict p hσ hα).euler +
    (M.restrict (fun x => ¬ p x) (not_invariant_σ p hσ) (not_invariant_α p hα)).euler
proof:
:= by
  have hV := numOrbits_subtypePerm_add M.σ p hσ
  have hE := numOrbits_subtypePerm_add M.α p hα
  have hF := numOrbits_subtypePerm_add M.φ p (invariant_φ p hσ hα)
  have hF1 := restrict_φ p hσ hα
  have hF2 := restrict_φ (fun x => ¬ p x) (not_invariant_σ p hσ) (not_invariant_α p hα)
  unfold euler numVertices numEdges numFaces
  rw [hF1, hF2]
  simp only [restrict] at *
  push_cast [hV, hE, hF]
  ring

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.invariant_of_eqvGen
statement: theorem invariant_of_eqvGen (hσ : ∀ x, p (M.σ x) ↔ p x) (hα : ∀ x, p (M.α x) ↔ p x) {u v : M.D} (h : Relation.EqvGen M.Step u v) : p u ↔ p v
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel u v h => rcases h with rfl | rfl
                 · exact (hσ u).symm
                 · exact (hα u).symm
  | refl => exact Iff.rfl
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.restrict_connected
statement:
theorem restrict_connected (hσ : ∀ x, p (M.σ x) ↔ p x) (hα : ∀ x, p (M.α x) ↔ p x) (c : M.D) (hc : p c)
    (hreach : ∀ x, p x → Relation.EqvGen M.Step c x) : (M.restrict p hσ hα).Connected
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ u v, Relation.EqvGen M.Step u v → ∀ (hu : p u) (hv : p v),
      Relation.EqvGen (M.restrict p hσ hα).Step ⟨u, hu⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩ := by
    intro u v h
    induction h with
    | rel u v h =>
      intro hu hv
      refine Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ?_
      rcases h with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr rfl
    | refl => intro _ _; exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
    | symm u v _ ih => intro hu hv; exact (ih hv hu).symm
    | trans u w v huw _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro hu hv
      have hw : p w := (invariant_of_eqvGen p hσ hα huw).1 hu
      exact (ih₁ hu hw).trans _ _ _ (ih₂ hw hv)
  refine connected_of_base _ ⟨c, hc⟩ ?_
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact key c x (hreach x hx) hc hx

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.component_invariant_σ
statement:
theorem component_invariant_σ : ∀ x, Relation.EqvGen M.Step c (M.σ x) ↔
    Relation.EqvGen M.Step c x
proof:
:= fun x =>
  ⟨fun h => h.trans _ _ _ ((Relation.EqvGen.rel x (M.σ x) (Or.inl rfl)).symm _ _),
    fun h => h.trans _ _ _ (Relation.EqvGen.rel x (M.σ x) (Or.inl rfl))⟩

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.component_invariant_α
statement:
theorem component_invariant_α : ∀ x, Relation.EqvGen M.Step c (M.α x) ↔
    Relation.EqvGen M.Step c x
proof:
:= fun x =>
  ⟨fun h => h.trans _ _ _ ((Relation.EqvGen.rel x (M.α x) (Or.inr rfl)).symm _ _),
    fun h => h.trans _ _ _ (Relation.EqvGen.rel x (M.α x) (Or.inr rfl))⟩

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.euler_component_add
statement: theorem euler_component_add : M.euler = (M.component c).euler + (M.componentCompl c).euler
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact euler_restrict_add _ (M.component_invariant_σ c) (M.component_invariant_α c)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.component_connected
statement: theorem component_connected : (M.component c).Connected
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact restrict_connected _ _ _ c (Relation.EqvGen.refl _) fun _ h => h

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.componentCompl_connected
statement:
theorem componentCompl_connected (d : M.D) (hd : ¬ Relation.EqvGen M.Step c d)
    (h : ∀ x, ¬ Relation.EqvGen M.Step c x → Relation.EqvGen M.Step d x) :
    (M.componentCompl c).Connected
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact restrict_connected _ _ _ d hd h

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_sameFace_spherical
statement:
theorem split_sameFace_spherical (hM : M.Connected) (hχ : M.euler = 2) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hσ : M.σ.SameCycle a b) (hφ : M.φ.SameCycle a b) :
    ¬ Relation.EqvGen (M.split a b).Step a b ∧
    (M.split a b).euler = 4 ∧
    (∀ x, Relation.EqvGen (M.split a b).Step a x ∨ Relation.EqvGen (M.split a b).Step b x) ∧
    ((M.split a b).component a).Connected ∧ ((M.split a b).component a).euler = 2 ∧
    ((M.split a b).componentCompl a).Connected ∧ ((M.split a b).componentCompl a).euler = 2
proof:
:= by
  have h4 : (M.split a b).euler = 4 := by rw [split_euler_of_sameCycle_face hab hσ hφ, hχ]; rfl
  have hdis : ¬ Relation.EqvGen (M.split a b).Step a b := by
    intro h
    have := (M.split a b).euler_le_two (split_connected_of_eqvGen hM h)
    omega
  have hreach := split_reach (a := a) (b := b) hM
  have hc1 := (M.split a b).component_connected a
  have hc2 := (M.split a b).componentCompl_connected a b hdis
    fun x hx => (hreach x).resolve_left hx
  have hadd := (M.split a b).euler_component_add a
  have hle1 := ((M.split a b).component a).euler_le_two hc1
  have hle2 := ((M.split a b).componentCompl a).euler_le_two hc2
  refine ⟨hdis, h4, hreach, hc1, ?_, hc2, ?_⟩ <;> omega

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eqvGen_φ
statement: theorem eqvGen_φ (x : M.D) : Relation.EqvGen M.Step x (M.φ x)
proof:
:=
  (Relation.EqvGen.rel x (M.α x) (Or.inr rfl)).trans _ _ _
    (Relation.EqvGen.rel (M.α x) (M.φ x) (Or.inl rfl))

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eqvGen_of_sameCycle_φ
statement:
theorem eqvGen_of_sameCycle_φ {x y : M.D} (h : M.φ.SameCycle x y) :
    Relation.EqvGen M.Step x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h.exists_nat_pow_eq
  clear h
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | succ n ih =>
    refine ih.trans _ _ _ ?_
    rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply]
    exact M.eqvGen_φ _

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_σ
statement: @[simp] theorem split_σ : (M.split a b).σ = swap a b * M.σ
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_α
statement: @[simp] theorem split_α : (M.split a b).α = M.α
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_φ
statement: theorem split_φ : (M.split a b).φ = swap a b * M.φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [φ, split, mul_assoc]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_numEdges
statement: theorem split_numEdges : (M.split a b).numEdges = M.numEdges
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_numVertices
statement:
theorem split_numVertices (hab : a ≠ b) (h : M.σ.SameCycle a b) :
    (M.split a b).numVertices = M.numVertices + 1
proof:
:=
  numOrbits_swap_mul_split hab h

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_numFaces_of_not_sameCycle
statement:
theorem split_numFaces_of_not_sameCycle (h : ¬ M.φ.SameCycle a b) :
    (M.split a b).numFaces + 1 = M.numFaces
proof:
:= by
  unfold numFaces
  rw [split_φ]
  exact (numOrbits_swap_mul h).symm

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_numFaces_of_sameCycle
statement:
theorem split_numFaces_of_sameCycle (hab : a ≠ b) (h : M.φ.SameCycle a b) :
    (M.split a b).numFaces = M.numFaces + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold numFaces
  rw [split_φ]
  exact numOrbits_swap_mul_split hab h

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_euler_of_not_sameCycle_face
statement:
theorem split_euler_of_not_sameCycle_face (hab : a ≠ b) (hσ : M.σ.SameCycle a b)
    (hφ : ¬ M.φ.SameCycle a b) : (M.split a b).euler = M.euler
proof:
:= by
  have hV := split_numVertices hab hσ
  have hE := split_numEdges M a b
  have hF := split_numFaces_of_not_sameCycle hφ
  unfold euler
  omega

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_euler_of_sameCycle_face
statement:
theorem split_euler_of_sameCycle_face (hab : a ≠ b) (hσ : M.σ.SameCycle a b)
    (hφ : M.φ.SameCycle a b) : (M.split a b).euler = M.euler + 2
proof:
:= by
  have hV := split_numVertices hab hσ
  have hE := split_numEdges M a b
  have hF := split_numFaces_of_sameCycle hab hφ
  unfold euler
  omega

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eqvGen_split_join_of_step
statement:
theorem eqvGen_split_join_of_step {x y : M.D} (h : M.Step x y) :
    Relation.EqvGen (fun u v => (M.split a b).Step u v ∨ (u = a ∧ v = b)) x y
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ u v, (M.split a b).Step u v →
      Relation.EqvGen (fun u v => (M.split a b).Step u v ∨ (u = a ∧ v = b)) u v :=
    fun u v huv => Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (Or.inl huv)
  have hab : Relation.EqvGen (fun u v => (M.split a b).Step u v ∨ (u = a ∧ v = b)) a b :=
    Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
  rcases h with rfl | rfl
  · by_cases ha : M.σ x = a
    · rw [ha]
      refine (hs x b (Or.inl ?_)).trans _ _ _ (hab.symm _ _)
      simp [split, ha]
    · by_cases hb : M.σ x = b
      · rw [hb]
        refine (hs x a (Or.inl ?_)).trans _ _ _ hab
        simp [split, hb]
      · exact hs _ _ (Or.inl (by simp [split, swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne ha hb]))
  · exact hs _ _ (Or.inr rfl)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_reach
statement:
theorem split_reach (hM : M.Connected) (x : M.D) :
    Relation.EqvGen (M.split a b).Step a x ∨ Relation.EqvGen (M.split a b).Step b x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : M.D → Prop, ∀ x, T x ↔
      (Relation.EqvGen (M.split a b).Step a x ∨ Relation.EqvGen (M.split a b).Step b x) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
  rw [← hT]
  have key : ∀ u v, Relation.EqvGen (fun u v => (M.split a b).Step u v ∨ (u = a ∧ v = b)) u v →
      (T u ↔ T v) := by
    intro u v h
    induction h with
    | rel u v h =>
      rcases h with h | ⟨hu, hv⟩
      · have e := Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ h
        rw [hT, hT]
        exact ⟨fun h' => h'.imp (·.trans _ _ _ e) (·.trans _ _ _ e),
          fun h' => h'.imp (·.trans _ _ _ (e.symm _ _)) (·.trans _ _ _ (e.symm _ _))⟩
      · rw [hT, hT, hu, hv]
        exact ⟨fun _ => Or.inr (Relation.EqvGen.refl _),
          fun _ => Or.inl (Relation.EqvGen.refl _)⟩
    | refl => exact Iff.rfl
    | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
    | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂
  have hjoin : ∀ u v, Relation.EqvGen M.Step u v →
      Relation.EqvGen (fun u v => (M.split a b).Step u v ∨ (u = a ∧ v = b)) u v := by
    intro u v h
    induction h with
    | rel u v h => exact eqvGen_split_join_of_step h
    | refl => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
    | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
    | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans _ _ _ ih₂
  exact (key a x (hjoin a x (hM a x))).1 ((hT a).2 (Or.inl (Relation.EqvGen.refl _)))

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_connected_of_eqvGen
statement:
theorem split_connected_of_eqvGen (hM : M.Connected)
    (h : Relation.EqvGen (M.split a b).Step a b) : (M.split a b).Connected
proof:
:= by
  refine (M.split a b).connected_of_base a fun x => ?_
  rcases split_reach hM x with hx | hx
  · exact hx
  · exact h.trans _ _ _ hx

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.sameCycle_face_of_split_not_eqvGen
statement:
theorem sameCycle_face_of_split_not_eqvGen (h : ¬ Relation.EqvGen (M.split a b).Step a b) :
    M.φ.SameCycle a b
proof:
:= by
  have h' : ¬ (M.split a b).φ.SameCycle a b := fun hs => h ((M.split a b).eqvGen_of_sameCycle_φ hs)
  have := sameCycle_swap_mul_left_right h'
  rwa [split_φ, swap_mul_swap_mul] at this

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_connected
statement:
theorem split_connected (hM : M.Connected) (hφ : ¬ M.φ.SameCycle a b) :
    (M.split a b).Connected
proof:
:=
  split_connected_of_eqvGen hM (by_contra fun h => hφ (sameCycle_face_of_split_not_eqvGen h))

name: TheoremA.Picture.numOrbits_pos
statement: theorem numOrbits_pos {D : Type*} [Finite D] (π : Perm D) (d : D) : 0 < numOrbits π
proof:
:= by
  unfold numOrbits
  haveI : Nonempty (Quotient (Perm.SameCycle.setoid π)) := ⟨⟦d⟧⟩
  exact Nat.card_pos

name: TheoremA.Picture.two_le_numOrbits
statement:
theorem two_le_numOrbits {D : Type*} [Finite D] (π : Perm D) {d e : D} (h : ¬ π.SameCycle d e) :
    2 ≤ numOrbits π
proof:
:= by
  unfold numOrbits
  haveI : Nontrivial (Quotient (Perm.SameCycle.setoid π)) :=
    ⟨⟨⟦d⟧, ⟦e⟧, fun he => h (Quotient.exact he)⟩⟩
  exact Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.2 this

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.restrict_σ_pow_val
statement:
theorem restrict_σ_pow_val (x : (M.restrict p hσ hα).D) (n : ℕ) :
    (((M.restrict p hσ hα).σ ^ n) x).val = (M.σ ^ n) x.val
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, ← ih]; rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.restrict_sameCycle_iff
statement:
theorem restrict_sameCycle_iff {x y : (M.restrict p hσ hα).D} :
    (M.restrict p hσ hα).σ.SameCycle x y ↔ M.σ.SameCycle x.val y.val
proof:
:=
  Perm.sameCycle_subtypePerm (h := hσ)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.restrict_α_sameCycle_iff
statement:
theorem restrict_α_sameCycle_iff {x y : (M.restrict p hσ hα).D} :
    (M.restrict p hσ hα).α.SameCycle x y ↔ M.α.SameCycle x.val y.val
proof:
:=
  Perm.sameCycle_subtypePerm (h := hα)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.restrict_cycleWord
statement:
theorem restrict_cycleWord {G : Type*} [Monoid G] (f : M.D → G) (x : (M.restrict p hσ hα).D) :
    cycleWord (M.restrict p hσ hα).σ (f ∘ Subtype.val) x = cycleWord M.σ f x.val
proof:
:= by
  unfold cycleWord
  have hmp : minimalPeriod (M.restrict p hσ hα).σ x = minimalPeriod M.σ x.val := by
    refine minimalPeriod_eq_of (minimalPeriod_perm_pos _ _) ?_ ?_
    · exact Subtype.ext (by rw [restrict_σ_pow_val]; exact pow_minimalPeriod_apply _ _)
    · intro k hk hk' h
      exact pow_apply_ne_self_of_lt hk hk' (by rw [← restrict_σ_pow_val, h])
  rw [hmp]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, restrict_σ_pow_val]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.numEdges_restrict_add
statement:
theorem numEdges_restrict_add : M.numEdges = (M.restrict p hσ hα).numEdges +
    (M.restrict (fun x => ¬ p x) (not_invariant_σ p hσ) (not_invariant_α p hα)).numEdges
proof:
:=
  numOrbits_subtypePerm_add M.α p hα

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.numEdges_component_add
statement:
theorem numEdges_component_add :
    M.numEdges = (M.component c).numEdges + (M.componentCompl c).numEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact numEdges_restrict_add _ (M.component_invariant_σ c) (M.component_invariant_α c)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_sameFace_component
statement:
theorem split_sameFace_component (hM : M.Connected) (hχ : M.euler = 2) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hσ : M.σ.SameCycle a b) (hφ : M.φ.SameCycle a b) (c : M.D) :
    ((M.split a b).component c).euler = 2 ∧ ((M.split a b).componentCompl c).Connected ∧
      ((M.split a b).componentCompl c).euler = 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hdis, h4, hreach, -⟩ := split_sameFace_spherical hM hχ hab hσ hφ
  have hc1 := (M.split a b).component_connected c
  have hc2 : ((M.split a b).componentCompl c).Connected := by
    rcases hreach c with hca | hcb
    · refine (M.split a b).componentCompl_connected c b
        (fun h => hdis (hca.trans _ _ _ h)) fun y hy => ?_
      rcases hreach y with hy' | hy'
      · exact absurd ((hca.symm _ _).trans _ _ _ hy') hy
      · exact hy'
    · refine (M.split a b).componentCompl_connected c a
        (fun h => hdis ((hcb.trans _ _ _ h).symm _ _)) fun y hy => ?_
      rcases hreach y with hy' | hy'
      · exact hy'
      · exact absurd ((hcb.symm _ _).trans _ _ _ hy') hy
  have hadd := (M.split a b).euler_component_add c
  have hle1 := ((M.split a b).component c).euler_le_two hc1
  have hle2 := ((M.split a b).componentCompl c).euler_le_two hc2
  refine ⟨?_, hc2, ?_⟩ <;> omega

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.exists_cycleWord_eq_letter
statement:
theorem exists_cycleWord_eq_letter {D : Type*} [Finite D] (π : Perm D) (lab : D → C.Letter)
    (t : V ⊕ T) (x : D) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, (lab ((π ^ n) x)).1 = t) :
    ∃ Q : C.loc t, cycleWord π (C.letterWord ∘ lab) x = C.letterWord ⟨t, Q⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : cycleWord π (C.letterWord ∘ lab) x ∈
      MonoidHom.mrange (Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := C.loc) (i := t)) := by
    unfold cycleWord
    refine Submonoid.list_prod_mem _ fun y hy => ?_
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy
    have hi := h i
    rcases hl : lab ((π ^ i) x) with ⟨k, g⟩
    rw [hl] at hi
    subst hi
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hl]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hmem
  exact ⟨Q, hQ.symm⟩

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.split_type_σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [RawPicture.split_sameCycle_base_iff hint hσ] at hd
  show (R.lab (swap a b (R.M.σ d))).1 = (R.lab d).1
  have hd1 : ∀ e, R.M.σ d = e → R.M.σ.SameCycle d e := fun e he => ⟨1, by simpa using he⟩
  by_cases ha : R.M.σ d = a
  · rw [ha, swap_apply_left]
    exact R.type_eq_of_sameCycle hd ((hd1 a ha).trans hσ)
  · by_cases hb : R.M.σ d = b
    · rw [hb, swap_apply_right]
      exact R.type_eq_of_sameCycle hd ((hd1 b hb).trans hσ.symm)
    · rw [swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne ha hb]
      exact R.type_σ d hd

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.split_local_eq
statement:
theorem split_local_eq (hσ : R.M.σ.SameCycle a b) (hint : ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base a)
    {d : R.M.D} (hd : ¬ (R.M.split a b).σ.SameCycle R.base d)
    (hda : ¬ (R.M.split a b).σ.SameCycle a d) (hdb : ¬ (R.M.split a b).σ.SameCycle b d) :
    cycleWord (R.M.split a b).σ (C.letterWord ∘ R.lab) d = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [RawPicture.split_sameCycle_base_iff hint hσ] at hd
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, (R.M.σ ^ n) d = ((R.M.split a b).σ ^ n) d := by
    intro n
    have := swap_mul_pow_apply_of_not_sameCycle hda hdb n
    rwa [CombMap.split_σ, swap_mul_swap_mul] at this
  rw [cycleWord_congr _ (fun n => (hpow n).symm)]
  exact R.local_eq d hd

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.split_interior_of_not_conn
statement:
theorem split_interior_of_not_conn (hσ : R.M.σ.SameCycle a b)
    (hint : ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base a) {d : R.M.D}
    (hd : ¬ Relation.EqvGen (R.M.split a b).Step R.base d) :
    ¬ (R.M.split a b).σ.SameCycle R.base d ∧ ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base d
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ¬ (R.M.split a b).σ.SameCycle R.base d :=
    fun h => hd ((R.M.split a b).eqvGen_of_sameCycle h)
  exact ⟨h1, by rwa [RawPicture.split_sameCycle_base_iff hint hσ] at h1⟩

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.splitU_splitO
statement:
theorem splitU_splitO : (R.splitU a b = a ∧ R.splitO a b = b) ∨
    (R.splitU a b = b ∧ R.splitO a b = a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold splitU splitO
  split_ifs
  · exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.splitO_conn
statement: theorem splitO_conn : Relation.EqvGen (R.M.split a b).Step R.base (R.splitO a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold splitO
  split_ifs with h
  · exact h
  · rcases CombMap.split_reach (a := a) (b := b) R.connected R.base with h' | h'
    · exact absurd (h'.symm _ _) h
    · exact h'.symm _ _

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.split_not_conn_ab
statement: theorem split_not_conn_ab : ¬ Relation.EqvGen (R.M.split a b).Step a b
proof:
:=
  (CombMap.split_sameFace_spherical R.connected R.spherical hab hσ hφ).1

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.splitU_not_conn
statement: theorem splitU_not_conn : ¬ Relation.EqvGen (R.M.split a b).Step R.base (R.splitU a b)
proof:
:= by
  have hdis := R.split_not_conn_ab hab hσ hφ
  unfold splitU
  split_ifs with h
  · exact fun h' => hdis ((h.symm _ _).trans _ _ _ h')
  · exact h

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.splitU_type_pow
statement:
theorem splitU_type_pow (n : ℕ) :
    (R.lab (((R.M.split a b).σ ^ n) (R.splitU a b))).1 = (R.lab a).1
proof:
:= by
  have hu := R.split_interior_of_not_conn hσ hint (R.splitU_not_conn hab hσ hφ)
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rcases R.splitU_splitO with ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ <;> rw [pow_zero, Perm.one_apply, h]
    exact R.type_eq_of_sameCycle hint hσ
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, R.split_type_σ hσ hint, ih]
    intro h
    exact hu.1 (h.trans (sameCycle_of_pow_eq n rfl).symm)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.splitQ_spec
statement:
theorem splitQ_spec : cycleWord (R.M.split a b).σ (C.letterWord ∘ R.lab) (R.splitU a b) =
    C.letterWord ⟨(R.lab a).1, R.splitQ a b⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h := exists_cycleWord_eq_letter (R.M.split a b).σ R.lab (R.lab a).1 (R.splitU a b)
    (R.splitU_type_pow hab hσ hφ hint)
  unfold splitQ
  rw [dif_pos h]
  exact h.choose_spec

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.split_word_o
statement:
theorem split_word_o : cycleWord (R.M.split a b).σ (C.letterWord ∘ R.lab) (R.splitO a b) =
    (C.letterWord ⟨(R.lab a).1, R.splitQ a b⟩)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hold := CombMap.split_cycleWord (C.letterWord ∘ R.lab) hab hσ
  rw [R.local_eq a hint] at hold
  rw [← R.splitQ_spec hab hσ hφ hint]
  rcases R.splitU_splitO with ⟨hu, ho⟩ | ⟨hu, ho⟩ <;> rw [hu, ho]
  · exact (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hold.symm)
  · exact (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hold.symm)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.split_words_one
statement:
theorem split_words_one (hQ : R.splitQ a b = 1) :
    cycleWord (R.M.split a b).σ (C.letterWord ∘ R.lab) a = 1 ∧
    cycleWord (R.M.split a b).σ (C.letterWord ∘ R.lab) b = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hu := R.splitQ_spec hab hσ hφ hint
  have ho := R.split_word_o hab hσ hφ hint
  rw [hQ] at hu ho
  have h1 : C.letterWord ⟨(R.lab a).1, 1⟩ = 1 := map_one _
  rw [h1] at hu ho
  rw [inv_one] at ho
  rcases R.splitU_splitO with ⟨eu, eo⟩ | ⟨eu, eo⟩ <;> rw [eu] at hu <;> rw [eo] at ho
  · exact ⟨hu, ho⟩
  · exact ⟨ho, hu⟩

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.splitRetain_numEdges
statement:
theorem splitRetain_numEdges (hQ : R.splitQ a b = 1) :
    (R.splitRetain hab hσ hφ hint hQ).M.numEdges =
      ((R.M.split a b).component R.base).numEdges
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.splitRetain_numEdges_lt
statement:
theorem splitRetain_numEdges_lt (hQ : R.splitQ a b = 1) :
    (R.splitRetain hab hσ hφ hint hQ).M.numEdges < R.M.numEdges
proof:
:= by
  rw [splitRetain_numEdges, ← CombMap.split_numEdges R.M a b,
    CombMap.numEdges_component_add (R.M.split a b) R.base]
  have := numOrbits_pos ((R.M.split a b).componentCompl R.base).α
    ⟨R.splitU a b, R.splitU_not_conn hab hσ hφ⟩
  unfold CombMap.numEdges
  omega

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.splitDefect_cap_numEdges
statement:
theorem splitDefect_cap_numEdges :
    (R.splitDefect hab hσ hφ hint).cap.M.numEdges =
      ((R.M.split a b).componentCompl R.base).numEdges + 1
proof:
:=
  (R.splitDefect hab hσ hφ hint).cap_numEdges

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.splitDefect_cap_numEdges_add_one_le
statement:
theorem splitDefect_cap_numEdges_add_one_le
    (hMo : 2 ≤ ((R.M.split a b).component R.base).numEdges) :
    (R.splitDefect hab hσ hφ hint).cap.M.numEdges + 1 ≤ R.M.numEdges
proof:
:= by
  rw [splitDefect_cap_numEdges, ← CombMap.split_numEdges R.M a b,
    CombMap.numEdges_component_add (R.M.split a b) R.base]
  omega

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.sameFace_extract
statement:
theorem sameFace_extract (hMo : 2 ≤ ((R.M.split a b).component R.base).numEdges) :
    (R.splitQ a b = 1 ∧ ∃ R' : C.RawPicture x, R'.M.numEdges < R.M.numEdges) ∨
    (R.splitQ a b ≠ 1 ∧ ∃ R' : C.RawPicture (C.letterWord ⟨(R.lab a).1, R.splitQ a b⟩),
      R'.M.numEdges + 1 ≤ R.M.numEdges)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hQ : R.splitQ a b = 1
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hQ, R.splitRetain hab hσ hφ hint hQ, R.splitRetain_numEdges_lt hab hσ hφ hint hQ⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hQ, (R.splitDefect hab hσ hφ hint).cap,
      R.splitDefect_cap_numEdges_add_one_le hab hσ hφ hint hMo⟩

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.leafEdge_numVertices
statement: theorem leafEdge_numVertices : leafEdge.numVertices = 2
proof:
:=
  numOrbits_eq_of_invariant (N := 1) leafEdge.σ ![0, 1] (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.leafEdge_numEdges
statement: theorem leafEdge_numEdges : leafEdge.numEdges = 1
proof:
:=
  numOrbits_eq_of_invariant (N := 2) leafEdge.α ![0, 0] (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.leafEdge_numFaces
statement: theorem leafEdge_numFaces : leafEdge.numFaces = 1
proof:
:=
  numOrbits_eq_of_invariant (N := 2) leafEdge.φ ![0, 0] (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.leafEdge_connected
statement: theorem leafEdge_connected : leafEdge.Connected
proof:
:=
  leafEdge.connected_of_walks (0 : Fin 2) [[], [false]] (by decide)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_α_inl
statement:
theorem addMarkedLeaf_α_inl (x : M.D) :
    (M.addMarkedLeaf b).α (Sum.inl x) = Sum.inl (M.α x)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_α_z
statement: theorem addMarkedLeaf_α_z : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).α (M.leafZ b) = M.leafM b
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_α_m
statement: theorem addMarkedLeaf_α_m : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).α (M.leafM b) = M.leafZ b
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_σ_apply
statement:
theorem addMarkedLeaf_σ_apply (x : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).D) :
    (M.addMarkedLeaf b).σ x =
      swap (Sum.inl b) (Sum.inr (0 : Fin 2)) (Perm.sumCongr M.σ (1 : Perm (Fin 2)) x)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_σ_pred
statement:
theorem addMarkedLeaf_σ_pred :
    (M.addMarkedLeaf b).σ (Sum.inl (M.σ⁻¹ b)) = M.leafZ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [addMarkedLeaf_σ_apply]; simp [leafZ]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_σ_z
statement: theorem addMarkedLeaf_σ_z : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).σ (M.leafZ b) = Sum.inl b
proof:
:= by
  rw [addMarkedLeaf_σ_apply]; simp [leafZ]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_σ_m
statement: theorem addMarkedLeaf_σ_m : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).σ (M.leafM b) = M.leafM b
proof:
:= by
  rw [addMarkedLeaf_σ_apply]
  simp only [leafM, Perm.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inr, Perm.coe_one, id]
  exact swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne Sum.inr_ne_inl
    (fun h => absurd (Sum.inr_injective h) (show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide))

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_σ_of_ne
statement:
theorem addMarkedLeaf_σ_of_ne {x : M.D} (hx : M.σ x ≠ b) :
    (M.addMarkedLeaf b).σ (Sum.inl x) = Sum.inl (M.σ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [addMarkedLeaf_σ_apply]
  simp only [Perm.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl]
  exact swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (fun h => hx (Sum.inl_injective h)) (by simp)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_φ_apply
statement:
theorem addMarkedLeaf_φ_apply (x : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).D) :
    (M.addMarkedLeaf b).φ x = (M.addMarkedLeaf b).σ ((M.addMarkedLeaf b).α x)
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_φ_r
statement:
theorem addMarkedLeaf_φ_r :
    (M.addMarkedLeaf b).φ (Sum.inl (M.α (M.σ⁻¹ b))) = M.leafZ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [addMarkedLeaf_φ_apply, addMarkedLeaf_α_inl, M.α_α, addMarkedLeaf_σ_pred]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_φ_z
statement: theorem addMarkedLeaf_φ_z : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).φ (M.leafZ b) = M.leafM b
proof:
:= by
  rw [addMarkedLeaf_φ_apply, addMarkedLeaf_α_z, addMarkedLeaf_σ_m]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_φ_m
statement: theorem addMarkedLeaf_φ_m : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).φ (M.leafM b) = Sum.inl b
proof:
:= by
  rw [addMarkedLeaf_φ_apply, addMarkedLeaf_α_m, addMarkedLeaf_σ_z]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_φ_of_ne
statement:
theorem addMarkedLeaf_φ_of_ne {x : M.D} (hx : M.φ x ≠ b) :
    (M.addMarkedLeaf b).φ (Sum.inl x) = Sum.inl (M.φ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [addMarkedLeaf_φ_apply, addMarkedLeaf_α_inl, addMarkedLeaf_σ_of_ne _ _ hx]; rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.φ_eq_iff_eq
statement: theorem φ_eq_iff_eq (x : M.D) : M.φ x = b ↔ x = M.α (M.σ⁻¹ b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    change x = M.α (M.σ⁻¹ (M.σ (M.α x)))
    simp [M.α_α]
  · rintro rfl
    change M.σ (M.α (M.α (M.σ⁻¹ b))) = b
    simp [M.α_α]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_numVertices
statement:
theorem addMarkedLeaf_numVertices :
    (M.addMarkedLeaf b).numVertices = M.numVertices + 1
proof:
:= by
  have := glue_numVertices M leafEdge b (0 : Fin 2)
  rw [leafEdge_numVertices] at this
  change (M.addMarkedLeaf b).numVertices + 1 = _ at this
  omega

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_numEdges
statement: theorem addMarkedLeaf_numEdges : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).numEdges = M.numEdges + 1
proof:
:= by
  have := glue_numEdges M leafEdge b (0 : Fin 2)
  rwa [leafEdge_numEdges] at this

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_numFaces
statement: theorem addMarkedLeaf_numFaces : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).numFaces = M.numFaces
proof:
:= by
  have := glue_numFaces M leafEdge b (0 : Fin 2)
  rw [leafEdge_numFaces] at this
  change (M.addMarkedLeaf b).numFaces + 1 = _ at this
  omega

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_euler
statement: theorem addMarkedLeaf_euler : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).euler = M.euler
proof:
:= by
  have hV := addMarkedLeaf_numVertices M b
  have hE := addMarkedLeaf_numEdges M b
  have hF := addMarkedLeaf_numFaces M b
  unfold euler
  omega

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_connected
statement: theorem addMarkedLeaf_connected (hM : M.Connected) : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).Connected
proof:
:=
  glue_connected _ _ _ _ hM leafEdge_connected

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_sameCycle_m_iff
statement:
theorem addMarkedLeaf_sameCycle_m_iff (x : (M.addMarkedLeaf b).D) :
    (M.addMarkedLeaf b).σ.SameCycle (M.leafM b) x ↔ x = M.leafM b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h.exists_nat_pow_eq
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, ih ⟨n, rfl⟩, addMarkedLeaf_σ_m]
  · rintro rfl; exact Perm.SameCycle.refl _ _

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectPicture.type_pow
statement: theorem type_pow (d : Δ.M.D) (n : ℕ) : (Δ.lab ((Δ.M.σ ^ n) d)).1 = (Δ.lab d).1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, Δ.type_σ, ih]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectPicture.type_eq_of_sameCycle
statement:
theorem type_eq_of_sameCycle {d e : Δ.M.D} (h : Δ.M.σ.SameCycle d e) :
    (Δ.lab e).1 = (Δ.lab d).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h.exists_nat_pow_eq
  exact Δ.type_pow d n

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectPicture.cap_local_b
statement:
theorem cap_local_b : cycleWord (Δ.M.addMarkedLeaf Δ.b).σ (C.letterWord ∘ Δ.capLab)
    (Sum.inl Δ.b) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change cycleWord (swap (Sum.inl Δ.b) (Sum.inr (0 : Fin 2)) *
    Perm.sumCongr Δ.M.σ (1 : Perm (Fin 2))) (C.letterWord ∘ Δ.capLab) (Sum.inl Δ.b) = 1
  rw [cycleWord_swap_mul _ not_sameCycle_sumCongr_inl_inr, cycleWord_sumCongr_inl,
    cycleWord_sumCongr_inr, cycleWord_of_fixed (π := (1 : Perm (Fin 2))) _ (x := 0) rfl]
  change cycleWord Δ.M.σ (C.letterWord ∘ Δ.lab) Δ.b * C.letterWord ⟨s, P⁻¹⟩ = 1
  rw [Δ.defect_word]
  change Monoid.CoprodI.of P * Monoid.CoprodI.of P⁻¹ = 1
  rw [← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectPicture.cap_numEdges
statement: theorem cap_numEdges : Δ.cap.M.numEdges = Δ.M.numEdges + 1
proof:
:=
  CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_numEdges _ _

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectPicture.cap_numVertices_numFaces
statement:
theorem cap_numVertices_numFaces :
    Δ.cap.M.numVertices = Δ.M.numVertices + 1 ∧ Δ.cap.M.numFaces = Δ.M.numFaces
proof:
:=
  ⟨CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_numVertices _ _, CombMap.addMarkedLeaf_numFaces _ _⟩

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.DefectPicture.cap_word_ne_one
statement: theorem cap_word_ne_one (hP : P ≠ 1) : C.letterWord ⟨s, P⟩ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hP (Monoid.CoprodI.of_injective s (h.trans (map_one _).symm))

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.α_retained_iff
statement:
theorem α_retained_iff (a : M.D) (x : M.D) :
    (M.α x ≠ a ∧ M.α x ≠ M.α a) ↔ (x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ M.α a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨fun h => h2 (by rw [h]), fun h => h1 (by rw [h, M.α_α])⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨fun h => h2 (by rw [← h, M.α_α]), fun h => h1 (M.α.injective h)⟩

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.ne_α
statement: theorem ne_α (a : M.D) : a ≠ M.α a
proof: := fun h => M.α_ne a h.symm

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_σ_val
statement:
theorem eraseEdge_σ_val (x : (M.eraseEdge π a).D) :
    ((M.eraseEdge π a).σ x).val = erase2 π a (M.α a) x.val
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_α_val
statement:
theorem eraseEdge_α_val (x : (M.eraseEdge π a).D) :
    ((M.eraseEdge π a).α x).val = M.α x.val
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_numVertices
statement:
theorem eraseEdge_numVertices :
    (M.eraseEdge π a).numVertices + 2 = numOrbits (erase2 π a (M.α a))
proof:
:=
  numOrbits_subtypePerm_fix2 (M.ne_α a) (erase2_apply_left (M.ne_α a)) erase2_apply_right
    (erase2_retained_iff (M.ne_α a))

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_numEdges
statement: theorem eraseEdge_numEdges : (M.eraseEdge π a).numEdges + 1 = M.numEdges
proof:
:= by
  unfold numEdges
  rw [numOrbits_subtypePerm_add M.α (fun x => x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ M.α a) (M.α_retained_iff a)]
  congr 1
  have hmem : ∀ z : {x // ¬ (x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ M.α a)}, z.val = a ∨ z.val = M.α a := by
    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    by_contra h'
    push_neg at h'
    exact hz h'
  rw [numOrbits_eq_of_iff _ (fun _ => ()), Nat.card_unique]
  · intro u; exact ⟨⟨a, by simp⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro z w
    simp only [true_iff]
    rw [Perm.sameCycle_subtypePerm]
    have key : M.α.SameCycle a (M.α a) := ⟨1, by simp⟩
    rcases hmem z with e1 | e1 <;> rcases hmem w with e2 | e2 <;> rw [e1, e2] <;>
      first | exact key | exact key.symm

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_φ_val
statement:
theorem eraseEdge_φ_val (x : (M.eraseEdge π a).D) :
    ((M.eraseEdge π a).φ x).val = erase2 (swap a (M.α a) * π * M.α) a (M.α a) x.val
proof:
:=
  erase2_apply_α M.α_α (M.ne_α a) rfl x.2.1 x.2.2

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_numFaces
statement:
theorem eraseEdge_numFaces :
    (M.eraseEdge π a).numFaces + 2 =
      numOrbits (erase2 (swap a (M.α a) * π * M.α) a (M.α a))
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : (M.eraseEdge π a).φ = (erase2 (swap a (M.α a) * π * M.α) a (M.α a)).subtypePerm
      (p := fun x => x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ M.α a) (erase2_retained_iff (M.ne_α a)) := by
    exact Equiv.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (eraseEdge_φ_val π a x)
  unfold numFaces
  rw [hφ]
  exact numOrbits_subtypePerm_fix2 (M.ne_α a) (erase2_apply_left (M.ne_α a)) erase2_apply_right
    (erase2_retained_iff (M.ne_α a))

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_euler
statement:
theorem eraseEdge_euler :
    (M.eraseEdge π a).euler + 3 = (numOrbits (erase2 π a (M.α a)) : ℤ) - M.numEdges +
      numOrbits (erase2 (swap a (M.α a) * π * M.α) a (M.α a))
proof:
:= by
  have hV := eraseEdge_numVertices π a
  have hE := eraseEdge_numEdges π a
  have hF := eraseEdge_numFaces π a
  unfold euler
  push_cast [← hV, ← hE, ← hF]
  ring

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_sameCycle_iff
statement:
theorem eraseEdge_sameCycle_iff {x y : (M.eraseEdge π a).D} :
    (M.eraseEdge π a).σ.SameCycle x y ↔ π.SameCycle x.val y.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (M.eraseEdge π a).σ.SameCycle x y ↔ (erase2 π a (M.α a)).SameCycle x.val y.val from
    Perm.sameCycle_subtypePerm (h := erase2_retained_iff (M.ne_α a))]
  exact sameCycle_erase2_iff x.2.1 x.2.2 y.2.1 y.2.2

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_cycleWord
statement:
theorem eraseEdge_cycleWord {G : Type*} [Monoid G] (f : M.D → G) (x : (M.eraseEdge π a).D) :
    cycleWord (M.eraseEdge π a).σ (f ∘ Subtype.val) x = cycleWord (erase2 π a (M.α a)) f x.val
proof:
:=
  restrict_cycleWord (M := M.withσ (erase2 π a (M.α a))) _ _ _ f x

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eqvGen_map
statement:
theorem eqvGen_map {r : M.D → M.D → Prop} (g : M.D → M.D)
    (hσ : ∀ y, Relation.EqvGen r (g y) (g (M.σ y)))
    (hα : ∀ y, Relation.EqvGen r (g y) (g (M.α y))) {u v : M.D}
    (h : Relation.EqvGen M.Step u v) : Relation.EqvGen r (g u) (g v)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel u v h =>
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · exact hσ u
    · exact hα u
  | refl => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans _ _ _ ih₂

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_eqvGen
statement:
theorem eraseEdge_eqvGen {u v : M.D}
    (h : Relation.EqvGen (M.withσ (erase2 π a (M.α a))).Step u v)
    (hu : u ≠ a ∧ u ≠ M.α a) (hv : v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ M.α a) :
    Relation.EqvGen (M.eraseEdge π a).Step ⟨u, hu⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hσ := erase2_retained_iff (π := π) (M.ne_α a)
  have hα := M.α_retained_iff a
  induction h with
  | rel u v h =>
    refine Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ?_
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl
  | refl => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | symm u v _ ih => exact (ih hv hu).symm
  | trans u w v huw _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    have hw : w ≠ a ∧ w ≠ M.α a :=
      (invariant_of_eqvGen (M := M.withσ (erase2 π a (M.α a))) (fun x => x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ M.α a)
        hσ hα huw).1 hu
    exact (ih₁ hu hw).trans _ _ _ (ih₂ hw hv)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.eraseEdge_connected_of
statement:
theorem eraseEdge_connected_of (hM : M.Connected) (g : M.D → M.D) (hgid : ∀ y, y ≠ a → y ≠ M.α a → g y = y)
    (hσ : ∀ y, Relation.EqvGen (M.withσ (erase2 π a (M.α a))).Step (g y) (g (M.σ y)))
    (hα : ∀ y, Relation.EqvGen (M.withσ (erase2 π a (M.α a))).Step (g y) (g (M.α y))) :
    (M.eraseEdge π a).Connected
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  have hx := eqvGen_map g hσ hα (hM x.val y.val)
  rw [hgid _ x.2.1 x.2.2, hgid _ y.2.1 y.2.2] at hx
  exact eraseEdge_eqvGen π a hx x.2 y.2

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.withσ_eqvGen_of_sameCycle
statement:
theorem withσ_eqvGen_of_sameCycle {σ' : Perm M.D} {x y : M.D} (h : σ'.SameCycle x y) :
    Relation.EqvGen (M.withσ σ').Step x y
proof:
:=
  (M.withσ σ').eqvGen_of_sameCycle h

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.withσ_eqvGen_α
statement:
theorem withσ_eqvGen_α {σ' : Perm M.D} (x : M.D) :
    Relation.EqvGen (M.withσ σ').Step x (M.α x)
proof:
:=
  Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (Or.inr rfl)

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.numEdges_component_of_connected
statement:
theorem numEdges_component_of_connected (N : CombMap) (hN : N.Connected) (c : N.D) :
    (N.component c).numEdges = N.numEdges
proof:
:= by
  have h := N.numEdges_component_add c
  have h0 : (N.componentCompl c).numEdges = 0 := by
    haveI : IsEmpty (N.componentCompl c).D := ⟨fun x => x.2 (hN c x.1)⟩
    unfold numEdges numOrbits
    simp
  omega

name: TheoremA.Picture.cycleWord_eq_one_of_sameCycle
statement:
theorem cycleWord_eq_one_of_sameCycle [Group G] {π : Perm D} (f : D → G) {x y : D}
    (hxy : π.SameCycle x y) (h : cycleWord π f x = 1) : cycleWord π f y = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hxy.exists_nat_pow_eq
  clear hxy
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using h
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, cycleWord_apply, ih]; group

name: TheoremA.Picture.cycleWord_of_fixed
statement:
theorem cycleWord_of_fixed [Monoid G] {π : Perm D} (f : D → G) {x : D} (hx : π x = x) :
    cycleWord π f x = f x
proof:
:= by
  have : minimalPeriod π x = 1 :=
    minimalPeriod_eq_of (by norm_num) (by simpa using hx) (fun k hk hk' => by omega)
  simp [cycleWord, this]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_cycleWord
statement:
theorem split_cycleWord [Monoid G] (f : M.D → G) (hab : a ≠ b) (hσ : M.σ.SameCycle a b) :
    cycleWord M.σ f a = cycleWord (M.split a b).σ f a * cycleWord (M.split a b).σ f b
proof:
:=
  cycleWord_swap_mul_split f hab hσ

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_cycleWord_eq_inv
statement:
theorem split_cycleWord_eq_inv [Group G] (f : M.D → G) (hab : a ≠ b) (hσ : M.σ.SameCycle a b)
    (h : cycleWord M.σ f a = 1) :
    cycleWord (M.split a b).σ f b = (cycleWord (M.split a b).σ f a)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [split_cycleWord f hab hσ] at h
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_cycleWord_right_eq_one
statement:
theorem split_cycleWord_right_eq_one [Group G] (f : M.D → G) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hσ : M.σ.SameCycle a b) (h : cycleWord M.σ f a = 1)
    (hP : cycleWord (M.split a b).σ f a = 1) : cycleWord (M.split a b).σ f b = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [split_cycleWord_eq_inv f hab hσ h, hP, inv_one]

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_cycleWord_right_eq
statement:
theorem split_cycleWord_right_eq [Monoid G] (f : M.D → G) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hσ : M.σ.SameCycle a b) {x : G} (h : cycleWord M.σ f a = x)
    (hP : cycleWord (M.split a b).σ f a = 1) : cycleWord (M.split a b).σ f b = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [split_cycleWord f hab hσ, hP, one_mul] at h
  exact h

name: TheoremA.Picture.CombMap.split_labels_obstruction
statement:
theorem split_labels_obstruction :
    ∃ (M : CombMap) (a b : M.D) (f : M.D → Multiplicative (ZMod 2)),
      a ≠ b ∧ M.σ.SameCycle a b ∧ cycleWord M.σ f a = 1 ∧
      cycleWord (M.split a b).σ f a ≠ 1 ∧ cycleWord (M.split a b).σ f b ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨digon, (0 : Fin 4), (3 : Fin 4), fun _ => Multiplicative.ofAdd 1, show (0 : Fin 4) ≠ 3 by decide,
    ⟨1, by decide⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [cycleWord_of_apply_apply _ _ _ (by decide) (by decide)]
    decide
  · rw [cycleWord_of_fixed _ (by decide)]
    decide
  · rw [cycleWord_of_fixed _ (by decide)]
    decide

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.type_pow
statement:
theorem RawPicture.type_pow {d : P.M.D} (hd : ¬ P.M.σ.SameCycle P.base d) (n : ℕ) :
    (P.lab ((P.M.σ ^ n) d)).1 = (P.lab d).1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Perm.mul_apply, P.type_σ _ (fun h => hd (h.trans
      (sameCycle_of_pow_eq n rfl).symm)), ih]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.type_eq_of_sameCycle
statement:
theorem RawPicture.type_eq_of_sameCycle {d e : P.M.D} (hd : ¬ P.M.σ.SameCycle P.base d)
    (hde : P.M.σ.SameCycle d e) : (P.lab e).1 = (P.lab d).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hde.exists_nat_pow_eq
  exact P.type_pow hd n

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.split_pow_of_not
statement:
theorem RawPicture.split_pow_of_not {d : P.M.D} (hda : ¬ P.M.σ.SameCycle a d)
    (hdb : ¬ P.M.σ.SameCycle b d) (n : ℕ) :
    (((P.M.split a b).σ) ^ n) d = (P.M.σ ^ n) d
proof:
:=
  swap_mul_pow_apply_of_not_sameCycle hda hdb n

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.split_sameCycle_base_iff
statement:
theorem RawPicture.split_sameCycle_base_iff (hint : ¬ P.M.σ.SameCycle P.base a)
    (hσ : P.M.σ.SameCycle a b) {d : P.M.D} :
    (P.M.split a b).σ.SameCycle P.base d ↔ P.M.σ.SameCycle P.base d
proof:
:= by
  have ha : ¬ P.M.σ.SameCycle a P.base := fun h => hint h.symm
  have hb : ¬ P.M.σ.SameCycle b P.base := fun h => hint (h.symm.trans hσ.symm)
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h.exists_nat_pow_eq
    rw [RawPicture.split_pow_of_not ha hb n]
    exact sameCycle_of_pow_eq n rfl
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h.exists_nat_pow_eq
    rw [← RawPicture.split_pow_of_not ha hb n]
    exact sameCycle_of_pow_eq n rfl

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.α_e
statement: theorem α_e : R.M.α P.e = P.v
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.α_v
statement: theorem α_v : R.M.α P.v = P.e
proof: := R.M.α_α _

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.α_d
statement: theorem α_d : R.M.α P.d = P.u
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.α_u
statement: theorem α_u : R.M.α P.u = P.d
proof: := R.M.α_α _

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.marked_e
statement: theorem marked_e : R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base P.e
proof:
:=
  P.marked.trans ⟨1, by simpa using P.next⟩

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.not_marked_u
statement: theorem not_marked_u : ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base P.u
proof: := (R.edge_boundary P.d P.marked).1

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.not_marked_v
statement: theorem not_marked_v : ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base P.v
proof: := (R.edge_boundary P.e P.marked_e).1

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.d_ne_u
statement: theorem d_ne_u : P.d ≠ P.u
proof: := fun h => P.not_marked_u (h ▸ P.marked)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.d_ne_v
statement: theorem d_ne_v : P.d ≠ P.v
proof: := fun h => P.not_marked_v (h ▸ P.marked)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.e_ne_u
statement: theorem e_ne_u : P.e ≠ P.u
proof: := fun h => P.not_marked_u (h ▸ P.marked_e)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.e_ne_v
statement: theorem e_ne_v : P.e ≠ P.v
proof: := fun h => P.not_marked_v (h ▸ P.marked_e)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.u_ne_v
statement: theorem u_ne_v : P.u ≠ P.v
proof: := fun h => P.ne (R.M.α.injective h)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.ne_α_e
statement: theorem ne_α_e : P.e ≠ R.M.α P.e
proof: := P.e_ne_v

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.base_ne_u
statement: theorem base_ne_u : R.base ≠ P.u
proof: := fun h => P.not_marked_u (h ▸ Perm.SameCycle.refl _ _)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.base_ne_v
statement: theorem base_ne_v : R.base ≠ P.v
proof: := fun h => P.not_marked_v (h ▸ Perm.SameCycle.refl _ _)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.not_marked_of_u
statement:
theorem not_marked_of_u {z : R.M.D} (hz : R.M.σ.SameCycle P.u z) :
    ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base z
proof: := fun h => P.not_marked_u (h.trans hz.symm)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.not_marked_of_v
statement:
theorem not_marked_of_v {z : R.M.D} (hz : R.M.σ.SameCycle P.v z) :
    ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base z
proof: := fun h => P.not_marked_v (h.trans hz.symm)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.σe_ne_e
statement: theorem σe_ne_e : R.M.σ P.e ≠ P.e
proof: := fun h => P.ne (R.M.σ.injective (P.next.trans h.symm))

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.marked_σ
statement:
theorem marked_σ {z : R.M.D} (hz : R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base z) :
    R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base (R.M.σ z)
proof: := hz.trans ⟨1, by simp⟩

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.lab_u
statement: theorem lab_u : R.lab P.u = ⟨P.k, P.g₁⁻¹⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [u, (R.edge_boundary P.d P.marked).2, P.lab_d]; rfl

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.lab_v
statement: theorem lab_v : R.lab P.v = ⟨P.k, P.g₂⁻¹⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [v, (R.edge_boundary P.e P.marked_e).2, P.lab_e]; rfl

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.lab'_d
statement: theorem lab'_d : P.lab' P.d = ⟨P.k, P.g₁ * P.g₂⟩
proof: := by simp [lab']

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.lab'_u
statement: theorem lab'_u : P.lab' P.u = ⟨P.k, (P.g₁ * P.g₂)⁻¹⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [lab', P.d_ne_u.symm]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.lab'_e
statement: theorem lab'_e : P.lab' P.e = ⟨P.k, 1⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [lab', P.ne.symm, P.e_ne_u]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.lab'_v
statement: theorem lab'_v : P.lab' P.v = ⟨P.k, 1⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [lab', P.d_ne_v.symm, P.u_ne_v.symm]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.lab'_of_ne
statement:
theorem lab'_of_ne {z : R.M.D} (h1 : z ≠ P.d) (h2 : z ≠ P.u) (h3 : z ≠ P.e) (h4 : z ≠ P.v) :
    P.lab' z = R.lab z
proof:
:= by
  simp [lab', h1, h2, h3, h4]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.lab'_fst
statement: theorem lab'_fst (z : R.M.D) : (P.lab' z).1 = (R.lab z).1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h1 : z = P.d
  · rw [h1, lab'_d, P.lab_d]
  by_cases h2 : z = P.u
  · rw [h2, lab'_u, P.lab_u]
  by_cases h3 : z = P.e
  · rw [h3, lab'_e, P.lab_e]
  by_cases h4 : z = P.v
  · rw [h4, lab'_v, P.lab_v]
  rw [P.lab'_of_ne h1 h2 h3 h4]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.word_e
statement: theorem word_e : C.letterWord (P.lab' P.e) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lab'_e]; exact map_one _

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.word_v
statement: theorem word_v : C.letterWord (P.lab' P.v) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lab'_v]; exact map_one _

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.cycleWord_lab'_base
statement:
theorem cycleWord_lab'_base :
    cycleWord R.M.σ (C.letterWord ∘ P.lab') R.base = x
proof:
:= by
  refine Eq.trans ?_ R.boundary_word
  refine cycleWord_merge_consecutive (d := P.d) (by rw [P.next]; exact P.ne.symm)
    P.marked.symm (by rw [P.next]; exact P.ne_base.symm) (fun y hy hyd hye => ?_) ?_
  · rw [P.next] at hye
    have hym : R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base y := P.marked.trans hy
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [P.lab'_of_ne hyd (fun h => P.not_marked_u (h ▸ hym)) hye
      (fun h => P.not_marked_v (h ▸ hym))]
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply, P.next]
    rw [P.lab'_d, P.lab'_e, P.lab_d, P.lab_e]
    simp [letterWord, map_mul]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.edge_boundary_lab'
statement:
theorem edge_boundary_lab' {z : R.M.D} (hz : R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base z) (hze : z ≠ P.e) :
    ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base (R.M.α z) ∧ P.lab' (R.M.α z) = (P.lab' z).inv
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(R.edge_boundary z hz).1, ?_⟩
  by_cases hzd : z = P.d
  · rw [hzd, α_d, lab'_u, lab'_d]; rfl
  have hzu : z ≠ P.u := fun h => P.not_marked_u (h ▸ hz)
  have hzv : z ≠ P.v := fun h => P.not_marked_v (h ▸ hz)
  have h1 : R.M.α z ≠ P.d := fun h => hzu (by rw [← R.M.α_α z, h]; rfl)
  have h2 : R.M.α z ≠ P.u := fun h => hzd (R.M.α.injective h)
  have h3 : R.M.α z ≠ P.e := fun h => hzv (by rw [← R.M.α_α z, h]; rfl)
  have h4 : R.M.α z ≠ P.v := fun h => hze (R.M.α.injective h)
  rw [P.lab'_of_ne h1 h2 h3 h4, P.lab'_of_ne hzd hzu hze hzv]
  exact (R.edge_boundary z hz).2

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.edge_interior_lab'
statement:
theorem edge_interior_lab' {z : R.M.D} (hz : ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base z)
    (hz' : ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base (R.M.α z)) :
    C.RelEdge (P.lab' z) (P.lab' (R.M.α z)) ∨ C.RelEdge (P.lab' (R.M.α z)) (P.lab' z)
proof:
:= by
  have hzd : z ≠ P.d := fun h => hz (h ▸ P.marked)
  have hze : z ≠ P.e := fun h => hz (h ▸ P.marked_e)
  have hzu : z ≠ P.u := fun h => hz' (by rw [h, α_u]; exact P.marked)
  have hzv : z ≠ P.v := fun h => hz' (by rw [h, α_v]; exact P.marked_e)
  have h1 : R.M.α z ≠ P.d := fun h => hz' (h ▸ P.marked)
  have h2 : R.M.α z ≠ P.u := fun h => hzd (R.M.α.injective h)
  have h3 : R.M.α z ≠ P.e := fun h => hz' (h ▸ P.marked_e)
  have h4 : R.M.α z ≠ P.v := fun h => hze (R.M.α.injective h)
  rw [P.lab'_of_ne h1 h2 h3 h4, P.lab'_of_ne hzd hzu hze hzv]
  exact R.edge_interior z hz hz'

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.type_of_u
statement: theorem type_of_u {z : R.M.D} (hz : R.M.σ.SameCycle P.u z) : (R.lab z).1 = P.k
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.type_eq_of_sameCycle P.not_marked_u hz, P.lab_u]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.type_of_v
statement: theorem type_of_v {z : R.M.D} (hz : R.M.σ.SameCycle P.v z) : (R.lab z).1 = P.k
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.type_eq_of_sameCycle P.not_marked_v hz, P.lab_v]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.cycleWord_lab'_u
statement:
theorem cycleWord_lab'_u (hv : ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle P.u P.v) :
    cycleWord R.M.σ (C.letterWord ∘ P.lab') P.u =
      C.letterWord (P.lab' P.u) * (C.letterWord (R.lab P.u))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycleWord_update_first (f := C.letterWord ∘ R.lab) R.M.σ, R.local_eq _ P.not_marked_u,
    mul_one]
  · rfl
  intro y hy hyu
  have hyd : y ≠ P.d := fun h => P.not_marked_of_u hy (h ▸ P.marked)
  have hye : y ≠ P.e := fun h => P.not_marked_of_u hy (h ▸ P.marked_e)
  have hyv : y ≠ P.v := fun h => hv (h ▸ hy)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [P.lab'_of_ne hyd hyu hye hyv]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.cycleWord_lab'_v
statement:
theorem cycleWord_lab'_v (hv : ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle P.u P.v) :
    cycleWord R.M.σ (C.letterWord ∘ P.lab') P.v =
      C.letterWord (P.lab' P.v) * (C.letterWord (R.lab P.v))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycleWord_update_first (f := C.letterWord ∘ R.lab) R.M.σ, R.local_eq _ P.not_marked_v,
    mul_one]
  · rfl
  intro y hy hyv
  have hyd : y ≠ P.d := fun h => P.not_marked_of_v hy (h ▸ P.marked)
  have hye : y ≠ P.e := fun h => P.not_marked_of_v hy (h ▸ P.marked_e)
  have hyu : y ≠ P.u := fun h => hv (h ▸ hy).symm
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [P.lab'_of_ne hyd hyu hye hyv]

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.lab'_eq_of_not
statement:
theorem lab'_eq_of_not {z y : R.M.D} (hz : ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base z)
    (hu : ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle P.u z) (hv : ¬ R.M.σ.SameCycle P.v z) (hy : R.M.σ.SameCycle z y) :
    P.lab' y = R.lab y
proof:
:= by
  refine P.lab'_of_ne ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact fun h => hz ((h ▸ P.marked).trans hy.symm)
  · exact fun h => hu (h ▸ hy.symm)
  · exact fun h => hz ((h ▸ P.marked_e).trans hy.symm)
  · exact fun h => hv (h ▸ hy.symm)

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.πA_sameCycle_iff
statement:
theorem πA_sameCycle_iff {y z : R.M.D} :
    P.πA.SameCycle y z ↔ R.M.σ.SameCycle y z ∨
      ((R.M.σ.SameCycle P.u y ∨ R.M.σ.SameCycle P.v y) ∧
        (R.M.σ.SameCycle P.u z ∨ R.M.σ.SameCycle P.v z))
proof:
:=
  sameCycle_swap_mul_iff hdist

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.πA_marked_iff
statement:
theorem πA_marked_iff {z : R.M.D} :
    P.πA.SameCycle R.base z ↔ R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base z
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.πA_sameCycle_iff hdist]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨h | h, -⟩)
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h.symm P.not_marked_u
    · exact absurd h.symm P.not_marked_v
  · exact Or.inl

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.πA_apply_of_marked
statement:
theorem πA_apply_of_marked {z : R.M.D} (hz : R.M.σ.SameCycle R.base z) :
    P.πA z = R.M.σ z
proof:
:= by
  have h := marked_σ hz
  exact swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (fun e => P.not_marked_u (e ▸ h)) (fun e => P.not_marked_v (e ▸ h))

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.πA_v_ne
statement: theorem πA_v_ne : P.πA P.v ≠ P.e ∧ P.πA P.v ≠ P.v
proof:
:= by
  change swap P.u P.v (R.M.σ P.v) ≠ P.e ∧ swap P.u P.v (R.M.σ P.v) ≠ P.v
  by_cases hσv : R.M.σ P.v = P.v
  · rw [hσv, swap_apply_right]
    exact ⟨P.e_ne_u.symm, P.u_ne_v⟩
  · have h1 : R.M.σ P.v ≠ P.u := fun h => hdist (Perm.SameCycle.symm
      (show R.M.σ.SameCycle P.v P.u from ⟨1, by simpa using h⟩))
    rw [swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h1 hσv]
    refine ⟨fun h => P.not_marked_of_v (⟨1, by simpa using h⟩ : R.M.σ.SameCycle P.v P.e)
      P.marked_e, hσv⟩

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.σA_sameCycle_iff
statement:
theorem σA_sameCycle_iff {y z : R.M.D} (hy : y ≠ P.e ∧ y ≠ P.v) (hz : z ≠ P.e ∧ z ≠ P.v) :
    (P.σA).SameCycle y z ↔ P.πA.SameCycle y z
proof:
:=
  sameCycle_erase2_iff hy.1 hy.2 hz.1 hz.2

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.cycleWord_σA_u
statement: theorem cycleWord_σA_u : cycleWord P.σA (C.letterWord ∘ P.lab') P.u = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycleWord_erase2 (b := R.M.α P.e) _ P.e_ne_u.symm P.u_ne_v P.word_e P.word_v]
  change cycleWord (swap P.u P.v * R.M.σ) _ P.u = 1
  rw [cycleWord_swap_mul _ hdist, P.cycleWord_lab'_u hdist, P.cycleWord_lab'_v hdist, P.lab'_u,
    P.lab'_v, P.lab_u, P.lab_v]
  simp only [letterWord, map_inv, map_mul, map_one]
  group

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.consolidatePre_M
statement: theorem consolidatePre_M : (P.consolidatePre hdist).M = R.M.eraseEdge P.πA P.e
proof: := rfl

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.consolidate_numVertices
statement:
theorem consolidate_numVertices :
    (R.M.eraseEdge P.πA P.e).numVertices + 1 = R.M.numVertices
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := CombMap.eraseEdge_numVertices P.πA P.e
  have h2 := numOrbits_erase2 P.πA P.e (R.M.α P.e)
  have h3 : numOrbits R.M.σ = numOrbits P.πA + 1 := numOrbits_swap_mul hdist
  have h4 : P.πA P.e ≠ P.e := by rw [P.πA_apply_of_marked P.marked_e]; exact P.σe_ne_e
  have h5 : erasePt P.πA P.e (R.M.α P.e) ≠ R.M.α P.e := by
    change erasePt P.πA P.e P.v ≠ P.v
    rw [erasePt_apply_of_ne P.e_ne_v.symm (P.πA_v_ne hdist).1]
    exact (P.πA_v_ne hdist).2
  rw [if_neg h4, if_neg h5] at h2
  unfold CombMap.numVertices at *
  omega

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.consolidate_numEdges'
statement: theorem consolidate_numEdges' : (R.M.eraseEdge P.πA P.e).numEdges + 1 = R.M.numEdges
proof:
:=
  CombMap.eraseEdge_numEdges _ _

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.swap_identity
statement:
theorem swap_identity :
    swap P.e P.v * swap P.u P.v = swap P.u P.v * swap P.e P.u
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := P.e_ne_u
  have h2 := P.e_ne_v
  have h3 := P.u_ne_v
  ext z
  simp only [Perm.mul_apply, swap_apply_def]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.consolidate_numFaces
statement:
theorem consolidate_numFaces :
    (R.M.eraseEdge P.πA P.e).numFaces = R.M.numFaces
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := CombMap.eraseEdge_numFaces P.πA P.e
  have hφu : R.M.φ P.u = P.e := by
    change R.M.σ (R.M.α P.u) = P.e
    rw [α_u, P.next]
  have hχ : numOrbits (swap P.e (R.M.α P.e) * P.πA * R.M.α) = R.M.numFaces := by
    have e1 : swap P.e (R.M.α P.e) * P.πA * R.M.α =
        swap P.u P.v * (swap P.e P.u * R.M.φ) := by
      change swap P.e P.v * (swap P.u P.v * R.M.σ) * R.M.α = _
      rw [← mul_assoc, P.swap_identity]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
      rfl
    have e2 : numOrbits (swap P.e P.u * R.M.φ) = numOrbits R.M.φ + 1 :=
      numOrbits_swap_mul_split P.e_ne_u
        (Perm.SameCycle.symm (show R.M.φ.SameCycle P.u P.e from ⟨1, by simpa using hφu⟩))
    have hfix : (swap P.e P.u * R.M.φ) P.u = P.u := by
      rw [Perm.mul_apply, hφu, swap_apply_left]
    have e3 := numOrbits_swap_mul (π := swap P.e P.u * R.M.φ) (a := P.u) (b := P.v)
      (fun h => P.u_ne_v (h.eq_of_left hfix))
    rw [e1]
    unfold CombMap.numFaces
    omega
  have hχe : (swap P.e (R.M.α P.e) * P.πA * R.M.α) P.e = P.πA P.v := by
    change swap P.e P.v (P.πA (R.M.α P.e)) = _
    exact swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (P.πA_v_ne hdist).1 (P.πA_v_ne hdist).2
  have hχv : (swap P.e (R.M.α P.e) * P.πA * R.M.α) (R.M.α P.e) = R.M.σ P.e := by
    change swap P.e P.v (P.πA (R.M.α P.v)) = _
    rw [α_v, P.πA_apply_of_marked P.marked_e]
    exact swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne P.σe_ne_e
      (fun h => P.not_marked_v (h ▸ marked_σ P.marked_e))
  have h2 := numOrbits_erase2 (Equiv.swap P.e (R.M.α P.e) * P.πA * R.M.α) P.e (R.M.α P.e)
  have h4 : (swap P.e (R.M.α P.e) * P.πA * R.M.α) P.e ≠ P.e := by
    rw [hχe]; exact (P.πA_v_ne hdist).1
  have h5 : erasePt (swap P.e (R.M.α P.e) * P.πA * R.M.α) P.e (R.M.α P.e) ≠ R.M.α P.e := by
    rw [erasePt_apply_of_ne (x := R.M.α P.e) P.e_ne_v.symm (by rw [hχv]; exact P.σe_ne_e), hχv]
    exact fun h => P.not_marked_v (by rw [v, ← h]; exact marked_σ P.marked_e)
  rw [if_neg h4, if_neg h5, hχ] at h2
  omega

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.consolidate_euler
statement: theorem consolidate_euler : (R.M.eraseEdge P.πA P.e).euler = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hV := P.consolidate_numVertices hdist
  have hE := P.consolidate_numEdges'
  have hF := P.consolidate_numFaces hdist
  have h := R.spherical
  unfold CombMap.euler at h ⊢
  omega

name: TheoremA.ConeComplex.RawPicture.MarkedPair.consolidate_connected
statement: theorem consolidate_connected : (R.M.eraseEdge P.πA P.e).Connected
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hSC : ∀ y z, (y ≠ P.e ∧ y ≠ P.v) → (z ≠ P.e ∧ z ≠ P.v) → P.πA.SameCycle y z →
      Relation.EqvGen (R.M.withσ P.σA).Step y z := fun y z hy hz h =>
    CombMap.withσ_eqvGen_of_sameCycle ((P.σA_sameCycle_iff hy hz).2 h)
  have hσ1 : ∀ y, R.M.σ.SameCycle y (R.M.σ y) := fun y => ⟨1, by simp⟩
  have hσe1 : R.M.σ P.e ≠ P.v := fun h => P.not_marked_v (h ▸ marked_σ P.marked_e)
  refine CombMap.eraseEdge_connected_of P.πA P.e R.connected
    (fun z => if z = P.e then P.d else if z = P.v then P.u else z)
    (fun y hy1 hy2 => by simp only [if_neg hy1, if_neg (show y ≠ P.v from hy2)]) ?_ ?_
  · intro y
    by_cases hye : y = P.e
    · subst hye
      simp only [if_neg P.σe_ne_e, if_neg hσe1]
      refine hSC _ _ ⟨P.ne, P.d_ne_v⟩ ⟨P.σe_ne_e, hσe1⟩ ((P.πA_sameCycle_iff hdist).2 (Or.inl ?_))
      exact (show R.M.σ.SameCycle P.d P.e from ⟨1, by simpa using P.next⟩).trans (hσ1 _)
    by_cases hyv : y = P.v
    · subst hyv
      simp only [if_neg P.e_ne_v.symm]
      by_cases hσv : R.M.σ P.v = P.v
      · rw [hσv]; simp only [if_neg P.e_ne_v.symm]; exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
      have hσve : R.M.σ P.v ≠ P.e := fun h =>
        P.not_marked_of_v (show R.M.σ.SameCycle P.v P.e from ⟨1, by simpa using h⟩) P.marked_e
      simp only [if_neg hσve, if_neg hσv]
      exact hSC _ _ ⟨P.e_ne_u.symm, P.u_ne_v⟩ ⟨hσve, hσv⟩ ((P.πA_sameCycle_iff hdist).2
        (Or.inr ⟨Or.inl (Perm.SameCycle.refl _ _), Or.inr (hσ1 _)⟩))
    simp only [if_neg hye, if_neg hyv]
    by_cases h1 : R.M.σ y = P.e
    · have : y = P.d := R.M.σ.injective (h1.trans P.next.symm)
      rw [h1, if_pos rfl, this]
      exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
    by_cases h2 : R.M.σ y = P.v
    · rw [h2, if_neg P.e_ne_v.symm, if_pos rfl]
      exact hSC _ _ ⟨hye, hyv⟩ ⟨P.e_ne_u.symm, P.u_ne_v⟩ ((P.πA_sameCycle_iff hdist).2
        (Or.inr ⟨Or.inr (Perm.SameCycle.symm (show R.M.σ.SameCycle y P.v from
          ⟨1, by simpa using h2⟩)), Or.inl (Perm.SameCycle.refl _ _)⟩))
    simp only [if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
    exact hSC _ _ ⟨hye, hyv⟩ ⟨h1, h2⟩ ((P.πA_sameCycle_iff hdist).2 (Or.inl (hσ1 _)))
  · intro y
    by_cases hye : y = P.e
    · subst hye
      rw [α_e]
      simp only [if_neg P.e_ne_v.symm]
      exact CombMap.withσ_eqvGen_α P.d
    by_cases hyv : y = P.v
    · subst hyv
      rw [α_v]
      simp only [if_neg P.e_ne_v.symm]
      exact (CombMap.withσ_eqvGen_α (σ' := P.σA) P.d).symm _ _
    have h1 : R.M.α y ≠ P.e := fun h => hyv (by rw [← R.M.α_α y, h]; rfl)
    have h2 : R.M.α y ≠ P.v := fun h => hye (R.M.α.injective h)
    simp only [if_neg hye, if_neg hyv, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
    exact CombMap.withσ_eqvGen_α y

statement:
theorem σB_sameCycle_iff {y z : R.M.D} (hy : y ≠ P.e ∧ y ≠ P.v) (hz : z ≠ P.e ∧ z ≠ P.v) :
